model_requirements.description: Clinical Trials is a specialized industry that designs, manages, and monitors clinical research studies for pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors, providing data analytics, regulatory expertise, and patient recruitment to accelerate drug development.

model.name: Clinical Trials
model.description: Clinical Trials is a specialized industry that designs, manages, and monitors clinical research studies for pharmaceutical and biotech sponsors, providing data analytics, regulatory expertise, and patient recruitment to accelerate drug development.

domains.name: study
domains.description: Core operational domain managing clinical study protocols, design, phases, objectives, endpoints, inclusion/exclusion criteria, visit schedules, and study lifecycle from protocol development through database lock. Serves as the foundational blueprint for all trial activities and the authoritative source for study identifiers, timelines, amendments, and study-specific procedures.
domains.references: ICH GCP E6(R3); CDISC Protocol Representation Model

products.name: protocol
products.description: Master record for the clinical study protocol including all formal amendments (version history). Captures protocol number, version, title, phase, therapeutic area, indication, investigational product, study design parameters (allocation method, intervention model, masking details, primary purpose, number of arms, adaptive design flags), primary/secondary objectives summary, study population description, planned sample size, study duration, sponsor reference, IND/CTA number, protocol status (draft, approved, amended, final), amendment history (amendment number, date, type, rationale, regulatory submission status, IRB/IEC notification, impact assessment), and GCP/ICH compliance declarations. SSOT for protocol identity, design parameters, and amendment lifecycle. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Veeva Vault.
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Protocol

attributes.name: protocol_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the clinical study protocol record in the lakehouse. Primary key for the protocol data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Every protocol is conducted under an IND. This link is required for annual IND report generation, clinical hold management, and safety reporting obligation tracking. ind_cta_number is a denormalized t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: indication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.indication. Business justification: Protocol has indication as free text. Linking to the canonical indication product ensures MedDRA coding consistency, supports regulatory dossier assembly by indication, and enables cross-protocol indi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that owns and funds the clinical study. Links to the sponsor master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: sponsor_regulatory_strategy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.regulatory_strategy. Business justification: Protocols are developed in alignment with the sponsor's regulatory strategy (submission pathway, health authority requirements, special designations). Protocol design decisions and regulatory submissi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.therapeutic_area. Business justification: Protocol has therapeutic_area as a free-text denormalized column. Linking to the canonical therapeutic_area product enforces MedDRA/CDISC TA coding consistency, enables portfolio reporting by TA, and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method by which participants are assigned to study arms. 'Randomized' indicates use of RTSM/IRT for random assignment; 'non-randomized' indicates assignment by investigator or other non-random method. Drives RTSM configuration in Medidata Rave and Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ClinicalTrials.gov

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol amendment was formally issued or approved. Null for the original protocol version. Used to establish the amendment timeline and regulatory notification deadlines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential identifier for the protocol amendment (e.g., Amendment 1, Amendment 2). Null for the original protocol version. Used to track the amendment history and link to regulatory submission records in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA Variation Regulation

attributes.name: amendment_rationale
attributes.description: Formal justification for the protocol amendment describing the scientific, safety, or operational reasons for the change. Required for regulatory submissions and IRB/IEC notifications. Stored in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the protocol amendment per regulatory definitions. 'Substantial' amendments require prior regulatory authority and IRB/IEC approval before implementation; 'non-substantial' require notification only; 'administrative' are clerical corrections with no impact on study conduct or subject safety.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; MHRA Clinical Trials Regulations

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol version received final sponsor and/or regulatory/IRB/IEC approval, making it the operative protocol for study conduct. Tracked in Veeva Vault quality management workflow. Establishes the effective date for GCP compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this protocol record was first created in the source system or ingested into the lakehouse. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures; ALCOA+ Data Integrity; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: dsmb_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol mandates the establishment of a Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) for independent safety oversight and interim analysis review. Typically required for Phase III trials and studies with significant safety risks.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Data Monitoring Committees (2006); ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; EMA Guideline on DMC

attributes.name: eudract_number
attributes.description: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) number or Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) number assigned under EU CTR 536/2014. Required for all clinical trials conducted in the EU/EEA. Used for EMA regulatory tracking and public registry disclosure.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EudraCT/CTIS Registration; EMA Transparency Policy

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_declaration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol includes a formal declaration of compliance with ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements. Required for all interventional clinical trials. Tracked in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA GCP Regulations

attributes.name: ich_compliance_declaration
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Compliance Declaration
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protocol formally declares compliance with applicable ICH guidelines (E6, E8, E9, E10, etc.). Distinct from GCP declaration; covers the broader ICH guideline framework including statistical and design standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E8(R1); ICH E9(R1); ICH E10; FDA/EMA/PMDA ICH Implementation

attributes.name: intervention_model
attributes.description: Describes the strategy for assigning interventions to participants. Determines the statistical analysis plan (SAP) structure, number of arms, and eCRF design in Medidata Rave. Aligns with CDISC SDTM ARM domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E9(R1) Addendum; ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_status
attributes.description: Status of the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) notification or approval for this protocol version or amendment. Tracks compliance with ethics review requirements across jurisdictions. Sourced from Veeva Vault regulatory module.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 4; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: is_adaptive_design
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study employs an adaptive design allowing pre-specified modifications to the trial or statistical procedures based on interim data analysis. Triggers additional regulatory review requirements and DSMB/DMC oversight obligations.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs for Clinical Trials (2019); EMA Reflection Paper on Adaptive Designs; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: is_pediatric
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study includes a pediatric population (subjects under 18 years). Triggers Pediatric Investigation Plan (PIP) requirements under EMA and Pediatric Study Plan (PSP) under FDA PREA/BPCA, and specific ICF/assent requirements.
attributes.references: FDA PREA/BPCA; EMA Pediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006; ICH E11(R1)

attributes.name: masking_type
attributes.description: Level of blinding applied to the study to minimize bias. Specifies which parties (participant, investigator, outcomes assessor, data analyst) are blinded to treatment assignment. Critical for RTSM/IRT configuration and unblinding procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; CDISC SDTM IG; ClinicalTrials.gov; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: number_of_arms
attributes.description: Total count of treatment arms (groups) defined in the protocol. Drives RTSM randomization configuration, eCRF arm assignment, and statistical analysis plan (SAP) structure. Must be consistent with the intervention model.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain; ICH E9 Statistical Principles; Oracle Clinical One Study Design

attributes.name: planned_duration_months
attributes.description: Total planned duration of the study in months from first subject first visit (FSFV) to last subject last visit (LSLV) or database lock (DBL), as specified in the protocol. Used for timeline planning, resource forecasting, and milestone tracking in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.5; Oracle Siebel CTMS Study Timeline

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of last subject last visit (LSLV) or database lock (DBL) as defined in the protocol and project plan. Used for resource planning, regulatory submission timelines, and study close-out activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; WHO ICTRP Registration

attributes.name: planned_sample_size
attributes.description: Total number of subjects planned for enrollment across all study sites and arms as specified in the protocol. Derived from the statistical power calculation in the SAP. Used for site feasibility, patient recruitment planning, and IP supply forecasting.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date of first subject first visit (FSFV) or study initiation as defined in the protocol and project plan. Used for milestone tracking, site activation planning, and regulatory submission timelines in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; WHO ICTRP Registration

attributes.name: primary_endpoint
attributes.description: The principal outcome measure used to evaluate the primary objective of the study. Defines the variable, measurement method, timepoint, and population. Drives eCRF design in Medidata Rave and the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: primary_objective
attributes.description: Formal statement of the primary scientific objective of the study as defined in the protocol. Describes the main question the study is designed to answer. Directly linked to the primary endpoint and powers the sample size calculation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.2; ICH E9(R1) Addendum on Estimands; FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: primary_purpose
attributes.description: The primary reason for conducting the clinical study. Determines regulatory pathway, endpoint requirements, and IRB/IEC review criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: treatment|prevention|diagnostic|supportive_care|screening|health_services_research|basic_science|device_feasibility — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration; ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: protocol_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, sponsor-assigned unique alphanumeric identifier for the clinical study protocol (e.g., ABC-2024-001). Used across all regulatory submissions, site documents, and operational systems as the primary business key. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; CDISC SDTM STUDYID

attributes.name: protocol_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the protocol version. 'draft' indicates under development; 'approved' indicates IRB/IEC and sponsor approval obtained; 'amended' indicates a formal amendment is in effect; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'final' indicates study completed and protocol finalized; 'retired' indicates withdrawn. Sourced from Veeva Vault quality management workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: registry_identifier
attributes.description: Public clinical trial registry identifier such as ClinicalTrials.gov NCT number (e.g., NCT12345678) or WHO ICTRP identifier. Required by ICMJE for publication eligibility and by FDA/EMA for transparency. Sourced from Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP; ClinicalTrials.gov (42 CFR Part 11); ICMJE Clinical Trial Registration Policy; FDA FDAAA 801

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory authority submission for this protocol version or amendment (e.g., IND amendment to FDA, CTA variation to EMA/MHRA). Tracks compliance with regulatory notification and approval requirements. Sourced from Veeva Vault regulatory submissions module.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; ICH E6(R2); MHRA Clinical Trials Regulations

attributes.name: secondary_objectives
attributes.description: Summary of secondary scientific objectives of the study as defined in the protocol. Describes additional questions the study is designed to address beyond the primary objective. Linked to secondary endpoints in the SAP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.2; ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints

attributes.name: short_title
attributes.description: Abbreviated or lay-language title of the clinical study used in operational communications, CTMS displays, patient-facing materials, and internal reporting. Distinct from the full regulatory title.
attributes.references: WHO ICTRP Registration Data Set; ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this protocol record was sourced. Primary sources are Oracle Clinical One (study design and protocol configuration) and Veeva Vault (eTMF and regulatory document management). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles; 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; EU Annex 11

attributes.name: source_system_identifier
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating operational system (Oracle Clinical One study ID or Veeva Vault document ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Data Integrity Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: ICH-defined phase of clinical development for the investigational product. Determines regulatory requirements, sample size expectations, and study design complexity. 'Not Applicable' used for non-IND studies such as device or observational studies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Phase I|Phase I/II|Phase II|Phase II/III|Phase III|Phase IV|Not Applicable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1) General Considerations for Clinical Studies; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.21; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_population_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the target patient population for the study, including disease characteristics, demographic parameters, and key eligibility criteria summary. Used in IRB/IEC submissions, regulatory filings, and patient recruitment materials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the study design indicating whether participants receive an intervention or are observed. Determines applicable regulatory framework, IRB review requirements, and reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ClinicalTrials.gov Protocol Registration; ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full official title of the clinical study protocol as it appears on the protocol document and regulatory submissions. Used in IRB/IEC submissions, clinical trial registries, and the Clinical Study Report (CSR).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; WHO ICTRP Registration Data Set; ClinicalTrials.gov

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this protocol record in the source system or lakehouse. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records and Signatures; ALCOA+ Data Integrity; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of the protocol document (e.g., 1.0, 2.0, 3.1). Combined with protocol_number, uniquely identifies a specific iteration of the protocol. Incremented with each formal amendment. Sourced from Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6.1; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

products.name: study_protocol_amendment
products.description: Tracks all formal amendments to an approved clinical study protocol. Records amendment number, amendment date, amendment type (substantial/non-substantial), description of changes, rationale, regulatory submission status per health authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA), IRB/IEC notification status, effective date, and impact assessment on ongoing subjects. Supports the protocol lifecycle from initial approval through database lock. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Veeva Vault.
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) Protocol Amendment

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each protocol amendment record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: amendment_tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Each protocol amendment generates a TMF essential document (DIA TMF Zone 4). Amendment tracking and TMF completeness assessments require linking the amendment record to its filed TMF document. Inspect
