products.name: signal_notification
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory notification Event between a safety_signal and a health_authority. It captures the operational record of a specific safety signal being reported to a specific health authority, including submission details, authority-specific required actions, and response tracking. Each record links one safety_signal to one health_authority and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific notification — they cannot reside on the signal master record (which is authority-agnostic) nor on the health authority reference record (which is signal-agnostic).. Existence Justification: In clinical trials pharmacovigilance, a single safety signal (e.g., potential hepatotoxicity detected via disproportionality analysis) must be reported to multiple health authorities simultaneously — FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA — each with its own notification deadline, submission reference, and response tracking. Conversely, each health authority receives and tracks many safety signals across all studies and sponsors. The business actively manages these notifications as operational records: safety teams create them, update their status, record agency responses, and audit them for regulatory compliance. This is a textbook operational M:N with rich relationship-specific data.

attributes.description: The date and time when data was first entered into this eCRF form in Medidata Rave. Represents the ALCOA+ 'Contemporaneous' requirement — data must be recorded at the time of the observation. This is the record creation audit timestamp.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: data_review_status
attributes.description: Current status of the medical/data management review of this subject visit form. Tracks the review workflow from initial data entry through medical monitor approval. Values: not_started, in_review, reviewed, approved, requires_correction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP; Medidata Rave; ALCOA+

attributes.name: edc_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by Medidata Rave EDC to this subject visit form instance. Used for traceability back to the source EDC system and for audit trail reconciliation.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: entered_by
attributes.description: The username of the Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) or site staff member who initially entered data into this eCRF form in Medidata Rave. Satisfies ALCOA+ 'Attributable' requirement — data must be traceable to the person who recorded it.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: freeze_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subject visit form has been frozen in Medidata Rave (True = frozen; False = not frozen). Freezing is a pre-lock step that prevents further data entry while allowing review. Distinct from lock_status.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: freeze_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this subject visit form was frozen in Medidata Rave. Null if the form has not been frozen. Supports the pre-database lock workflow audit trail.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: investigator_signature_status
attributes.description: Status of the Principal Investigator (PI) or sub-investigator electronic signature on this eCRF form. Required for regulatory compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Values: not_required, pending, signed, rejected.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Medidata Rave; FDA

attributes.name: investigator_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the Principal Investigator (PI) or sub-investigator applied their electronic signature to this eCRF form. Null if not yet signed. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: The username of the user who most recently modified this eCRF form record in Medidata Rave. Supports ALCOA+ 'Attributable' requirement for all data changes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this eCRF form record was most recently modified in Medidata Rave. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and change tracking for data management workflows.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: lock_status
attributes.description: Indicates the database lock state of this subject visit form. Unlocked = data entry and editing permitted; locked = form locked as part of the database lock (DBL) workflow; hard_locked = irreversibly locked post-database lock for regulatory submission.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave; ALCOA+

attributes.name: lock_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this subject visit form was locked in Medidata Rave as part of the database lock (DBL) workflow. Null if the form has not been locked. Critical for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave; ALCOA+

attributes.name: locked_by
attributes.description: The username of the data management user who applied the lock to this subject visit form in Medidata Rave. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave; ALCOA+

attributes.name: medical_coding_status
attributes.description: Status of medical coding for verbatim terms on this eCRF form using MedDRA (adverse events, medical history) or WHO Drug Dictionary (concomitant medications). Values: not_applicable (no codeable terms), pending, coded, approved, rejected.

attributes.name: missing_data_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more required data fields are missing or unanswered on this eCRF form for the subject visit. True = missing data present; False = all required fields populated. Supports ALCOA+ compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: missing_field_count

attributes.name: open_query_count

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag

attributes.name: rave_page_repeat_key

attributes.references: Medidata Rave; CDISC ODM; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sdv_date
attributes.description: The date on which source data verification (SDV) was completed for this subject visit form by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA). Null if SDV has not been performed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Current status of source data verification (SDV) for this subject visit form. Reflects whether the CRA has verified the eCRF data against source documents at the site. Values: not_required (SDV not mandated per monitoring plan), pending (SDV not yet performed), partial (some fields verified), verified (all required fields SDV-confirmed), overdue (SDV past due per monitoring plan).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this subject visit data was captured. Primarily Medidata Rave for EDC-based studies; may be Oracle Clinical One or paper CRF for legacy or hybrid studies.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the subject within the study (e.g., site-subject number such as '001-0042'). Used in eCRF, regulatory submissions, and CDISC SDTM USUBJID derivation. Directly identifies a trial participant.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM USUBJID; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.11; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: total_query_count
attributes.description: The total number of data queries (discrepancies) ever raised against this subject visit form, including open, answered, and closed queries. Supports data quality trend analysis.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: visit_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the subject attended the study visit and clinical data was collected. Represents the principal real-world event date. Maps to SVSTDTC in CDISC SDTM.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM SVSTDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: visit_name
attributes.description: The protocol-defined name of the study visit as configured in Medidata Rave (e.g., 'Screening', 'Baseline', 'Week 4', 'End of Treatment'). Maps to VISITDESC in CDISC SDTM.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM VISIT; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: visit_number
attributes.description: The sequential numeric identifier of the study visit as defined in the protocol schedule of assessments. Maps to VISITNUM in CDISC SDTM. Used for ordering and analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM VISITNUM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: visit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the visit as defined in the protocol (e.g., scheduled per protocol, unscheduled/ad hoc, early termination, follow-up, telephone contact). Drives protocol deviation detection and data completeness expectations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: visit_window_end_date
attributes.description: The latest acceptable calendar date for this protocol-defined visit per the study schedule of assessments. Used to assess whether the visit occurred within the protocol-specified window.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: visit_window_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest acceptable calendar date for this protocol-defined visit per the study schedule of assessments. Used to assess whether the visit occurred within the protocol-specified window.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: visit_within_window
attributes.description: Indicates whether the actual visit date falls within the protocol-defined visit window (visit_window_start_date to visit_window_end_date). True = within window; False = outside window (potential protocol deviation).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: alcoa_attributable

attributes.name: alcoa_contemporaneous
attributes.description: ALCOA+ compliance flag indicating whether the field entry was recorded at the time the observation was made (i.e., entry_timestamp is within an acceptable window of the actual observation date). Supports data integrity and GCP compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: alcoa_legible
attributes.description: ALCOA+ compliance flag indicating whether the field entry value is legible and readable. Particularly relevant for transcribed or scanned source data. Supports data integrity assessments during regulatory inspections.

attributes.name: alcoa_original
attributes.description: ALCOA+ compliance flag indicating whether this field entry represents the original (first) recorded value, as opposed to a transcription or copy. Distinguishes primary source data from derived or transferred data.

attributes.name: data_entry_type
attributes.description: Classifies how the field value was populated in the EDC system. Distinguishes between manual site entry, system auto-population (e.g., calculated fields), data migration, or external data import (e.g., lab data transfer). Supports ALCOA+ 'Original' assessment.

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (with timezone) at which the field value was originally entered into the EDC system by the site user. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneous data entry verification and audit trail analysis.

attributes.name: entry_value

attributes.name: is_missing

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: is_multi_source
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SDTM variable mapping requires data from more than one source field or form (True) or derives from a single source field (False). When True, the derivation_algorithm field documents all contributing source fields and the combination logic.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; ALCOA+

attributes.name: is_predecessor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predecessor variable dependency documented in predecessor_variable is a hard requirement (True) that must be resolved before this mapping executes, or an informational dependency (False). Governs transformation program execution sequencing.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: is_sensitive_variable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the target SDTM variable contains sensitive subject data requiring special handling under GDPR, HIPAA, or sponsor data privacy agreements (True). Examples include subject identifiers, dates of birth, and geographic data. Governs data masking and de-identification procedures in submission datasets.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SDTM mapping rule record was most recently updated. Updated on every change to the mapping rule, derivation logic, or status. Supports change tracking and ALCOA+ audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: mapping_rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code identifying this mapping rule within the study's SDTM mapping specification document. Follows the pattern MAP-{DOMAIN}-{VARIABLE}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in Data Management Plans (DMP) and CDISC submission packages.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: mapping_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this SDTM mapping rule. Controls which version is active for production CDISC transformation runs. 'approved' rules are eligible for DBL and regulatory submission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_review|approved|deprecated|superseded|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: mapping_version
attributes.description: Version number of this mapping rule in major.minor format (e.g., 1.0, 2.3). Incremented when the transformation logic, source field, or controlled terminology mapping changes. Supports version-controlled, auditable CDISC data transformation per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional programmer or reviewer notes about this mapping rule, including special handling instructions, known data quality issues, sponsor-specific requirements, or cross-references to related mapping rules. Not included in regulatory submission artifacts.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: predecessor_variable
attributes.description: Name of the SDTM variable (within the same or a different domain) that must be derived before this mapping can be executed. Documents derivation dependencies for sequencing transformation programs. Format: '{DOMAIN}.{VARIABLE}' (e.g., 'AE.AEDECOD'). Null if no predecessor dependency exists.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: reviewer_name

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.description: Two-letter CDISC SDTM domain code identifying the target dataset domain (e.g., DM, AE, LB, VS, CM, EX, MH, DS, SV, TU). Determines the SDTM class and required/expected variable set for this mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DM|AE|LB|VS|CM|EX|MH|DS|SV|TU|EC|FA|RS|TR|TU|PR|CE|DD|HO|ML|PC|PP|RE|RP|SR|SS|TI|TS|TV — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sdtm_ig_version
attributes.description: Version of the CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide that governs this mapping rule (e.g., 'SDTMIG v3.4', 'SDTMIG-AP v1.0'). Ensures regulatory submission compliance with the correct CDISC standard version as required by FDA and EMA data submission guidelines.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_core
attributes.description: CDISC core designation indicating whether the target SDTM variable is Required (Req), Expected (Exp), or Permissible (Perm) for the domain. Required variables must be populated; Expected variables should be populated when data is collected; Permissible variables are optional.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_label
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive label for the target SDTM variable as defined in the CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide (e.g., 'Dictionary-Derived Term', 'Numeric Result/Finding in Standard Units'). Used in SAS dataset metadata and regulatory submission define.xml.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; CDISC Define-XML v2.1

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_name
attributes.description: Name of the target CDISC SDTM variable within the specified domain (e.g., AEDECOD, LBSTRESN, VSORRES). Must conform to CDISC SDTM naming conventions: uppercase, 2–8 characters, domain prefix for most variables. This is the column name in the final SDTM dataset submitted to regulatory agencies.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_role
attributes.description: CDISC-defined role of the target SDTM variable within its domain class (Identifier, Topic, Qualifier, Timing, Rule). Determines how the variable functions within the SDTM dataset structure and governs its position and usage in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4

attributes.name: sdtm_variable_type
attributes.description: CDISC-defined data type of the target SDTM variable. 'Char' for character/text variables and 'Num' for numeric variables, as specified in the SDTM Implementation Guide and define.xml metadata. Governs SAS dataset column type in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4; CDISC Define-XML v2.1

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this mapping rule within the parent SDTM dataset specification. Governs the order in which variables appear in the SDTM dataset and define.xml, and the execution order of transformation programs in SAS Drug Development.

attributes.name: source_dataset_name
attributes.description: Name of the raw/staging dataset (SAS dataset or EDC extract table) that contains the source field prior to SDTM transformation (e.g., 'RAW_AE', 'RAW_VS'). Used in SAS Drug Development transformation programs to identify the input dataset for each mapping rule.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; SAS Drug Development; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: suppqual_flag

attributes.name: suppqual_qnam
attributes.description: Short variable name (QNAM) used in the SUPPQUAL dataset for this non-standard variable. Populated only when suppqual_flag is True. Must be uppercase, 1–8 characters, and unique within the SUPPQUAL dataset for the domain.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide v3.4

attributes.name: validation_error_code
attributes.description: Pinnacle 21 / CDISC conformance rule error or warning code associated with the most recent validation failure for this mapping (e.g., 'SD0083', 'SD0006'). Null when validation_status is 'passed' or 'not_validated'. Supports targeted remediation by the CDISC programmer.
attributes.references: CDISC Conformance Rules; Pinnacle 21; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CDISC Pinnacle 21 / OpenCDISC validation check result for this mapping rule. 'passed' indicates no conformance errors; 'failed' indicates outstanding validation errors requiring remediation before DBL; 'waived' indicates a documented exception approved by the Data Management team.
attributes.references: CDISC Conformance Rules; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; Pinnacle 21

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: build_version
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the EDC study build (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Incremented with each approved change to the build configuration to support audit trail and change control.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cdash_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDISC Clinical Data Acquisition Standards Harmonization (CDASH) Version
attributes.description: Version of the CDISC CDASH standard used to design the eCRF data collection fields in this EDC study build. Ensures harmonized data collection aligned with regulatory submission requirements.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH Implementation Guide; FDA; EMA

attributes.name: cdisc_sdtm_mapping_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDISC Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Mapping Version
attributes.description: Version of the CDISC SDTM mapping specification applied to this EDC study build. Governs how collected eCRF data is transformed into SDTM-compliant datasets for regulatory submission.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EDC study build record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: crf_count
attributes.description: Total number of electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs) configured in this EDC study build. Provides a high-level measure of build scope and complexity.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: derivation_count
attributes.description: Total number of programmed data derivations (auto-calculated fields) configured in this EDC study build. Derivations reduce manual data entry and support data consistency.
attributes.references: CDISC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: econsent_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDC study build is integrated with an eConsent platform (e.g., Clinpal) for electronic Informed Consent Form (ICF) management and subject consent tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: edit_check_count
attributes.description: Total number of programmed edit checks (data validation rules) configured in this EDC study build. Edit checks enforce data quality and ALCOA+ compliance at point of entry.
attributes.references: CDISC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; FDA Guidance on Electronic Source Data

attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: The date on which the EDC study build was deployed to the production environment and made available for live clinical data collection at study sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: lab_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDC study build has automated laboratory data integration configured (e.g., central lab data feeds into Medidata Rave). Reduces manual transcription and supports ALCOA+.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC LAB; ALCOA+

attributes.name: part11_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDC study build has been validated and confirmed compliant with 21 CFR Part 11 requirements for electronic records and electronic signatures.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

attributes.name: randomization_integrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this EDC study build is integrated with the Medidata Rave RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) module for subject randomization and IRT functionality.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: rave_study_name
attributes.description: The exact study name as configured and registered within the Medidata Rave EDC system. Used for system-level identification and integration with downstream CDISC SDTM pipelines.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: rave_study_uuid
attributes.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to the study within Medidata Rave. Used for system-to-system integration, API calls, and cross-environment traceability.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this EDC study build version was retired and superseded by a newer build version. Null if the build is still active.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor provided formal approval for the EDC study build. Null if sponsor approval is not required or not yet received.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal sponsor sign-off is required for this EDC build before production deployment. Driven by the study contract and Data Management Plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: uat_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which UAT was formally completed and signed off. Prerequisite for build approval and production deployment.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GAMP 5; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: uat_defect_count
attributes.description: Total number of defects identified during UAT for this build version. Used to assess build quality and readiness for production deployment.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GAMP 5

attributes.name: uat_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EDC study build successfully passed all UAT test cases without critical defects. True = UAT passed; False = UAT failed or has open critical defects.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GAMP 5

attributes.name: uat_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which User Acceptance Testing of the EDC study build commenced. UAT validates that the build meets protocol requirements before production deployment.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GAMP 5; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this EDC study build record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: critical_discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies classified as critical (e.g., safety-impacting, primary endpoint data, regulatory submission data). Critical discrepancies require mandatory resolution before DBL.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines; ALCOA+

attributes.name: dataset_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific CDISC SDTM domain or dataset (e.g., AE, LB, CM, VS) being reconciled. Provides dataset-level traceability for SDTM submission readiness.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: dbl_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation is a mandatory prerequisite for Database Lock (DBL). When True, outstanding discrepancies must be resolved or formally waived before DBL can proceed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Standards; FDA Guidance on DBL

attributes.name: discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Total number of data discrepancies identified between the source and target systems during this reconciliation exercise. Includes all open, resolved, and outstanding discrepancies.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: discrepancy_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of records with at least one discrepancy relative to total records compared (discrepancy_count / total_records_compared * 100). Key quality KPI for data management performance reporting and study risk assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: escalation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for escalation, including the nature of critical discrepancies, impacted data domains, and recommended corrective actions. Populated only when escalation_required is True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reconciliation outcome requires escalation to the study team, sponsor, or Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) due to critical unresolved discrepancies or systemic data quality issues.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which this type of reconciliation is performed for the study, as defined in the DMP. Drives scheduling and resource planning for data management activities.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for data manager comments, observations, or contextual information about the reconciliation activity, including any known data transfer delays, system outages, or protocol amendments affecting the comparison.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: outstanding_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies that remain unresolved at the time of the reconciliation record. A non-zero value blocks DBL (Database Lock) unless formally justified and documented.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: period_end
attributes.description: End date of the data window covered by this reconciliation activity. Defines the upper bound of the data extract or comparison period.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the data window covered by this reconciliation activity. Defines the lower bound of the data extract or comparison period.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: planned_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the reconciliation activity as defined in the Data Management Plan (DMP) or study timeline. Enables variance tracking between planned and actual reconciliation dates.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the reconciliation activity was formally executed. Principal business event date used for scheduling, DMP milestone tracking, and pre-DBL (Database Lock) compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Standards; ALCOA+

attributes.name: reconciliation_method
attributes.description: Approach used to perform the reconciliation — fully manual review, automated system comparison, or a hybrid semi-automated process. Informs quality risk assessment and resource planning.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the reconciliation activity, used in Data Management Plans (DMP), audit trails, and cross-system references. Typically formatted as REC-{StudyCode}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: reconciliation_scope
attributes.description: Granularity level at which the reconciliation is performed — whether it covers the full study, a specific site, individual subjects, a visit window, or a specific dataset. Determines the breadth of the reconciliation exercise.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reconciliation activity, from initiation through sign-off. Drives workflow progression and DBL (Database Lock) readiness gates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC Data Management Standards; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: reconciliation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciliation activity by the category of external data source being reconciled against the EDC (Electronic Data Capture) system. Drives workflow routing and DMP compliance checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: central_lab|safety_database|irt_rtsm|epro|external_vendor|edc_internal — promote to reference product if additional types are anticipated]
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; DMP Guidelines

attributes.name: resolved_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies that have been investigated and resolved (closed) as of the reconciliation sign-off date. Used to assess reconciliation completeness.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: signoff_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual who formally approved and signed off the reconciliation activity. Supports electronic signature audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: signoff_status
attributes.description: Formal approval status of the reconciliation activity by the responsible data manager and/or study team. Approved sign-off is required before the reconciliation can be considered complete for DBL purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC Data Management Standards

attributes.name: signoff_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the reconciliation was formally signed off. Provides the precise audit timestamp for regulatory inspection readiness per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_data_extract_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the data extract was pulled from the source system for reconciliation purposes. Critical for ALCOA+ contemporaneity and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the originating operational system providing data for reconciliation (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC, Oracle Argus Safety, IRT/RTSM, ePRO platform, central laboratory LIMS). Identifies the system-of-record on the sending side.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: target_data_extract_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the data extract was pulled from the target system for reconciliation comparison. Paired with source_data_extract_timestamp to establish the comparison window.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: target_system
attributes.description: Name of the receiving or comparison operational system against which source data is reconciled (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC, Oracle Argus Safety, SAS Drug Development). Identifies the system-of-record on the receiving side.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: tool
attributes.description: Name of the software tool or system used to perform the reconciliation (e.g., Medidata Rave, SAS macro, custom script, Oracle Clinical One). Supports audit trail and reproducibility documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Standards; ALCOA+

attributes.name: total_records_compared
attributes.description: Total count of data records (e.g., subject visits, lab results, AE entries) included in the reconciliation comparison between source and target systems. Denominator for discrepancy rate calculations.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reconciliation record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail integrity, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the reconciliation activity, incremented when a reconciliation is re-executed (e.g., after additional data is received or discrepancies are resolved). Supports iterative reconciliation tracking.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: waived_count
attributes.description: Number of discrepancies formally waived with documented justification (e.g., clinically insignificant, data not required for analysis). Supports transparent DBL decision-making.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Management Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+
