attributes.name: change_reason_text
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explanation provided by the user for the data change, supplementing the coded reason. Required for UPDATE and DELETE actions to satisfy ALCOA+ Accurate and Attributable requirements. Must be entered at time of change.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §4.9.3; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e)

attributes.name: data_entry_lag_minutes
attributes.description: Number of minutes elapsed between the clinical event date/time (as recorded in the eCRF) and the event_timestamp of this audit entry. Used to assess Contemporaneous compliance — large lags may indicate ALCOA+ violations requiring investigation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Contemporaneous; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: dbl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry was created after the Database Lock (DBL) event for the associated study. Post-lock entries require special authorization and are flagged for regulatory scrutiny. True = post-lock entry; False = pre-lock entry.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC; FDA Guidance on DBL; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: ecrf_version
attributes.description: Version of the eCRF form design active in the EDC system at the time of the data change. Supports traceability of data collected under different form versions across protocol amendments.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave EDC; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: edc_record_reference
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier of the specific eCRF record (data point) within Medidata Rave EDC that was created or modified. Provides direct traceability to the source data record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+

attributes.name: edc_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the EDC system that generated this audit entry (e.g., Medidata Rave). Supports multi-system audit trail consolidation and system-level traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Available

attributes.name: edc_system_version
attributes.description: Version of the EDC software at the time the audit entry was generated. Required for regulatory inspection readiness to demonstrate system validation status at the time of data entry.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); ICH E6(R2) §5.5.3; GAMP 5

attributes.name: esignature_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the electronic signature applied to this audit entry, where applicable (e.g., for SIGN action types or investigator-verified records). Links to the 21 CFR Part 11 compliant e-signature record in Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: esignature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the electronic signature was applied to this record, where applicable. Distinct from the event_timestamp (data change time). Required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance on signed records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated, non-editable timestamp recording the exact date and time the data change event occurred in the EDC system. Satisfies the Contemporaneous requirement of ALCOA+. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §5.5.3; ALCOA+

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the workstation or device from which the EDC user performed the data change. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 access control audit and security investigation. May be considered PII in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(d); GDPR Article 4; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: is_accurate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Accurate requirement of ALCOA+: the data value is correct, and any change is accompanied by a valid change reason. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_attributable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Attributable requirement of ALCOA+: the data change is traceable to the individual who made it (user_identifier is populated and valid). True = compliant; False = compliance gap requiring remediation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Available requirement of ALCOA+: the record is accessible for review by authorized personnel and regulatory inspectors throughout the required retention period. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(c); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Complete requirement of ALCOA+: all required fields for this data change are populated with no missing mandatory data. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_consistent
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Consistent requirement of ALCOA+: the data change is internally consistent with other related data points and does not introduce contradictions within the subject record. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_contemporaneous
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Contemporaneous requirement of ALCOA+: the event_timestamp reflects the actual time of data entry or change, not a backdated or delayed entry. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_enduring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Enduring requirement of ALCOA+: the record is stored in a durable, non-erasable medium and will be retained for the required regulatory retention period. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(c); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_legible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Legible requirement of ALCOA+: the data values (original and new) are readable and interpretable. True = compliant; False = compliance gap (e.g., corrupted or unreadable data).
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: is_original
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry satisfies the Original requirement of ALCOA+: the data represents the first recorded observation or a properly documented change from the original. True = compliant; False = compliance gap.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); FDA Data Integrity Guidance

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The data value entered or updated in the eCRF field as a result of this change event. NULL for DELETE actions. Satisfies the Accurate requirement of ALCOA+ by capturing the current authoritative value.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) §4.9.3

attributes.name: original_value
attributes.description: The data value that existed in the eCRF field before the change was applied. NULL for CREATE actions. Satisfies the Original requirement of ALCOA+ by preserving the prior state of the data.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) §4.9.3

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit entry record was written to the Silver Layer lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp (the EDC system event time). Supports data pipeline lineage and ingestion audit.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; ALCOA+ Enduring

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Status of Source Data Verification (SDV) for the data change captured in this audit entry. NOT_REQUIRED = SDV not mandated per monitoring plan; PENDING = awaiting CRA review; VERIFIED = CRA confirmed data matches source; FAILED = discrepancy found during SDV.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ALCOA+

attributes.name: sdv_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when Source Data Verification was completed for this audit entry. Populated only when sdv_status is VERIFIED or FAILED. Supports monitoring visit reporting and SDV coverage metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sdv_user_identifier
attributes.description: Identifier of the CRA or authorized user who performed Source Data Verification for this audit entry. Provides attribution for the SDV action per GCP monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: study_protocol_version
attributes.description: Version of the study protocol in effect at the time of the data change. Ensures the audit entry is contextualized against the correct protocol amendment, supporting protocol deviation analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: user_role
attributes.description: Role of the EDC user at the time of the data change (e.g., CRC - Clinical Research Coordinator, CRA - Clinical Research Associate, PI - Principal Investigator, DATA_MANAGER). Captured at event time to support role-based audit analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CRC|CRA|PI|DATA_MANAGER|MEDICAL_MONITOR|BIOSTATISTICIAN|SYSTEM_ADMIN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11; GCP; ALCOA+ Attributable

attributes.name: visit_name
attributes.description: Name of the study visit (e.g., Screening, Week 4, End of Treatment) associated with the eCRF record that was modified. Contextualizes the data change within the study schedule of events.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E6(R2); Medidata Rave EDC

products.name: data_entry_session
products.description: Master reference table for data_entry_session. Referenced by session_id.

attributes.name: data_entry_session_id
attributes.description: Primary key for data_entry_session

attributes.name: ecrf_form_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.ecrf_form. Business justification: data_entry_session has an ecrf_id column (BIGINT) that semantically refers to the eCRF form being entered during the session. Per domain-level FK resolution, ecrf_id maps to ecrf_form (the primary eCR
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the EDC system user who performed the data entry during this session.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investigational site where the data entry session originated.

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical study/trial to which this data entry session belongs.

attributes.name: subject_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical trial subject/patient whose data is being entered during this session.

attributes.name: visit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the study visit/event associated with this data entry session.

attributes.name: access_channel
attributes.description: Interface or device channel through which the user accessed the EDC system for this data entry session.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the user for data modifications made during this session, required for ALCOA+ compliance and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: coding_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether data entered in this session requires medical coding (MedDRA or WHO-DD) for adverse events, medications, or medical history.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes recorded by the user during or about this data entry session, providing context for data management review.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this data entry session record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_page_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific eCRF data page or form section being completed during this session (e.g., Demographics, Vital Signs, Adverse Events).

attributes.name: domain_code
attributes.description: Two-character CDISC SDTM domain code (e.g., DM, AE, VS, LB) indicating the clinical data domain being entered.

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time of the data entry session measured in seconds, used for productivity analysis and anomaly detection.

attributes.name: edc_system_version
attributes.description: Version of the EDC system (e.g., Medidata Rave) in use at the time of this data entry session, important for validation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the data entry session was concluded, either by user action, system timeout, or completion of data entry.

attributes.name: entry_method
attributes.description: Method by which data was entered into the EDC system during this session.

attributes.name: fields_entered_count
attributes.description: Total number of eCRF fields that were populated or modified during this data entry session.

attributes.name: fields_with_errors_count
attributes.description: Number of fields that triggered edit check or validation rule failures during this data entry session.

attributes.name: form_version
attributes.description: Version of the eCRF form definition that was active during this data entry session, critical for tracking form amendments.

attributes.name: freeze_status
attributes.description: Indicates the freeze state of data entered in this session. Frozen data cannot be modified without formal unfreeze (thaw) approval.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address from which the data entry session was conducted, captured for audit trail and security compliance purposes.

attributes.name: is_double_data_entry
attributes.description: Indicates whether this session is part of a double data entry (DDE) process where data is entered twice independently for verification purposes.

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data entered in this session has been locked as part of the database lock (DBL) process, preventing further modifications.

attributes.name: is_source_data_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether source data verification was performed during or as part of this data entry session, confirming data matches source documents.

attributes.name: is_training_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether this session was conducted in training/sandbox mode rather than production, ensuring training data is excluded from analysis.

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: Locale setting (language and country) of the user interface during this data entry session (e.g., en_US, ja_JP), relevant for multi-regional trials.

attributes.name: lock_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the data from this session was locked as part of the database lock workflow.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this data entry session record was last modified.

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether data entered during this session was flagged as a potential protocol deviation requiring further review.

attributes.name: queries_generated_count
attributes.description: Number of data queries (discrepancies) automatically generated by edit checks during this session, requiring resolution.

attributes.name: save_count
attributes.description: Number of times the user saved data during this session, indicating session complexity and user behavior patterns.

attributes.name: session_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the data entry session, used for audit trail references and query management communications.

attributes.name: session_type
attributes.description: Classification of the data entry session indicating the nature of the data entry activity being performed.

attributes.name: signature_status
attributes.description: Status of the electronic signature applied to the data entered during this session, per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.

attributes.name: signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the electronic signature was applied to the data entered in this session.

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the data entry session was initiated by the user in the EDC system. This is the principal business event timestamp.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the data entry session indicating whether it is active, completed, or terminated.

attributes.name: timezone_offset
attributes.description: UTC timezone offset of the user's location during the data entry session, critical for accurate timestamp reconciliation in global trials.

attributes.name: user_role
attributes.description: Role of the user performing data entry during this session, determining access permissions and workflow routing.

attributes.name: resumed_data_entry_session_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on data_entry_session (resumed_data_entry_session_id)

domains.name: laboratory
domains.description: Manages central and local laboratory operations for clinical trials. Owns lab panel definitions, specimen collection and processing workflows, lab results (including PK/PD and DMPK data), reference ranges, critical values, sample chain of custody, bioanalytical assays, and lab certification/accreditation status.
domains.references: CDISC SDTM LB Domain; CAP/CLIA Laboratory Standards; WHO-DD

products.name: lab_panel
products.description: Master definition of a laboratory test panel or battery used in clinical trials. Captures panel code, name, specimen type requirements, analyte list, applicable study phases, CDISC SDTM domain mapping (LB), turnaround time SLA, and whether the panel is central or local lab. Serves as the catalog of all lab assessments available for protocol inclusion.
products.reference: CDISC SDTM LB Domain Panel Definition

attributes.name: lab_panel_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the laboratory test panel or battery record in the clinical trials lab catalog.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LB Domain

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: GCP-compliant labs must reference the governing SOP for each panel's collection, processing, and analysis procedures. Audit trails and inspection readiness reviews require traceability from panel defi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: adam_dataset_mapping
attributes.description: CDISC ADaM dataset name to which this panel's results are mapped for statistical analysis (e.g., ADLB for laboratory data, ADPC for PK concentration data, ADPP for PK parameter data). Used by SAS Drug Development for ADaM dataset generation.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM IG v1.1; CDISC ADaM ADLB; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: applicable_study_phases
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of clinical trial phases for which this panel is applicable (e.g., 'Phase I|Phase II|Phase III'). Guides protocol designers in selecting appropriate panels for the study phase. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phase_i|phase_i_ii|phase_ii|phase_ii_iii|phase_iii|phase_iv|first_in_human — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trial Regulation 536/2014

attributes.name: assay_method
attributes.description: Primary analytical method or technology platform used to perform the panel (e.g., LC-MS/MS, ELISA, Flow Cytometry, Immunoturbidimetry, PCR, Automated Hematology Analyzer). Relevant for bioanalytical method validation per ICH M10.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline

attributes.name: cdisc_lbcat_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Laboratory Category (LBCAT) Code
attributes.description: Standardized CDISC SDTM LBCAT value for this panel's category as defined in the CDISC controlled terminology (e.g., 'HEMATOLOGY', 'CHEMISTRY', 'URINALYSIS'). Required for SDTM dataset compliance in regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LBCAT; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: container_type
attributes.description: Type of collection tube or container required for specimen collection (e.g., EDTA tube, SST tube, Lithium Heparin tube, Urine cup). Critical for pre-analytical quality and chain of custody. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: edta|sst|lithium_heparin|sodium_citrate|fluoride_oxalate|urine_cup|cryovial — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CLSI H3-A6; CLSI GP44-A4; Lab Manual SOP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lab panel definition record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: critical_value_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any analyte in this panel has defined critical (panic) values that require immediate notification to the investigator or site per laboratory SOP. Drives alert workflows in the EDC and CTMS.
attributes.references: CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ISO 15189; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this version of the lab panel definition is no longer valid for new protocol inclusions. Null for currently active panel versions. Supports panel retirement and version management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the lab panel definition is valid and available for protocol inclusion. Supports temporal validity management of the panel catalog.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: fasting_duration_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours the subject must fast before specimen collection when fasting is required. Null when fasting_required is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Protocol Schedule of Assessments

attributes.name: fasting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject must be in a fasted state (typically ≥8 hours) prior to specimen collection for this panel. Relevant for lipid panels, glucose, and insulin assays. Drives patient instructions and visit scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Protocol Schedule of Assessments

attributes.name: is_biomarker_panel
attributes.description: Indicates whether this panel includes exploratory or validated biomarker assessments (e.g., genomic, proteomic, or metabolomic markers). Biomarker panels may require additional consent and specialized sample handling.
attributes.references: FDA Biomarker Qualification Program; ICH E16; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3

attributes.name: is_pd_panel
attributes.description: Indicates whether this panel is a Pharmacodynamics (PD) panel measuring the biological effect of the drug. PD panels may map to CDISC SDTM LB or FA domains depending on the analyte type.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LB/FA Domains; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_pk_panel
attributes.description: Indicates whether this panel is a Pharmacokinetics (PK) panel used to measure drug concentration over time. PK panels map to CDISC SDTM PC domain and require specialized bioanalytical assay management.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - PC Domain; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance; ICH M10

attributes.name: is_safety_panel
attributes.description: Indicates whether this panel is designated as a safety monitoring panel (e.g., liver function, renal function, hematology) required for adverse event assessment and DSMB/DMC review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: lab_certification_standard
attributes.description: Accreditation or certification standard under which the performing laboratory is certified for this panel (e.g., CAP, ISO 15189, CLIA, GLP, GCLP). Required for regulatory submission credibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cap|iso_15189|clia|glp|gclp|jci|ukas — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ISO 15189; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; OECD GLP Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: lab_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this panel is performed at a central laboratory (single reference lab processing all specimens), a local laboratory (site-level lab), or both. Central labs provide standardized reference ranges; local labs may be used for safety monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: method_validation_status
attributes.description: Validation status of the analytical method used for this panel per ICH M10 and FDA/EMA guidance. 'validated' methods have full regulatory-grade validation; 'qualified' methods have partial validation; 'exploratory' methods are research-grade only.
attributes.references: ICH M10 Bioanalytical Method Validation; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guidance 2018; EMA Bioanalytical Method Validation Guideline

attributes.name: panel_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the panel by clinical discipline or analyte group (e.g., Hematology, Clinical Chemistry, Coagulation, Urinalysis, Immunology, Pharmacokinetics, Biomarker). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hematology|clinical_chemistry|coagulation|urinalysis|immunology|pharmacokinetics|biomarker|microbiology|serology|endocrinology — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LBCAT; NCI Thesaurus

attributes.name: panel_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, sponsor- or CRO-assigned alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the lab panel within the study catalog (e.g., CHEM20, CBC, LFT). Used as the business key for cross-system reference and CDISC SDTM LBTESTCD mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LBTESTCD; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: panel_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the laboratory test panel or battery (e.g., 'Complete Blood Count', 'Comprehensive Metabolic Panel', 'Liver Function Tests'). Maps to CDISC SDTM LBTEST.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LBTEST; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: panel_short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated display name for the panel used in eCRF headers, reports, and dashboards where space is constrained (e.g., 'CBC', 'CMP', 'LFT').
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LBTESTCD; Medidata Rave EDC field conventions

attributes.name: panel_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lab panel definition in the catalog. 'active' panels are available for protocol inclusion; 'retired' panels are no longer used in new studies; 'draft' panels are pending validation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3

attributes.name: panel_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification within the panel category providing finer granularity (e.g., within Clinical Chemistry: 'Liver Function', 'Renal Function', 'Lipid Panel'). Maps to CDISC SDTM LBSCAT.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LBSCAT

attributes.name: reference_range_source
attributes.description: Source of the normal reference ranges applied to results from this panel. Central lab-derived ranges are preferred for regulatory submissions; sponsor-defined ranges may be used for novel biomarkers.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LBORNRLO/LBORNRHI; FDA Bioanalytical Method Validation; ISO 15189

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether results from this panel must be included in regulatory submissions (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA). Drives data management and CDISC SDTM/ADaM transformation requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trial Regulation 536/2014; ICH E3 CSR Guidelines

attributes.name: sdtm_domain
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Domain
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM domain code to which this panel's results are mapped for regulatory submission (e.g., LB for Laboratory Test Results, PC for Pharmacokinetics Concentrations, PP for Pharmacokinetics Parameters). Required for FDA/EMA eCTD submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide; EMA Data Standards

attributes.name: shipping_condition
attributes.description: Required temperature condition for shipping specimens from the clinical site to the central laboratory. Governs cold chain logistics, packaging requirements, and IATA compliance for biological specimens.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; CLSI GP44-A4; ISO 15189

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this lab panel definition was sourced (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle Clinical One, LIMS). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special pre-analytical or handling requirements for the specimen (e.g., 'Protect from light', 'Process within 30 minutes', 'Do not freeze', 'Centrifuge at 2000g for 10 minutes'). Communicated to site staff via lab manual.
attributes.references: CLSI GP44-A4; ISO 15189; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: specimen_collection_method
attributes.description: Standardized method used to collect the specimen (e.g., Venipuncture, Finger Stick, Midstream Catch, Lumbar Puncture). Maps to CDISC SDTM LBMETHOD. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: venipuncture|finger_stick|midstream_catch|lumbar_puncture|biopsy|swab|catheterization — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LBMETHOD; CLSI H3-A6

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Primary biological specimen type required for this panel (e.g., Whole Blood, Serum, Plasma, Urine, CSF, Tissue Biopsy). Maps to CDISC SDTM LBSPEC. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_blood|serum|plasma|urine|csf|tissue|saliva|stool|bone_marrow|synovial_fluid — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - LBSPEC; CLSI GP44-A4

attributes.name: specimen_volume_ml
attributes.description: Minimum volume of specimen required in millilitres to perform all analytes in the panel. Used for phlebotomy planning, patient burden assessment, and paediatric study feasibility.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CLSI GP44-A4; Protocol Feasibility Assessment

attributes.name: stability_hours_ambient
attributes.business_glossary_term: Specimen Stability Hours at Ambient Temperature
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours the collected specimen remains analytically stable at ambient temperature (15–25°C) before processing or freezing is required. Critical for chain of custody and pre-analytical quality management.
attributes.references: CLSI EP25-A; ISO 15189; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3

attributes.name: stability_hours_refrigerated
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours the collected specimen remains analytically stable when stored refrigerated (2–8°C). Used to define shipping and processing windows for central lab specimens.
attributes.references: CLSI EP25-A; ISO 15189; CLSI GP44-A4

attributes.name: stat_turnaround_time_hours
attributes.description: Expedited turnaround time in hours for urgent (STAT) requests, typically triggered by safety events or critical value alerts. Distinct from standard SLA turnaround time.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ISO 15189

attributes.name: storage_temperature
attributes.description: Required storage temperature condition for the specimen prior to analysis (e.g., ambient, refrigerated 2–8°C, frozen –20°C, frozen –80°C). Governs cold chain logistics and sample chain of custody.
attributes.references: CLSI GP44-A4; ISO 15189; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: turnaround_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Turnaround Time Service Level Agreement (SLA) Hours
attributes.description: Contracted or target turnaround time in hours from specimen receipt at the laboratory to result reporting. Used for SLA monitoring, site management, and safety decision timelines. Critical for SAE-related panels.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ISO 15189

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lab panel definition record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the lab panel definition (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Tracks changes to panel specifications over time to support audit trails and protocol amendment management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: visit_timepoints
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of protocol visit names or codes at which this panel is scheduled (e.g., 'Screening, Day 1, Week 4, Week 8, End of Treatment, Follow-Up'). Supports protocol schedule of assessments design and EDC form configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 - VISITNUM; Oracle Clinical One Study Design

products.name: lab_facility
products.description: Master record for central and local laboratory facilities performing specimen analysis for clinical trials. Captures facility name, type (central/local/bioanalytical/PK), CLIA/CAP/ISO 15189 accreditation status, accreditation expiry, regulatory certifications, geographic location, contact details, LIMS system identifier, and operational status. SSOT for lab facility identity and certification.
products.reference: CAP/CLIA/ISO 15189 Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the laboratory facility record. Primary key for the lab_facility data product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CLIA (42 CFR Part 493); CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the laboratory facility. Used for specimen shipment labels, regulatory correspondence, and audit documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA; CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, floor, building) for the laboratory facility. Supplements address_line1 for complete mailing and shipment address.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: biobanking_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory facility has certified long-term specimen storage (biobanking) capabilities, including controlled-temperature archival storage. Relevant for studies requiring retained samples for future exploratory analyses.
attributes.references: ISBER Best Practices for Repositories; ISO 20387:2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cap_accreditation_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: College of American Pathologists (CAP) Accreditation Number
attributes.description: Accreditation number issued by the College of American Pathologists (CAP) confirming the laboratory meets rigorous quality standards. Widely recognized by sponsors and regulatory agencies as evidence of laboratory quality. Null if not CAP-accredited.
attributes.references: CAP Accreditation Program Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance for Industry

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the laboratory facility is physically located. Used for geographic reporting, logistics planning, and specimen shipment routing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; GDPR Article 4; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: clia_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments (CLIA) Certificate Number
attributes.description: Federal CLIA certificate number issued by CMS to U.S. clinical laboratories authorizing them to perform testing on human specimens. Required for regulatory compliance and sponsor qualification audits. Null for non-U.S. facilities.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493; CMS CLIA Program; FDA 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the laboratory facility is physically located (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Drives regulatory jurisdiction determination and applicable accreditation standards.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 44; HIPAA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the laboratory facility record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dmpk_analysis_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) Analysis Capability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory facility is equipped and validated to perform Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) analyses, including metabolite profiling and enzyme characterization studies.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2018); ICH M10; EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation

attributes.name: edi_lab_code
attributes.description: Standardized laboratory code used in electronic data interchange (EDI) transmissions between the laboratory and EDC/CTMS systems. Aligns with CDISC LAB data standards for lab results transfer.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB Data Standard; HL7 FHIR; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique business identifier for the laboratory facility (e.g., 'LAB-CENT-001'). Used in study protocols, eCRFs, and regulatory submissions to reference the facility. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER per MASTER_RESOURCE canonical requirements.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 58

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Official legal or operating name of the laboratory facility as registered with accreditation bodies and regulatory authorities. Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL per MASTER_RESOURCE canonical requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022; CAP Accreditation Standards; CLIA 42 CFR Part 493

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the laboratory facility by its operational role in clinical trials. Central labs process specimens from multiple sites; local labs are site-affiliated; bioanalytical labs perform assay development and sample analysis; PK/DMPK labs focus on pharmacokinetics and drug metabolism. Serves as CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE per MASTER_RESOURCE canonical requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM LB Domain; FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation

attributes.name: flow_cytometry_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory facility has validated flow cytometry capabilities for immunophenotyping and cell-based assays, commonly required in oncology and immunology trials.
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022; CAP Accreditation Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: gcp_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory facility holds a current Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certification or has been qualified under GCP guidelines by the sponsor or CRO. Required for laboratories participating in regulated clinical trials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

attributes.name: genomics_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory facility is equipped to perform genomic analyses (e.g., PCR, NGS, genotyping) relevant to pharmacogenomics endpoints in clinical trials.
attributes.references: ICH E15 Pharmacogenomics; FDA Guidance on Pharmacogenomics; ISO 15189:2022

attributes.name: glp_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory facility is certified under Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) regulations, required for non-clinical safety studies and certain bioanalytical work supporting regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: OECD GLP Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 58; EMA GLP Directive 2004/10/EC

attributes.name: iso_15189_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued by a national accreditation body (e.g., UKAS, DAkkS, COFRAC) confirming the laboratory conforms to ISO 15189 requirements for medical laboratories. Recognized internationally for cross-border clinical trial operations.
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022; ILAC P15; EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation

attributes.name: lims_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this facility within its Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). Used for electronic data exchange, specimen tracking, and results transmission to EDC systems such as Medidata Rave.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB Data Standard; 21 CFR Part 11; GAMP 5; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: lims_vendor
attributes.description: Name of the LIMS software vendor used by the facility (e.g., LabVantage, STARLIMS, LabWare). Relevant for EDC integration planning and data transfer agreement scoping.
attributes.references: CDISC LAB Data Standard; 21 CFR Part 11; GAMP 5

attributes.name: medical_director_name
attributes.description: Full name of the licensed physician or doctoral scientist serving as the laboratory's Medical Director, as required by CLIA and CAP accreditation. Accountable for overall laboratory quality and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: CLIA 42 CFR Part 493.1441; CAP Accreditation Standards; ISO 15189:2022 Section 4.1

attributes.name: network_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the central laboratory network or parent organization to which this facility belongs (e.g., 'Covance', 'Q2 Solutions', 'BioReference', 'PPD'). Used for contract management, network-level performance reporting, and escalation routing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: normal_hours_of_operation
attributes.description: Description of the laboratory facility's standard operating hours (e.g., 'Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00 EST'). Used for specimen shipment scheduling, turnaround time SLA definition, and site coordinator guidance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189:2022 Section 4.1

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the laboratory facility indicating whether it is actively accepting specimens for clinical trial studies. Drives eligibility for new study assignments and site qualification workflows. Serves as LIFECYCLE_STATUS per MASTER_RESOURCE canonical requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; ISO 15189:2022; CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: pk_analysis_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the laboratory facility is equipped and validated to perform pharmacokinetic (PK) sample analysis, including bioanalytical assays for drug concentration measurement.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation (2018); EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation; ICH M10

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the laboratory facility's physical address. Used for specimen shipment logistics and geographic analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: preferred_courier
attributes.description: Name of the preferred or contracted courier service for specimen shipment to this facility (e.g., 'World Courier', 'Marken', 'FedEx Custom Critical'). Used for logistics planning and chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189:2022 Section 5.4

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary operational contact at the laboratory facility. Used for study coordination communications, specimen shipment notifications, and results transmission alerts.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary operational contact person at the laboratory facility (e.g., Laboratory Director or Operations Manager). Used for study coordination, issue escalation, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; CAP Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the laboratory facility's operational contact. Used for urgent specimen handling queries, critical value notifications, and logistics coordination.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: qualification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor or CRO qualification of the laboratory facility expires, requiring re-qualification before the facility can be assigned to new studies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; FDA Guidance on Vendor Qualification

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Sponsor or CRO qualification status of the laboratory facility, reflecting the outcome of vendor qualification audits and ongoing performance reviews. Determines whether the facility may be assigned to new studies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; FDA Guidance on Vendor Qualification; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: regulatory_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional regulatory certifications held by the facility beyond primary accreditation (e.g., 'FDA-registered, EMA-compliant, PMDA-approved, NY State DOH'). Supports multi-jurisdictional study eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 493; EMA GCP Directive; PMDA Guidelines; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: specimen_capacity_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of specimens the facility can process per business day under normal operating conditions. Used for capacity planning, site feasibility assessments, and study logistics. Serves as MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE per MASTER_RESOURCE canonical requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 15189:2022 Section 4.1

attributes.name: specimen_receipt_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour format, local facility time) by which specimens must be received to be processed on the same business day. Critical for study protocol logistics and turnaround time commitments.
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022; CAP Accreditation Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region in which the laboratory facility is physically located. Used for regulatory jurisdiction mapping and logistics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the laboratory facility's local time (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Used for specimen receipt timestamp normalization, turnaround time calculations, and critical value notification SLA tracking.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: turnaround_time_standard_hours
attributes.description: Standard turnaround time in hours from specimen receipt to results availability for routine panels. Used in study feasibility assessments and service level agreement (SLA) monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022 Section 5.8; CAP Accreditation Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: turnaround_time_stat_hours
attributes.description: Turnaround time in hours for STAT (urgent) specimen processing. Used for safety monitoring protocols where rapid results are required for subject safety decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 15189:2022 Section 5.8; CAP Accreditation Standards; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the laboratory facility record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

products.name: specimen
products.description: Master record for each biological specimen collected from a trial subject, including collection event details. Captures specimen barcode/ID, subject ID, visit reference, collection date/time, specimen type (blood, urine, CSF, tissue), collection tube type, volume collected, collector ID, collection site (body location), collection method, collection kit lot, pre-analytical processing performed, collection deviations, primary/aliquot flag, parent specimen reference, receipt status, condition on arrival, LIMS accession number, and current disposition status. SSOT for specimen identity, collection event, receipt, and chain of custody.
products.reference: CDISC SDTM SD/SS Domain; IATA P650 Biological Substance Shipping

attributes.name: specimen_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each biological specimen record in the laboratory data product. Primary key for the specimen entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 Domain: PC/LB; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical staff member (e.g., Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC), nurse, phlebotomist) who performed the specimen collection. Required for ALCOA+ attributability and GCP audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA 21 CFR §312

attributes.name: lab_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the central or local laboratory responsible for analyzing this specimen. Used for lab-level quality monitoring, accreditation tracking, and result attribution.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBNAM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: lab_panel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_panel. Business justification: A specimen is collected for a specific laboratory panel (e.g., a CBC panel, chemistry panel). The assay_panel_code STRING column on specimen is a denormalized reference to lab_panel. Adding lab_panel_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parent_specimen_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent specimen from which this aliquot was derived. Null for primary specimens. Enables full chain-of-custody traceability from primary collection through all downstream aliquots.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record under which this specimen was transported to the central laboratory or biorepository. Enables chain-of-custody tracking and cold-chain compliance verification.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR §312

attributes.name: specimen_collection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_collection. Business justification: A specimen is produced by a specimen collection event. The specimen_collection table records the scheduled or unscheduled collection event, while specimen records the physical biological material coll
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical site where the specimen was collected. Used for site-level quality monitoring and logistics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3

attributes.name: study_visit_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to study.study_visit_schedule. Business justification: Specimens are collected at protocol-defined visits; linking to the visit schedule enables deviation detection (collection outside visit window), SDTM domain mapping, and protocol compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit during which this specimen was collected. Enables visit-level specimen tracking.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 VISITNUM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (participant) from whom this specimen was collected. Core linkage for subject-level traceability.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 USUBJID; ICH E6(R2) GCP; HIPAA 45 CFR §164

attributes.name: actual_timepoint_hours
attributes.description: Actual elapsed time in hours from the reference event (e.g., dose administration) to specimen collection. Critical for pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) analysis and nominal time deviation assessment.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBTPTNUM; FDA Guidance on PK Studies; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: aliquot_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number identifying the order of this aliquot within the set of aliquots derived from the same parent specimen (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Null for primary specimens. Used for aliquot management and laboratory workflow.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3

attributes.name: barcode
attributes.description: Unique barcode or label identifier affixed to the specimen container at the point of collection. Used for physical tracking and LIMS accession matching. Serves as the primary operational identifier in the laboratory.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBREFID; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_status
attributes.description: Current status of the specimen's chain of custody documentation. 'Intact' indicates unbroken custody from collection to current location; 'broken' indicates a gap requiring investigation. Critical for regulatory and legal defensibility of specimen data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR §312; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: collection_body_site
attributes.description: Anatomical body location from which the specimen was collected (e.g., left antecubital vein, right arm, lumbar region). Required for specimens where site of collection affects result interpretation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBLOC; NCI Thesaurus; ISO 15189

attributes.name: collection_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time at which the specimen was collected from the subject. Principal real-world event timestamp for the specimen. Used for PK/PD time-point calculations, protocol compliance, and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: collection_deviation_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the collection deviation when collection_deviation_flag is True (e.g., incorrect tube used, delayed processing, missed time window). Supports protocol deviation reporting and CAPA.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR §312; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: collection_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation occurred during specimen collection (True) or not (False). Triggers deviation documentation workflow and may affect specimen usability for primary analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR §312; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ISO 15189

attributes.name: collection_kit_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number of the collection kit used for specimen collection. Required for traceability of kit materials, deviation investigation, and supply chain accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR §312; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Procedure or technique used to collect the specimen (e.g., venipuncture, fingerstick, lumbar puncture, biopsy, swab). Affects pre-analytical processing and result interpretation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: venipuncture|fingerstick|catheter|lumbar_puncture|biopsy|swab|midstream_void|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBMETHOD; ISO 15189; NCI Thesaurus

attributes.name: collection_tube_type
attributes.description: Type of collection tube or container used (e.g., EDTA, SST, lithium heparin, sodium citrate, PAXgene). Critical for pre-analytical integrity and analyte stability. Aligns with laboratory manual specifications.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBMETHOD; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: condition_on_arrival
attributes.description: Assessment of the specimen's physical condition upon receipt at the laboratory (e.g., acceptable, hemolyzed, lipemic, temperature excursion). Determines whether the specimen is suitable for analysis or requires rejection/re-collection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: acceptable|hemolyzed|lipemic|icteric|insufficient_volume|temperature_excursion|damaged|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBREASND

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this specimen record was first created in the system. Required for ALCOA+ audit trail, 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: destruction_date
attributes.description: Date on which the specimen was destroyed or disposed of, in accordance with the protocol-defined retention period and applicable regulations. Required for regulatory accountability and chain-of-custody closure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR §312; GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR §164; ISO 15189

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the specimen within the laboratory workflow. Drives operational actions and regulatory accountability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending_receipt|received|in_analysis|analyzed|stored|shipped|destroyed|rejected|lost — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the specimen is no longer considered analytically valid for its intended assay(s). Determined by specimen type, storage conditions, and analyte stability data. Used to flag specimens requiring re-collection or exclusion.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation

attributes.name: fasting_status
attributes.description: Fasting status of the subject at the time of specimen collection (fasted, non-fasted, unknown). Required for metabolic panels, lipid profiles, and glucose assays where fasting state affects reference ranges.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBFAST; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: freeze_thaw_cycles
attributes.description: Number of freeze-thaw cycles the specimen has undergone. Excessive freeze-thaw cycles can degrade analyte integrity; this field is used to assess specimen quality and flag specimens that may yield unreliable results.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specimen record represents the primary (original) specimen (True) or an aliquot derived from a parent specimen (False). Drives chain-of-custody logic and parent-child specimen relationships.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: lims_accession_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) Accession Number
attributes.description: Accession number assigned by the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) upon receipt of the specimen at the central or local laboratory. Used for laboratory workflow tracking and result linkage.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBREFID

attributes.name: pre_analytical_processing
attributes.description: Description of pre-analytical processing steps performed on the specimen prior to analysis or storage (e.g., centrifugation speed/duration, temperature, time to processing). Critical for result interpretation and protocol compliance.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBMETHOD; ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: processing_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time at which pre-analytical processing of the specimen was completed. Used to calculate time-from-collection-to-processing, a key pre-analytical quality metric per laboratory manual requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: receipt_datetime
attributes.description: Date and time at which the specimen was received at the central or local laboratory. Used to calculate transit time, assess cold-chain compliance, and trigger LIMS accession workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for specimen rejection when disposition_status is 'rejected' (e.g., insufficient volume, wrong tube type, temperature excursion, unlabelled, clotted). Required for deviation tracking and re-collection decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBREASND; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Biological matrix type of the specimen collected from the subject (e.g., blood, urine, plasma, serum, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), tissue). Drives pre-analytical processing rules and reference range selection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: blood|urine|plasma|serum|csf|tissue|saliva|stool|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 LBSPEC; NCI Thesaurus; ISO 15189

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Physical storage location of the specimen within the laboratory or biorepository (e.g., freezer ID, rack, box, position). Required for specimen retrieval, inventory management, and chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; FDA 21 CFR §312; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: storage_temperature_c
attributes.description: Required storage temperature for this specimen in degrees Celsius (e.g., -80, -20, 2-8, ambient). Used to verify cold-chain compliance and specimen integrity throughout the chain of custody.
attributes.references: ISO 15189; CAP Laboratory Accreditation; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR §312

attributes.name: subject_number
