attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dispensed_quantity
attributes.description: The actual number of dosage units dispensed to the subject from this kit. Used for drug accountability reconciliation and compliance with protocol-specified dosing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: dispensed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this kit was physically dispensed to the subject by site staff. Captured in RTSM (Medidata Rave) as part of the chain-of-custody audit trail. Conforms to ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: dispensing_visit
attributes.description: The protocol-defined visit name or number at which this kit was dispensed to the subject (e.g., 'Visit 2 - Week 4'). Used for protocol compliance verification and eCRF reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM EX domain; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the investigational medicinal product within this kit as printed on the label. Kits must not be dispensed after this date. Used for expiry management, re-supply planning, and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137; ICH Q1A Stability; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: kit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the physical randomization kit by the RTSM (Medidata Rave). This is the primary business identifier used in drug accountability logs, dispensing records, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: kit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the kit within the supply chain. 'available' = at depot or site, ready for assignment; 'assigned' = allocated to a subject via RTSM but not yet dispensed; 'dispensed' = physically given to subject; 'expired' = past expiry date; 'returned' = returned from site or subject; 'destroyed' = destruction confirmed; 'quarantine' = held pending investigation; 'lost' = unaccounted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|assigned|dispensed|expired|returned|destroyed|quarantine|lost — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

attributes.name: label_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the IMP label applied to this kit. Used to verify that the correct, IRB/IEC-approved label version was used at the time of dispensing and for regulatory label reconciliation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.6; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which the investigational medicinal product in this kit was manufactured. Used for shelf-life calculation, batch traceability, and regulatory accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ICH Q7

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: The version of the study protocol under which this kit was dispensed or assigned. Ensures that kit dispensing is traceable to the correct protocol amendment for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: The unique randomization number assigned to the subject-kit pairing by the RTSM (IRT/IVRS) at the point of subject randomization. Links the kit to the randomization schedule for unblinding and accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM RANDO; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the kit must be retested or re-evaluated for continued use, particularly for products with conditional shelf-life extensions. Distinct from expiry_date; used for stability management.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: returned_quantity
attributes.description: The number of dosage units returned by the subject or site for this kit. Used in drug accountability reconciliation to calculate compliance and account for unused medication.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: returned_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the kit was returned by the subject or site to the depot or destruction facility. Part of the chain-of-custody audit trail for drug accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: rtsm_kit_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) Kit ID
attributes.description: The source system identifier for this kit record as assigned by the RTSM module in Medidata Rave. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational RTSM system, and audit trail traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: site_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the kit was received and confirmed at the investigational site. Marks the transfer of custody from depot/logistics to site. Used for site inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this kit as specified on the label and protocol. Drives warehouse and site storage assignment, cold-chain logistics, and temperature excursion monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211.142; USP <1079>

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion event has been recorded for this kit during storage or transit. When True, the kit must be quarantined and assessed by QA before dispensing.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q1A; FDA Guidance on Temperature-Sensitive Drug Products; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: treatment_arm
attributes.description: The randomization treatment arm or cohort to which this kit is allocated (e.g., 'Active 10mg', 'Placebo', 'Dose Level 2'). Populated by RTSM at randomization. May be blinded and masked for double-blind studies.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM TA domain; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this kit inventory record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

products.name: depot
products.description: Master record for clinical supply depots (central and regional warehouses) that store and distribute IMPs. Captures depot name, geographic location, GMP certification status, temperature-controlled storage capabilities (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), qualified person details, regulatory licenses, and operational contact information. Depots are the primary nodes in the clinical supply logistics network.
products.reference: Clinical Supply Depot

attributes.name: depot_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the clinical supply depot. Primary key for the depot master record.
attributes.references: ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: qualified_person_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: EU GDP regulations require a named Qualified Person responsible for each IMP depot. This FK enables QP qualification tracking, depot audit readiness, and wholesale distribution license compliance repo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subcontract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.subcontract. Business justification: Depot 3PL providers are engaged via subcontracts that govern service obligations, GMP requirements, and liability. 3PL depot subcontract management is a named business process; sponsor approval of sub
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Depot qualification reports and GMP certificates are ICH GCP essential TMF documents (Zone 5). Each depot must link to its qualification/GMP certificate document in the eTMF. gmp_certificate_number on
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the depot facility. Used for logistics routing, regulatory filings, and cold-chain shipment documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address detail (suite, building, floor) for the depot facility.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ICH Q10

attributes.name: ambient_storage_capacity_m3
attributes.description: Total ambient temperature storage capacity of the depot measured in cubic metres. Ambient storage is typically 15–25°C. Used for supply planning and capacity allocation across studies.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Guidelines; EU GMP Annex 13; USP <1079>

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the depot facility is located. Used for geographic distribution planning and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: cold_chain_qualified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot has been formally qualified for cold-chain IMP handling, including validated temperature monitoring, qualified packaging, and trained personnel per WHO and GDP guidelines.
attributes.references: WHO TRS 961 Annex 9; EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: controlled_substance_licensed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot is licensed to store and handle controlled substances (narcotics, psychotropics) as defined by DEA Schedule (US), Home Office (UK), or equivalent national authority. Required for studies involving opioids, CNS agents, or other scheduled compounds.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; UK Misuse of Drugs Regulations 2001; UN Convention on Psychotropic Substances

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the depot is located. Drives regulatory jurisdiction, import/export rules, and cold-chain routing logic.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the depot master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctms_depot_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Depot ID
attributes.description: Depot identifier as recorded in Oracle Siebel CTMS. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the supply chain data product and clinical trial management records.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the depot was or is scheduled to be decommissioned and removed from the active clinical supply network. Null for currently active depots.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: depot_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the depot within the clinical supply network. Used in RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) and CTMS for depot referencing across studies.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH Q10

attributes.name: depot_name
attributes.description: Full legal or operational name of the clinical supply depot as registered with regulatory authorities and used in the Trial Master File (TMF).
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: depot_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the depot. Active depots are approved for IMP storage and distribution. Suspended depots are temporarily halted pending investigation or re-qualification. Decommissioned depots are permanently closed.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: depot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the depot within the clinical supply logistics network. Central depots serve as primary distribution hubs; regional depots serve geographic clusters; local depots are near investigational sites; satellite depots are temporary; returns depots handle IMP returns and destruction.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: destruction_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot is authorized to perform on-site destruction of expired, returned, or unusable IMPs in compliance with GMP and environmental regulations.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EPA Hazardous Waste Regulations

attributes.name: erp_vendor_code
attributes.description: Vendor or supplier identifier for the depot as registered in SAP S/4HANA. Used for purchase order processing, invoice matching, and financial reconciliation of depot service fees.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; SOX Section 404; ICH Q10

attributes.name: frozen_storage_capacity_m3
attributes.description: Total frozen storage capacity (typically -20°C or -80°C) of the depot in cubic metres. Required for biologics, gene therapies, and other temperature-sensitive IMPs.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; EU GMP Annex 13; USP <1079>; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Certificate Expiry Date
attributes.description: Date on which the depot's GMP certificate expires. Triggers re-qualification workflows and may suspend depot operations if not renewed prior to expiry.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; EMA

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official certificate number issued by the regulatory authority confirming GMP compliance for the depot. Referenced in regulatory submissions and audit documentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; EMA; MHRA; TGA

attributes.name: gmp_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot holds a current Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) certification as required for IMP storage and handling under ICH Q7/Q10 and applicable regional regulations.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; EMA GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: import_license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the depot's import license for IMP receipt. Expired licenses block inbound international shipments.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA; PMDA

attributes.name: import_license_number
attributes.description: Regulatory import license number permitting the depot to receive IMP shipments from international origins. Required for cross-border clinical supply operations.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA IND Regulations; PMDA; Health Canada

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent GMP/GDP audit conducted at the depot by the sponsor, CRO, or regulatory authority. Audit outcomes are tracked in the quality management system (MasterControl).
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: last_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the depot last completed a formal qualification or re-qualification exercise (IQ/OQ/PQ). Qualification records are maintained in the eTMF and are subject to regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 15; 21 CFR Part 211.68; ISPE GAMP 5

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next GMP/GDP audit at the depot. Used for audit planning and compliance calendar management.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: next_qualification_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next depot qualification or re-qualification. Drives preventive maintenance and compliance calendar in the CTMS and quality management system.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 15; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or depot-specific constraints relevant to clinical supply operations. Not intended for regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q10

attributes.name: operational_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the depot became operationally active for clinical supply activities. Used for lifecycle tracking and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the depot facility. Used for logistics routing and regulatory jurisdiction mapping.
attributes.references: ICH Q10

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary operational contact at the depot. Used for shipment alerts, RTSM notifications, and supply chain communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ICH Q10

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary operational contact person at the depot. Used for logistics coordination, shipment notifications, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the depot operational contact. Used for urgent logistics coordination and cold-chain incident escalation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ICH Q10

attributes.name: refrigerated_storage_capacity_m3
attributes.description: Total refrigerated storage capacity (typically 2–8°C) of the depot in cubic metres. Critical for IMPs requiring cold-chain management.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A; EU GMP Annex 13; USP <1079>; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9

attributes.name: returns_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot is authorized to receive returned Investigational Medicinal Products (IMPs) from investigational sites. Required for accountability reconciliation and destruction workflows.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: rtsm_depot_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Depot Code
attributes.description: Depot identifier as configured in the RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM). Used to link depot master records to RTSM dispensing, randomization kit assignment, and resupply trigger logic.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the depot is located. Relevant for import/export licensing and regional regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: temperature_monitoring_system
attributes.description: Name or model of the continuous temperature monitoring system installed at the depot (e.g., Sensitech TempTale, Berlinger ELPRO). Ensures 21 CFR Part 11 compliant electronic records of storage conditions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU GDP Guidelines; WHO TRS 961 Annex 9; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the depot location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for scheduling shipment windows, expiry checks, and operational hours alignment.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ICH Q10

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the depot master record. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: wholesale_distribution_license
attributes.description: License number authorizing the depot to distribute investigational medicinal products (IMPs) as a wholesale distributor. Required under EU GDP guidelines and equivalent national regulations.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; MHRA; Health Canada; TGA; 21 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: wholesale_license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the wholesale distribution license. Depot cannot legally distribute IMPs after this date without renewal.
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; MHRA; 21 CFR Part 205

products.name: site_inventory
products.description: Tracks IMP and kit stock positions at supply chain nodes (investigational sites and depots). Each record represents current inventory levels by IMP/kit type at a specific location, including quantity on-hand, received, dispensed, allocated, quarantined, returned, and expired. Records storage condition compliance, last physical count date, and location type (site or depot). Enables accountability reconciliation, resupply trigger management, and regulatory inventory reporting. Linked to site or depot via location reference.
products.reference: Site Drug Accountability

attributes.name: site_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each site inventory record representing a stock position of an Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) or kit type at a specific supply chain node (investigational site or depot).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: imp_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) master record defining the drug substance, formulation, and dosage form tracked in this inventory position.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 59; 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: kit_definition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the randomization kit type as defined in the RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) system (Medidata Rave). Identifies the specific kit configuration (e.g., treatment arm, dose level, pack size) tracked in this inventory record.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM Kit Type; ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: manufacture_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: Site inventory is tracked by batch (site_inventory.batch_number is denormalized). Each site inventory record represents stock of a specific manufacturing batch at a site. Adding manufacture_batch_id c
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: receipt_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: Site inventory records are created or updated when a shipment is received at the investigational site. Adding receipt_shipment_id links the site inventory record to the inbound shipment. This enables
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this inventory is being tracked. Links inventory records to the sponsoring protocol and enables study-level accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM IG; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site or depot location where this inventory is physically held. Enables site-level stock position reporting and resupply trigger management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS site record; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: accountability_reconciled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IMP accountability reconciliation has been completed for this inventory position. Set to True when all received, dispensed, returned, expired, and destroyed quantities have been formally reconciled and signed off per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; GCP

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer's batch or lot number for the IMP stock held at this location. Required for regulatory traceability, recall management, and accountability reconciliation. Corresponds to the batch/lot number on the IMP label.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23; ICH Q7; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: blinding_level
attributes.description: Blinding level applicable to this inventory position, indicating whether the IMP identity is masked at this location. Drives labeling requirements and access controls for inventory data to preserve study integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: destruction_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether destruction of expired, returned, or quarantined IMP stock at this location has been formally authorized by the sponsor or designee. Required before physical destruction can proceed per GCP and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; GCP

attributes.name: destruction_date
attributes.description: Date on which IMP units or kits were destroyed at or from this location. Required for regulatory accountability documentation and study close-out reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the IMP batch or kit stock held at this location, as stated on the product label. Used for expiry management, resupply planning, and to prevent dispensing of expired product to study subjects.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.23; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13.2; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: imp_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure used to count IMP stock at this location (e.g., kit, vial, tablet, capsule, syringe, ampoule). Ensures consistent quantity reporting across different IMP formulations and packaging configurations.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: inventory_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for this inventory position record, typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS system. Used in regulatory accountability documentation and audit trails.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this inventory position. 'active' indicates stock is available for dispensing; 'quarantined' indicates stock is held pending investigation or quality review; 'depleted' indicates zero usable stock; 'closed' indicates the position is no longer active post study close-out; 'suspended' indicates dispensing is temporarily halted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_dispensing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent IMP or kit dispensing event occurred at this location. Used to monitor site dispensing activity and identify inactive sites that may require supply reallocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM dispensing records; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count was conducted at this location for this IMP or kit type. Used to assess inventory data currency and schedule the next physical count per the accountability reconciliation plan.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_physical_count_qty
attributes.description: Actual physical count of IMP units or kits recorded during the most recent physical inventory count at this location. Compared against the system quantity to identify discrepancies requiring investigation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: last_shipment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent inbound IMP or kit shipment was received and confirmed at this location. Used to track supply chain activity and assess time since last replenishment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM shipment module

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supply chain node holding this inventory. Distinguishes between investigational sites (where IMP is dispensed to subjects), depots (regional or central storage), central pharmacies, and satellite depots. Drives resupply logic and accountability reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: maximum_stock_qty
attributes.description: Maximum number of IMP units or kits permitted at this location to prevent overstocking, minimize expiry risk, and comply with storage capacity constraints. Used in supply planning and RTSM configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: minimum_stock_qty
attributes.description: Absolute minimum number of IMP units or kits that must be maintained at this location to ensure uninterrupted subject dosing. Falling below this level triggers an urgent resupply escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM supply parameters

attributes.name: qty_adjusted
attributes.description: Net inventory adjustment quantity applied to this position due to physical count discrepancies, data corrections, or reconciliation differences. Positive values indicate upward adjustments; negative values indicate downward adjustments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: qty_allocated
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits currently reserved or allocated to specific subjects or randomization slots via the RTSM but not yet physically dispensed. Reduces available-for-dispensing stock.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13

attributes.name: qty_destroyed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits that have been destroyed at or from this location, including expired, damaged, or returned-and-destroyed stock. Required for regulatory accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: qty_dispensed
attributes.description: Cumulative number of IMP units or kits dispensed to study subjects at this location since the study began or since the last accountability reconciliation period. Sourced from dispensing records in the RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: qty_expired
attributes.description: Number of IMP units or kits that have passed their expiry date at this location and are no longer eligible for dispensing. Tracked separately for regulatory accountability and waste reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical count of IMP units or kits available at this location, excluding quarantined, allocated, and reserved stock. Represents the net usable inventory at the time of the last update. Used as the primary metric for resupply trigger evaluation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.13; Medidata Rave RTSM; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: qty_quarantined

attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Testing; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: gmp_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the GMP manufacturing authorisation or certificate issued by the relevant regulatory authority for the manufacturing site. Confirms the site is authorised to manufacture IMPs for clinical trials.
attributes.references: EU GMP Directive 2003/94/EC; 21 CFR Part 211; ICH Q7; EMA

attributes.name: is_comparator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch is a comparator (active control or placebo) product rather than the investigational drug. True = comparator/placebo; False = investigational drug. Used for supply planning, kit assembly, and RTSM randomization configuration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_placebo
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch contains placebo (no active ingredient). True = placebo batch; False = active drug batch. Distinct from is_comparator as a batch may be a comparator active drug. Used for blinded supply management and kit labelling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E9

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: The date on which manufacturing of this IMP batch was completed, as recorded in the batch manufacturing record. Used as the reference point for shelf-life and expiry date calculation.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.188; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the manufacturing site is located. Used for import/export regulatory compliance and supply chain risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: manufacturing_site_name
attributes.description: Name of the GMP-certified facility where this IMP batch was manufactured. Used for regulatory traceability, site audit trails, and supply chain accountability.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH CTD Module 3

attributes.name: packaging_configuration
attributes.description: Description of the primary and secondary packaging configuration for this batch (e.g., '30-count HDPE bottle', '10-pack blister card', '1 mL pre-filled syringe'). Used for kit assembly planning and site dispensing instructions.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.94; ICH Q8

attributes.name: quarantine_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units from this batch currently held in quarantine pending QP release or investigation. Tracked separately from available quantity for GMP accountability.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192

attributes.name: recall_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recall of this batch was initiated. Populated only when recall_flag is True. Used for regulatory reporting timelines and site notification tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7; EU GMP Chapter 8; FDA; EMA

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this batch has been subject to a product recall. True = batch recalled; False = no recall. Triggers urgent site notification, return logistics, and regulatory reporting obligations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 7; EU GMP Chapter 8; ICH E6(R2); FDA; EMA

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Qualified Person (QP) or authorized release authority formally released this batch for clinical use. Marks the transition from quarantine to released status and triggers downstream supply chain activities.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 211.192

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Current GMP release status of the batch as determined by the Qualified Person (QP) or authorized release authority. Controls whether the batch may be shipped to depots or dispensed to subjects. Valid values: quarantine (awaiting QP release), released (approved for use), rejected (failed QC), recalled (post-release recall), destroyed (confirmed destruction), under_review (hold pending investigation).
attributes.references: ICH Q7; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; EMA Guideline on QP Certification

attributes.name: retest_date
attributes.description: Date by which the batch must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications before further use. Applicable for APIs and some drug products where retest rather than expiry dating is used.
attributes.references: ICH Q7; ICH Q1A(R2); 21 CFR Part 211.137

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: Approved shelf life of the IMP batch in months, as determined by stability data and declared in the product specification. Used to calculate and validate the expiry date relative to the manufacture date.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); ICH Q1E; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: source_system_batch_key
attributes.description: Native batch record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM batch record ID, sponsor ERP batch key from SAP S/4HANA). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: sponsor_batch_reference
attributes.description: Sponsor-assigned reference number for this batch as provided in the sponsor batch release documentation. May differ from the manufacturing site batch number. Used for sponsor reconciliation and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH Q7; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: stability_study_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the ICH stability study protocol under which this batch is enrolled for ongoing stability monitoring. Used to track shelf-life extensions and expiry date updates.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); ICH Q1E; 21 CFR Part 211.166; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this IMP batch as specified in the product dossier and CoA. Drives cold-chain logistics planning, depot and site storage requirements, and temperature excursion monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: room_temperature|refrigerated|frozen|ultra_frozen|controlled_room_temperature|protect_from_light|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); ICH Q8; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: storage_temp_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this IMP batch, as specified in the product specification. Used for cold-chain monitoring, temperature excursion assessment, and depot/site compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: storage_temp_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this IMP batch, as specified in the product specification. Used for cold-chain monitoring, temperature excursion assessment, and depot/site compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: Declared strength or concentration of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) per unit dose in this batch (e.g., '100 mg', '5 mg/mL'). Used for dose verification and dispensing accountability.
attributes.references: ICH Q6A; 21 CFR Part 201; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: units_per_kit
attributes.description: Number of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials) contained in each randomization kit assembled from this batch. Used by RTSM for kit assembly configuration and dispensing accountability calculations.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this manufacture batch record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5

Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM and logistics provider integrations.

attributes.name: batch_number

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customs_clearance_date

attributes.name: customs_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment requires customs clearance due to international cross-border transit. Drives import/export documentation requirements and regulatory import permits for IMP.

attributes.name: destination_node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the supply chain destination node (e.g., site name, depot name). Supports logistics documentation and regulatory accountability records.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.68

attributes.name: destination_node_type
attributes.description: Type of supply chain node to which the shipment is directed (e.g., clinical site, central depot, manufacturer). Supports supply chain network mapping and inventory accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: destruction_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued upon confirmed destruction of returned or expired IMP. Required for regulatory accountability reconciliation and GMP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates the directional flow of the shipment: outbound (manufacturer/depot to site), inbound (site to depot/returns), or lateral (site to site). Supports supply chain node mapping and accountability.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dispatch_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IMP shipment was physically dispatched from the origin node. Represents the principal business event timestamp for outbound shipments. Used for lead-time calculations and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the IMP shipment was dispatched from the origin node. Supports cold-chain elapsed time calculations and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: excursion_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total cumulative duration in minutes during which the shipment temperature was outside the specified storage condition range. Used for product impact assessment and quality disposition decisions.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q1A; WHO TRS 961

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which the IMP shipment is expected to arrive at the destination node. Used for site inventory planning, expiry management, and supply chain KPI monitoring.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the IMP batch included in this shipment. Used for expiry management, re-test date tracking, and prevention of expired product administration to subjects.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.137; ICH Q1A

attributes.name: imp_description
attributes.description: Description of the investigational medicinal product (IMP) or comparator included in the shipment (e.g., drug name, formulation, strength). Supports accountability documentation and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: import_permit_number
attributes.description: Regulatory import permit or authorization number issued by the receiving country's health authority for the IMP shipment. Required for cross-border clinical supply and regulatory compliance documentation.

attributes.name: incoterms_code

Governs insurance, customs, and cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; EU GMP Annex 13; SAP S/4HANA Procurement

attributes.name: kit_count

attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: max_recorded_temp_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius recorded by the cold-chain data logger during transit. Used to assess whether the IMP was exposed to excessive heat or out-of-range conditions.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q1A; WHO TRS 961; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: min_recorded_temp_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius recorded by the cold-chain data logger during transit. Used to assess whether the IMP was exposed to freezing or sub-optimal low temperatures.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH Q1A; WHO TRS 961; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: notes

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: origin_node_name

attributes.name: origin_node_type

attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: quarantine_flag

attributes.name: line_status

attributes.name: quarantine_status

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical site or depot where the excursion was detected or occurred. Null if the excursion occurred in-transit between locations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: affected_batch_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IMP manufacturing batch/lot numbers affected by this excursion. Required for traceability to the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) and stability data package submitted to the sponsor and regulatory authorities.
attributes.references: EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q7

attributes.name: affected_kit_count
attributes.description: Total number of IMP kits exposed to the temperature excursion. Used for impact scoping, supply replacement planning, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: affected_kit_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IMP kit numbers (as assigned in the RTSM/IRT system, e.g., Medidata Rave) that were exposed to the temperature excursion. Captured as a denormalized string for audit readiness; detailed kit-level records are maintained in the supply kit inventory.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 57

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) has been determined to be required as a result of this excursion event. True = CAPA required; False = no CAPA required. Drives workflow integration with MasterControl CAPA tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 9001:2015; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this temperature excursion record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_logger_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the electronic temperature data logger or continuous monitoring device that recorded the excursion. Used for equipment traceability, calibration verification, and audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU GMP Annex 11; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: The mechanism or system that first detected the temperature excursion: data_logger (electronic temperature logger device), continuous_monitor (real-time monitoring system), manual_check (routine manual temperature check), irt_alert (Interactive Response Technology system alert from Medidata Rave RTSM), courier_report (reported by logistics provider), site_report (reported by site staff).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 11

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor or QA team formally issued the disposition decision for the affected IMP kits. Required for regulatory audit trail and supply chain accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 211.192; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: disposition_decision
attributes.description: The final disposition decision made by the sponsor or QA team following the impact assessment. Distinct from impact_assessment_outcome in that this represents the formal, authorized decision (which may differ from the initial assessment recommendation). Drives downstream supply replacement and accountability reconciliation actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH Q10

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes from excursion start to excursion end. Populated once the excursion is closed. Used by QA and the sponsor to assess cumulative thermal exposure against stability data. Derived operationally from start/end timestamps but stored for audit and reporting efficiency.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 Annex 9; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: excursion_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) at which the temperature returned within the acceptable range, marking the end of the excursion event. Null if the excursion is still ongoing at time of record creation.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); 21 CFR Part 211.166; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: excursion_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the circumstances of the temperature excursion, including any contextual information provided by the site, depot, or courier at the time of detection. Supports GCP audit readiness and regulatory inspection documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: excursion_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to this excursion event, used in sponsor communications, QA investigations, and regulatory audit trails. Typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS system (e.g., Medidata Rave or Oracle Siebel CTMS).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: excursion_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) at which the temperature excursion began — i.e., when the temperature first breached the defined threshold. This is the principal real-world event time for the excursion. Critical for duration calculation and impact assessment.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); 21 CFR Part 211.166; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: excursion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the excursion event record. Drives QA workflow: open (newly detected), under_investigation (impact assessment in progress), pending_disposition (awaiting sponsor/QA decision), closed (disposition finalized), voided (false alarm or data entry error confirmed).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 211.192; MasterControl CAPA workflow

attributes.name: excursion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the excursion by the nature of the breach: high_temperature (exceeded upper limit), low_temperature (fell below lower limit), freeze_thaw (frozen product that should not be), humidity (relative humidity breach), combined (multiple parameter breach simultaneously).
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 Annex 9; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: impact_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the scientific/QA impact assessment determining the usability of the affected IMP: use (product confirmed acceptable for continued use), quarantine (product held pending further evaluation), destroy (product deemed unusable and scheduled for destruction), pending (assessment not yet completed), return_to_sponsor (product to be returned to sponsor for evaluation). Critical for GCP compliance and patient safety.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ICH Q10

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Categorizes where in the cold-chain the excursion occurred: depot (central or regional IMP warehouse), site (investigational site pharmacy or storage), in_transit (during shipment between locations), courier_hub (third-party logistics hub), customs (held at customs/border control).
attributes.references: EU GDP Guidelines 2013/C 343/01; ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 211.142

attributes.name: logger_calibration_date
attributes.description: The most recent calibration date of the temperature data logger at the time of the excursion. Required to validate the reliability of the recorded temperature data for GCP audit readiness and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 211.68; EU GMP Annex 11; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: lower_threshold_c
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable storage temperature (in degrees Celsius) defined for the affected IMP, as specified in the kit definition or product stability data. Breach of this threshold constitutes a low-temperature excursion.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.166

attributes.name: max_temp_recorded_c
attributes.description: The highest temperature value (in degrees Celsius) recorded during the excursion event. Used to assess the severity of a high-temperature excursion against product stability specifications.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); USP <1079>; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: mean_kinetic_temp_c
attributes.description: The Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) in degrees Celsius calculated for the excursion period. MKT is the single calculated temperature that, if maintained over the storage period, would produce the same thermal stress as the actual temperature fluctuations. Used per USP <1079> and WHO guidelines for stability impact assessment.
attributes.references: USP <1079>; WHO Technical Report Series No. 961 Annex 9; ICH Q1A(R2)

attributes.name: min_temp_recorded_c
attributes.description: The lowest temperature value (in degrees Celsius) recorded during the excursion event. Used to assess the severity of a low-temperature or freeze-thaw excursion against product stability specifications.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); USP <1079>; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: replacement_kits_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether replacement IMP kits need to be dispatched to the affected site or depot as a result of the disposition decision (e.g., quarantine or destroy outcome). Drives supply replenishment workflow in the RTSM (Medidata Rave).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: reported_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the person (e.g., CRC, CRA, site pharmacist, depot manager) who first reported or logged the temperature excursion into the system. Supports ALCOA+ attributability requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the excursion was formally reported or entered into the system. May differ from excursion_start_timestamp if there was a delay in detection or reporting. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneity assessment.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause identified during the CAPA or investigation process: equipment_failure (refrigeration/monitoring device malfunction), process_failure (SOP not followed), human_error (incorrect handling), logistics_failure (carrier/transit failure), environmental (external weather or facility event), unknown (root cause not yet determined). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equipment_failure|process_failure|human_error|logistics_failure|environmental|unknown — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 9001:2015; MasterControl CAPA; 21 CFR Part 820.100

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified root cause of the temperature excursion, as documented during the QA investigation. Supports CAPA development and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 211.192; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: rtsm_excursion_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Excursion Reference
attributes.description: The excursion or alert reference identifier as recorded in the RTSM system (Medidata Rave IRT/RTSM module). Used for cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational source system.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor was formally notified of the temperature excursion. Null if sponsor_notification_required is False or notification has not yet been sent. Used to track compliance with contractual and regulatory notification timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor must be formally notified of this excursion per the clinical supply agreement or protocol requirements. True = notification required; False = not required (e.g., minor excursion within pre-defined acceptable limits).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: stability_data_reviewed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product stability data (from the Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier or stability package) was formally reviewed as part of the impact assessment for this excursion. True = reviewed; False = not yet reviewed. Required for GCP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU GMP Annex 13

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this temperature excursion record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and incremental data processing in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: upper_threshold_c
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable storage temperature (in degrees Celsius) defined for the affected IMP, as specified in the kit definition or product stability data. Breach of this threshold constitutes a high-temperature excursion.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A(R2); EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211.166

products.name: accountability_reconciliation
products.description: Periodic drug accountability reconciliation record at the site level, capturing the reconciliation period, opening balance, receipts, dispensed quantities, returned quantities, destroyed quantities, closing balance, discrepancy count and detail, reconciliation status (open, reconciled, discrepancy-flagged), investigator sign-off, and CRA/monitor sign-off. Required at every monitoring visit and prior to database lock (DBL). Supports GCP §8.3.13 compliance, regulatory inspection readiness, and site close-out.
products.reference: Drug Accountability Reconciliation

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which this drug accountability reconciliation is conducted. Each reconciliation is site-specific and covers all IMP activity at that site for the defined period.

Linking accountability_reconciliation to subject_randomization enables per-

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.subject_visit_data. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation is performed per subject per visit. Linking accountability_reconciliation to subject_visit_data allows CRAs to confirm that eCRF data completeness and SDV status alig

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation is an ICH GCP essential TMF document (Section 8.3). The reconciliation record must link to its filed TMF document to support inspection readiness. inspection_ready_fl
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_closing_balance_units
attributes.description: Physical count of IMP units on hand at the site at the end of the reconciliation period, as verified by the site staff and/or CRA during the monitoring visit. This is the ground-truth inventory count.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); ISO 14155

attributes.name: adjusted_units
attributes.description: Net quantity adjustment applied to the reconciliation (positive or negative) to account for documented corrections such as data entry errors, kit relabeling, or sponsor-approved adjustments. Zero if no adjustments were made.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or contextual notes entered by the CRA, site staff, or data manager regarding this reconciliation. Supplements the discrepancy_detail field for general narrative.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: cra_signoff_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA / monitor signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation. Null if cra_signoff_flag is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: cra_signoff_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Research Associate (CRA) Monitor Sign-Off Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) / monitor has reviewed and signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation record. True = signed; False = pending. Required at every monitoring visit per ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this drug accountability reconciliation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: destroyed_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units destroyed at the site or returned to depot for destruction during the reconciliation period. Destruction must be documented per sponsor SOP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: discrepancy_count
attributes.description: Number of individual discrepancy line items identified during this reconciliation (e.g., missing kit, unaccounted return, dispensing record mismatch). Distinct from discrepancy_units which measures total quantity variance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: discrepancy_detail
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature, root cause, and resolution status of identified discrepancies. Captured by the CRA or site staff. Required when discrepancy_count > 0. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and CAPA documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: discrepancy_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current resolution status of identified discrepancies. 'not_applicable' = no discrepancy found; 'open' = discrepancy identified, investigation not started; 'under_investigation' = root cause analysis in progress; 'resolved' = discrepancy explained and documented; 'escalated' = referred to sponsor QA or regulatory authority.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: discrepancy_units
attributes.description: Quantity difference between expected_closing_balance_units and actual_closing_balance_units (actual minus expected). A non-zero value triggers discrepancy investigation. Positive = surplus; negative = shortage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: dispensed_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units dispensed to subjects at the site during the reconciliation period. Sourced from dispensing records in Medidata Rave RTSM and eCRF dispensing logs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: expected_closing_balance_units
attributes.description: Calculated expected closing balance: opening_balance_units + received_units - dispensed_units + returned_units - destroyed_units + adjusted_units. Used as the reference value against which the physical count is compared to identify discrepancies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: expired_units_count
attributes.description: Number of IMP units that had expired as of the reconciliation period end date. Expired units must be quarantined and destroyed per sponsor SOP; their presence in usable inventory constitutes a protocol deviation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: expiry_date_earliest
attributes.business_glossary_term: Earliest IMP Expiry Date on Site
attributes.description: The earliest expiry date among all IMP units currently on hand at the site as of the reconciliation period end date. Used to flag impending expiry risk and trigger resupply or destruction actions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.13.3; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation record is fully compliant with GCP §8.3.13 requirements (both investigator and CRA sign-offs obtained, no unresolved discrepancies, all required fields populated). True = compliant; False = non-compliant or pending.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: inspection_ready_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reconciliation record and its supporting documentation are complete and ready for regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.). True = inspection-ready; False = documentation gaps exist. Supports eTMF completeness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; EU CTR 536/2014; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: investigator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Principal Investigator (PI) who signed off on this reconciliation. Captured at time of sign-off for audit trail integrity per ALCOA+ principles. Confidential as it identifies a named professional in a regulatory context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.6.1; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: investigator_signoff_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) or delegated sub-investigator signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation. Null if investigator_signoff_flag is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: investigator_signoff_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) or delegated sub-investigator has reviewed and signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation record. True = signed; False = pending. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.6.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: next_reconciliation_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled due date for the next drug accountability reconciliation at this site for this IMP. Derived from the monitoring visit schedule or protocol-defined reconciliation frequency. Used for proactive compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5.18.4; Oracle Siebel CTMS Visit Tracking

attributes.name: opening_balance_units
attributes.description: The quantity of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) on hand at the site at the start of the reconciliation period. Carried forward from the closing balance of the prior reconciliation period or from the initial receipt if this is the first period.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Defines the closing boundary for all IMP transactions included in this reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Together with period_end_date, defines the window of IMP activity (receipts, dispensing, returns, destruction) being reconciled.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a)

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation was identified during this reconciliation (e.g., expired IMP dispensed, incorrect kit dispensed, dispensing outside visit window). True = deviation identified; False = no deviation. Triggers deviation reporting workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: received_units
attributes.description: Total quantity of IMP units received at the site from the depot or sponsor during the reconciliation period. Sourced from shipment receipt records in Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62(a); CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the drug accountability reconciliation was physically performed (i.e., the date of the physical count and record review). This is the principal business event date for this transaction, distinct from sign-off dates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this reconciliation record, typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS (e.g., RECON-SITE001-20240315). Used in monitoring reports, TMF filings, and regulatory inspection packages. Maps to the accountability record reference in Oracle Siebel CTMS and Medidata Rave RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §8.3.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC SDTM EX Domain

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the reconciliation record.
