attributes.name: analysis_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pharmacokinetic analysis methodology. Non-Compartmental Analysis (NCA) is standard for most Phase I studies; compartmental and population PK (PopPK) are used for Phase II/III. Bioequivalence (BE) applies to generic/biosimilar studies.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Population PK; EMA Guideline on PK Studies; ICH E9; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PK analysis specification was formally approved. Marks the transition from draft to approved status and establishes the effective date for analysis execution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: auc_extrapolation_pct_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable percentage of AUC0-inf attributable to extrapolation beyond the last measurable concentration (AUC_extrap%). Subjects exceeding this threshold (typically 20%) may have AUC0-inf excluded from analysis per regulatory guidance.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioequivalence; EMA Guideline on PK Studies; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: be_lower_bound_pct
attributes.description: Lower bound of the bioequivalence acceptance range expressed as a percentage of the reference geometric mean ratio (e.g., 80.00 for the standard 80-125% BE window). Applies when bioequivalence_flag is True.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioequivalence; EMA Guideline on Bioequivalence; ICH E9

attributes.name: be_upper_bound_pct
attributes.description: Upper bound of the bioequivalence acceptance range expressed as a percentage of the reference geometric mean ratio (e.g., 125.00 for the standard 80-125% BE window). Applies when bioequivalence_flag is True.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioequivalence; EMA Guideline on Bioequivalence; ICH E9

attributes.name: bioequivalence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PK analysis specification includes a formal bioequivalence (BE) assessment. True = BE criteria and confidence interval (CI) testing apply. Relevant for generic drug applications (ANDA) and biosimilar submissions.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioequivalence; EMA Guideline on Bioequivalence; ICH E9

attributes.name: blinding_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PK analysis is conducted under blinded, unblinded, or open-label conditions. Interim PK analyses for dose escalation decisions may be conducted unblinded by an independent DSMB/DMC while the main study remains blinded.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: ci_level_pct
attributes.description: Confidence level for the statistical interval estimate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 90.00 for 90% CI used in BE studies, 95.00 for standard efficacy analyses). Regulatory standard for BE is 90%.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioequivalence; EMA Guideline on Bioequivalence; ICH E9

attributes.name: ci_method
attributes.description: Statistical method used to construct the confidence interval for the primary PK parameter comparison. The two one-sided t-test (TOST) / 90% CI using a linear mixed-effects model is the regulatory standard for bioequivalence. Schuirmann's procedure is the classical BE test.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioequivalence; EMA Guideline on Bioequivalence; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 320

attributes.name: compartmental_model_type
attributes.description: Specifies the pharmacokinetic compartmental model structure used when compartmental or population PK analysis is selected. Drives model parameterization in Phoenix WinNonlin or NONMEM. Not applicable for pure NCA analyses.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Population PK; EMA Guideline on Reporting PK Studies; ICH E9

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PK analysis specification record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record integrity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dmpk_collaboration_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) Collaboration Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this PK analysis specification to the Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) team collaboration record, preclinical PK data package, or DMPK study report. Supports integrated PK/PD and translational PK reporting.
attributes.references: ICH S9; FDA Guidance on Population PK; EMA Guideline on DMPK Studies

attributes.name: dose_normalization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether PK parameters are to be dose-normalized (divided by administered dose) to enable cross-dose comparisons in multiple ascending dose (MAD) or dose-proportionality studies. True = dose normalization applied.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Population PK; EMA Guideline on Reporting PK Studies; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: dose_normalization_method
attributes.description: Method used to normalize PK parameters by dose when dose_normalization_flag is True. Actual dose uses the recorded administered dose; nominal dose uses the protocol-specified dose. Body weight and BSA normalization are used for oncology and pediatric studies.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Population PK; ICH E11 (Pediatric Studies); EMA Guideline on PK Studies

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this version of the PK analysis specification is effective and governs analysis execution. For versioned specifications, this date determines which version applies to a given analysis run.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: interim_analysis_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specification governs an interim PK analysis (e.g., for dose escalation decisions, DSMB review, or adaptive design triggers) as opposed to the final analysis. Interim analyses require additional blinding and data governance controls.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; EMA Reflection Paper on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: lambda_z_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Terminal Elimination Rate Constant (Lambda-z) Estimation Method
attributes.description: Method for selecting the terminal log-linear phase data points used to estimate the terminal elimination rate constant (Lambda-z / Kel) and derived parameters (t½, AUC0-inf). Best-fit uses automated regression; manual selection allows analyst override.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation; Phoenix WinNonlin User Guide; CDISC SDTM PP Domain

attributes.name: lambda_z_min_points
attributes.description: Minimum number of data points required in the terminal phase for Lambda-z estimation to be considered valid. Typically set to 3 per regulatory guidance. Specifications below this threshold result in flagged or excluded Lambda-z estimates.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation; Phoenix WinNonlin User Guide

attributes.name: lloq_handling_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Lower Limit of Quantification (LLOQ) Handling Method
attributes.description: Specifies how concentrations below the lower limit of quantification (LLOQ) are handled in the PK analysis dataset. Regulatory guidance typically requires setting pre-dose BLQ values to zero and post-dose BLQ values to zero or excluding them depending on context.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation; EMA Guideline on Bioanalytical Method Validation; CDISC SDTM PC Domain

attributes.name: log_transformation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether PK parameters are log-transformed prior to statistical analysis. Log-normal distribution is the regulatory default for AUC and Cmax in BE and PK studies per FDA and EMA guidance.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioequivalence; EMA Guideline on Bioequivalence; ICH E9

attributes.name: missing_concentration_rule
attributes.description: Rule applied when scheduled PK concentration timepoints are missing. Defines whether the subject is excluded from analysis, the timepoint is excluded, or imputation is applied. Last Observation Carried Forward (LOCF) imputation is used in specific contexts per the SAP.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM; FDA Guidance on Missing Data in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: nca_method
attributes.description: Specifies the trapezoidal integration rule applied during Non-Compartmental Analysis (NCA) for area-under-the-curve (AUC) estimation. Linear-up/log-down is the most common default in Phoenix WinNonlin for oral dosing studies.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation; CDISC SDTM PK Domain; Phoenix WinNonlin User Guide

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for biostatistician or DMPK analyst notes regarding special considerations, deviations from standard methodology, or sponsor-specific requirements for this PK analysis specification.
attributes.references: ICH E9; GCP ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: pk_parameters
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of pharmacokinetic parameters to be estimated in this analysis (e.g., AUC0-t, AUC0-inf, Cmax, Tmax, t½, CL, Vd, Vss, MRT, Kel). Defines the scope of PK endpoints reported in the CSR and regulatory submission. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AUC0_t|AUC0_inf|Cmax|Tmax|t_half|CL|Vd|Vss|MRT|Kel|F|ka|Cmin|Ctrough — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM PC/PP Domains; FDA Guidance on Bioanalytical Method Validation; ICH E3

attributes.name: pk_software
attributes.description: Software platform used to execute the PK analysis (e.g., Phoenix WinNonlin for NCA, NONMEM for population PK, SAS Drug Development for CDISC-compliant outputs). Documented for regulatory reproducibility per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Population PK; EMA Guideline on Reporting PK Studies

attributes.name: pk_software_version
attributes.description: Version of the PK analysis software used (e.g., Phoenix WinNonlin 8.3, SAS 9.4). Required for regulatory submission reproducibility and audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GCP ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Population PK

attributes.name: primary_pk_parameter
attributes.description: The single primary pharmacokinetic parameter designated as the principal endpoint for this analysis (e.g., AUC0-inf for bioavailability studies, Cmax for peak exposure). Drives the primary statistical comparison and sample size justification in the SAP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AUC0_t|AUC0_inf|Cmax|Tmax|t_half|CL|Vd|Vss — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Bioequivalence; EMA Guideline on PK Studies

attributes.name: r_squared_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum adjusted R-squared value required for the terminal phase regression used in Lambda-z estimation to be accepted (e.g., 0.8000). Estimates below this threshold are flagged for biostatistician review.
attributes.references: Phoenix WinNonlin User Guide; FDA Guidance on Population PK

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PK analysis outputs from this specification are intended for inclusion in a regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, or eCTD package). Triggers additional CDISC compliance validation and 21 CFR Part 11 audit requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Guidance; ICH M4

attributes.name: sampling_schedule_type
attributes.description: Classifies the blood sampling schedule design for PK data collection. Intensive sampling (rich PK) is used in Phase I; sparse/population sampling is used in Phase II/III for population PK modeling. Trough-only is used for therapeutic drug monitoring.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Population PK; EMA Guideline on Population PK; ICH E9

attributes.name: sdtm_pc_domain_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) PC Domain Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the CDISC SDTM Pharmacokinetics Concentrations (PC) domain dataset that serves as the source data for this PK analysis. Ensures traceability from raw concentration data through ADaM to TLF outputs per CDISC standards.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: spec_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to this PK analysis specification (e.g., PK-SPEC-001). Used for cross-referencing in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP), Clinical Study Report (CSR), and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM; ICH E3; FDA Guidance on Population PK

attributes.name: spec_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PK analysis specification. Controls which version is active for analysis execution. Transitions from draft through review to approved prior to database lock (DBL).
attributes.references: ICH E9; GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: spec_title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the PK analysis specification (e.g., 'Non-Compartmental PK Analysis for Study XYZ Phase I Single Ascending Dose'). Used for identification in SAS Drug Development and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM; ICH E3

attributes.name: spec_version
attributes.description: Version number of this PK analysis specification (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Supports versioning lifecycle as the specification evolves through SAP amendments and protocol updates.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide

attributes.name: study_design_type
attributes.description: Specifies the clinical study design relevant to PK analysis (e.g., crossover for BE studies, parallel for oncology PK, replicate crossover for highly variable drugs). Determines the statistical model structure for PK comparisons.

attributes.name: endpoint_type
attributes.description: Statistical nature of the endpoint variable. Determines the appropriate population-level summary measure and analysis methodology (e.g., continuous endpoints use mean difference; time-to-event use hazard ratio).

attributes.name: estimand_code

attributes.name: estimand_status

attributes.name: estimand_type

attributes.name: intercurrent_event_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific intercurrent event(s) addressed by this estimand (e.g., 'Discontinuation of study treatment due to adverse event', 'Initiation of rescue medication'). Provides regulatory-submission-ready documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Section 3.2; FDA Estimand Framework Guidance

attributes.name: intercurrent_event_strategy
attributes.description: The primary strategy applied to handle intercurrent events (ICEs) for this estimand, per ICH E9(R1) Section 3.2. Defines how post-ICE data are treated in the analysis (e.g., treatment policy ignores ICE occurrence; hypothetical posits ICE did not occur).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Section 3.2 — Strategies for Handling Intercurrent Events; EMA Reflection Paper on Estimands

attributes.name: interim_analysis_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this estimand is evaluated at one or more pre-specified interim analyses (e.g., for DSMB/DMC review, adaptive design decision points, or early stopping rules).
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; DSMB Charter; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_confirmatory
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this estimand is part of the confirmatory (inferential) testing hierarchy, as opposed to exploratory or descriptive analyses. Confirmatory estimands are subject to multiplicity control procedures defined in the SAP.

attributes.name: is_primary_endpoint
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this estimand corresponds to the study's primary endpoint. Primary endpoint estimands carry the highest regulatory weight and drive sample size calculations and confirmatory testing procedures.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Short human-readable label or title for the estimand (e.g., 'Primary Efficacy Estimand', 'Key Secondary Estimand 1'). Used in TLF headers, CSR statistical sections, and regulatory submission narratives.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); EMA Guideline on the Investigation of Subgroups in Confirmatory Clinical Trials

attributes.name: missing_data_strategy
attributes.description: The statistical strategy applied to handle missing outcome data for this estimand (e.g., Last Observation Carried Forward (LOCF), multiple imputation, mixed model for repeated measures). Distinct from the ICE strategy — addresses data gaps rather than post-ICE observations.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); NRC Panel on Handling Missing Data in Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Missing Data

attributes.name: multiplicity_adjustment_method
attributes.description: The statistical method used to control Type I error across multiple estimands or endpoints in the confirmatory testing hierarchy (e.g., 'Bonferroni', 'Hochberg', 'Hierarchical testing', 'Gatekeeping procedure'). Null if estimand is exploratory.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Multiple Endpoints in Clinical Trials; EMA Guideline on Multiplicity Issues

attributes.name: non_inferiority_margin
attributes.description: The pre-specified non-inferiority margin (delta) for this estimand, applicable when the effect direction is non-inferiority. Expressed in the units of the summary measure. Null for superiority or equivalence estimands.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Non-Inferiority Clinical Trials; EMA Guideline on the Choice of the Non-Inferiority Margin

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional biostatistician commentary, regulatory discussion points, or cross-references not captured in structured fields. Supports regulatory submission narrative preparation and internal review discussions.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); ICH E3 CSR Structure

attributes.name: population_level_summary
attributes.description: The 'Summary Measure' component of the ICH E9(R1) estimand framework — the statistical measure used to summarize the endpoint at the population level (e.g., 'Difference in means', 'Odds ratio', 'Hazard ratio', 'Difference in proportions').
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Section 3.1 — Summary Measure; CDISC ADaM; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

attributes.name: regulatory_framework

attributes.name: superseded_date

attributes.name: charter_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the DSMB/DMC charter that was in effect at the time of this meeting. The charter defines the committee's mandate, operating procedures, and stopping rules. Traceability to the applicable charter version is required for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: confidentiality_maintained
attributes.description: Confirms that the confidentiality of unblinded interim analysis data was maintained throughout the DSMB meeting process, with no unauthorized disclosure to sponsor or study team. Required attestation for blinding integrity audit trail.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DSMB meeting record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_cut_date
attributes.description: The date through which clinical data was included in the interim analysis data package reviewed at this meeting. Establishes the temporal boundary of the safety and efficacy data presented to the DSMB.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM; FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: etmf_document_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) Document Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the DSMB meeting minutes and associated documents as filed in the Veeva Vault eTMF system. Enables cross-system traceability between the biostatistics data product and the document management system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: independent_statistician_present
attributes.description: Indicates whether the independent (unblinded) statistician was present at the closed session of this DSMB meeting. The independent statistician's presence is required for valid interim analysis review per the DSMB charter.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E9; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: interim_analysis_data_package_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the unblinded interim analysis data package (ADaM datasets and TLFs) reviewed by the DSMB at this meeting. Ensures traceability to the exact data cut used for committee deliberations.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM IG; FDA DMC Guidance (2006); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E9

attributes.name: meeting_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the DSMB/DMC meeting was held or is scheduled to be held. Principal real-world event date for this transaction record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA DMC Guidance (2006); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: meeting_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the DSMB meeting in minutes, including both open and closed sessions. Used for meeting management reporting and resource planning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA DMC Guidance (2006)

attributes.name: meeting_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Meeting Identifier
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code or reference number assigned to this DSMB/DMC meeting (e.g., STUDY001-DSMB-003). Used in regulatory correspondence, meeting minutes, and TMF filing.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Clinical Trial Sponsors: Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Data Monitoring Committees (2006); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: meeting_location
attributes.description: Physical location or virtual platform where the DSMB meeting was conducted (e.g., city and venue for in-person meetings, or platform name for teleconferences). Documented in meeting minutes for audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA DMC Guidance (2006)

attributes.name: meeting_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal number of this DSMB/DMC meeting within the study (e.g., 1st, 2nd, 3rd meeting). Used to track the cadence of oversight activities across the study lifecycle.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: meeting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DSMB/DMC meeting record. Tracks whether the meeting has been scheduled, is in progress, has been completed, cancelled, or postponed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA DMC Guidance (2006); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: meeting_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meeting as a regularly scheduled review, an ad hoc convening triggered by a safety signal or sponsor request, or an emergency meeting. Drives agenda preparation and regulatory notification requirements.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: members_present_count
attributes.description: Number of DSMB/DMC voting members who attended this meeting. Used to verify quorum and document committee composition for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2); DSMB Charter

attributes.name: minutes_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DSMB meeting minutes were formally approved by the committee chair. Required for eTMF filing and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA DMC Guidance (2006); 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: minutes_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the DSMB meeting minutes document. Tracks the lifecycle from draft through committee review to final approval. Finalized minutes are filed in the eTMF and are subject to regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA DMC Guidance (2006); 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: next_meeting_date
attributes.description: Tentative or confirmed date for the next scheduled DSMB meeting as agreed upon at the conclusion of this meeting. Supports study oversight planning and timeline management.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: protocol_amendment_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DSMB recommendation from this meeting resulted in a protocol amendment being initiated (e.g., dose modification, stopping rule revision, sample size re-estimation). Links to the protocol amendment workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: quorum_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required quorum of DSMB/DMC members was present for the meeting to be considered valid per the DSMB charter. Meetings without quorum may require rescheduling or special procedures.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2); DSMB Charter requirements

attributes.name: recommendation
attributes.description: The formal recommendation issued by the DSMB/DMC following review of the interim data. Drives critical study-level decisions including continuation, modification, or termination. Regulatory agencies require documentation of all DSMB recommendations.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: recommendation_rationale
attributes.description: Narrative explanation of the scientific and safety basis for the DSMB recommendation. Captured in the closed session minutes and required for regulatory submissions and CSR documentation.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the required regulatory notification (e.g., IND safety report to FDA) was submitted following this DSMB meeting. Null if no regulatory notification was required.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; ICH E2A; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DSMB recommendation or findings from this meeting trigger a mandatory regulatory notification (e.g., IND safety report, SUSAR submission, protocol amendment). Drives regulatory affairs workflow.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; ICH E2A; EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA

attributes.name: sae_count_reviewed
attributes.description: Total number of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) included in the safety data package reviewed by the DSMB at this meeting. Provides a quantitative measure of the safety data scope presented.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; ICH E6(R2); MedDRA

attributes.name: session_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting session was open (sponsor representatives present), closed (committee members and unblinded statistician only), or executive (committee deliberation only). Critical for blinding integrity and regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; OHRP Regulations 45 CFR 46

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor was formally notified of the DSMB recommendation. Required for regulatory compliance tracking and audit trail. Must be within the timeframe specified in the DSMB charter.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: sponsor_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor has been formally notified of the DSMB recommendation following this meeting. Regulatory timelines for sponsor notification are defined in the DSMB charter and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: statistical_report_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the unblinded statistical report (produced in SAS Drug Development) submitted to the DSMB for this meeting. Distinct from the data package version; tracks the analysis output document.
attributes.references: SAS Drug Development; CDISC ADaM; FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E9

attributes.name: stopping_boundary_crossed
attributes.description: Indicates whether any pre-specified statistical stopping boundary (efficacy, futility, or safety) was crossed at this interim analysis. True triggers mandatory sponsor notification and potential protocol amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; FDA Adaptive Design Guidance; ICH E9(R1) Estimands

attributes.name: stopping_boundary_type
attributes.description: Specifies which type of pre-defined stopping boundary was crossed at this interim analysis, if any. Null or 'none' when no boundary was crossed. Informs the recommendation and regulatory notification pathway.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Adaptive Design Guidance; SAP alpha-spending framework

attributes.name: subjects_completed_at_review
attributes.description: Number of subjects who had completed the study treatment or observation period as of the data cut-off date. Used by the DSMB to assess study progress relative to the planned timeline.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM DS domain; FDA DMC Guidance (2006)

attributes.name: subjects_enrolled_at_review
attributes.description: Total number of subjects enrolled in the study as of the data cut-off date for this DSMB meeting. Provides context for the safety and efficacy data reviewed and supports sample size tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA DMC Guidance (2006); CDISC SDTM DM domain

attributes.name: unblinding_occurred
attributes.description: Indicates whether treatment assignment unblinding occurred for the purposes of this DSMB meeting's interim analysis. Critical for blinding integrity audit trail and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.5; FDA DMC Guidance (2006); 21 CFR Part 312.32; ICH E9

attributes.name: unblinding_scope
attributes.description: Describes the extent of unblinding performed for this meeting: full (all treatment arms revealed), partial (aggregate or selected data only), or none (blinded review only). Supports blinding integrity documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA DMC Guidance (2006); ICH E9(R1)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DSMB meeting record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

Serves as the authoritative catalog of all IRB/IEC-approved ICF versions, translations, and amendments per study and site. Source system: Veeva Vault (eTMF) and Clinpal (eConsent).

attributes.description: The date on which the back-translation quality review was completed and approved for this translated ICF version. Null for master language versions or translations where back-translation is not yet complete.

attributes.name: biobanking_consent_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ICF version includes optional or mandatory consent language for the collection, storage, and future use of biological samples (biobanking). Relevant for studies collecting samples for future exploratory research.

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal cognitive or decisional capacity assessment is required before a subject can be consented using this ICF version (e.g., for vulnerable populations, pediatric studies, or studies involving subjects with cognitive impairment).

attributes.name: clinpal_consent_form_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier assigned by Clinpal (eConsent platform) to the deployed electronic consent form corresponding to this ICF version. Enables reconciliation between the eTMF document record and the active eConsent workflow.

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consent form by its purpose in the subject enrollment lifecycle. 'initial' = first consent at enrollment; 're-consent' = required after protocol amendment or new safety information; 'assent' = minor subject assent form; 'lar' = Legally Authorized Representative consent; 'short_form' = abbreviated oral consent form; 'addendum' = supplemental consent for a specific procedure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: econsent_deployment_date

attributes.name: econsent_enabled

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this ICF version is authorized for use in obtaining subject consent. May equal or follow the IRB/IEC approval date. Subjects consented on or after this date must use this version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.description: The date after which this ICF version is no longer valid for obtaining new subject consent, typically aligned with the IRB/IEC continuing review approval expiry. Null if no expiry has been set or the version is superseded before expiry.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1.2; 21 CFR Part 56.109(e); OHRP 45 CFR 46.109(e)

attributes.name: gdpr_data_processing_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Processing Disclosure Included Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ICF version includes the required GDPR data processing disclosure and consent language for EU/EEA subjects, covering data controller identity, processing purposes, data subject rights, and cross-border transfer provisions.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 7, 13, 14; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28; EMA Guidance on GDPR in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: genetic_testing_consent_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ICF version includes specific consent language for genetic or genomic testing, as required by applicable regulations and IRB/IEC requirements for studies involving genetic data collection.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; GINA (Genetic Information Nondiscrimination Act); ICH E15; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_included

attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508; 21 CFR Part 50; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: icf_title

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8.2.3; Veeva Vault eTMF; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: icf_version_number
attributes.description: The official version number of the ICF as assigned by the sponsor or CRO (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', '3.0a'). Used to uniquely identify and reference the ICF version in regulatory submissions, IRB/IEC correspondence, and subject consent records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8.2.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; EMA ICF Guidance

attributes.name: internal_review_status

attributes.name: is_master_language
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ICF version is the master (source) language version from which translations are derived. True = this is the authoritative master language document; False = this is a translation derived from a master language version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF document management

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) indicating the language of this ICF version (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'ja', 'zh-CN'). Supports multi-language consent management for multinational trials.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; GDPR Article 7; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: lar_consent_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) Consent Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ICF version includes or supports consent by a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) on behalf of a subject who lacks decision-making capacity. Relevant for emergency research, pediatric studies, or cognitively impaired populations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.24; OHRP 45 CFR 46.408; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this ICF version record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: readability_grade_level
attributes.description: The assessed reading grade level of this ICF version (e.g., '6th grade', '8th grade') based on a standardized readability assessment (e.g., Flesch-Kincaid, Gunning Fog). Regulatory guidance recommends ICFs be written at an 8th grade reading level or below to ensure subject comprehension.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); OHRP Guidance; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2

attributes.name: reconsent_deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which all affected enrolled subjects must be re-consented using this ICF version, as specified by the IRB/IEC approval conditions or sponsor protocol. Null if re-consent is not required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; OHRP Guidance; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: reconsent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether currently enrolled subjects are required to be re-consented using this new ICF version. True = re-consent is mandatory for affected enrolled subjects; False = re-consent is not required (e.g., administrative or translation-only update).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance on Re-consent; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28

attributes.name: regulatory_basis_for_change
attributes.description: The regulatory or scientific rationale driving the ICF amendment (e.g., new safety signal from DSMB review, protocol design change, updated risk-benefit information, new IND safety report, SUSAR notification). Provides audit trail for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor (pharmaceutical or biotech company) formally approved this ICF version prior to IRB/IEC submission. Part of the internal quality control and document approval workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.8; GCP; MasterControl document approval workflow

attributes.name: superseded_date
attributes.description: The date on which this ICF version was superseded by a newer approved version. After this date, new subjects must be consented using the superseding version. Null if the version is still current.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Protocol Amendments and Informed Consent

attributes.name: tmf_reference_number
attributes.description: The TMF artifact reference number assigned to this ICF document per the TMF Reference Model (e.g., '04.01.01' for Informed Consent Forms). Enables systematic TMF completeness tracking and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 37; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: translator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified translator responsible for producing this translated ICF version. Applicable only for non-master-language versions. Required for translation quality audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; ISO 17100 Translation Services

attributes.name: vault_document_code
attributes.description: The unique document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault (eTMF) to the ICF document record. Enables direct traceability back to the source system document for audit and regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 37

attributes.name: vault_lifecycle_state
attributes.description: The document lifecycle state as managed within Veeva Vault eTMF, reflecting the document management workflow state. Distinct from the regulatory approval_status — this represents the eTMF system-level document state used for TMF completeness and inspection readiness tracking.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; TMF Reference Model; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 37

attributes.name: witness_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a witness signature is required on this ICF version in addition to the subject and investigator signatures (e.g., for illiterate subjects, subjects using a short form, or per local regulatory requirements).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

products.name: subject_consent
products.description: Core transactional record capturing the consent event for a trial subject at a specific site and study. Records the date and time of consent, ICF version consented to, consent method (paper, eConsent via Clinpal), consenting staff (PI, CRC), witness details, subject capacity assessment outcome, LAR (Legally Authorized Representative) involvement flag, and consent status (consented, withdrawn, re-consent pending, expired). This is the SSOT for subject-level consent status across the trial lifecycle.
products.reference: Subject Informed Consent / ICF Execution Record

attributes.name: subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the subject consent record. Primary key for the subject_consent data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: consent_icf_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific IRB/IEC-approved Informed Consent Form (ICF) version that was presented to and signed by the subject. Ensures traceability to the exact document version consented to.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: consenting_staff_study_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consenting Staff Study Assignment Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.study_assignment. Business justification: ICH E6(R2) requires that consenting staff have a valid, active study assignment at the time of consent. consenting_staff_study_assignment_id enables GCP compliance verification that the consenting emp
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: econsent_session_id
attributes.description: Unique session identifier from the Clinpal eConsent platform for this consent event. Enables direct traceability back to the eConsent audit trail in Clinpal for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature verification.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent (2016); Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualified study staff member (Principal Investigator or delegated Clinical Research Coordinator) who conducted the informed consent discussion and obtained the subject's signature.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.10; 21 CFR Part 50.27; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: ethics_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_approval. Business justification: Each subject consent must be obtained under a currently ethics-approved ICF version. Linking subject_consent to ethics_approval enables direct regulatory traceability confirming the governing approval
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: GCP requirement: consent obtained from a subject must reference the currently approved IRB/IEC approval in effect at consent date. Enables compliance verification that no subject was consented under a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lar_representative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.lar_representative. Business justification: subject_consent has denormalized lar_name and lar_relationship STRING fields. lar_representative is the master record for LARs associated with a subject. When a LAR is involved in a consent event (lar
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this consent was obtained. Links the consent record to the parent study protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TS Domain

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which the consent was obtained. Used for site-level consent compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The executed signed consent form is an essential TMF document (ICH E6 R2 Section 8). Site file completeness checks and TMF inspection readiness require tracing each subject_consent record to its filed
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (participant) who provided or withdrew consent. Core party reference for this consent transaction.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM Domain; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the subject decision-making capacity assessment. 'capable' = subject has full capacity to consent; 'incapable' = subject lacks capacity, LAR consent required; 'borderline' = capacity is uncertain, additional review required; 'not_applicable' = assessment not required for this subject.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal subject decision-making capacity assessment was performed prior to obtaining consent. Required for vulnerable populations and subjects with potential cognitive impairment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: comprehension_assessment_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal comprehension assessment (e.g., teach-back method, quiz) was administered to verify the subject understood the consent information. Increasingly required by IRBs and FDA for complex protocols.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2014); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.10; OHRP Guidance on Comprehension

attributes.name: comprehension_assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score from the comprehension assessment administered to the subject (e.g., percentage correct on a quiz). Populated when comprehension_assessment_performed is True. Used for quality metrics and IRB reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2014); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.10

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the subject (or LAR) signed or electronically acknowledged the Informed Consent Form. This is the principal real-world event date for the consent transaction and is used for protocol eligibility window calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.27; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; ALCOA+

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: Method by which informed consent was obtained. 'paper' = traditional wet-ink signature on paper ICF; 'econsent' = electronic consent via Clinpal eConsent platform; 'remote_econsent' = remote electronic consent (e.g., telemedicine); 'telephone' = verbal consent with witness (where permitted); 'legally_authorized_rep' = consent obtained via a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR).
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: consent_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this consent event, typically generated by the EDC or eConsent system (Clinpal). Used for cross-system traceability and audit referencing (e.g., CNST-2024-00123).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the subject's consent. Drives subject eligibility and study participation decisions. 'consented' = valid active consent; 'withdrawn' = subject revoked consent; 're_consent_pending' = amendment requires new signature; 'expired' = consent period lapsed; 'not_obtained' = consent process not yet completed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the consent signature or electronic acknowledgement was captured. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consent event. 'initial' = first consent for study participation; 're_consent' = repeat consent after protocol amendment; 'amendment' = consent to a specific protocol change; 'optional_procedure' = consent for an optional sub-study or procedure; 'genetic' = consent for genetic sample collection; 'long_term_followup' = consent for extended follow-up beyond main study. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial|re_consent|amendment|optional_procedure|genetic|long_term_followup|biobanking|companion_diagnostic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: consenting_staff_role
attributes.description: Role of the staff member who obtained consent. 'PI' = Principal Investigator; 'sub_investigator' = Sub-Investigator; 'CRC' = Clinical Research Coordinator; 'delegate' = other delegated staff member listed on the delegation log.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA Delegation of Authority

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: data_use_after_withdrawal
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Use After Withdrawal Permitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject explicitly permitted use of previously collected data after withdrawal of consent. Critical for GDPR right-to-erasure compliance and statistical analysis plan (SAP) decisions on data inclusion.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.3; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; HIPAA

attributes.name: econsent_completion_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the eConsent workflow modules completed by the subject in Clinpal (0.00–100.00). Used to track partial completions and identify subjects who did not fully review all consent materials before signing.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent (2016); Clinpal eConsent Platform; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.description: Legal basis under GDPR Article 9 for processing the subject's special category (health) data. 'explicit_consent' = subject provided explicit consent per Article 9(2)(a); 'vital_interests' = Article 9(2)(c); 'public_interest' = Article 9(2)(i) for scientific research; 'not_applicable' = non-EU subject.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; GDPR Article 6; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA Guidance on GDPR in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether a HIPAA Authorization for use and disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI) was obtained from the subject, as required for U.S. clinical trials. May be combined with or separate from the ICF.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.508; 21 CFR Part 50; FDA Guidance on HIPAA and Clinical Research

attributes.name: icf_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Informed Consent Form (ICF) IRB/IEC Approval Date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB or IEC approved the specific ICF version used for this consent event. Confirms that the consent was obtained using a currently approved document, a key GCP compliance check.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 9

attributes.name: icf_version_number
attributes.description: Human-readable version identifier of the ICF document presented to the subject at the time of consent (e.g., 'v2.1', 'Amendment 3'). Denormalized from the ICF version record for direct audit trail access without joins.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: lar_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) provided consent on behalf of the subject (e.g., for subjects who lack decision-making capacity, minors, or cognitively impaired individuals).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.3(l); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31

attributes.name: reconsent_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the subject must complete re-consent to remain eligible for continued study participation. Populated when reconsent_required is True. Drives site monitoring alerts.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring workflow

attributes.name: reconsent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is required to provide re-consent due to a protocol amendment, new safety information, or ICF version update. Triggers re-consent workflow in Clinpal.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent Amendments

attributes.name: reconsent_trigger
attributes.description: Reason that triggered the re-consent requirement. 'protocol_amendment' = protocol change affecting subject participation; 'safety_update' = new safety information impacting risk-benefit; 'icf_version_update' = new IRB-approved ICF version; 'irb_requirement' = IRB/IEC-mandated re-consent; 'regulatory_request' = regulatory authority request.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: sample_use_after_withdrawal
attributes.business_glossary_term: Biological Sample Use After Withdrawal Permitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject permitted continued use of previously collected biological samples (e.g., blood, tissue) after withdrawal of consent. Distinct from data_use_after_withdrawal as it governs physical biospecimen retention.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.3; GDPR Article 17; 21 CFR Part 50; EU Biobanking Regulations

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this consent record originated. 'Clinpal' = eConsent platform (primary source); 'Medidata_Rave' = EDC system; 'Oracle_Clinical_One' = study management platform; 'Oracle_Siebel_CTMS' = CTMS; 'manual' = manually entered record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Clinpal eConsent Platform; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: subject_questions_documented
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's questions and the investigator's responses were documented during the consent discussion, as required by GCP. Supports audit readiness and IRB inspection compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.10; 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: translation_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code of the ICF translation provided to the subject (e.g., 'es' for Spanish, 'fr' for French, 'zh-CN' for Simplified Chinese). Null if the ICF was provided in the site's primary language. Required for multi-lingual trial compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.6; 21 CFR Part 50.25; ISO 639-1; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Required for change tracking, audit trail completeness, and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject formally withdrew consent to participate in the study. Populated only when consent_status is 'withdrawn'. Triggers subject discontinuation workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.3; 21 CFR Part 50.25(a)(8); GDPR Article 7(3); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Primary reason for consent withdrawal as documented at the site. Used for subject disposition analysis and protocol feasibility reporting. Aligns with CDISC SDTM DS Domain disposition reason coding.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.3; CDISC SDTM DS Domain; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: witness_name
attributes.description: Full name of the impartial witness present during the informed consent process, where required. Captured when witness_required is True. Classified as confidential as it identifies a third-party individual in a clinical context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b)

attributes.name: witness_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a witness was required for this consent event (e.g., for illiterate subjects, subjects with limited reading ability, or verbal consent scenarios per ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b)

attributes.name: witness_signature_date
attributes.description: Date on which the impartial witness signed the ICF, confirming they witnessed the consent process. Must match or follow the subject's consent_date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b); ALCOA+

products.name: econsent_session
products.description: Tracks each eConsent workflow session initiated in Clinpal for a subject, including both on-site and remote/decentralized consent sessions. Captures session start and end timestamps, device type, IP address, session modality (in-person, remote via teleconference/video), communication platform for remote sessions, session recording reference, subject location, session status (in-progress, completed, abandoned, timed-out), subject authentication method, number of review steps completed, comprehension check results (question set version, individual responses, pass/fail per question, overall score, attempts, remediation steps), electronic signature capture timestamp, technical issues encountered, and Clinpal session reference ID. Supports 21 CFR Part 11, FDA remote consent guidance, and GDPR audit requirements.
products.reference: eConsent Session / Clinpal Session

attributes.name: econsent_session_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each eConsent workflow session initiated in Clinpal for a trial subject. Primary key for this data product.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: consent_icf_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific IRB/IEC-approved Informed Consent Form (ICF) version presented to the subject during this session. Ensures the correct, current consent document was used.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the site staff member (Principal Investigator or delegated Clinical Research Coordinator) who witnessed or facilitated the eConsent session. Required for GCP compliance and delegation log traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020)

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial site at which the subject is enrolled and where this consent session is associated. Supports site-level compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) for which this eConsent session was conducted. Enables study-level consent compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (participant) for whom this eConsent session was initiated. Links to the subject master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the capacity assessment performed for the subject. 'capable' indicates the subject has decision-making capacity; 'not-capable' indicates a legally authorized representative is required; 'not-assessed' indicates no assessment was conducted; 'deferred' indicates assessment was postponed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.20; OHRP Guidance; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal capacity assessment was performed for the subject prior to or during this consent session (True = performed; False = not performed). Required for vulnerable populations and subjects with potential cognitive impairment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: clinpal_session_ref
attributes.description: The native session identifier assigned by the Clinpal eConsent platform for this workflow session. Used for cross-system traceability and reconciliation with the source system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: communication_platform
attributes.description: The teleconference or video communication platform used for remote consent sessions (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, WebEx). Applicable only when session_modality is 'remote-video' or 'remote-phone'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Zoom|Teams|WebEx|Skype|Clinpal-Video|Phone|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: comprehension_attempt_number
attributes.description: The sequential attempt number for the comprehension check within this session. Subjects may be permitted multiple attempts after remediation. Tracks how many times the subject attempted the comprehension assessment.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: comprehension_check_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the comprehension check question set administered to the subject during this session. Ensures traceability to the specific validated question set used, as question sets may be updated with ICF amendments.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: comprehension_overall_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject passed the overall comprehension check for this session (True = passed; False = failed). Determined by comparing the score against the minimum passing threshold defined in the ICF version.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: comprehension_questions_passed
attributes.description: Number of comprehension check questions answered correctly by the subject in this session. Used to compute the overall comprehension score and determine pass/fail outcome.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: comprehension_questions_total
attributes.description: Total number of comprehension check questions administered to the subject in this session. Used to calculate the comprehension score and assess understanding of the consent content.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: consent_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject (or legally authorized representative) granted informed consent at the conclusion of this session (True = consent granted; False = consent not granted or declined). The definitive consent outcome flag for this session.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 50; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; GDPR Article 7; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: consenter_role
attributes.description: The role of the individual who provided consent during this session. 'subject' indicates the participant themselves; 'legally-authorized-representative' indicates a proxy consenter; 'parent' or 'guardian' applies to pediatric studies. Required for capacity assessment and consent validity determination.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 50.25; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when this eConsent session record was first created in the data platform. Supports ALCOA+ (Attributable, Contemporaneous) audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5(2); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: device_os
attributes.description: Operating system and version of the device used during the eConsent session (e.g., iOS 16.4, Android 13, Windows 11). Supports technical audit trail and system validation requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020)

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of device used by the subject to access and complete the eConsent session. Supports technical audit trail requirements and device compatibility analysis.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020)

attributes.name: esignature_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether an electronic signature was successfully captured from the subject (or legally authorized representative) during this session (True = captured; False = not captured). A prerequisite for consent to be considered legally valid under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.50; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: esignature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when the subject's electronic signature was captured in Clinpal. Critical for ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous) compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail. Null if no signature was captured.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.50; ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: interpreter_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether a language interpreter was used during the consent session (True = interpreter used; False = no interpreter). Relevant for non-English-speaking subjects and required for GCP documentation of consent comprehension.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016)

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device used by the subject during the eConsent session. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records audit trail and GDPR accountability. May be considered PII in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.10; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA Security Rule

attributes.name: irb_approval_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board (IRB) / Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) Approval Reference
attributes.description: The IRB or IEC approval number or reference associated with the ICF version used in this session. Confirms the consent document presented was approved by the appropriate ethics body at the time of the session.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56; ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: reconsent_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this session was initiated as a re-consent event (True) rather than an initial consent (False). Re-consent is triggered by protocol amendments, new safety information, or ICF version updates requiring subjects to re-affirm consent.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28

attributes.name: remediation_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether remediation (additional educational content or re-review of ICF sections) was provided to the subject following a failed comprehension check attempt (True = remediation was provided; False = not provided).
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: remediation_steps_count
attributes.description: Number of remediation steps (re-review sections or educational modules) completed by the subject following a failed comprehension check. Null if no remediation was provided.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: review_steps_completed
attributes.description: The number of ICF review steps (content sections) the subject completed during this session. Compared against review_steps_total to assess session progress and identify drop-off points.
attributes.references: Clinpal eConsent Platform; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: review_steps_total
attributes.description: The total number of review steps (content sections or pages) defined in the ICF version presented during this session. Used to calculate completion percentage and identify where subjects abandoned the session.
attributes.references: Clinpal eConsent Platform; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when the eConsent session concluded, regardless of outcome (completed, abandoned, timed-out, or declined). Null if the session is still in-progress.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: session_language
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the language in which the eConsent session was conducted (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr-CA'). Ensures the subject received consent information in their preferred language, as required by GCP and GDPR.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25(b); GDPR Article 7; IETF BCP 47

attributes.name: session_modality
attributes.description: The mode by which the consent session was conducted. 'in-person' indicates the subject and site staff were physically co-located; 'remote-video' indicates a teleconference/video call; 'remote-phone' indicates a telephone-only session; 'hybrid' indicates a combination. Supports FDA remote consent guidance compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: session_recording_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the recording of the remote consent session (e.g., stored in Veeva Vault or a secure media repository). Applicable for remote sessions where recording is required per FDA remote consent guidance. Null for in-person sessions.
attributes.references: FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when the eConsent session was initiated by the subject or site staff in Clinpal. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the eConsent workflow session. 'in-progress' indicates an active session; 'completed' indicates the subject finished all steps; 'abandoned' indicates the subject exited without completing; 'timed-out' indicates the session expired due to inactivity; 'declined' indicates the subject explicitly refused consent.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: subject_auth_method
attributes.description: The method used to authenticate the subject's identity at the start of the eConsent session. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 identity verification requirements for electronic signatures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: password|otp-sms|otp-email|biometric|pin|site-staff-verified — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.100; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: subject_location_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the subject was physically located at the time of the eConsent session. Relevant for decentralized trials and cross-border GDPR/HIPAA compliance determination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; HIPAA; ISO 3166-1; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020)

attributes.name: technical_issue_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of any technical issue encountered during the session (e.g., 'Video connection dropped at step 3', 'Signature pad unresponsive'). Null if no technical issue was encountered. Supports deviation investigation and CAPA processes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: technical_issue_encountered
attributes.description: Indicates whether any technical issue (connectivity failure, platform error, device malfunction, signature capture failure) was encountered during the session (True = issue encountered; False = no issues). Supports root cause analysis for incomplete sessions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Remote Consent Guidance (2020); Clinpal eConsent Platform

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when this eConsent session record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5(2); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: witness_esignature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) when the site staff witness (PI or CRC) applied their electronic countersignature to the consent record. Required for GCP-compliant consent documentation. Null if witness signature was not captured in this session.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.50; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50

Drives re-consent workflow management across sites.

attributes.name: affected_icf_version_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affected Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Number
