attributes.description: The total number of subjects at the site (or study-wide, per subject_scope) who are required to be re-consented as a result of this trigger. Used for site workload planning and sponsor oversight reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring; FDA Guidance on Protocol Amendments

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject's mental capacity to provide informed consent was formally assessed. Nullable when capacity_assessment_required is False. Required for vulnerable population compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the mental capacity assessment for the subject. Determines whether the subject can provide direct consent or whether a legally authorized representative (LAR) must consent on their behalf.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; Mental Capacity Act 2005 (UK)

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a mental capacity assessment is required before re-consent can be obtained from this subject, applicable for vulnerable populations or subjects with cognitive impairment. Triggers capacity assessment workflow when True.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; Mental Capacity Act 2005 (UK)

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The method by which re-consent was or will be obtained from the subject. Drives regulatory compliance checks and audit trail requirements. Values: electronic (eConsent via Clinpal), paper (wet-ink signature), verbal_with_witness (emergency/capacity situations), remote_electronic (remote eConsent), legally_authorized_representative (LAR consent for incapacitated subjects).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.27; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this re-consent trigger record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance. Distinct from trigger_date which represents the real-world event date.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this re-consent trigger was escalated to the sponsor, CRA, or regulatory authority. Nullable when escalation_required is False. Used for compliance tracking and CAPA initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl CAPA tracking

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this re-consent trigger has been escalated to the sponsor, CRA, or regulatory authority due to non-compliance, overdue status, or subject refusal. Triggers escalation workflow and sponsor notification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring; FDA Guidance on Clinical Investigator Responsibilities

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Date
attributes.description: The date on which the IRB or IEC approved the updated ICF version that subjects must sign. Establishes the earliest permissible date for initiating re-consent at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1.2; 21 CFR Part 56.109; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 4

attributes.name: issuing_regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority that issued the directive requiring re-consent, when trigger_type is 'regulatory_authority_requirement'. Values: FDA (U.S. Food and Drug Administration), EMA (European Medicines Agency), PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency), MHRA (Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency), TGA (Therapeutic Goods Administration), Health_Canada, other. attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, site communications, or contextual information related to this re-consent trigger that is not captured in structured fields. Supports audit trail completeness per ALCOA+ principles.

attributes.name: previous_icf_version_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Previous Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version Number
attributes.description: The version number of the ICF that the subject had previously signed before this re-consent trigger was raised. Enables version-to-version change tracking and audit trail completeness per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_raised
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation has been raised in the compliance system as a result of failure to re-consent within the required timeframe. When True, links to the compliance.protocol_deviation product for CAPA tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312.62; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: reconsent_completed_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the subject was successfully re-consented and signed the updated ICF. Nullable until re-consent is completed. Used to calculate cycle time and compliance metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.27; ALCOA+ principles; Clinpal eConsent

attributes.name: reconsent_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which re-consent must be obtained from the subject, as mandated by the IRB/IEC approval, regulatory authority, or sponsor protocol. Used to calculate overdue status and drive site escalation workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50; IRB/IEC approval conditions; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: reconsented_subject_count
attributes.description: The number of subjects who have been successfully re-consented to date against this trigger. Compared against affected_subject_count to track completion progress and identify outstanding re-consents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring; Clinpal eConsent

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_directive_ref
attributes.description: The reference number or identifier of the regulatory authority directive (e.g., FDA clinical hold letter, EMA variation request, PMDA query) that mandated this re-consent. Nullable for non-regulatory triggers. Required for regulatory submission traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42 (FDA Clinical Hold); EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; EU CTR 536/2014; PMDA Pharmaceutical Affairs Law

attributes.name: reminder_count
attributes.description: The total number of reminder notifications sent to the site for this re-consent trigger. Used to assess site responsiveness and determine when escalation is warranted per sponsor oversight SOPs.

attributes.name: reminder_sent_date

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the re-consent trigger. Drives operational dashboards and site follow-up. Values: pending (trigger raised, re-consent not yet initiated), in_progress (re-consent process underway), completed (subject successfully re-consented), waived (re-consent waived with documented IRB/IEC justification), overdue (deadline passed without completion), cancelled (trigger voided, e.g., subject discontinued).

attributes.name: subject_scope
attributes.description: Defines the population of subjects affected by this re-consent trigger. attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject whose mental capacity to provide informed consent is being assessed. Links to the subject master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the formal mental capacity assessment was conducted. This is the principal real-world event date for the assessment, distinct from the record creation timestamp. Required for GCP compliance and ALCOA+ data integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this capacity assessment, typically generated by the CTMS or eConsent system (Clinpal). Used for cross-system referencing, audit trails, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Formal determination of the subject's mental capacity to provide informed consent. Drives downstream consent workflow: Capable proceeds to standard ICF signing; Incapable triggers LAR (Legally Authorized Representative) requirement; Borderline may require re-assessment or specialist review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.1; 21 CFR Part 50.3(l); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; Mental Capacity Act 2005 (UK)

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score produced by the assessment tool (e.g., MMSE score out of 30, MacCAT-CR subscale score). Provides quantitative evidence supporting the capacity determination outcome.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; CDISC CDASH; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: assessment_score_max
attributes.description: Maximum possible score for the assessment tool used, providing context for interpreting the assessment_score. Required when multiple tools with different scales are used across sites.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; CDISC CDASH Standards

attributes.name: assessment_setting
attributes.description: Mode in which the capacity assessment was conducted: In-Person at the investigative site, Remote via telehealth/eConsent platform (Clinpal), or Hybrid. Relevant for regulatory acceptability and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Remote Clinical Trials; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capacity assessment record. Drives workflow routing in Clinpal and CTMS. Superseded indicates a newer assessment has replaced this one for the same subject-study combination.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 11; Clinpal eConsent Workflow

attributes.name: assessment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the capacity assessment was performed. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements and audit trail integrity per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: assessment_tool
attributes.description: Name or code of the standardized tool, instrument, or method used to evaluate mental capacity (e.g., MacCAT-CR, MMSE, ACE-III, clinical interview, structured questionnaire). Supports methodological consistency and IRB/IEC reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50 Subpart B; OHRP Guidance on Vulnerable Populations

attributes.name: assessment_tool_version
attributes.description: Version or edition of the assessment tool or instrument used. Ensures reproducibility and comparability of assessments across sites and time points.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; CDISC CDASH Standards

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment within the subject's consent lifecycle: Initial (first assessment at screening), Re-Assessment (triggered by condition change or borderline outcome), Periodic (scheduled interval), Post-Amendment (following protocol or ICF amendment), or Withdrawal (assessing capacity to withdraw consent).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: assessor_credentials
attributes.description: Professional credentials or qualifications of the assessor (e.g., MD, PhD, RN, NP) as documented at the time of assessment. Supports regulatory verification of assessor competency.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; ISO 14155

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified individual who conducted the capacity assessment, captured at the time of assessment for audit trail completeness. Retained as a denormalized field to preserve historical accuracy even if personnel records change.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: assessor_role
attributes.description: Professional role or qualification of the individual who conducted the capacity assessment. Determines the regulatory acceptability of the assessment per GCP and applicable local regulations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Principal Investigator|Sub-Investigator|Study Physician|Psychiatrist|Psychologist|Nurse Practitioner|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.1; 21 CFR Part 50; ISO 14155 Section 6.4

attributes.name: assessor_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the assessor applied their electronic signature to the capacity assessment record, as required by 21 CFR Part 11 for electronic records. Distinct from the assessment_timestamp (when the assessment occurred).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional clinical observations, contextual notes, or qualifications related to the capacity assessment that are not captured in structured fields. Supports comprehensive documentation per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this capacity assessment record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements and audit trail integrity per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: interpreter_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether a language interpreter was used during the capacity assessment. Relevant for GCP compliance and assessment validity documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB/IEC was notified of the capacity assessment outcome. Populated when irb_iec_notification_required is True. Used for regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56.108; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 9

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outcome of this capacity assessment requires notification to the IRB/IEC (e.g., enrollment of an incapable subject, use of LAR consent). Drives regulatory reporting workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 9; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: language_of_assessment
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code indicating the language in which the capacity assessment was conducted (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'zh-CN'). Ensures the subject was assessed in their primary language per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; ISO 639; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: lar_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) is required to provide consent on behalf of the subject due to incapacity or borderline capacity determination. Triggers LAR consent workflow in Clinpal eConsent system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 50.3(l); ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.12; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: outcome_basis
attributes.description: Narrative description of the clinical and factual basis for the capacity determination, including observations, test scores, and reasoning. Required for regulatory defensibility and IRB/IEC reporting. Supports ALCOA+ attributable and accurate principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance; Mental Capacity Act 2005 (UK)

attributes.name: reassessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which a follow-up capacity re-assessment must be completed. Populated when reassessment_required is True. Used for site monitoring and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: reassessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up capacity re-assessment is required, typically triggered by a borderline outcome, change in subject condition, protocol amendment, or regulatory requirement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance on Continuing Review

attributes.name: reassessment_trigger
attributes.description: Reason or event that triggered the requirement for a capacity re-assessment. Supports audit trail and IRB/IEC reporting on re-consent and re-assessment activities.
attributes.value_regex: Borderline Outcome|Change in Condition|Protocol Amendment|Regulatory Requirement|Scheduled Interval|Other
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this capacity assessment record originated (e.g., Clinpal eConsent, Oracle Clinical One, Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.value_regex: Clinpal|Oracle Clinical One|Medidata Rave|Oracle Siebel CTMS|Manual
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; CDISC Data Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this capacity assessment record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail completeness and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: vulnerability_category
attributes.description: Classification of the type of vulnerability applicable to the subject. Drives additional regulatory safeguards and IRB/IEC reporting requirements. Populated when vulnerable_population_flag is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Cognitive Impairment|Psychiatric Disorder|Minor|Prisoner|Pregnant|Economically Disadvantaged|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 1.61; 21 CFR Part 50 Subpart D; 45 CFR Part 46 Subparts B-D; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: vulnerable_population_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject is classified as a member of a vulnerable population (e.g., cognitively impaired, prisoner, pregnant, minor, economically disadvantaged) requiring additional consent protections per GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 1.61; 21 CFR Part 50 Subpart D; EU CTR 536/2014 Articles 31-32; OHRP 45 CFR Part 46

attributes.name: witness_name
attributes.description: Full name of the impartial witness present during the capacity assessment and consent process. Populated when witness_required is True. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: witness_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an impartial witness was required to be present during the capacity assessment and consent process, as mandated for illiterate subjects or those with specific vulnerabilities per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.27(b); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

products.name: withdrawal
products.description: Records the formal withdrawal of informed consent by a subject or their LAR. Captures withdrawal date and time, withdrawal reason category (voluntary, AE-related, sponsor decision, lost to follow-up), subject-stated reason free text, withdrawal type (full withdrawal, withdrawal from treatment only, withdrawal from data use), post-withdrawal data handling instructions per protocol, notifying staff, and downstream impact flags (e.g., safety follow-up required, data retention status). SSOT for consent withdrawal events.
products.reference: Consent Withdrawal / Subject Withdrawal of Consent

attributes.name: withdrawal_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the consent withdrawal event record. Primary key for the consent_withdrawal data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: compliance_protocol_deviation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.protocol_deviation. Business justification: Consent withdrawals can trigger protocol deviations (e.g., subject withdraws mid-treatment requiring deviation reporting). consent_withdrawal has protocol_deviation_triggered flag but no FK to the spe
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the site staff member (Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) or Clinical Research Associate (CRA)) who received and documented the withdrawal notification. Supports ALCOA+ attributability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles; Oracle Siebel CTMS staff record

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial site where the subject was enrolled and where the withdrawal is being processed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; Oracle Siebel CTMS site record

attributes.name: lar_representative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consent.lar_representative. Business justification: consent_withdrawal has lar_name (STRING) and lar_relationship (STRING) as denormalized fields for cases where a LAR initiates withdrawal on behalf of the subject. Linking to lar_representative normali
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: When a subject withdraws consent, the IRT randomization record must be cancelled. consent_withdrawal already flags irt_randomization_cancelled as a boolean; replacing this with a direct FK to subject_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (participant) who is withdrawing consent. Links to the subject master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; CDISC SDTM DM domain

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal decision-making capacity assessment was performed for the subject prior to processing the withdrawal, particularly relevant for vulnerable populations or subjects with cognitive impairment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; 21 CFR Part 50.55; OHRP guidance; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or notes entered by site staff or the sponsor regarding the withdrawal event, circumstances, or follow-up actions required. Supplements the structured withdrawal reason fields.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this consent withdrawal record was first created in the system, per ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements. Distinct from the withdrawal_timestamp which captures the real-world event time.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5.3; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: ctms_withdrawal_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Withdrawal Reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier for this withdrawal event in Oracle Siebel CTMS, enabling reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational CTMS system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: data_retention_status
attributes.description: Current status of the subject's data retention following withdrawal. Tracks whether data has been retained, anonymized, or destroyed in accordance with post_withdrawal_data_handling instructions and applicable privacy regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.530; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: edc_subject_status_updated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) Subject Status Updated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's status in the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (Medidata Rave) has been updated to reflect the withdrawal, ensuring downstream data collection is halted appropriately.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Identifies the party who formally initiated the withdrawal: 'subject' (the enrolled participant), 'lar' (Legally Authorized Representative acting on behalf of the subject), 'investigator' (Principal Investigator or site physician), 'sponsor' (study sponsor or CRO), 'regulatory_authority' (FDA, EMA, or other governing body mandate).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50.25; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) must be notified of this withdrawal event per protocol or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 56.108; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_notified_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB or IEC was formally notified of the consent withdrawal, when notification was required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.3; 21 CFR Part 56.108; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: itt_population_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the impact of this withdrawal on the subject's inclusion in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) analysis population: 'included' means the subject remains in ITT per SAP rules; 'excluded' means the subject is removed from ITT; 'pending_review' means biostatistics team review is required.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC ADaM ADSL; SAP guidelines

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this consent withdrawal record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.5.3; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

attributes.name: pi_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the Principal Investigator (PI) was formally notified of the consent withdrawal event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: pi_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) has been formally notified of the subject's withdrawal of consent, as required by GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: post_withdrawal_data_handling
attributes.description: Specifies how previously collected subject data must be handled following withdrawal, per protocol and applicable regulations. 'retain_all' allows retention of all data collected prior to withdrawal; 'retain_safety_only' retains only safety-relevant data; 'destroy_all' requires deletion of all subject data; 'anonymize' requires de-identification; 'per_protocol' defers to the protocol-specific data handling plan.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.524; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent withdrawal event triggered a protocol deviation that must be reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: reason_category
attributes.description: Standardized categorical classification of the primary reason for withdrawal. 'voluntary' indicates subject-initiated without specific cause; 'adverse_event_related' indicates withdrawal driven by an Adverse Event (AE) or safety concern; 'sponsor_decision' indicates sponsor or regulatory authority-mandated withdrawal; 'lost_to_follow_up' indicates subject is unreachable; 'protocol_non_compliance' indicates withdrawal due to protocol deviation; 'physician_decision' indicates investigator-initiated withdrawal for medical reasons. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary|adverse_event_related|sponsor_decision|lost_to_follow_up|protocol_non_compliance|physician_decision — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; CDISC SDTM DS domain DSDECOD; MedDRA coding

attributes.name: reconsent_attempted
attributes.description: Indicates whether site staff attempted to re-consent the subject before the withdrawal was finalized, for example by providing additional information or addressing concerns.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: reconsent_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the re-consent attempt: 'successful' indicates the subject agreed to continue and withdrawal was rescinded; 'unsuccessful' indicates the subject maintained the withdrawal decision; 'not_attempted' indicates no re-consent was attempted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: safety_follow_up_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which safety follow-up activities must continue for the subject post-withdrawal, as defined by the protocol. Applicable when safety_follow_up_required is true.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: safety_follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject requires ongoing safety follow-up activities (e.g., SAE reporting, survival follow-up) after withdrawal of consent, as mandated by the protocol or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ICH E2A; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject was formally discontinued from the study following consent withdrawal. Used for Intent-to-Treat (ITT) and Per Protocol (PP) population analyses.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS domain; ICH E9 Statistical Principles

attributes.name: subject_stated_reason
attributes.description: Free-text verbatim reason for withdrawal as stated by the subject or their Legally Authorized Representative (LAR). Captured to support ALCOA+ attributability and regulatory audit requirements. May contain sensitive personal context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.3; ALCOA+ principles; CDISC SDTM DS domain DSTERM

attributes.name: tmf_filing_status
attributes.description: Status of the withdrawal documentation filing in the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) in Veeva Vault: 'pending' indicates documents are awaiting upload; 'filed' indicates documents have been uploaded; 'verified' indicates QC review of the filing is complete.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF; EU CTR 536/2014; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: treatment_stop_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject's investigational treatment was discontinued as a result of the consent withdrawal. May differ from the withdrawal_timestamp for treatment_withdrawal type.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; CDISC SDTM EX domain; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: withdrawal_method
attributes.description: The medium through which the withdrawal was communicated and documented: 'electronic' via Clinpal eConsent platform, 'paper' via signed paper form, 'verbal' with documented witness, 'telephone' with documented confirmation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 11; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: withdrawal_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this withdrawal event, typically generated by the eConsent system (Clinpal) or CTMS (Oracle Siebel). Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: withdrawal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the withdrawal record. 'pending' indicates the withdrawal has been initiated but not yet formally confirmed; 'confirmed' indicates the withdrawal is complete and binding; 'rescinded' indicates the subject reversed the withdrawal and re-consented; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a subsequent withdrawal event; 'archived' indicates the record has been closed out.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7(3)

attributes.name: withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the subject or their Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) formally communicated withdrawal of consent. This is the principal real-world event time per GCP requirements and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.3; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: withdrawal_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the scope of the withdrawal: 'full_withdrawal' means the subject withdraws from all study activities and data use; 'treatment_withdrawal' means withdrawal from investigational treatment only while allowing continued data collection; 'data_use_withdrawal' means the subject requests no further use of their data; 'future_sample_withdrawal' means withdrawal of consent for future use of biological samples.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; GDPR Article 7(3); HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

products.name: audit_entry
products.description: Immutable audit trail record for every create, update, or status change event on consent domain records (subject consent, ICF version, eConsent session, withdrawal, etc.). Captures event timestamp, event type (created, signed, amended, withdrawn, re-consented, voided, status_changed), actor user ID and role, source system (Clinpal, Veeva Vault, CTMS), previous and new field values, applicable ICF version at time of change, digital signature hash, and IP address. Provides complete chronological consent status history per subject-study-site combination. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity requirements, 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance, GCP audit trail obligations, and regulatory inspection queries about subject consent history.
products.reference: Consent Audit Trail / GCP Audit Log

attributes.name: audit_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each immutable consent audit trail record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the consent_audit_entry data product. Role: EVENT_LOG.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: consent_icf_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific IRB/IEC-approved Informed Consent Form (ICF) version that was in effect at the time of this audit event. Critical for demonstrating that the correct consent version was used.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; document.document_icf_version

attributes.name: econsent_session_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Clinpal eConsent session during which this audit event occurred. Links the audit entry to the specific electronic consent workflow session for end-to-end eConsent traceability.
attributes.references: Clinpal eConsent Platform; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8

attributes.name: primary_audit_employee_id
attributes.description: System user identifier of the individual who performed the consent action that triggered this audit entry. Satisfies ALCOA+ Attributable requirement and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature attribution. Sourced from Clinpal or Veeva Vault user registry.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(d); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ALCOA+ (Attributable)

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which the consent event occurred. Enables study-level audit trail aggregation and regulatory inspection queries.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the consent event took place. Required for site-level GCP monitoring and IRB/IEC jurisdiction tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: subject_consent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent subject consent record that was created or modified by this audit event. Provides the link between the audit entry and the consent lifecycle record it documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject whose consent record was affected by this audit event. Links to the subject master entity for subject-level consent history queries.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; CDISC SDTM USUBJID

attributes.name: actor_full_name
attributes.description: Full name of the user who performed the consent action, captured at the time of the event for human-readable audit trail display. Stored as confidential business data to support regulatory inspection readiness without exposing unnecessary PII.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(d); ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ (Attributable)

attributes.name: actor_role
attributes.description: Clinical role of the user who performed the consent action (e.g., Principal Investigator (PI), Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC), subject, Legally Authorized Representative (LAR)). Required for GCP accountability and regulatory inspection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PI|CRC|CRA|subject|LAR|sponsor_monitor|data_manager|system — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: affected_record_reference
attributes.description: Surrogate identifier of the specific consent domain record (subject_consent, icf_version, econsent_session, etc.) that was created or modified by this audit event. Used in conjunction with affected_record_type to locate the exact record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Attributable); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: affected_record_type
attributes.description: Identifies the type of consent domain record that was created or modified by this audit event (e.g., subject_consent, icf_version, econsent_session, withdrawal). Enables filtering audit entries by consent entity type during regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: The protocol amendment number that necessitated the ICF update or re-consent event captured in this audit entry. Populated for event_type = 'amended' or 're_consented'. Links consent changes to specific protocol amendments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.30; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the subject's mental capacity assessment conducted prior to or during the consent process. Populated for events involving capacity evaluation. Determines whether direct consent or LAR consent pathway applies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.55; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the consent record was modified (e.g., DATA_ENTRY_ERROR, PROTOCOL_AMENDMENT, SUBJECT_REQUEST, SYSTEM_CORRECTION). Supports ALCOA+ Attributable requirement and audit trail completeness for regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Attributable, Accurate); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9.3

attributes.name: change_reason_text
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explanation provided by the actor for the consent record modification. Complements change_reason_code with additional context. Required by ALCOA+ and GCP for any post-entry modification to clinical data.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Attributable); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9.3

attributes.name: changed_field_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific data field on the consent record that was modified by this audit event. Null for creation events where no prior value exists. Supports granular field-level audit trail as required by ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Accurate, Original); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the ICF version presented to the subject at the time of this consent event (e.g., 'en', 'fr-FR', 'es-ES'). Confirms the subject received consent information in their understood language.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; ISO 639-1

attributes.name: consent_method
attributes.description: The modality through which consent was obtained for this event (e.g., paper ICF, Clinpal eConsent, remote eConsent via video). Relevant for regulatory submissions and site monitoring to confirm GCP-compliant consent procedures.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: consent_status_after
attributes.description: The overall consent status of the subject-study-site combination immediately after this audit event was applied. Together with consent_status_before, provides a complete state transition record for regulatory inspection and GCP compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: consent_status_before
attributes.description: The overall consent status of the subject-study-site combination immediately before this audit event. Provides a high-level consent lifecycle snapshot independent of field-level changes. Enables chronological consent status history reconstruction per subject.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: device_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device (tablet, computer, mobile) used to perform the consent action. Relevant for eConsent sessions via Clinpal where device-level traceability is required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(d); Clinpal eConsent Platform; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: digital_signature_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash of the electronic signature applied to the consent record at the time of this audit event. Validates the integrity and non-repudiation of the electronic consent signature per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Sourced from Clinpal eConsent platform.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.70; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.9; ESIGN Act

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the consent domain event occurred in the source system. This is the real-world event time, distinct from the record ingestion timestamp. Mandatory for ALCOA+ contemporaneous data integrity and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous)

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Discriminator classifying the nature of the consent domain event captured in this audit record. Drives regulatory reporting and consent status history reconstruction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: created|signed|amended|withdrawn|re_consented|voided|status_changed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Lawful Basis
attributes.description: The GDPR Article 6/9 lawful basis under which the subject's personal data is processed in connection with this consent event. Required for EU/EEA trial sites to demonstrate lawful processing of special category health data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 9(2)(a); EU CTR 536/2014; EMA Policy 0070

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a HIPAA Authorization for use and disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI) was obtained as part of this consent event. Applicable for US trial sites. Required for HIPAA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.508; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the consent action was performed. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance by providing network-level attribution for each consent event. May be considered PII under GDPR.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(d); GDPR Article 4(1); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Number
attributes.description: The IRB or IEC approval reference number associated with the ICF version in effect at the time of this audit event. Confirms that the consent was obtained under a currently approved protocol version, as required by GCP and FDA/EMA regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 10

attributes.name: is_void
attributes.description: Indicates whether this audit entry has been voided due to a system error or data correction. Voided entries are retained for regulatory completeness but excluded from active consent status calculations. Supports ALCOA+ Enduring data integrity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Enduring, Available); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: lar_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) to the subject when consent was obtained via a surrogate (e.g., parent, legal guardian, spouse). Populated when actor_role = 'LAR'. Required for vulnerable population consent documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.55; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The value of the changed field after this audit event was applied. Stores the resulting state for the modified field. Required for before/after comparison in regulatory inspections and ALCOA+ data integrity verification.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Accurate); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9

attributes.name: previous_value
attributes.description: The value of the changed field immediately before this audit event was applied. Null for record creation events. Stored as STRING to accommodate any field type. Required for before/after comparison in regulatory inspections and ALCOA+ Original data integrity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Original); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9

attributes.name: re_consent_trigger_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason that triggered a re-consent requirement for the subject (e.g., protocol amendment, new safety information, ICF version update). Populated only for event_type = 're_consented' or 'status_changed' to re_consent_required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25; OHRP Guidance on Re-Consent

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit entry record was first ingested into the Silver Layer lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp (the real-world event time). Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous, Available); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this audit entry record in the Silver Layer. Since consent audit entries are immutable by design, this field is expected to remain null after initial load; populated only for void corrections or metadata updates.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ (Enduring, Available); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: signature_meaning
attributes.description: The declared meaning associated with the electronic signature captured at this audit event (e.g., 'I agree', 'Witnessed', 'Approved'). Required by 21 CFR Part 11.50 to associate a meaning with each electronic signature in the audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.50; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.9

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record that generated this audit event (e.g., Clinpal for eConsent workflows, Veeva Vault for ICF document management, Oracle Siebel CTMS for site management). Enables cross-system audit trail reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ (Original)

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier assigned by the originating source system (Clinpal, Veeva Vault, CTMS) for this audit event. Enables traceability back to the system of record for data lineage and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Original, Attributable); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why this audit entry was voided. Populated only when is_void = True. Maintains a complete and transparent audit trail even for corrected records, as required by ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Attributable, Enduring); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason provided by the subject or their Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) for withdrawing consent. Populated only for event_type = 'withdrawn'. Required for subject safety follow-up and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 50.25(a)(8); GDPR Article 7(3)

products.name: lar_representative
products.description: Master record for a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) associated with a trial subject who lacks capacity to consent independently. Stores LAR full name, relationship to subject, contact details, legal authority documentation type and reference, jurisdiction of authority, authorization start and end dates, and verification status. Required for pediatric trials, cognitively impaired populations, and emergency research settings per 21 CFR 50.25 and ICH E6.
products.reference: LAR / Legally Authorized Representative

attributes.name: lar_representative_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) master record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.25; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: legal_authority_tmf_document_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legal Authority Tmf Document Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The legal authority document (power of attorney, guardianship order) authorizing the LAR must be on file in the TMF as an essential document for vulnerable subject protection. legal_authority_document
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this LAR authorization is applicable. Scopes the LAR record to a specific trial protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the subject is enrolled and where the LAR authorization is operative.

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject for whom this LAR is authorized to provide consent. Links the LAR record to the subject master.

attributes.name: verified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: LAR legal authority verification must be performed by a qualified employee per GCP and IRB requirements for vulnerable population protection. verified_by is a plain text denormalization; verified_by_e
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: authorization_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR's legal authority to consent on behalf of the subject expires or is terminated. Null indicates open-ended authority. Used to enforce consent eligibility checks.

attributes.name: authorization_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR's legal authority to consent on behalf of the subject became effective. Defines the beginning of the valid consent authorization window.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the LAR's legal authorization to consent on behalf of the subject. Drives consent workflow eligibility in Clinpal eConsent and Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.25; ICH E6(R2) 4.8; GCP

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal assessment of the subject's decision-making capacity was conducted, confirming the need for LAR consent. Required for regulatory documentation in pediatric and cognitively impaired populations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.3(l); ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the formal capacity assessment determining the subject's ability to provide independent informed consent. Drives the requirement for LAR consent and re-assessment scheduling.

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal capacity assessment was required to establish the subject's inability to consent independently, thereby necessitating LAR involvement. True for cognitively impaired or pediatric populations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the LAR master record was first created in the system, conforming to ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) data integrity principles. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 5.5.3; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: ctms_lar_record_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) LAR Record ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the LAR record in Oracle Siebel CTMS. Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the CTMS operational system for site monitoring and visit tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 5.5; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: econsent_platform_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the LAR record in the Clinpal eConsent platform. Used for cross-system traceability between the Silver layer lakehouse and the operational eConsent system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 5.5.3; ALCOA+

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email address of the Legally Authorized Representative. Used for eConsent workflow notifications via Clinpal, re-consent triggers, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the Legally Authorized Representative as it appears on their government-issued identification or legal authority document.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR 50.3(l)

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRB/IEC Approval Required for LAR Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific IRB (Institutional Review Board) or IEC (Independent Ethics Committee) approval was required for the use of LAR consent procedures for this subject population at this site.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 56; ICH E6(R2) 3.1; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The legal jurisdiction (country, state, or province) under whose laws the LAR's authority document was issued and is recognized. Governs applicable legal standards for LAR validity (e.g., US-CA, US-NY, GBR, DEU).
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.3(l); EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name or surname of the Legally Authorized Representative as it appears on their government-issued identification or legal authority document.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR 50.3(l)

attributes.name: legal_authority_document_date
attributes.description: Date on which the legal authority document (e.g., court order, power of attorney) was issued or became effective. Used to validate currency of authorization.

attributes.name: legal_authority_document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal instrument that establishes the LAR's authority to consent on behalf of the subject (e.g., court order, power of attorney, guardianship certificate). Required for regulatory compliance per 21 CFR 50.3(l).
attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.3(l); ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: mailing_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the LAR's mailing address (street number and name). Used for postal correspondence, regulatory notifications, and ICF delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; 21 CFR 50.25

attributes.name: mailing_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the LAR's mailing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Supplements address line 1 for complete postal delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the LAR's mailing address. Required for complete postal address and jurisdictional determination.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the LAR's mailing address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA) and legal authority standards.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the LAR's mailing address. Required for complete postal address and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: mailing_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the LAR's mailing address. Used for jurisdictional compliance and postal delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Legal middle name or initial of the Legally Authorized Representative as recorded on official identification documents. May be null if not applicable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for site staff to record additional observations, special circumstances, or contextual information about the LAR's authorization that are not captured in structured fields. Subject to ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8; GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: population_category
attributes.description: Classification of the vulnerable population category that necessitates LAR consent for this subject. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and IRB/IEC conditions.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_method
attributes.description: The LAR's preferred channel for receiving communications from the site, including re-consent notifications and study updates. Drives outreach workflow in Clinpal and Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8; GCP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code representing the LAR's preferred language for consent documentation and communications (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'fr-CA'). Ensures ICF is provided in a language the LAR understands per GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.9; 21 CFR 50.25(b); GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for contacting the Legally Authorized Representative. Used for re-consent notifications, safety communications, and site follow-up.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514; ICH E6(R2) 4.8

attributes.name: re_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a re-consent process is required for this LAR due to a protocol amendment, new safety information, or ICF version update. Triggers re-consent workflow in Clinpal.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; 21 CFR 50.25; GCP; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: re_consent_trigger_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why re-consent is required from the LAR. Drives re-consent workflow prioritization and regulatory documentation in the eConsent system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; 21 CFR 50.25; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the LAR's legal or familial relationship to the trial subject (e.g., parent, legal guardian, healthcare proxy). Determines the basis of legal authority. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent|legal_guardian|spouse|adult_child|sibling|healthcare_proxy|court_appointed|power_of_attorney|next_of_kin — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: secondary_phone
attributes.description: Alternate telephone number for the Legally Authorized Representative, used when the primary phone is unreachable. Supports continuity of contact for consent and safety communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.514

attributes.name: subject_assent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject's assent was obtained alongside the LAR's consent. Applicable for pediatric or partially capacitated subjects. Null if assent was not required or not obtained.

attributes.name: subject_assent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject's assent (agreement to participate, distinct from formal consent) was obtained in addition to the LAR's consent. Applicable for pediatric subjects with developing capacity per 21 CFR 50.55.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the LAR master record. Used for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) 5.5.3; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR's identity and legal authority documentation were verified by authorized site personnel (PI or CRC). Required for GCP audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the site staff's verification of the LAR's identity and legal authority documentation. Tracks whether the CRC or PI has confirmed the LAR's credentials per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.12; GCP; 21 CFR 50.25; ALCOA+

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the LAR withdrew their consent authorization on behalf of the subject, or the date on which the LAR's authority was formally revoked. Triggers subject withdrawal workflow.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for the withdrawal of the LAR's consent authorization or revocation of legal authority. Required for regulatory reporting and subject safety follow-up.

products.name: icf_amendment
products.description: Tracks amendments to an approved ICF version, capturing the amendment number, amendment date, nature of change (safety update, protocol change, administrative correction), regulatory authority requiring the amendment, IRB/IEC submission date and approval date, affected subject population (all enrolled, newly enrolling only), and re-consent obligation flag. Links to the parent ICF version and the resulting new ICF version. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and TMF completeness.
products.reference: ICF Amendment / Informed Consent Form Amendment

attributes.name: icf_amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the ICF amendment record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: authored_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: ICF amendment authorship must be traceable to a qualified employee per ICH E6(R2) for TMF and regulatory inspection. authored_by is a plain text denormalization of the employee; replacing it with auth

attributes.name: clinpal_workflow_id
attributes.description: The workflow identifier assigned by the Clinpal eConsent system for the re-consent or new consent workflow triggered by this amendment. Enables traceability between the amendment record and the eConsent execution.
attributes.references: Clinpal eConsent Platform; FDA Guidance on Use of Electronic Informed Consent; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: consent_icf_version_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Resulting Informed Consent Form (ICF) Version ID
attributes.description: Reference to the new ICF version produced as a result of this amendment. Null until the amended ICF version is formally approved and issued.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Veeva Vault eTMF document versioning

attributes.name: investigator_brochure_safety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.investigator_brochure_safety. Business justification: IB safety updates with new risk information directly trigger ICF amendments per ICH E6 GCP. icf_amendment has `safety_related` flag and `protocol_version_reference` text but no FK to the IB safety rec

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: Regulatory requirement: every ICF amendment must receive IRB/IEC approval before implementation. Direct FK to site.irb_iec_approval enables traceability from amendment to its authorizing approval reco
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Every ICF amendment is driven by a protocol amendment requiring IRB/IEC resubmission. Regulatory affairs tracks this link for TMF completeness, submission traceability, and inspection readiness. proto
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: safety_communication_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to safety.safety_communication. Business justification: Safety-related ICF amendments are directly triggered by safety communications (e.g., SUSAR letters, urgent safety measures). icf_amendment has a `safety_related` boolean but no FK to the triggering sa
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: superseded_by_amendment_icf_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subsequent amendment that supersedes this one, if applicable. Null for the current active amendment. Enables full amendment lineage chain reconstruction for regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; Veeva Vault eTMF; TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: affected_subject_population
attributes.description: Defines which subject population is required to undergo re-consent as a result of this amendment. Drives the re-consent workflow in Clinpal and determines the scope of CRA site monitoring activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; OHRP; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world date on which the amendment was formally initiated or authored. Serves as the primary business event date for the amendment lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known sequential identifier for the amendment (e.g., AM-001, AM-002). Used in regulatory submissions, IRB/IEC correspondence, and TMF filing to uniquely reference the amendment within the study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: amendment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the ICF amendment. Tracks progression from initial drafting through IRB/IEC submission, approval or rejection, and eventual supersession by a subsequent amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of change driving the amendment. attributes.references: 21 CFR 50.55; ICH E6(R2) 4.8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_outcome

'capable' = subject can provide assent; 'incapable' = subject cannot provide assent (assent waived); 'partially_capable' = limited capacity, assent obtained with accommodations; 'deferred' = assessment deferred pending further evaluation.

attributes.name: capacity_assessment_performed

attributes.description: Full name of the qualified professional (e.g., physician, psychologist) who performed the capacity assessment. Retained for audit and regulatory inspection purposes.

attributes.name: comprehension_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consenter confirmed that the subject demonstrated adequate understanding of the study and their rights before assent was obtained. Core GCP requirement for valid assent.

attributes.name: consenter_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified study team member (e.g., CRC, sub-investigator) who administered the assent process and documented the subject's assent.

attributes.name: consenter_role
attributes.description: Role of the study team member who administered the assent. Must be a qualified individual delegated on the site delegation log per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; 21 CFR 312.62; GCP Delegation Log

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this assent record was first created in the system. Part of the ALCOA+ audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.

attributes.name: eassent_platform

attributes.name: interpreter_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether a language interpreter was used during the assent process. When True, interpreter details must be documented in the site source records.

attributes.name: language_code

attributes.name: questions_asked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject asked questions during the assent discussion, and whether those questions were answered to the subject's satisfaction. Documents the interactive nature of the assent process per GCP.

attributes.name: reconsent_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which re-assent must be obtained from the subject or their guardian. Drives compliance monitoring and site follow-up activities in Oracle Siebel CTMS.

attributes.name: reconsent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a re-assent is required for this subject, triggered by a protocol amendment, new safety information, updated assent form version, or the subject reaching the age of majority.

attributes.name: sdv_date

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Status of Source Data Verification (SDV) for this assent record, performed by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) during site monitoring visits. Tracks whether the assent documentation has been verified against source records.

attributes.name: source_document_location

attributes.name: subject_age_group
attributes.description: ICH E11 pediatric age group classification of the subject at time of assent. Used for regulatory reporting and pediatric study compliance. Values align with ICH E11(R1) age band definitions.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this assent record. Required for audit trail completeness per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subject withdrew their assent. Populated only when assent_status is 'withdrawn'. Triggers subject discontinuation workflow in the EDC and CTMS.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the subject or guardian for withdrawing assent. Retained for regulatory reporting and subject safety follow-up.

attributes.name: witness_name
attributes.description: Full name of the impartial witness present during the assent process. Required when the subject cannot read or when verbal assent is documented. Null if no witness was required.

attributes.name: witness_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the witness to the subject. Must be impartial and independent per GCP requirements. Used to verify no conflict of interest in the assent witnessing process.

attributes.name: witness_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a witness was required for the assent process, typically when the subject is illiterate, assent is verbal, or applicable regulations mandate a witness.
