attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Date
attributes.description: The date on which the HIPAA Authorization was signed by the data subject or their legally authorized representative. Null if HIPAA authorization is not applicable.

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Expiry Date
attributes.description: The date on which the HIPAA Authorization expires, if a specific expiration date was stated. Null if the authorization is open-ended or not applicable.

attributes.name: hipaa_authorization_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Authorization Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a HIPAA Authorization (45 CFR 164.508) is required for this data subject in addition to GDPR consent, applicable for US-based subjects or US-covered entities. True = HIPAA authorization required.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.502

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Reference
attributes.description: The IRB or IEC approval reference number for the privacy notice and data processing consent form version used. Confirms that the consent documentation was reviewed and approved by the ethics committee.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) 3.1; OHRP 45 CFR 46; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 4; FDA 21 CFR 56

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction applicable to this consent record (e.g., 'EU', 'US', 'UK', 'JP', 'AU'). Determines which privacy regulation (GDPR, HIPAA, UK GDPR, APPI, Privacy Act) governs the data processing consent.
attributes.references: GDPR; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508; MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The GDPR Article 6 lawful basis under which personal data is processed. 'consent' applies when the data subject has given explicit consent; other bases apply per applicable regulatory context. Required for GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing Activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 9(2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: notice_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country subtag) of the privacy notice delivered to the data subject (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'ja', 'en-US'). Ensures the notice was provided in the subject's native language.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(1); EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2

attributes.name: primary_research_consent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Research Data Processing Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has consented to processing of their personal data for the primary clinical research purpose of the study (e.g., efficacy and safety analysis). True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 9(2)(j); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28

attributes.name: privacy_notice_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the privacy notice was delivered to the data subject prior to or at the time of consent. Required to demonstrate compliance with GDPR transparency obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; GDPR Article 14

attributes.name: privacy_notice_delivery_method
attributes.description: The method by which the privacy notice was delivered to the data subject. Supports audit evidence for GDPR transparency compliance. Values: paper, electronic (e.g., Clinpal eConsent), verbal (with written record), email, portal.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; GDPR Article 14; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: privacy_notice_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the privacy notice (per GDPR Articles 13/14) delivered to the data subject at the time of consent. Enables tracking of which notice version was in effect when consent was obtained.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; GDPR Article 14; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: re_consent_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the data subject completed the re-consent process following a re-consent trigger. Null if re-consent has not yet been completed.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2

attributes.name: re_consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject is required to provide fresh data processing consent due to a material change in processing purposes, privacy notice amendment, or protocol amendment. True = re-consent workflow must be initiated.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 32; ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: re_consent_trigger_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason that triggered the re-consent requirement, such as a protocol amendment, updated privacy notice, new data processing purpose, or change in data controller. Null if re_consent_required is False.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICH E6(R2) 4.8.2; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 28

attributes.name: recontact_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has consented to being re-contacted for future studies, follow-up research, or additional data collection after the current study concludes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 13(2)(a); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: rights_request_response_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Subject Rights Request Response Date
attributes.description: The date on which the organization responded to the data subject's rights request. Must be within 30 days of the request per GDPR Article 12(3). Null if no rights request has been submitted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12(3); GDPR Article 12(4)

attributes.name: rights_request_status
attributes.description: Current status of any outstanding data subject rights request (access, erasure, restriction, portability) associated with this consent record. 'none' if no rights request has been submitted.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 12; GDPR Articles 15-20

attributes.name: secondary_research_consent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secondary Research Data Processing Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has consented to use of their data for secondary research purposes beyond the primary study objective (e.g., exploratory analyses, future research). True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 89; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: subject_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the data subject formally acknowledged receipt and understanding of the privacy notice. May differ from consent_date if acknowledgment precedes formal consent signature.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 13; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the data subject has consented to sharing of their personal data with third parties (e.g., sponsors, regulatory authorities, CRO partners, academic institutions). True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 46; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this data processing consent record was last modified. Tracks amendments, status changes, and withdrawal events for audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the data subject withdrew their data processing consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Triggers downstream data erasure or restriction workflows per GDPR Article 17.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); GDPR Article 17; HIPAA 45 CFR 164.508(b)(5)

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the data subject for withdrawing data processing consent. Supports regulatory reporting and subject rights management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this translated ICF version is authorized for use in subject consent activities at the applicable site. Typically aligned with IRB/IEC approval date or sponsor authorization date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; GCP; FDA 21 CFR 50

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this translated ICF version requires separate IRB/IEC approval in the applicable country or region. True = local ethics committee approval is required before use at site.

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Status
attributes.description: Current approval status of this translated ICF version with the relevant IRB or IEC. 'not_submitted' = pending submission; 'submitted' = under review; 'approved' = ethics committee approved; 'rejected' = not approved; 'waived' = formal approval waived by authority.

attributes.name: irb_iec_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Name
attributes.description: Name of the IRB or IEC responsible for reviewing and approving this translated ICF version. Supports multi-site trials where different ethics committees govern different countries.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.1; FDA 21 CFR 56; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: quality_review_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal quality review (QC check) of the translated ICF has been completed by the sponsor, CRO, or designated reviewer. True = QC review passed. Supports GCP quality assurance requirements.

attributes.name: quality_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the quality review of the translated ICF was completed. Null if quality review has not yet been performed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; ALCOA+; MasterControl

attributes.name: readability_grade_level
attributes.description: Descriptive grade level or reading age equivalent of the translated ICF (e.g., '6th grade', 'B1 CEFR'). Supports compliance with FDA and EMA guidance that consent documents be understandable to the lay population.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); EMA; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: readability_score
attributes.description: Numeric readability score of the translated ICF document (e.g., Flesch-Kincaid or equivalent localized readability metric). Regulatory guidance recommends ICF documents be written at an appropriate reading level for the target population.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: reconciliation_notes

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; ALCOA+; FDA 21 CFR 50

attributes.name: region_name

attributes.name: source_icf_version_number

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; FDA 21 CFR 50

attributes.name: source_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter code representing the original language of the ICF document prior to translation (e.g., 'en' for English). Establishes the translation direction.

attributes.name: sponsor_approval_date

attributes.name: target_language_code

attributes.name: target_language_name

attributes.name: deviation_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the specific type of informed consent process failure. Examples: consent obtained after study procedures began (consent_after_procedure), an expired ICF version was used (expired_icf_version), required witness signature was absent (missing_witness_signature), re-consent was not completed within the required timeframe (reconsent_not_completed), or a subject capacity assessment was not documented (capacity_assessment_missing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: consent_after_procedure|expired_icf_version|missing_witness_signature|reconsent_not_completed|capacity_assessment_missing|incomplete_icf_elements|lag_in_reconsent|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; FDA Guidance on Informed Consent (2016); EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the consent deviation was first identified or discovered, whether by site staff, a Clinical Research Associate (CRA) during monitoring, or through a data review. Distinct from the date the deviation occurred.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18; 21 CFR Part 312.62; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: impact_assessment
attributes.description: Narrative assessment of the actual or potential impact of the consent deviation on subject rights, subject safety, data integrity, and study validity. Informs the regulatory reportability determination and severity classification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Oversight of Clinical Investigations; EMA GCP Inspection Findings

attributes.name: inspection_ready
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this consent deviation record and all associated documentation (CAPA, notifications, re-consent records) are complete and ready for regulatory inspection review. Supports inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA Inspection Readiness; EMA GCP Inspection Findings; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was formally notified of this consent deviation. Nullable if notification has not yet occurred or is not required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3.7; 21 CFR Part 56.108; OHRP 45 CFR 46

attributes.name: irb_iec_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notified Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study has been formally notified of this consent deviation, as required by GCP and applicable regulations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3.7; 21 CFR Part 56.108; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 52; OHRP 45 CFR 46

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the consent deviation actually occurred (e.g., the date the study procedure was performed before consent was obtained, or the date the expired ICF was signed). This is the principal real-world event date, distinct from the discovery date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: pi_aware
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the Principal Investigator (PI) at the site has been made aware of this consent deviation. PI awareness is a GCP requirement for site-level deviation management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.60; FDA Guidance on Investigator Responsibilities

attributes.name: pi_awareness_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was formally made aware of this consent deviation. Used to track timeliness of PI notification and GCP compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 312.60

attributes.name: preventive_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of preventive actions planned or implemented to prevent recurrence of this type of consent deviation (e.g., site retraining on ICF version control, system alert configuration in Clinpal for ICF expiry). Complements the formal CAPA record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl CAPA; ISO 9001 preventive action

attributes.name: reconsent_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the required re-consent process was completed and the subject signed the appropriate ICF version. Nullable if re-consent is not required or has not yet been completed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; Clinpal eConsent; 21 CFR Part 50

attributes.name: reconsent_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the subject must undergo a re-consent process as a corrective action for this deviation (e.g., signing the current approved ICF version to replace an expired version that was used).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.25; Clinpal eConsent re-consent workflow

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this consent deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, etc.), IRB/IEC, or sponsor per applicable regulations and the study protocol. Drives regulatory submission workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 52; EMA GCP Inspection Findings

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent deviation was formally reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority as applicable. Used to calculate reporting timeliness and compliance with notification windows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; 21 CFR Part 312.66; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 52

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consent deviation was fully resolved, including completion of any required corrective actions (e.g., re-consent obtained, missing signatures collected, CAPA closed). Nullable until resolution is achieved.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; MasterControl CAPA closure; FDA Inspection readiness

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Documented root cause analysis narrative explaining the underlying reason the consent deviation occurred (e.g., site staff training gap, ICF version control failure, system notification failure for re-consent trigger). Used to drive CAPA development and prevent recurrence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA CAPA guidance; MasterControl root cause analysis module

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Structured categorical classification of the root cause to enable trend analysis across deviations. Categories include training deficiencies, process failures, system issues, communication breakdowns, and oversight gaps.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.20; FDA Quality Systems Guidance; ISO 9001 root cause classification

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Risk-based severity classification of the consent deviation. Critical deviations may directly impact subject rights, safety, or data integrity and typically require immediate escalation and regulatory reporting. Major deviations have significant impact on GCP compliance. Minor deviations have limited impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Oversight of Clinical Investigations (2013); EMA GCP Inspection Findings

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this consent deviation record originated (e.g., MasterControl for quality events, Clinpal for eConsent workflow deviations, Oracle Siebel CTMS for monitoring-identified deviations). Supports data lineage in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ data provenance; Databricks Silver Layer lineage

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., MasterControl deviation record number, Clinpal event ID). Enables reverse traceability from the lakehouse back to the system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ data provenance; Databricks Silver Layer lineage

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the study sponsor was formally notified of this consent deviation. Used to calculate notification timeliness against contractual and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: sponsor_notified
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this consent deviation per the Clinical Trial Agreement and GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5.2; Oracle Siebel CTMS monitoring workflow

attributes.name: subject_continued_in_study
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the affected subject continued participation in the clinical study following the consent deviation and any required corrective actions. A value of False may indicate subject withdrawal or discontinuation related to the deviation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: subject_rights_impacted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the consent deviation directly impacted the rights or welfare of the trial subject (e.g., subject underwent a procedure without valid informed consent). Critical for regulatory reportability and IRB/IEC notification decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50; GDPR Article 9; OHRP guidance on unanticipated problems

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent deviation record. Used for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

domains.name: randomization
domains.description: Manages subject allocation algorithms, stratification factors, randomization codes, blinding integrity, and unblinding procedures. Integrated with eCRF and supply domains for kit assignment and treatment arm allocation via IRT/IVRS/RTSM systems.

products.name: rand_scheme
products.description: Master definition of a randomization scheme for a clinical study. Captures the allocation algorithm type (simple, block, stratified, minimization, adaptive), block sizes, allocation ratio, seed values, and scheme version. Owned by the biostatistics/RTSM team and referenced by all randomization activities. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave RTSM module.
products.reference: RTSM Randomization Scheme

Business justification: The rand_scheme.regulatory_submission_flag, geographic_scope, and irb_iec_approval_required are directly governed by the sponsor's regulatory strategy. attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this randomization scheme is defined. Links the scheme to its parent protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM TA Domain

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization scheme was activated in the IRT/RTSM system and made available for subject allocation. Marks transition to 'active' status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: allocation_algorithm
attributes.description: The statistical randomization algorithm used to assign subjects to treatment arms. 'simple' = unrestricted random; 'block' = fixed block sizes; 'stratified_block' = blocks within strata; 'minimization' = dynamic balancing; 'adaptive' = response-adaptive; 'covariate_adaptive' = covariate-adaptive randomization.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: allocation_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of subjects allocated to each treatment arm (e.g., '1:1', '2:1:1', '1:1:1'). Defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) and protocol. Drives kit assignment quantities in RTSM.
attributes.references: ICH E9; SAP; Oracle Clinical One RTSM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization scheme received formal biostatistics and QA approval, authorizing its use in the study. Marks transition from 'draft' to 'approved' status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual (QA or biostatistics lead) who formally approved the randomization scheme. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Blinding level applied to this randomization scheme. Determines who has access to treatment arm assignments and governs unblinding procedures. Critical for blinding integrity management.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.5; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: block_size_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of permissible block sizes used in block or stratified-block randomization (e.g., '4,6,8'). Variable block sizes reduce predictability. Null for non-block algorithms.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: cdisc_sdtm_domain
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM domain code associated with randomization data derived from this scheme (typically 'RAND' or 'SUPPRAND'). Supports SDTM submission package preparation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD Submission Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this randomization scheme record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: generation_method_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the randomization list generation methodology, including algorithm parameters, SAS/R procedure used, and any special considerations. Included in the Randomization Plan and CSR.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM; SAP

attributes.name: generation_software
attributes.description: Name and version of the software used to generate the randomization list (e.g., 'SAS 9.4', 'R 4.2.1', 'Oracle Clinical One 21.3'). Required for regulatory submission and reproducibility validation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of 3-letter ISO country codes where this randomization scheme is applicable (e.g., 'USA,GBR,DEU'). Relevant for multi-regional trials with country-specific regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E9; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA IND; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a scheme amendment requires re-submission to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). Relevant when stratification factors or allocation ratios change.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: irt_scheme_reference
attributes.description: The scheme identifier or configuration reference as recorded in the IRT/RTSM system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One scheme ID or Medidata Rave RTSM list ID). Enables cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: irt_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system used to execute this randomization scheme (e.g., 'Oracle Clinical One', 'Medidata Rave RTSM', 'Almac IXRS'). Identifies the operational system of record for subject allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on IRT/IVRS; Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave

attributes.name: is_centralized
attributes.description: Indicates whether randomization is performed centrally via IRT/IVRS/RTSM (True) or locally at the site (False). Centralized randomization is the standard for GCP-compliant multi-center trials.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on IRT; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: is_stratified_by_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether randomization is stratified by investigative site. Site stratification is common in multi-center trials to ensure balance across sites.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: is_variable_block
attributes.description: Indicates whether variable (random) block sizes are used rather than a fixed block size. Variable blocks reduce the ability to predict upcoming assignments and are preferred for double-blind studies.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: list_generation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization list was generated using the specified software and seed. Required for audit trail and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: minimization_objective_function
attributes.description: For minimization or covariate-adaptive algorithms, the mathematical objective function used to minimize imbalance across covariates (e.g., 'range', 'variance', 'weighted_range'). Null for non-minimization schemes.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Pocock & Simon (1975); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance

attributes.name: minimization_probability
attributes.description: For minimization algorithms, the probability (0.0–1.0) of assigning a subject to the arm that minimizes imbalance (e.g., 0.8000 = 80% biased coin). Null for non-minimization schemes.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Pocock & Simon (1975); FDA Adaptive Design Guidance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, amendment rationale, or special instructions related to this randomization scheme. Not intended for structured data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: random_seed
attributes.description: Numeric seed value used to initialize the pseudo-random number generator for reproducible list generation. Classified confidential to protect blinding integrity; disclosed only at database lock (DBL) or unblinding. Required for regulatory audit and CSR appendix.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Randomization; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this randomization scheme version has been included in a regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, or eCTD package). Triggers additional change-control requirements.
attributes.references: FDA IND/NDA/BLA; EMA MAA; ICH CTD; eCTD

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the randomization scheme was retired or superseded. Null if the scheme is still active. Used for version lifecycle management and TMF archival.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: sap_version_reference
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) that specifies this randomization scheme. Ensures traceability between the scheme implementation and the approved statistical methodology.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC ADaM; FDA SAP Guidance

attributes.name: scheme_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this randomization scheme within the RTSM/IRT system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One or Medidata Rave RTSM). Used as the business key for cross-system reference.
attributes.references: Oracle Clinical One RTSM; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E9

attributes.name: scheme_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the randomization scheme (e.g., 'Phase III Stratified Block Randomization v2'). Used in reports, TMF documentation, and biostatistics deliverables.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: scheme_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the randomization scheme. 'draft' = under development; 'approved' = biostatistics/QA sign-off obtained; 'active' = in use for subject allocation; 'suspended' = temporarily halted (e.g., DSMB hold); 'retired' = superseded or study closed.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: scheme_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the randomization scheme (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Incremented when the scheme is amended post-approval. Supports audit trail and regulatory submission traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: strata_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct strata defined by the combination of stratification factors. Used to validate that the randomization list covers all strata and to monitor enrollment balance.
attributes.references: ICH E9; SAP; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: stratification_factors
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of stratification factors used to define strata for stratified randomization (e.g., 'site;gender;disease_severity'). Defined in the protocol and SAP. Null for non-stratified schemes.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 2.3; CDISC SDTM; SAP

attributes.name: total_randomization_slots
attributes.description: Total number of randomization positions (slots) generated in the scheme list. Represents the maximum number of subjects that can be randomized under this scheme version.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Oracle Clinical One RTSM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: treatment_arm_count
attributes.description: Number of treatment arms (including placebo/control) defined in this randomization scheme. Must align with the protocol and allocation ratio.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM TA Domain; Protocol

attributes.name: unblinding_procedure
attributes.description: Defines the authorized unblinding procedure for this scheme. 'emergency_only' = individual subject emergency unblinding; 'dsmb_only' = unblinding restricted to DSMB/DMC; 'dbk_full' = full unblinding at database lock; 'partial_sponsor' = sponsor statistician partial unblinding for interim analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this randomization scheme record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and version control in the silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: rand_list
products.description: The generated randomization list produced from a randomization scheme. Stores the ordered sequence of treatment assignments, list version, generation timestamp, generation method, blinding level, and approval status. A rand_list is the authoritative artifact used by IRT/IVRS/RTSM to assign subjects to treatment arms. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One.

attributes.name: superseded_by_list_rand_list_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer randomization list that supersedes this one. Null if this is the current active version. Supports version chain traceability.

attributes.name: allocated_slots
attributes.description: Number of randomization slots that have been assigned to subjects at the time of record. Used to monitor enrollment capacity and list utilization.

attributes.name: allocation_ratio

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the randomization list was formally approved for use in the study by the authorized statistician or delegate. Required for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: blinding_level
attributes.description: Degree of blinding applied to this randomization list. Determines which roles (subject, investigator, sponsor) are masked to treatment assignment. Critical for blinding integrity management.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: block_size_sequence
attributes.description: Encoded representation of the block sizes used in permuted block randomization (e.g., '2,4,4,2'). Classified as confidential to protect blinding integrity during the study.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this randomization list record was first captured in the data platform. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dsmb_access_granted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Access Granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) / Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) has been granted access to the unblinded version of this randomization list for interim safety reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.9; FDA Guidance on DSMB; ICH E9

attributes.name: generated_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the biostatistician or system process that generated the randomization list. Supports ALCOA+ attributability requirement.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: generation_method
attributes.description: Algorithm or statistical method used to generate the randomization list (e.g., permuted block, minimization, stratified). Documented in the SAP and protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: generation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the randomization list was computationally generated by the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this artifact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Country or region code(s) for which this randomization list is applicable (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes, comma-separated). Relevant for multi-regional trials with country-specific lists.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E5 Ethnic Factors; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRB/IEC approval is required before activating this randomization list (e.g., for protocol amendments that change the randomization scheme).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irt_list_type
attributes.description: Scope of the randomization list as configured in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system — whether it applies globally across all sites, to specific sites, strata, or countries.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether treatment assignments in this list are masked (True) or open-label (False). Drives access control and unblinding procedures in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system.

attributes.name: sdtm_arm_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) ARM Value
attributes.description: The exact ARM variable value as it will appear in the CDISC SDTM DM (Demographics) and ARM domains for regulatory submission. Must conform to CDISC Controlled Terminology and be consistent across all SDTM datasets submitted in the eCTD package.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG v3.3 DM domain ARM variable; CDISC Controlled Terminology; FDA eCTD Submission Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this treatment arm definition was sourced or is mastered (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One). Used for data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and Silver layer ETL audit in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11; CDISC Data Management Plan (DMP)

attributes.name: stratification_factors
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of stratification factors applied during randomization to this arm (e.g., 'region, disease severity, prior treatment'). Defined in the protocol and SAP. Used to ensure balanced allocation across subgroups and configure IRT/RTSM stratification layers.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; SAP; CDISC SDTM STRATCD variable

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason for temporary suspension of randomization to this treatment arm (e.g., safety signal, supply shortage, protocol amendment). Documented for regulatory compliance and DSMB/DMC review. Populated only when arm_status is 'suspended'.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.17; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: target_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of randomized subjects to be allocated to this treatment arm as specified in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) and protocol. Used for enrollment monitoring, supply forecasting, and IRT/RTSM configuration. Example: 33.33 for a 1:1:1 three-arm study.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; SAP; CDISC SDTM IG ARM domain

attributes.name: treatment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the investigational treatment, comparator, or placebo administered in this arm, including drug name, formulation, dose, route of administration, and dosing schedule as specified in the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6; ICH E3 CSR; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: unblinding_procedure
attributes.description: Description of the emergency unblinding procedure applicable to this treatment arm, including authorized personnel, system access method (e.g., IRT/IVRS emergency unblinding), and documentation requirements. Classified confidential to protect blinding integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; FDA Guidance on Blinding; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: washout_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days required for washout between treatment periods for this arm in crossover or multi-period study designs. Defined in the protocol based on pharmacokinetic (PK) half-life data. Used for visit scheduling and IRT/RTSM period management.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; DMPK Guidelines; FDA Guidance on Crossover Studies

products.name: stratification_factor
products.description: Defines the stratification factors used in a randomization scheme, including factor name, factor code, data source (eCRF field reference), factor type (categorical, continuous-binned), enumerated levels (level code, label, sort order, active status), and optional minimization parameters (weight value, algorithm variant such as Pocock-Simon or weighted minimization). Each factor belongs to one randomization scheme and its levels define the axes of the stratification matrix. Owned by the biostatistics/RTSM team as part of scheme design.
products.reference: Stratification Factor

attributes.name: stratification_factor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the stratification factor record within the randomization scheme. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Stratification factor approval requires regulatory traceability to a qualified biostatistician per ICH E9. 'approved_by' is denormalized. The FK enables qualification verification reports confirming t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent randomization scheme to which this stratification factor belongs. Each factor is owned by exactly one scheme.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM TA domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Stratification factors are defined in the protocol and changes require a protocol amendment. Regulatory submissions and SAP documentation must reference the amendment version governing each stratifica
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this stratification factor is defined. Enables direct study-level filtering without joining through the scheme.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: adam_variable
attributes.description: The CDISC ADaM variable name in the ADSL dataset corresponding to this stratification factor (e.g., 'STRAT1', 'BSEVSEV'). Used in primary and sensitivity analyses per the Statistical Analysis Plan.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this stratification factor configuration was formally approved by the biostatistics or RTSM team. Required for regulatory audit trail and TMF documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: covariate_adjustment_method
attributes.description: Statistical method used to adjust for this stratification factor in the primary analysis: 'ancova' for Analysis of Covariance, 'cmh' for Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test, 'logistic_regression' for binary endpoints, 'none' if not used as a covariate in analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Covariate Adjustment (2023); CDISC ADaM; SAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stratification factor record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: data_source_type
attributes.description: Identifies the system or method from which the stratification factor value is captured at randomization: 'ecrf' from the EDC eCRF, 'ivrs' from Interactive Voice Response System, 'irt' from IRT/RTSM, 'central_lab' from laboratory results, 'manual_entry' for site-entered values.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC/RTSM; ALCOA+

attributes.name: ecrf_field_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) Field Reference
attributes.description: The eCRF form and field identifier in the EDC system (e.g., Medidata Rave) from which the stratification factor value is sourced at the time of randomization (e.g., 'SCREENING.DISVSEV'). Enables traceability from randomization to source data.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this stratification factor ceased to be effective for new randomizations, typically due to protocol amendment or study close-out. Null for currently active factors.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this stratification factor became effective for subject randomization, typically aligned with protocol approval or amendment effective date. Subjects randomized on or after this date are stratified using this factor.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: factor_code
attributes.description: Short, system-level alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the stratification factor within the scheme (e.g., REGION, DISEASE_STAGE, GENDER). Used as the programmatic key in RTSM/IRT configuration and SDTM mapping.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: factor_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the stratification factor, including its clinical rationale, how it is assessed, and its role in balancing treatment arms as documented in the Statistical Analysis Plan.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; SAP

attributes.name: factor_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the stratification factor as displayed in the RTSM/IRT interface and statistical analysis plan (e.g., 'Geographic Region', 'Baseline Disease Severity', 'Prior Treatment Status').
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM; SAP (Statistical Analysis Plan)

attributes.name: factor_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the stratification factor within the scheme design workflow: 'draft' during initial configuration, 'approved' after biostatistics/RTSM sign-off, 'active' when live in the IRT system, 'suspended' during protocol amendment review, 'retired' when permanently decommissioned.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; MasterControl; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: factor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the factor's measurement scale: 'categorical' for nominal groupings (e.g., region), 'continuous_binned' for numeric ranges converted to categories (e.g., age groups), 'ordinal' for ranked categories (e.g., disease severity), 'binary' for two-level factors (e.g., yes/no prior treatment).
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM; FDA Guidance on Stratified Randomization

attributes.name: irt_parameter_name
attributes.description: The exact parameter name as configured in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM or Oracle Clinical One) for this stratification factor. Used for system integration and UAT validation.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stratification factor is currently active and in use for subject randomization (True) or has been deactivated via protocol amendment (False). Inactive factors are retained for historical traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stratification factor value is masked from unblinded personnel (True) or visible to all study team members (False). Relevant for double-blind studies where certain stratification criteria could reveal treatment assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: is_primary_factor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this factor is designated as a primary stratification factor (True) versus a secondary or exploratory factor (False) in the Statistical Analysis Plan. Primary factors are used in the primary efficacy analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9; SAP; FDA Guidance on Stratified Randomization

attributes.name: is_used_in_primary_analysis
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stratification factor is included as a covariate in the primary statistical analysis model (True) or is used only for randomization balance without inclusion in the primary analysis (False). Relevant for ANCOVA and CMH test specifications in the SAP.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Covariate Adjustment; CDISC ADaM; SAP

attributes.name: level_count
attributes.description: Total number of enumerated levels (strata) defined for this stratification factor. Drives the dimensionality of the stratification matrix and the number of randomization lists required. For example, a 3-region factor has level_count = 3.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: max_imbalance_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum allowable imbalance (as a percentage or absolute count, per unit_of_imbalance) between treatment arms within any stratum defined by this factor before a balancing action is triggered in the minimization algorithm.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; SAP

attributes.name: minimization_variant
attributes.description: Specific variant of the minimization algorithm applied for this factor: 'pocock_simon' for the Pocock-Simon method, 'weighted_minimization' for factor-weighted minimization, 'biased_coin' for biased-coin minimization, 'deterministic' for deterministic minimization, 'none' if minimization is not applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Pocock-Simon (1975); FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: minimization_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weight assigned to this stratification factor in a minimization or weighted minimization algorithm (e.g., Pocock-Simon). Values typically range from 0.0 to 1.0, with higher weights indicating greater influence on treatment allocation balance. Null if minimization is not used.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Pocock-Simon Minimization Algorithm; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: missing_value_handling
attributes.description: Defines the RTSM system behavior when the stratification factor value is missing or unknown at the time of randomization: 'block_randomization' to prevent randomization, 'assign_default_level' to use a pre-specified default level, 'flag_and_hold' to alert the site, 'exclude_from_minimization' to proceed without this factor.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; SAP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, biostatistician comments, or RTSM configuration remarks related to this stratification factor that do not fit into structured fields. Not used for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section of the study protocol document that defines this stratification factor (e.g., 'Section 8.2.1 Stratification Factors'). Enables traceability from the data model to the governing protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA IND Regulations 21 CFR 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: randomization_algorithm
attributes.description: The randomization algorithm applied in conjunction with this stratification factor: 'permuted_block' for block randomization within strata, 'minimization' for adaptive minimization, 'stratified_block' for stratified permuted block, 'dynamic_allocation' for covariate-adaptive methods.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: rtsm_factor_code
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this stratification factor within the source RTSM/IRT system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM internal factor ID or Oracle Clinical One factor GUID). Used for system integration, reconciliation, and audit trail linkage.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: rtsm_system
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) System
attributes.description: Identifies the RTSM/IRT/IVRS system in which this stratification factor is configured and operationalized for subject randomization and kit assignment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: sap_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section of the Statistical Analysis Plan that describes the use of this stratification factor in primary and sensitivity analyses (e.g., 'SAP Section 5.3 Stratification'). Supports regulatory audit traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on SAP; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: sdtm_variable
attributes.description: The CDISC SDTM variable name that maps to this stratification factor for regulatory submission datasets (e.g., 'STRAT1', 'REGION1'). Used in SDTM TR/SUPPFA domains and ADaM ADSL derivations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA eCTD Submission Standards; SAS Drug Development

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Integer defining the display and processing sequence of this stratification factor within the randomization scheme. Lower values appear first in RTSM screens, SAP tables, and stratification matrix axes.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: unit_of_imbalance
attributes.description: Specifies whether the max_imbalance_threshold is expressed as a 'percentage' of subjects within the stratum or as an absolute 'subject_count'. Determines how the RTSM system evaluates balance during randomization.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Medidata Rave RTSM; SAP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this stratification factor record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks configuration changes and supports change control audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: validation_rule
attributes.description: Business rule or logical expression applied to validate the stratification factor value at the time of randomization (e.g., 'BMIBL >= 18 AND BMIBL < 30'). Prevents invalid factor assignments and ensures data integrity per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Medidata Rave RTSM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier of this stratification factor definition, incremented with each protocol amendment or RTSM configuration change (e.g., '1.0', '2.0'). Supports change control and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; MasterControl

products.name: stratification_cell
products.description: Represents the unique combination of stratification factor levels that defines a single stratum cell within a randomization scheme. Stores the cell identifier, composite cell label, target subject count per arm within the cell, actual enrolled count, and cell balance status. Used to monitor enrollment balance across strata.
products.reference: Stratification Cell / Stratum Cell

attributes.name: stratification_cell_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a stratification cell record within the randomization scheme. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E9 Statistical Principles for Clinical Trials

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent randomization scheme under which this stratification cell is defined. Links the cell to its governing allocation algorithm.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RAND domain

attributes.name: regulatory_protocol_amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Stratification cells are defined per protocol amendment version. Changes to stratification cell definitions require amendment approval. Regulatory audit trails and enrollment reports must link cells t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this stratification cell is defined. Enables cross-study reporting and enrollment balance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: treatment_arm_id
attributes.description: Reference to the treatment arm associated with this stratification cell. Enables arm-level enrollment balance monitoring within each stratum.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM ARM domain; FDA Guidance on Randomization

attributes.name: actual_enrolled_count
attributes.description: Current count of subjects who have been randomized and enrolled into this stratification cell. Updated in real time from the IRT/RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM / Oracle Clinical One) upon each randomization event.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RAND domain; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: allocation_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of subject allocation across treatment arms within this stratification cell (e.g., '1:1', '2:1', '1:1:1'). Defined in the protocol and SAP and configured in the RTSM system.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Randomization; CDISC SDTM RAND domain

attributes.name: balance_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage deviation from the target enrollment count before the cell is flagged as imbalanced. Defined in the SAP and used by the RTSM system to trigger balance alerts.
attributes.references: ICH E9; SAP; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: block_size
attributes.description: Size of the permuted block used for randomization within this stratification cell. A value of zero or null indicates variable block size or non-block-based methods. Stored as confidential to protect blinding integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Randomization; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cell_balance_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment balance status of this stratification cell relative to its target. 'balanced' indicates enrollment is within acceptable tolerance; 'under_enrolled' or 'over_enrolled' indicate deviation from target; 'closed' indicates the cell is no longer accepting subjects; 'suspended' indicates temporary halt.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Stratified Randomization; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: cell_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this stratification cell within the study randomization scheme. Used in IRT/IVRS/RTSM systems such as Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One for cell-level kit assignment and allocation tracking.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM RAND domain; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: cell_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the stratification cell, including the clinical rationale for the factor level combination and any protocol-specific notes.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cell_label
attributes.description: Human-readable composite label describing the full combination of stratification factor levels that define this cell (e.g., 'Age>=65 / Male / ECOG 0-1'). Used in study reports, CSR tables, and enrollment dashboards.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Stratified Randomization

attributes.name: cell_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this cell within the randomization scheme, used for consistent ordering in reports, listings, and IRT/RTSM system configuration.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM RAND domain; ICH E9

attributes.name: cell_status
attributes.description: Operational lifecycle status of the stratification cell within the randomization scheme. 'active' means the cell is open for randomization; 'inactive' means it has been deactivated; 'closed' means enrollment is complete; 'suspended' means temporarily halted; 'draft' means not yet activated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stratification cell record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: enrollment_close_date
attributes.description: Date on which this stratification cell was closed to further subject randomization, either due to reaching the enrollment cap or protocol-driven closure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: enrollment_open_date
attributes.description: Date on which this stratification cell was opened for subject randomization and enrollment, as recorded in the RTSM system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region stratification factor level associated with this cell (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific), when geography is used as a stratification factor. Supports regional enrollment balance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Multi-Regional Clinical Trials; EMA Guideline on Stratification

attributes.name: is_active_for_enrollment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stratification cell is currently open and accepting new subject randomizations. Controlled by the RTSM system and updated when enrollment caps or protocol amendments are applied.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: is_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the treatment arm assignment within this stratification cell is blinded to investigators and subjects. True for double-blind studies; False for open-label designs.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: last_randomization_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent subject randomization event recorded within this stratification cell. Used to monitor cell activity and detect stalled enrollment.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RAND domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: maximum_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Maximum number of subjects permitted in this stratification cell per treatment arm. Enrollment is capped at this value to prevent over-representation of a stratum.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; SAP

attributes.name: minimum_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of subjects required in this stratification cell to maintain statistical validity of the study, as specified in the SAP. Triggers an alert if actual enrollment falls below this threshold.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; SAP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or comments regarding this stratification cell, such as enrollment challenges, protocol deviation impacts, or DSMB/DMC recommendations affecting cell management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version of the study protocol under which this stratification cell definition was established or last amended. Ensures traceability of cell definitions to specific protocol versions for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: randomization_method
attributes.description: Randomization algorithm applied within this stratification cell (e.g., permuted block, minimization, dynamic allocation). Determines how subjects are allocated to treatment arms within the cell.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Randomization; CDISC SDTM RAND domain

attributes.name: randomized_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who have received a randomization code assignment within this stratification cell, which may differ from enrolled count if subjects are randomized but not yet dosed.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RAND domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: rtsm_cell_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) Cell Reference
attributes.description: External cell identifier as configured in the RTSM system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM or Oracle Clinical One IRT). Used for reconciliation between the data lakehouse and the operational RTSM system.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: sap_version
attributes.description: Version of the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) that defines the stratification factors, cell structure, and enrollment targets for this cell. Critical for regulatory audit traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on SAP; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: screened_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who have been screened and assessed for eligibility within this stratification cell, used to monitor the screening-to-enrollment funnel per stratum.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DS domain

attributes.name: sdtm_stratum_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) Stratum Value
attributes.description: CDISC SDTM-compliant stratum value code for this cell, mapped to the STRATCD variable in the RAND domain. Required for regulatory submission datasets and SDTM-to-ADaM derivations.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; FDA CDISC Technical Conformance Guide; ICH M8

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this stratification cell record originated (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: target_enrollment_count
attributes.description: Protocol-specified target number of subjects to be enrolled in this stratification cell per treatment arm, as defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) and randomization schedule.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the user or process that last modified this stratification cell record. Required for electronic records compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ attributability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this stratification cell record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: withdrawn_count
attributes.description: Number of subjects who were enrolled in this stratification cell but subsequently withdrew or were discontinued, used to assess cell-level dropout impact on balance.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM DS domain; FDA Guidance on Missing Data

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or system identifier of the user or process that created this stratification cell record. Required for electronic records compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ attributability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

products.name: subject_randomization
products.description: Transactional record of a subject's randomization or re-randomization event. Captures the subject identifier, study site, randomization number assigned, treatment arm allocated, stratification cell, randomization timestamp, IRT/IVRS transaction reference, randomizing user (CRC/IRT system), randomization status (randomized, cancelled, re-randomized), and for re-randomization events: original randomization reference, re-randomization reason (screen failure re-entry, protocol deviation, IRT error), and authorizing protocol amendment. This is the SSOT for all subject-to-treatment-arm allocation events including initial and subsequent randomizations. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM and Oracle Clinical One.
products.reference: Subject Randomization Event / IRT Randomization Transaction

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each subject randomization or re-randomization event record in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM IG; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: agreement_billing_milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to agreement.billing_milestone. Business justification: First-patient-randomized and Nth-patient-randomized are classic CRO billing milestone triggers. This link identifies which randomization event triggered a billing milestone, enabling revenue recogniti
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: blinding_config_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to randomization.blinding_config. Business justification: A subject randomization event is governed by a specific blinding configuration that determines what information is masked. subject_randomization currently stores blinding_type (STRING) as a denormaliz
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Captures kit number, kit type, dispensing site, dispensing visit, dispensing date, subject randomization reference, treatment arm, and kit return status. Links the randomization domain to the supply domain for IMP accountability.

attributes.name: subject_visit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit at which the IMP kit was dispensed to the subject.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM TV/SV domains; ICH E6(R2) GCP
