attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enrolled study subject who received the IMP kit. Links the kit assignment to the subject randomization record for IMP accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM DM domain

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the kit assignment record, tracking the kit from initial assignment through dispensing, return, destruction, or loss. Essential for IMP accountability and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the reason for the kit assignment: initial dispensing at randomization, resupply at a subsequent visit, replacement of a damaged/lost kit, dose titration, or rescue medication dispensing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One RTSM module

attributes.name: blinding_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the kit assignment is blinded (treatment identity concealed), unblinded (treatment identity revealed, e.g., after emergency unblinding or study completion), or open-label. Critical for maintaining trial integrity and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for site staff or data management to record additional notes or observations related to the kit assignment event (e.g., reason for kit replacement, notes on subject compliance, dispensing anomalies).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subject demonstrated acceptable dosing compliance for this kit assignment based on the quantity dispensed versus quantity returned. True if compliance meets protocol-defined threshold; False if a compliance issue is identified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM EX domain; FDA Guidance on Compliance; SAP (Statistical Analysis Plan)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this kit assignment record was first created in the data system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) GCP.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: dispensing_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the kit dispensing has been confirmed and acknowledged in the IRT/RTSM system by the site staff. True when confirmed; False when pending confirmation. Supports site monitoring and data quality checks.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: dispensing_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the IMP kit was physically dispensed to the subject at the investigational site. Corresponds to the CDISC SDTM EXSTDTC (Exposure Start Date) and is critical for dosing compliance and PK/PD analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXSTDTC; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: dispensing_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the IMP kit dispensing transaction was recorded in the IRT/RTSM system. Supports ALCOA+ compliance (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical dosage form of the IMP contained in the kit (e.g., Tablet, Capsule, Injection). Aligns with CDISC SDTM EX domain EXDOSFRM and supports IMP accountability and regulatory submissions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Tablet|Capsule|Injection|Infusion|Patch|Oral Solution|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXDOSFRM; ICH Q8 Pharmaceutical Development; FDA NDA/BLA requirements

attributes.name: dose_level
attributes.description: The protocol-defined dose level associated with the kit (e.g., 'Low Dose', 'High Dose', '10mg', '50mg'). Supports dose-response analysis and PK/PD modeling. May differ from treatment arm in dose-escalation or titration studies.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXDOSE; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Dose-Response Studies

attributes.name: irt_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system that generated and recorded the kit assignment transaction. Important for multi-system studies and audit trail traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: kit_batch_number
attributes.description: The manufacturing batch or lot number of the IMP kit. Required for IMP accountability, pharmacovigilance investigations, and regulatory submissions. Enables traceability from subject exposure back to the manufacturing batch.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU GMP Annex 13; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: kit_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the IMP kit as labeled by the manufacturer or packaging facility. Ensures that expired kits are not dispensed to subjects and supports IMP accountability and supply chain management.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; 21 CFR Part 211.137; EU GMP Annex 13; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13

attributes.name: kit_number
attributes.description: The unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) kit by the RTSM/IRT system or packaging facility. Used for IMP accountability and reconciliation across the supply chain.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: kit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the investigational medicinal product kit indicating whether it contains active IMP, placebo, comparator drug, rescue medication, or is open-label or blinded. Critical for treatment arm integrity and blinding management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM EX domain; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protocol deviation was associated with this kit assignment event (e.g., wrong kit dispensed, kit dispensed outside the protocol visit window, expired kit dispensed). True if a deviation is linked; False otherwise.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations; CDISC SDTM DV domain

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: The number of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, patches) dispensed to the subject as part of this kit assignment. Used for dosing compliance calculations and IMP accountability reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXDOSE; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: quantity_returned
attributes.description: The number of IMP units returned by the subject from this kit assignment. Used to calculate compliance (quantity dispensed minus quantity returned) and for IMP accountability at site level.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; CDISC SDTM EX domain

attributes.name: randomization_number
attributes.description: The unique randomization number assigned to the subject by the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system at the time of randomization. Serves as the primary cross-reference between the randomization event and the kit dispensing record.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM RSUBJID; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: The date on which the subject returned unused IMP units from this kit assignment to the investigational site. Null if no return has occurred or is not applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current return status of the IMP kit: whether return is pending, the kit has been returned, the return requirement has been waived, or return is not applicable (e.g., fully consumed). Supports IMP accountability and site monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The route by which the IMP in the kit is administered to the subject (e.g., Oral, Intravenous, Subcutaneous). Aligns with CDISC SDTM EX domain EXROUTE and is required for regulatory submissions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Oral|Intravenous|Subcutaneous|Intramuscular|Topical|Inhaled|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM EX domain EXROUTE; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA NDA/BLA; WHO-DD

attributes.name: stratification_factor_1
attributes.description: The value of the first stratification factor applied at randomization for this subject (e.g., 'Disease Severity: Mild', 'Region: North America'). Captured at the time of kit assignment to preserve the randomization context for statistical analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM STRATCD; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: stratification_factor_2
attributes.description: The value of the second stratification factor applied at randomization for this subject (e.g., 'Prior Treatment: Yes/No', 'Age Group: <65/≥65'). Null if fewer than two stratification factors are defined in the protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Statistical Principles; CDISC SDTM STRATCD; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: subject_number
attributes.description: The study-assigned subject identifier (e.g., site number + sequential subject number) used to identify the subject in the EDC and RTSM systems. Classified as restricted PII as it can be used to trace back to an individual patient.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM SUBJID; HIPAA; GDPR Article 4; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a temperature excursion was reported for this kit prior to or during dispensing. True if a temperature excursion was recorded; False otherwise. Relevant for temperature-sensitive IMPs and IMP accountability.
attributes.references: ICH Q1A Stability Testing; EU GMP Annex 13; 21 CFR Part 211; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.13

attributes.name: unblinding_date
attributes.description: The date on which the kit assignment was unblinded, revealing the treatment arm identity. Populated only when blinding_status transitions to 'Unblinded'. Null for blinded or open-label assignments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; FDA Guidance on Blinding; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: unblinding_reason
attributes.description: The documented reason for emergency or planned unblinding of the kit assignment, if applicable (e.g., 'SAE requiring treatment knowledge', 'Study completion', 'DSMB review'). Null if the kit remains blinded.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.7; FDA Guidance on Blinding; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this kit assignment record was last modified. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records regulations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

products.name: blinding_config
products.description: Defines the blinding configuration for a randomization scheme, including blinding type (open-label, single-blind, double-blind, triple-blind), blinded roles (subject, investigator, sponsor, CRA, statistician), blinding method (identical packaging, dummy tablets, double-dummy), and the system-enforced access controls for unblinded data. Governs who can see treatment assignments and under what conditions.
products.reference: Blinding Configuration / Masking Plan

attributes.name: previous_version_blinding_config_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding version of this blinding configuration, enabling version chain traceability for regulatory audit and TMF completeness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF; ALCOA+

attributes.name: rand_scheme_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent randomization scheme to which this blinding configuration belongs, linking blinding rules to the allocation algorithm.
attributes.references: ICH E9; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this blinding configuration was formally approved, captured as an auditable electronic record per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: blinding_method
attributes.description: Physical or procedural technique used to maintain blinding integrity: identical_packaging (active and placebo packaged identically), dummy_tablets (inert tablets matching active), double_dummy (two sets of dummy treatments for crossover), over_encapsulation (active drug encapsulated to match placebo), matching_placebo, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: identical_packaging|dummy_tablets|double_dummy|over_encapsulation|matching_placebo|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Blinding; EMA Guideline on Blinding

attributes.name: blinding_rationale
attributes.description: Narrative justification for the selected blinding type and method as documented in the study protocol, explaining why the chosen approach is scientifically and ethically appropriate.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 5.3; FDA Guidance on Blinding; EMA Guideline on Blinding

attributes.name: blinding_type
attributes.description: Classification of the blinding design applied to the study: open_label (all parties aware of treatment), single_blind (subject unaware), double_blind (subject and investigator unaware), triple_blind (subject, investigator, and sponsor/CRA unaware). Governs access control rules for treatment assignment data.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 5.3; FDA Guidance on Blinding; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: config_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this blinding configuration, used in RTSM/IRT system references and regulatory documentation (e.g., BLIND-001, BC-STUDY-A-DBL).
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM IG; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: config_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing this blinding configuration, used in CTMS and study documentation (e.g., 'Double-Blind Double-Dummy Phase III Config').
attributes.references: ICH E9; Oracle Clinical One Study Design Module

attributes.name: config_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the blinding configuration: draft (under development), active (in use for the study), superseded (replaced by a newer version), retired (no longer applicable).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: cra_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) performing site monitoring are blinded to treatment assignment. True = CRA cannot see treatment arm during Source Data Verification (SDV).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp recording when this blinding configuration record was first created in the data platform, supporting audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: dsmb_unblinded
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Unblinded Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) / Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) has access to unblinded treatment data for interim safety reviews. True = DSMB operates with unblinded data.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 4.5; FDA Guidance on DSMB; EMA Guideline on DMC

attributes.name: edc_access_restricted
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Capture (EDC) Access Restricted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EDC system (e.g., Medidata Rave) enforces field-level or form-level access restrictions to prevent blinded users from viewing treatment assignment data in the eCRF.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave EDC

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this blinding configuration becomes binding and operationally enforced for the study, aligned with protocol version effective date.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this blinding configuration ceases to be binding. Null indicates the configuration remains in effect indefinitely or until superseded.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: emergency_unblinding_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency unblinding is permitted at the site level for individual subjects in life-threatening situations, as governed by the protocol and IRB/IEC approval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR data protection requirements apply to the blinding configuration and associated treatment assignment data, relevant for EU-based studies or EU subject data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; EU CTR 536/2014; EMA

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether HIPAA privacy and security rules apply to the blinding configuration and associated treatment data, relevant for US-based studies involving protected health information (PHI).
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Part 164; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: interim_analysis_unblinding
attributes.description: Indicates whether treatment assignment data is unblinded for interim analysis purposes (e.g., for DSMB/DMC review or adaptive design decisions). True = unblinded interim analysis is planned.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1) Addendum; FDA Adaptive Design Guidance; EMA Adaptive Design Guideline

attributes.name: investigator_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) and site staff are blinded to treatment assignment. True = investigator does not know the subject's treatment arm.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 5.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) approved this blinding configuration as part of the study protocol review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether changes to this blinding configuration require prior approval from the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) before implementation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: irt_system_enforced
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interactive Response Technology (IRT) System Enforced Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether blinding access controls are enforced programmatically within the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM). True = system prevents unauthorized access to treatment codes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: kit_label_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether investigational product kit labels are blinded (i.e., do not reveal treatment assignment). True = kit labels show only kit number and dispensing instructions, not treatment identity.
attributes.references: ICH E9; EU GMP Annex 13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp recording the most recent modification to this blinding configuration record, supporting change audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special instructions, or clarifications regarding this blinding configuration not captured in structured fields (e.g., site-specific blinding exceptions, packaging vendor notes).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: randomization_code_masked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the randomization code (treatment arm identifier) is masked/encrypted in the RTSM and EDC systems for blinded users. True = treatment codes are not visible to blinded roles.
attributes.references: ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: sae_unblinding_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing whether treatment assignment is unblinded when a Serious Adverse Event (SAE) or Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) is reported: always_unblind, unblind_if_susar (only for SUSARs), maintain_blind (blinding maintained for SAE reporting), case_by_case (medical monitor decision).
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Guideline on SUSAR; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: sponsor_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether sponsor personnel are blinded to treatment assignment. True = sponsor staff cannot access unblinded treatment data during the study.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 5.3; FDA Guidance on Blinding; EMA Guideline on Blinding

attributes.name: statistician_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the biostatistician is blinded to treatment assignment during analysis. True = statistician works with blinded data until Database Lock (DBL) and unblinding per the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP).
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 5.3; ICH E9(R1) Addendum; SAP Guidelines

attributes.name: subject_blinded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study subject (patient) is blinded to their treatment assignment. True = subject does not know their treatment arm.
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 5.3; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: unblinding_authorization_roles
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of organizational roles authorized to initiate or approve unblinding (e.g., 'Medical Monitor, Pharmacovigilance Lead, DSMB Chair'). Governs system-enforced access controls in RTSM/IRT.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: unblinding_documentation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether each unblinding event must be formally documented with reason, date, and authorizing personnel, as required for regulatory audit trail and TMF completeness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: unblinding_procedure
attributes.description: Defined procedure by which treatment assignment may be revealed: emergency_envelope (physical sealed envelope at site), irt_system (automated unblinding via IRT/IVRS/RTSM), sponsor_pharmacovigilance (unblinding for SAE/SUSAR reporting), dsmb_request (unblinding at DSMB request), study_completion (unblinding at end of study/DBL). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emergency_envelope|irt_system|sponsor_pharmacovigilance|dsmb_request|study_completion|investigator_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E9 Section 5.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this blinding configuration record, supporting change control and audit trail requirements (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Incremented upon each approved amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Document Control; ALCOA+

products.name: unblinding_request
products.description: Transactional record of a request to unblind a subject's treatment assignment, encompassing the full request-through-resolution lifecycle including multi-level approval steps. Captures requestor identity, requestor role, clinical justification (SAE, medical emergency, regulatory requirement, planned DBL unblinding, interim analysis), urgency level, request timestamp, approval chain (approver identity, role, decision, rationale, conditions, timestamp per approval step), final outcome (approved/rejected/escalated), unblinding timestamp, and the unblinded treatment arm revealed. Covers both emergency single-subject unblinding and planned study-level unblinding events. Critical for GCP compliance, 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail, and DSMB/DMC oversight. Sourced from Oracle Clinical One and Medidata Rave RTSM.
products.reference: Emergency Unblinding Request / Code Break

attributes.name: unblinding_request_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the unblinding request record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approver_1_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce/user record of the first-level approver in the approval chain (typically the Medical Monitor or Sponsor representative). Captures the identity of the approver for GCP audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Workday HCM

attributes.name: approver_2_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce/user record of the second-level approver (e.g., CRO Medical Director or DSMB member). Populated only when a second approval level is required per the study protocol.

Adding blinding_config_id FK provides direct traceability to the blinding configuration being overridd

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_unblinding_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce/user record of the individual who submitted the unblinding request. Typically the Principal Investigator (PI), treating physician, or Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) at the site.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Workday HCM

attributes.name: requestor_study_assignment_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: serious_adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Serious Adverse Event record that triggered an emergency unblinding request. Null when the unblinding reason is not SAE-driven (e.g., planned DBL unblinding or interim analysis).
attributes.references: ICH E2A; 21 CFR 312.32; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) for which the unblinding request was raised. Links to the study master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the subject is enrolled and where the unblinding request originated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the randomization record (allocation event) for the subject whose treatment assignment is being unblinded. Links to the randomization domain master record.
attributes.references: ICH E9; CDISC SDTM RAND domain; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Emergency and non-emergency unblinding requests with their outcomes are GCP-required records that must be filed in the eTMF as essential documents. Regulatory inspectors specifically review unblinding
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) whose treatment assignment is being unblinded. Applicable for single-subject emergency unblinding events; may be null for planned study-level unblinding (e.g., DBL or interim analysis).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM USUBJID; HIPAA; GDPR

attributes.name: triggering_lab_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: Emergency unblinding requests triggered by critical lab findings (e.g., severe hepatotoxicity, critical hematology values) must document the specific lab result that justified unblinding per ICH E6 GC
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_level_count
attributes.description: Total number of approval levels required for this unblinding request based on the study protocol and urgency classification. Drives the multi-step approval workflow routing in the RTSM system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: approver_1_decision
attributes.description: Decision rendered by the first-level approver on the unblinding request. Approved advances the request; rejected terminates it; escalated routes to a higher authority; deferred postpones pending additional information.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: approver_1_rationale
attributes.description: Free-text rationale provided by the first-level approver explaining their decision. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory audit trail, particularly for rejections and escalations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: approver_1_role
attributes.description: Clinical or organizational role of the first-level approver at the time of their decision. Captured at decision time for audit trail integrity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical_monitor|sponsor_representative|cro_medical_director|irb_chair|dsmb_member|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: approver_1_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the first-level approver rendered their decision. Used to calculate approval cycle time and assess compliance with urgency SLAs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: approver_2_decision
attributes.description: Decision rendered by the second-level approver on the unblinding request. Follows the same decision taxonomy as level 1. Null when a second approval level is not required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: approver_2_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the second-level approver rendered their decision. Null when a second approval level is not required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: blinding_broken_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the blinding was actually broken as a result of this request (True) or whether the request was resolved without revealing the treatment assignment (False). Used for protocol deviation tracking and blinding integrity reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: clinical_justification
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the requestor describing the clinical rationale for unblinding. For SAE-driven requests, includes the nature of the adverse event, patient condition, and why knowledge of treatment assignment is medically necessary. Required for GCP compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.3; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: conditions_of_approval
attributes.description: Any conditions or restrictions imposed by the approver(s) on the approved unblinding (e.g., 'information to be shared only with treating physician', 'subject must be discontinued from study'). Null when no conditions were imposed or when the request was not approved.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this unblinding request record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: current_approval_level
attributes.description: The approval step currently pending action within the multi-level approval chain. Increments as each approver completes their review. Used for workflow routing and escalation monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Clinical One RTSM

attributes.name: dsmb_dmc_referral_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board / Data Monitoring Committee (DSMB/DMC) Referral Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this unblinding request was referred to or reviewed by the DSMB/DMC (True) or not (False). Applicable for interim analysis unblinding or escalated emergency cases requiring independent oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on DSMB; EMA Reflection Paper on DMC

attributes.name: final_outcome
attributes.description: The definitive resolution of the unblinding request after all approval levels have been completed. Approved means the treatment assignment was revealed; rejected means the request was denied; withdrawn means the requestor retracted the request; escalated means the request was referred to a higher authority (e.g., DSMB/DMC).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on DSMB

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Notification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the IRB/IEC must be notified of this unblinding event per the study protocol or applicable regulations (True) or not (False). Drives regulatory notification workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3; 21 CFR 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the IRB/IEC was formally notified of the unblinding event. Null if notification is not required or has not yet been sent. Used for regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_raised
attributes.description: Indicates whether an unplanned or unauthorized unblinding event associated with this request resulted in a protocol deviation being raised (True) or not (False). Links to the compliance domain for deviation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR 312.62; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the unblinding request, typically generated by the RTSM/IRT system (e.g., Oracle Clinical One or Medidata Rave). Used in regulatory correspondence, audit trails, and DSMB/DMC communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Clinical One RTSM

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the unblinding request workflow. Tracks progression from initial submission through multi-level approval to final resolution. Drives GCP audit trail and DSMB/DMC oversight reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: requestor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who submitted the unblinding request, captured at the time of submission for audit trail integrity per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ requirements. Preserved even if the workforce record is later modified.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: requestor_role
attributes.description: Clinical role of the individual who submitted the unblinding request at the time of submission. Captured at request time to preserve audit integrity even if the person's role changes later. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pi|sub_investigator|crc|sponsor_medical_monitor|cra|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: required_by_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time by which the unblinding decision is clinically required, as specified by the requestor. Used to enforce urgency SLAs and escalation triggers. For emergency requests, this may be within hours of submission.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this unblinding request originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: source_system_request_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this unblinding request in the originating operational system (Oracle Clinical One or Medidata Rave RTSM). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Oracle Clinical One; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the study sponsor was formally notified of the unblinding event. Required for emergency unblinding events per GCP and sponsor agreements. Null if not yet notified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5; 21 CFR 312.32; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the unblinding request was formally submitted by the requestor in the RTSM/IRT system. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Critical for measuring response time against urgency SLAs and for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Oracle Clinical One RTSM

attributes.name: treatment_arm_revealed
attributes.description: The treatment arm or randomization code revealed upon approved unblinding (e.g., 'Active Drug A 10mg', 'Placebo', 'Comparator B'). Populated only when final_outcome is 'approved'. Highly sensitive as it compromises blinding integrity for the subject. Restricted to authorized personnel only.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E9; 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: unblinding_reason
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the clinical or regulatory justification for the unblinding request. Drives urgency classification and approval routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sae_medical_emergency|regulatory_requirement|dsmb_interim_analysis|database_lock|planned_unblinding|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR 312.32; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: unblinding_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether the unblinding request pertains to a single subject (emergency or medical necessity) or to the entire study (planned events such as Database Lock, interim analysis, or final analysis).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs

attributes.name: unblinding_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the treatment assignment was actually revealed to the authorized recipient. Null if the request was rejected or withdrawn. Critical for GCP audit trail and regulatory reporting timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Oracle Clinical One RTSM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this unblinding request record was most recently modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Tracks the latest state change for audit trail and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: urgency_level
attributes.description: Clinical urgency classification of the unblinding request. Emergency indicates immediate patient safety risk requiring unblinding within hours; urgent indicates within 24 hours; routine indicates planned/scheduled unblinding with no immediate safety concern.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ICH E2A; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the requestor when withdrawing an unblinding request before final resolution. Null when the request was not withdrawn. Required for audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

products.name: unblinding_approval
products.description: Records the approval or rejection decision for an unblinding request. Captures the approver role (medical monitor, PI, sponsor medical officer), decision (approved, rejected, escalated), decision rationale, decision timestamp, and any conditions attached to the approval. Maintains the multi-level approval audit trail required by GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 for emergency unblinding events.
products.reference: Unblinding Approval / Code Break Authorization

attributes.name: unblinding_approval_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each unblinding approval record in the randomization domain. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approver_study_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.study_assignment. Business justification: Unblinding approvers must be formally authorized study team members. Linking to study_assignment confirms the approver's active, authorized role on the study at time of approval — a GCP blinding integ
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: electronic_signature_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the 21 CFR Part 11-compliant electronic signature applied by the approver at the time of decision. Links to the electronic signature audit record in the eTMF or EDC system for regulatory submission readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: primary_unblinding_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce/personnel record of the individual who rendered the approval decision. Enables linkage to credentials, training records, and delegation of authority documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Workday HCM

attributes.name: serious_adverse_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Serious Adverse Event (SAE) record that triggered the unblinding request, when applicable. Links the approval to the safety event in Oracle Argus Safety for integrated safety reporting and SUSAR assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which the unblinding approval is being recorded. Enables study-level audit trail and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site where the subject is enrolled and where the unblinding event is occurring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: subject_randomization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the subject's randomization record whose treatment arm assignment is the subject of the unblinding request. Links to the randomization domain for treatment arm and kit assignment context.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Trial Master File (TMF) document record in Veeva Vault eTMF where the signed unblinding approval form is archived. Required for inspection readiness and regulatory submission completeness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault eTMF; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: trial_subject_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trial subject (patient) whose treatment assignment blinding is being reviewed for unblinding. Classified as restricted PII as it can be linked to an individual participant.
attributes.references: HIPAA; GDPR Article 4; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: unblinding_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent unblinding request that this approval decision is associated with. Links the approval record to the originating request in the multi-level approval workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: approval_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any conditions or restrictions attached to a conditional approval decision (e.g., 'Unblinding permitted only to treating physician; sponsor team remains blinded'). Populated only when approval_status is conditionally_approved.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Numeric level within the multi-tier approval hierarchy (e.g., 1 = first-line approver such as PI, 2 = second-line such as Medical Monitor, 3 = final authority such as Sponsor Medical Officer). Supports multi-level approval workflow tracking required by GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Emergency Unblinding

attributes.name: approval_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for this approval record, used in regulatory submissions, audit trails, and cross-system references (e.g., UBA-STUDY01-202401). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the unblinding approval decision. Reflects the outcome of the approver's review: approved (unblinding authorized), rejected (unblinding denied), escalated (referred to higher authority), pending (awaiting decision), withdrawn (request retracted), or conditionally_approved (approved with attached conditions). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: approved|rejected|escalated|pending|withdrawn|conditionally_approved — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who rendered the approval or rejection decision. Required for GCP audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature attribution. Classified as confidential as it identifies a study personnel member.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: approver_role
attributes.description: The functional role of the individual who rendered the approval decision. Defines the authority level within the multi-level unblinding approval hierarchy. Valid roles include: medical_monitor, pi (Principal Investigator), sponsor_medical_officer, dsmb_chair (Data Safety Monitoring Board Chair), irb_representative (Institutional Review Board), cro_medical_director. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical_monitor|pi|sponsor_medical_officer|dsmb_chair|irb_representative|cro_medical_director — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; DSMB Charter Guidelines

attributes.name: blinding_maintained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the overall study blinding integrity was maintained following this unblinding event (True = blinding maintained for the broader study population; False = blinding compromised at study level). Critical for assessing impact on study validity.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional free-text comments or observations recorded by the approver beyond the formal decision rationale. May include follow-up actions required, safety observations, or cross-references to related records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this unblinding approval record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail completeness per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: decision_rationale
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explanation provided by the approver justifying the approval, rejection, escalation, or conditional approval decision. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory audit trail to demonstrate that the decision was medically and procedurally justified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) at which the approver rendered their decision on the unblinding request. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction, critical for GCP audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: delegation_of_authority
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approver was acting under a formal delegation of authority (True = delegated authority; False = primary role holder). Relevant when a PI delegates unblinding approval authority to a sub-investigator or designee.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Site Delegation Log

attributes.name: emergency_unblinding
attributes.description: Indicates whether this unblinding approval was processed under emergency procedures (True = emergency unblinding bypassing standard multi-level approval; False = standard approval workflow). Emergency unblinding events require expedited regulatory notification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the approval decision was escalated to a higher authority rather than resolved at the current approval level. Populated only when approval_status is 'escalated'.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: escalation_target_role
attributes.description: The role to which the unblinding decision has been escalated when approval_status is 'escalated'. Identifies the next authority in the approval chain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sponsor_medical_officer|dsmb_chair|irb_chair|regulatory_authority|cro_medical_director — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DSMB Charter; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: gcp_compliance_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approver explicitly confirmed that the unblinding procedure was conducted in accordance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and the applicable protocol SOP (True = confirmed; False = not confirmed or exception noted).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: irb_iec_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) must be notified of this unblinding event per protocol or regulatory requirements (True = notification required; False = not required).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP Regulations; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_notified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was formally notified of the unblinding event. Populated when irb_iec_notification_required is True and notification has been completed.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP Regulations; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory and sponsor notifications were dispatched following this approval decision (True = notifications sent; False = pending notification). Supports compliance tracking for expedited safety reporting timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which regulatory and sponsor notifications were dispatched following the approval decision. Populated when notification_sent is True. Used to verify compliance with expedited reporting timelines (e.g., 7-day/15-day SAE reporting).
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: The version of the study protocol that was in effect at the time of the unblinding approval decision. Required to confirm that the unblinding procedure followed the correct protocol version's unblinding SOP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: response_time_hours
attributes.description: Elapsed time in hours between the submission of the unblinding request and the rendering of this approval decision. Used for KPI monitoring of emergency unblinding response times and SOP compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; Site SOP

attributes.name: signature_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the approver applied their 21 CFR Part 11-compliant electronic signature to the approval decision. May differ from decision_timestamp if signature was applied after the verbal/written decision.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this unblinding approval record originated (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One, Veeva Vault, Oracle Argus Safety, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Medidata Rave workflow ID, Oracle Clinical One approval reference). Enables traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: treatment_arm_revealed
attributes.description: The treatment arm or randomization code that was disclosed to the approver upon approval of the unblinding request (e.g., 'Active Drug A 10mg', 'Placebo'). Populated only after approval is granted and unblinding is executed. Classified as confidential as it contains blinded study information.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Guidance on Blinding

attributes.name: unblinding_reason_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the reason driving the unblinding request being reviewed. Supports regulatory reporting and trend analysis of unblinding events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: emergency_medical|sae_reporting|regulatory_requirement|dsmb_review|study_completion|protocol_deviation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CIOMS Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this unblinding approval record was last modified. Supports audit trail integrity and change detection per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

products.name: rand_validation_run
products.description: Records the UAT and validation runs performed on a randomization scheme and IRT system prior to study go-live. Captures validation run type (UAT, dry run, parallel test), test scenario coverage, pass/fail status per scenario, tester identity, validation date, defects identified, and final sign-off status. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP compliance before first subject randomization.

attributes.name: validation_protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved validation protocol document (stored in Veeva Vault or eTMF) that governs the test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and sign-off requirements for this run.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, contextual notes, or deviations from the standard validation process recorded by the tester or approver.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GAMP 5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this validation run record was first created in the system, supporting ALCOA+ audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: critical_defects_count
attributes.description: Number of critical-severity defects identified during this validation run that directly impact randomization integrity, blinding, or patient safety. Critical defects must be resolved before go-live.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: electronic_signature_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the 21 CFR Part 11-compliant electronic signature applied to the validation run sign-off record in the eTMF or document management system (e.g., Veeva Vault signature ID).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; EU CTR 536/2014; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: irt_system_code
attributes.description: Reference to the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system instance (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, Oracle Clinical One) being validated in this run.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.5.3

attributes.name: irt_system_version
attributes.description: Version number of the IRT/RTSM system build under test during this validation run (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM build version). Critical for traceability in the validation package.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(k); GAMP 5 Appendix M4

attributes.name: kit_assignment_tested
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRT-driven investigational product kit assignment and supply chain allocation scenarios were included and validated in this run. Required for RTSM/supply domain integration.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; Medidata Rave RTSM

attributes.name: lead_tester_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead tester who executed this validation run, captured at time of execution for audit trail integrity per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(i); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: lead_tester_role
attributes.description: Professional role of the lead tester at the time of validation execution. Used to verify that testing was performed by qualified personnel per GCP requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CRA|CRC|IRT_specialist|biostatistician|data_manager|QA_analyst — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.5; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(i); GCP

attributes.name: major_defects_count
attributes.description: Number of major-severity defects identified during this validation run that significantly impact system functionality but may be accepted with documented risk mitigation.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: minor_defects_count
attributes.description: Number of minor-severity defects identified during this validation run that have low impact on system functionality and may be deferred to a future release.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: open_items_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of any open defects, deviations, or risk-accepted items documented at the time of sign-off for conditionally approved runs. Required for regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: overall_sign_off_status
attributes.description: Final sign-off decision for this validation run: pending (awaiting review), approved (run accepted, system cleared for go-live), rejected (run not accepted, re-validation required), conditionally_approved (accepted with documented open items). Required before first subject randomization.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(j); GAMP 5; ICH E6(R2) §5.5; GCP

attributes.name: rand_algorithm_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the randomization algorithm configuration (e.g., block randomization list version, minimization algorithm version) being validated.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Randomization; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: re_randomization_tested
attributes.description: Indicates whether subject re-randomization scenarios (e.g., after screen failure or protocol amendment) were included and validated in this run.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); Oracle Clinical One

attributes.name: revalidation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a subsequent re-validation run is required following this run, typically triggered by critical defects, system changes, or protocol amendments.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); ICH E6(R2) §5.5

attributes.name: run_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the validation run, used in TMF documentation, sign-off records, and regulatory submissions. Format: VAL-{STUDY}-{YEAR}-{SEQ}.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10; ICH E6(R2) §5.5; GAMP 5

attributes.name: run_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the validation run was executed. Used for regulatory timeline tracking and GCP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GAMP 5

attributes.name: run_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when execution of the validation run was completed or terminated. Used to calculate run duration and for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; GAMP 5

attributes.name: run_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when execution of the validation run commenced, including timezone offset. Required for ALCOA+ audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the validation run: planned (scheduled but not started), in_progress (execution underway), passed (all scenarios met acceptance criteria), failed (one or more critical scenarios failed), conditionally_passed (minor defects accepted with documented risk), cancelled (run abandoned before completion).
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.5

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the validation run: UAT (User Acceptance Testing), dry_run (pre-go-live rehearsal), parallel_test (concurrent with legacy system), regression (post-change re-test), smoke_test (basic sanity check), re_validation (after defect remediation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UAT|dry_run|parallel_test|regression|smoke_test|re_validation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); ICH Q10

attributes.name: scenarios_blocked
attributes.description: Number of test scenarios that could not be executed due to a blocking defect or environmental issue, preventing completion of the planned test coverage.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: scenarios_executed
attributes.description: Number of test scenarios actually executed during this validation run. May differ from planned if the run was interrupted or scenarios were deferred.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: scenarios_failed
attributes.description: Number of executed test scenarios that did not meet acceptance criteria, resulting in a defect or deviation record.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: scenarios_passed
attributes.description: Number of executed test scenarios that met all defined acceptance criteria without deviation.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sign_off_approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the approver who signed off on this validation run, captured at time of approval for ALCOA+ audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(i); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: sign_off_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final sign-off decision was recorded for this validation run. Must precede the first subject randomization date per GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(j); ICH E6(R2); GCP; GAMP 5

attributes.name: stratification_factors_tested
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of stratification factors (e.g., age_group, disease_severity, geographic_region, prior_treatment) included in the test scenarios to verify correct stratified randomization behavior.
attributes.references: ICH E9; FDA Guidance on Adaptive Designs; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: test_environment
attributes.description: The system environment in which the validation run was executed: development, QA (Quality Assurance), staging, production_mirror, or production. Determines regulatory weight of the validation evidence.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); ICH Q10

attributes.name: test_script_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the test script document used during this validation run. Ensures traceability between executed tests and the approved test script version in the TMF.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: total_scenarios_planned
attributes.description: Total number of test scenarios defined in the validation test script for this run, covering all randomization and IRT functional requirements.
attributes.references: GAMP 5; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §5.5

attributes.name: treatment_arms_tested
attributes.description: Number of treatment arms (including placebo/control) included in the validation test scenarios, confirming that all arms of the randomization scheme were exercised.
attributes.references: ICH E9; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: unblinding_procedure_tested
attributes.description: Indicates whether emergency unblinding procedures (e.g., SAE-triggered unblinding via IRT) were included in the validation test scenarios.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §4.3.2; FDA Guidance on Blinding; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this validation run record, supporting audit trail completeness and data integrity monitoring.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

products.name: dsmb_unblind_package
products.description: Manages the preparation and delivery of unblinded data packages to the DSMB (Data Safety Monitoring Board) or DMC (Data Monitoring Committee). Captures package version, meeting date, unblinded statistician identity, data cut-off date, treatment arm labels included, delivery method, receipt confirmation, and destruction confirmation post-meeting. Ensures controlled unblinded data access for interim safety reviews.
