attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal regulatory affairs professional responsible for preparing and submitting this sequence. Supports accountability tracking and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: ICH GCP E6(R2); ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: health_authority_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.health_authority. Business justification: Each eCTD submission sequence is sent to a specific health authority. The regulatory_authority_code and submission_country_code STRING fields on submission_sequence are denormalized references to heal
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor on whose behalf this submission sequence was filed. Supports multi-sponsor CRO operations and sponsor-level regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH GCP E6(R2) Section 5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.50; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Each eCTD submission sequence is packaged as a regulatory binder. Regulatory publishing teams build a binder per sequence; linking submission_sequence to regulatory_binder enables sequence-level binde
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study associated with this submission sequence, where the sequence relates to a specific study (e.g., a clinical study report submission). Null for application-level sequences not tied to a single study.
attributes.references: ICH GCP E6(R2); ICH M4E CTD Module 5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: veeva_vault_submission_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Veeva Vault Regulatory Information Management (RIM) Submission ID
attributes.description: External identifier of this submission sequence record within Veeva Vault RIM Submissions module, the system of record for regulatory dossier management. Enables cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational eTMF/RIM system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault RIM Submissions; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: agency_acknowledgement_number
attributes.description: Official confirmation or acknowledgement number issued by the regulatory authority upon receipt of the submission sequence (e.g., FDA ESG acknowledgement ID, EMA CESP submission ID). Used for tracking and correspondence reference.
attributes.references: FDA Electronic Submissions Gateway Technical Conformance Guide; EMA CESP User Guide

attributes.name: agency_action_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority issued a formal action or decision on this submission sequence (e.g., approval letter, complete response letter, refuse-to-file letter, Day 120 list of questions). Null if no action has been issued.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.110; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M8

attributes.name: agency_action_type
attributes.description: Type of formal regulatory action issued by the agency in response to this submission sequence. Drives downstream regulatory strategy and response planning.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.110/314.120; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M8

attributes.name: agency_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory authority officially acknowledged receipt of this submission sequence. Triggers the start of the agency review clock (e.g., PDUFA clock for FDA, Day 0 for EMA).
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA; EMA EU CTR 536/2014 Article 5; ICH M8

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level assigned to this submission sequence reflecting the sensitivity of the dossier content. Governs access controls within Veeva Vault and the lakehouse. 'highly_confidential' applies to trade secret CMC data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; 21 CFR Part 11; EMA Policy 0070 (Publication of Clinical Data); HIPAA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this submission sequence record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH GCP E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: ctd_module_scope
attributes.description: Identifies which CTD module(s) are primarily affected by this submission sequence. Module 1: Administrative/Regional; Module 2: Summaries; Module 3: Quality; Module 4: Nonclinical; Module 5: Clinical. 'multiple' indicates cross-module content.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; ICH M8 eCTD Specification; FDA CTD Guidance

attributes.name: ctd_section_list
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of specific CTD section identifiers (e.g., '3.2.P.1, 3.2.P.2, 5.3.5.1') included or modified in this submission sequence. Enables granular tracking of which dossier sections evolved with each sequence.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; ICH M8 eCTD Specification

attributes.name: document_count
attributes.description: Total number of documents included in this eCTD submission sequence package. Supports completeness verification and dossier audit.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: dossier_package_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to the eCTD submission package for this sequence (e.g., 'NDA 123456 Seq 0012 — CMC Amendment'). Used for identification in Veeva Vault and internal tracking systems.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Specification; Veeva Vault RIM

attributes.name: dossier_package_size_mb
attributes.description: Total file size in megabytes of the eCTD submission package for this sequence. Used for submission gateway capacity planning and agency file size compliance checks.
attributes.references: FDA ESG Technical Conformance Guide; EMA CESP User Guide

attributes.name: ectd_operation
attributes.description: Specifies the eCTD XML backbone lifecycle operation applied to documents in this sequence. 'new' adds documents for the first time; 'replace' supersedes a prior document; 'append' adds to an existing document set; 'delete' removes a document from the active dossier view.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: ectd_validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the eCTD technical validation was performed for this submission sequence. Used to confirm validation was completed prior to submission deadline.
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Validation Criteria

attributes.name: ectd_validation_error_count
attributes.description: Total number of technical validation errors identified during eCTD validation of this submission sequence. A value of zero is required for a passing validation status.
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Validation Criteria

attributes.name: ectd_validation_status
attributes.description: Result of the eCTD technical validation check performed against the agency's published validation criteria prior to or upon submission. 'pass' indicates full conformance; 'warning' indicates non-critical issues; 'fail' indicates the sequence was rejected for technical non-conformance.
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Validation Criteria; ICH M8

attributes.name: ectd_validation_tool
attributes.description: Name and version of the eCTD validation software used to validate this submission sequence (e.g., 'Lorenz docuBridge v5.2', 'Extedo eCTD Manager v8.1', 'Veeva Vault RIM Submissions v23.1'). Required for audit trail and reproducibility.
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Guidance; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: ectd_validation_warning_count
attributes.description: Total number of non-critical technical validation warnings identified during eCTD validation of this submission sequence. Warnings do not block submission but must be reviewed and justified.
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Validation Criteria

attributes.name: is_expedited
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission sequence qualifies for or was filed under an expedited regulatory pathway (e.g., FDA Fast Track, Breakthrough Therapy, Priority Review; EMA PRIME). True if expedited designation applies.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.310; FDA FDASIA Section 902; EMA PRIME Guideline

attributes.name: is_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission sequence contains or is primarily driven by safety-related content (e.g., IND Safety Report, SUSAR narrative, labeling safety update, DSUR). True if safety content is the primary driver.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2F; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42

attributes.name: prior_sequence_number
attributes.description: Four-digit sequence number of the immediately preceding submission sequence that this sequence supersedes or builds upon. Enables reconstruction of the dossier evolution chain and supports lifecycle operation traceability.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the sponsor must submit a response to an agency information request or complete response letter associated with this submission sequence. Null if no response is required.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.110; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M8

attributes.name: review_clock_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority's formal review clock begins for this submission sequence (e.g., PDUFA Day 1 for FDA, Day 0 for EMA). Derived from agency acknowledgement and used for PDUFA/review deadline tracking.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VI; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M8

attributes.name: review_clock_target_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the regulatory authority is expected to complete review of this submission sequence, calculated from the review clock start date per applicable PDUFA or EMA timelines. Critical for regulatory milestone planning.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VI; EMA EU CTR 536/2014 Article 6; ICH M8

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Four-digit zero-padded sequence number uniquely identifying this submission within the regulatory application lifecycle (e.g., 0000 for original, 0001 for first amendment). Assigned per ICH M8 eCTD specification and used by agency systems to order dossier evolution.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide v4.5

attributes.name: submission_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification of the submission type providing regulatory-specific granularity (e.g., Prior Approval Supplement, Changes Being Effected, Complete Response, Major Amendment, Minor Amendment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prior_approval_supplement|changes_being_effected|complete_response|major_amendment|minor_amendment|annual_report — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.70; EMA Variation Regulation (EC) No 1234/2008; ICH M8

attributes.name: submission_unit
attributes.description: The specific regulatory submission unit or grouping within the eCTD backbone that this sequence belongs to (e.g., 'IND Safety Report', 'NDA Module 5 Clinical Study Report', 'BLA CMC Supplement'). Aligns with Veeva Vault RIM submission unit taxonomy.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD Specification; Veeva Vault RIM; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this submission sequence record, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH GCP E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: agency_acknowledgment_date

attributes.name: agency_response_comments

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this protocol amendment record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.

attributes.name: dsmb_notification_required_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) must be notified of this protocol amendment, typically required for amendments affecting safety monitoring, stopping rules, or interim analysis plans.

attributes.name: ectd_sequence_number

attributes.name: ethics_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB/IEC granted approval for the protocol amendment. Required before implementation at sites under the jurisdiction of that ethics committee.

attributes.name: ethics_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the protocol amendment was submitted to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) for review and approval.

attributes.name: global_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment was submitted simultaneously to multiple health authorities as part of a global regulatory strategy, requiring coordinated timelines across FDA, EMA, PMDA, and other agencies.

attributes.name: icf_version_impacted
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Informed Consent Form (ICF) that must be updated as a result of this amendment. Links to the ICF version management workflow in Clinpal and the document management system.

attributes.name: implementation_date

attributes.name: planned_implementation_date
attributes.description: Target date for operational implementation of the amendment at clinical sites, used for project planning and site readiness tracking in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Oracle Siebel CTMS; GCP

attributes.name: prior_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this amendment requires prior approval from the health authority before implementation (true for substantial amendments) versus notification-only (false for non-substantial/administrative amendments).
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 15; 21 CFR Part 312.30; EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: reconsent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether enrolled subjects must provide updated informed consent (ICF re-consent) as a result of this amendment. Triggers ICF version update workflow in Clinpal and site notification via Oracle Siebel CTMS.

attributes.name: review_deadline_date
attributes.description: Calculated or mandated deadline by which the health authority must respond to the amendment submission per applicable regulations (e.g., 30-day FDA IND amendment review window, EMA assessment timeline). Used for escalation and follow-up tracking.

Also manages individual content units (documents, datasets, study reports) with CTD section references (e.g., Module 2.7.3, Module 5.3.5.1), document metadata, file format, lifecycle operations, and Veeva Vault document IDs. Serves as the structural backbone for all submission content and enables dossier gap analysis.

attributes.name: ctd_format

attributes.name: dossier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the CTD dossier. Tracks progression from authoring through regulatory submission and archival.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; Veeva Vault RIM

attributes.name: dossier_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the CTD dossier, typically including the drug name, application type, and submission sequence (e.g., 'DrugX NDA Initial Submission CTD Dossier').

attributes.name: dossier_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dossier submission type. Initial submissions establish the application; amendments and supplements update specific modules; annual reports fulfill periodic reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; 21 CFR Part 314.70 (NDA Supplements); EMA Variation Regulation (EC) No 1234/2008

attributes.name: dossier_version
attributes.description: Version number of the CTD dossier (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Incremented with each major revision or amendment cycle.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Name of the investigational drug or biologic product that is the subject of the CTD dossier (proprietary name, INN, or code name).
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; WHO INN Programme; FDA Drug Naming Guidance

attributes.name: dtd_version
attributes.description: Version of the eCTD Document Type Definition (DTD) or XML schema used for the dossier backbone (e.g., 3.2.2 for FDA, 4.0 for EMA). Determines structural compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ICH M2 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Specification

attributes.name: gap_analysis_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent dossier gap analysis was completed. Used to assess the currency of the gap analysis relative to dossier updates.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA Pre-Submission Meeting Guidance

attributes.name: gap_analysis_status
attributes.description: Status of the formal gap analysis conducted to identify missing or incomplete content units within the CTD dossier prior to submission.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA Pre-Submission Meeting Guidance; EMA Pre-Submission Guidance

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The therapeutic indication or disease area for which the drug is being developed and for which the CTD dossier is submitted.

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the CTD dossier has been assessed and confirmed as ready for regulatory agency inspection. True when all required documents are present, validated, and accessible.

attributes.name: last_compiled_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CTD dossier was most recently compiled and packaged for submission or review. Tracks the currency of the assembled dossier.
attributes.references: ICH M2 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the CTD dossier record. Required for audit trail and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.

attributes.name: module1_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 1 (Regional Administrative Information), which contains region-specific forms, cover letters, and labeling. Content varies by target agency.

attributes.name: module2_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 2 (CTD Summaries), including the Quality Overall Summary (QOS), Nonclinical Overview, Clinical Overview, Nonclinical Written and Tabulated Summaries, and Clinical Summary.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; ICH M4Q; ICH M4S; ICH M4E

attributes.name: module3_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 3 (Quality), covering drug substance, drug product, and related quality documentation per ICH M4Q.
attributes.references: ICH M4Q (R1) CTD Quality Guideline

attributes.name: module4_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 4 (Nonclinical Study Reports), including pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, and toxicology study reports per ICH M4S.
attributes.references: ICH M4S (R2) CTD Safety Guideline

attributes.name: module5_status
attributes.description: Completeness status of CTD Module 5 (Clinical Study Reports), including all clinical pharmacology, efficacy, and safety study reports per ICH M4E.
attributes.references: ICH M4E (R2) CTD Efficacy Guideline; ICH E3 Clinical Study Report

attributes.name: open_gap_count
attributes.description: Number of identified content gaps (missing or incomplete documents/sections) that remain unresolved in the current dossier version. Key metric for submission readiness.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA Pre-Submission Meeting Guidance

attributes.name: overall_completeness_status
attributes.description: Aggregate readiness assessment of the entire CTD dossier across all five modules. Used for dossier gap analysis and submission readiness reviews.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA Pre-Submission Meeting Guidance; EMA Pre-Submission Guidance

attributes.name: planned_submission_date
attributes.description: Target date on which the CTD dossier is planned to be submitted to the regulatory agency. Used for milestone tracking and resource planning.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Guideline; FDA PDUFA Goal Dates; EMA Submission Timelines

attributes.name: prior_submission_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the prior submission or dossier version that this submission amends or supplements. Enables lineage tracking across submission cycles.
attributes.references: ICH M2 eCTD Specification; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: publishing_tool
attributes.description: Name and version of the publishing software used to compile and validate the eCTD dossier (e.g., Lorenz docuBridge, Extedo eCTD Manager, Veeva Vault RIM Publisher). Critical for reproducibility and troubleshooting.
attributes.references: FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Specification

attributes.name: publishing_tool_version
attributes.description: Version number of the publishing tool used to compile this dossier. Required for audit trail and reproducibility of the eCTD package.

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that owns the regulatory application and CTD dossier.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: total_document_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual content units (documents, datasets, study reports) included in this CTD dossier version. Used for completeness tracking and submission package verification.

attributes.name: validation_report_date

attributes.name: validation_report_status

attributes.name: veeva_vault_binder_reference

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Name of the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that holds this regulatory approval. The Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) or IND holder as recognized by the health authority.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; ICH E6(R2) Section 5

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area or disease category associated with the approved indication (e.g., Oncology, Cardiovascular, Immunology, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for portfolio analytics and regulatory strategy reporting.
attributes.references: MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC); ICH E3; CDISC Therapeutic Area Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this regulatory approval record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: The document identifier in Veeva Vault (eTMF/regulatory submissions module) for the approval letter or decision document. Enables direct navigation to the source document in the system of record.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

products.name: ind_application
products.description: Specialized master record for Investigational New Drug (IND) applications filed with the FDA (or equivalent CTAs with EMA/MHRA). Tracks IND number, IND type (commercial, research, emergency), sponsor name, investigational product name, phase coverage, initial IND submission date, IND status (active, inactive, withdrawn), annual report due dates, safety reporting obligations, and cross-reference to the parent application record.
products.reference: IND Application (21 CFR Part 312, FDA IND Guidance)

attributes.name: ind_application_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the IND application record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: parent_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent regulatory application record when this IND is a sub-application or cross-references a master NDA/BLA/MAA application. Enables hierarchical navigation of the regulatory application portfolio.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; FDA Regulatory Application Hierarchy

attributes.name: responsible_regulatory_lead_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Responsible Regulatory Lead Employee Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: The regulatory lead managing an IND is accountable for annual reports, clinical hold responses, and protocol submissions. IND lifecycle management requires a traceable workforce employee. 'responsible
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of IND amendments (protocol amendments, information amendments, safety reports) submitted to the FDA under this IND. Tracks the volume of regulatory activity and dossier complexity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.31; 21 CFR Part 312.30; FDA IND Amendment Regulations

attributes.name: annual_report_due_date
attributes.description: The next due date for the IND Annual Report submission to the FDA. Annual reports are required within 60 days of the anniversary of the IND effective date and must summarize clinical progress, safety data, and manufacturing updates.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.33; FDA IND Annual Report Requirements

attributes.name: application_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which this application is filed (e.g., USA for FDA, GBR for MHRA, JPN for PMDA). Enables multi-country regulatory portfolio analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH CTD; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Breakthrough Therapy designation for the investigational product under this IND. Breakthrough Therapy designation provides intensive FDA guidance and rolling review for drugs showing substantial improvement over existing therapies.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.82; FDA Breakthrough Therapy Guidance; FDASIA Section 902

attributes.name: clinical_hold_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA issued a clinical hold order on this IND, halting enrollment or dosing of subjects. Nullable for INDs not on clinical hold. Triggers mandatory sponsor response within 30 days.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42; FDA Clinical Hold Regulations

attributes.name: clinical_hold_lifted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA lifted the clinical hold and authorized resumption of clinical trials under this IND. Nullable for INDs that have never been on clinical hold or where the hold remains active.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42; FDA Clinical Hold Regulations

attributes.name: clinical_hold_reason
attributes.description: Description of the FDA's stated reason for imposing a clinical hold on this IND. Captures the safety concern, protocol deficiency, or regulatory non-compliance issue cited by the agency. Nullable for INDs not on clinical hold.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.42; FDA Clinical Hold Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this IND application record was first created in the lakehouse data platform. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for audit trail and data lineage purposes. Conforms to 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The pharmaceutical dosage form of the investigational product (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, infusion, patch). Captured from the IND CMC section and used for supply chain and regulatory tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(7); ICH Q8

attributes.name: drug_substance_name
attributes.description: International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or chemical name of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) covered under this IND. Used for regulatory cross-referencing and WHO-DD coding.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(5); WHO-DD; ICH Q11

attributes.name: ectd_submission_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Submission Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this IND application is submitted in eCTD format via the FDA Electronic Submissions Gateway. True indicates eCTD format; False indicates paper or non-eCTD electronic submission. FDA mandates eCTD for most IND submissions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA eCTD Guidance; ICH M8

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IND became effective and clinical trials were authorized to commence. Under 21 CFR Part 312.40, an IND becomes effective 30 days after FDA receipt unless FDA places a clinical hold. This is the EFFECTIVE_FROM date for the IND agreement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.40; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: equivalent_application_number
attributes.description: The application number assigned by a non-FDA regulatory agency for an equivalent authorization (e.g., EMA CTA number, MHRA CTA reference, PMDA CTN). Used to cross-reference the IND with parallel international submissions.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA CTA Regulations; PMDA Regulations

attributes.name: fast_track_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Fast Track designation for the investigational product under this IND. Fast Track facilitates development and expedites review of drugs treating serious conditions with unmet medical need.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.82; FDA Fast Track Guidance; FDAMA Section 112

attributes.name: fda_application_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA officially acknowledged receipt of the IND application. Starts the 30-day review clock per 21 CFR Part 312.40. May differ from the initial submission date if there were transmission delays.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.40; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: fda_division
attributes.description: The FDA Center and Division responsible for reviewing this IND application (e.g., CDER/Division of Oncology Products 1, CBER/Division of Vaccines). Determines the regulatory review team and applicable FDA guidance documents.
attributes.references: FDA CDER/CBER Organizational Structure; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: inactivation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the IND was placed into inactive status, either by sponsor notification or FDA action. Nullable for active INDs. Represents the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL boundary for the active IND period.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.45; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: ind_number
attributes.description: Official IND number assigned by the FDA upon receipt of the IND application. This is the externally-known regulatory identifier used in all agency correspondence, safety reports, and annual reports. Format is a numeric string up to 6 digits as assigned by FDA.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: ind_serial_number_latest
attributes.description: The most recent serial number assigned to the latest IND submission sequence (original or amendment). IND submissions are numbered sequentially starting from 0000. Used to track the current version of the IND dossier in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23; FDA IND Submission Numbering

attributes.name: ind_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IND application by its intended purpose. Commercial INDs are filed by pharmaceutical/biotech sponsors for drug development. Research INDs are filed by investigators for academic studies. Emergency use and treatment INDs cover compassionate use scenarios. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|research|emergency_use|treatment|expanded_access — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.20; 21 CFR Part 312.310; 21 CFR Part 312.315

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The specific disease, condition, or patient population for which the investigational product is being studied under this IND. Aligns with the MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) for the target indication.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(3); MedDRA PT; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: initial_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the original IND application was first submitted to the FDA. This is the principal business event date for the IND lifecycle and triggers the 30-day FDA review clock per 21 CFR Part 312.40.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.40; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: investigational_product_code
attributes.description: Internal sponsor code or development compound number assigned to the investigational product (e.g., ABC-123). Used for cross-referencing across clinical, regulatory, and supply chain systems including RTSM and Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(5); CDISC SDTM IG

attributes.name: investigational_product_name
attributes.description: The name of the investigational drug, biologic, or compound covered under this IND application. May be a code name, generic name, or proprietary name as designated by the sponsor. Corresponds to the investigational product tracked in Medidata Rave and Oracle Clinical One.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(5); ICH E6(R2) Section 1.33

attributes.name: last_annual_report_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last IND Annual Report Submission Date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent IND Annual Report was submitted to the FDA. Used to track compliance with annual reporting obligations and calculate the next due date.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.33; FDA IND Annual Report Requirements

attributes.name: nda_bla_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Drug Application (NDA) / Biologics License Application (BLA) Number
attributes.description: The NDA or BLA application number to which this IND is expected to transition upon successful completion of clinical development. Nullable for early-phase INDs where the downstream marketing application has not yet been filed.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); 21 CFR Part 601 (BLA); FDA Regulatory Pathway

attributes.name: orphan_drug_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA Office of Orphan Products Development (OOPD) has granted Orphan Drug designation for the investigational product. Orphan designation provides tax credits, market exclusivity, and expedited review for drugs targeting rare diseases affecting fewer than 200,000 US patients.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 316; Orphan Drug Act; FDA OOPD

attributes.name: phase_coverage
attributes.description: The clinical development phase(s) authorized under this IND application. An IND may cover a single phase or span multiple phases. Phase 1 covers first-in-human safety studies; Phase 2 covers efficacy and dose-ranging; Phase 3 covers confirmatory trials; Phase 4 covers post-marketing studies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phase_1|phase_1_2|phase_2|phase_2_3|phase_3|phase_4|all_phases — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.21; ICH E8(R1)

attributes.name: protocol_count
attributes.description: The total number of clinical study protocols currently authorized and active under this IND application. An IND may cover multiple protocols across different phases and indications.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(6); FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: regulatory_agency
attributes.description: The health authority with which this application is filed. While IND is an FDA-specific designation, this field accommodates equivalent Clinical Trial Authorizations (CTAs) filed with EMA, MHRA, PMDA, Health Canada, or TGA under the same master record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); MHRA Regulations

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The route by which the investigational product is administered to subjects (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, intramuscular, topical). Sourced from the IND protocol section and CDISC SDTM ROUTE variable.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(3); CDISC SDTM IG; FDA Route of Administration Terminology

attributes.name: safety_reporting_obligation
attributes.description: Defines the IND-level safety reporting obligation tier. Standard obligations apply to all INDs. Expedited 7-day reporting applies to fatal or life-threatening unexpected SUSARs. Expedited 15-day reporting applies to other unexpected serious adverse reactions. Drives Oracle Argus Safety workflow configuration.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32; ICH E2A; FDA Safety Reporting Guidance

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the designated sponsor contact person for FDA correspondence related to this IND application. Used for regulatory notifications and agency communication tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(1); GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated sponsor contact person listed on the IND application for FDA correspondence. This individual receives all FDA communications including clinical hold letters and information requests.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(1); GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: sponsor_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the sponsor entity responsible for the IND application as filed with the FDA. The sponsor assumes legal and regulatory accountability for the investigational product and the conduct of the clinical trials under this IND.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.23(a)(1); ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sponsor organization type. Distinguishes between commercial pharmaceutical/biotech companies, academic institutions, government agencies, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) acting as sponsor.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.3; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The disease area or medical specialty that the investigational product targets (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for portfolio analytics, regulatory strategy, and resource planning.
attributes.references: MedDRA SOC Classification; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this IND application record was most recently modified in the lakehouse data platform. Represents the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail compliance per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: The document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF corresponding to the master IND application dossier. Enables direct cross-reference to the regulatory binder and TMF artifact in the document management system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sponsor formally withdrew the IND application from FDA. Nullable for non-withdrawn INDs. Triggers archival obligations and cessation of all clinical activities under the IND.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.38; FDA IND Regulations

products.name: nda_bla_application
products.description: Specialized master record for New Drug Applications (NDA), Biologics License Applications (BLA), and equivalent marketing authorization applications (MAA). Tracks application number, application type (NDA/BLA/MAA/sNDA/sBLA), PDUFA goal date, priority review designation, breakthrough therapy designation, orphan drug designation, rolling review status, advisory committee meeting date, and approval pathway.
products.reference: NDA/BLA/MAA (21 CFR Part 314/601, EU CTR, EMA CHMP Guidance)

attributes.name: nda_bla_application_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Drug Application (NDA) / Biologics License Application (BLA) Application ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the NDA, BLA, or equivalent marketing authorization application record in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); 21 CFR Part 601 (BLA); EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: nda_bla_application is a specialized master record that extends the generic application record for NDA/BLA/MAA submissions, mirroring the pattern of ind_application.parent_application_id → application
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Pre-NDA/BLA submission QA audits are a mandatory step in regulatory operations. The audit record must reference the NDA/BLA application being audited, supporting the submission quality certification r
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.inspection. Business justification: Pre-approval inspections (PAIs) are triggered by NDA/BLA applications. The NDA/BLA record must reference the PAI to support the complete application file and demonstrate inspection readiness, as requi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: FK to sponsor.organization

attributes.name: project_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: The project manager for an NDA/BLA owns PDUFA goal date tracking, rolling review coordination, and advisory committee preparation — all named regulatory operations processes. 'project_manager_name' is
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_binder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: NDA/BLA applications are assembled as regulatory binders for eCTD submission. Linking the NDA/BLA application record to its primary regulatory binder enables application-level binder management, suppo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accelerated_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the application is submitted under the FDA Accelerated Approval pathway (Subpart H/E), based on a surrogate or intermediate clinical endpoint with post-marketing confirmatory trial requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314 Subpart H; 21 CFR Part 601 Subpart E; FDA Omnibus Reform Act 2022

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the health authority formally accepted the application for substantive review (Day 74 for EMA; Day 60 for FDA filing decision). Null if not yet accepted or if refused at filing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.101; EMA Centralised Procedure Day 70/74 Acceptance

attributes.name: advisory_committee_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date of the FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) meeting convened to review this application. Null if no advisory committee meeting is planned or held.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 14; FDA MAPP 4151.1

attributes.name: advisory_committee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) meeting has been scheduled or held for this application. Advisory committee recommendations are a key input to the FDA approval decision.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 14; FDA MAPP 4151.1; PDUFA VII

attributes.name: advisory_committee_recommendation
attributes.description: Outcome vote or recommendation issued by the FDA Advisory Committee following their review meeting. Null if no meeting held. Informs but does not bind the FDA approval decision.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 14; FDA MAPP 4151.1

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the marketing authorization application as tracked in Veeva Vault regulatory submissions module. Drives workflow routing and regulatory milestone tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|accepted|under_review|approved|refused|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.100; EMA Procedural Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: application_type
attributes.description: Classification of the marketing authorization application: NDA (New Drug Application), BLA (Biologics License Application), sNDA (supplemental NDA), sBLA (supplemental BLA), or MAA (Marketing Authorization Application for EMA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NDA|BLA|sNDA|sBLA|MAA|JNDA|ANDS|NDS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314 (NDA); 21 CFR Part 601 (BLA); EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; Health Canada C.08.002

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the health authority issued the formal approval decision (FDA approval letter, EMA CHMP positive opinion, PMDA approval). Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.105; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004 Article 10; ICH E8

attributes.name: approval_pathway
attributes.description: Regulatory approval pathway under which the application is reviewed: standard review, accelerated approval (FDA), conditional marketing authorization (EMA), exceptional circumstances (EMA), or rolling review. Determines review timelines and post-approval commitments.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.500 (Accelerated Approval); EMA Regulation (EC) No 507/2006 (Conditional MA); ICH E9

attributes.name: breakthrough_therapy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation (BTD) for this drug, enabling intensive FDA guidance and rolling review. Applicable to FDA NDA/BLA only.
attributes.references: FDA Safety and Innovation Act (FDASIA) Section 902; FDA Guidance: Breakthrough Therapy Designation; 21 CFR Part 312.82

attributes.name: complete_response_letter_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FDA issued a Complete Response Letter (CRL) indicating the application cannot be approved in its current form and specifying deficiencies to be addressed. Null if no CRL issued.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.110; FDA Guidance: Complete Response Letters

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this NDA/BLA application record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Signatures); ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: ctd_module_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Common Technical Document (CTD) Module Completeness Status
attributes.description: Overall completeness status of the CTD dossier modules (1–5) at time of submission. Tracks whether all required CTD modules have been submitted to the health authority.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; ICH M8 eCTD; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.50

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: Physical form of the drug product as approved or under review (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection, lyophilized powder for injection, transdermal patch). Captured per ICH M4 CTD Module 3 pharmaceutical development.
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD Module 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.50(d); EMA QRD Template

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: Proprietary (brand) name or proposed trade name of the drug or biologic product as submitted in the application. Used for regulatory correspondence, labeling, and commercial tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 201.10 (labeling); EMA Guideline on Invented Name; ICH M4 CTD Module 1

attributes.name: ectd_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Common Technical Document (eCTD) Sequence Number
attributes.description: Four-digit eCTD sequence number assigned to the initial submission or most recent submission sequence in the eCTD lifecycle. Used to track the dossier version in Veeva Vault regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: ICH M8 eCTD; FDA eCTD Technical Conformance Guide; EMA eCTD Specification

attributes.name: exclusivity_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory market exclusivity granted upon approval: NCE (5-year new chemical entity), biologic (12-year), orphan drug (7-year), pediatric (6-month extension), new indication (3-year), or none.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.108; BPCIA 42 USC 262; Orphan Drug Act 21 CFR Part 316

attributes.name: fast_track_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Fast Track designation, facilitating more frequent interactions with FDA and eligibility for rolling review. Applicable to FDA NDA/BLA only.
attributes.references: FDA FDAMA Section 112; FDA Guidance: Expedited Programs for Serious Conditions; 21 CFR Part 312.80

attributes.name: health_authority
attributes.description: Regulatory health authority to which the application was submitted (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada, TGA). Determines applicable regulatory framework, timelines, and submission format requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|PMDA|MHRA|Health_Canada|TGA|ANVISA|NMPA|Swissmedic|COFEPRIS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH M4 CTD; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA Regulation (EC) No 726/2004; PMDA Pharmaceutical Affairs Law

attributes.name: ind_number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned Investigational New Drug (IND) application number that served as the regulatory basis for the clinical development program supporting this NDA/BLA. Links the marketing application to its clinical development history.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; FDA IND Application Regulations

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: Full text of the proposed or approved indication statement describing the disease, condition, or patient population for which the drug is intended. Directly maps to the approved labeling indication section.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 201.57(c)(2); EMA SmPC Section 4.1; ICH E8

attributes.name: inn
attributes.description: WHO-assigned International Nonproprietary Name (INN) for the active substance. Provides a globally unique, non-proprietary identifier for the drug substance used across regulatory submissions and scientific literature.
attributes.references: WHO INN Programme; ICH M4 CTD Module 2.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 299.4

attributes.name: market_exclusivity_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory market exclusivity period expires (e.g., 5-year NCE exclusivity, 12-year biologic exclusivity, 7-year orphan drug exclusivity). Critical for commercial lifecycle and generic/biosimilar entry planning.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.108 (NCE exclusivity); Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act (BPCIA); Orphan Drug Act

attributes.name: orphan_drug_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug or biologic has received Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) from FDA (Orphan Drug Act) or EMA (EC Regulation 141/2000), conferring market exclusivity and fee waivers.
attributes.references: FDA Orphan Drug Act 21 CFR Part 316; EMA Regulation (EC) No 141/2000; OHRP

attributes.name: pdufa_goal_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) Goal Date
attributes.description: FDA-assigned PDUFA action goal date by which the agency commits to completing its review. Applicable to FDA NDA/BLA submissions; null for non-FDA applications. Critical KPI for regulatory timeline management.
attributes.references: PDUFA VII (FY2023-2027); FDA 21 CFR Part 314.100; FDA MAPP 6020.3

attributes.name: post_marketing_commitment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approval includes required post-marketing commitments (PMCs) or post-marketing requirements (PMRs), such as confirmatory trials for accelerated approval or pediatric studies under PREA.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.81; FDA FDAAA 2007; Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA)

attributes.name: priority_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has granted Priority Review designation to this application, reducing the standard review period from 12 months to 6 months. Applicable to FDA NDA/BLA only.
attributes.references: FDA PDUFA VII; FDA Guidance for Industry: Expedited Programs for Serious Conditions; 21 CFR Part 312.81

attributes.name: refuse_to_file_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FDA issued a Refuse to File (RTF) action, indicating the application was not sufficiently complete for substantive review. Null if no RTF was issued.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.101(d); FDA Guidance: Refuse to File

attributes.name: rems_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FDA has required a Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) as a condition of approval to ensure the drug's benefits outweigh its risks.
attributes.references: FDA FDAAA 2007 Section 505-1; FDA 21 CFR Part 314.520; FDA REMS Guidance

attributes.name: resubmission_class
attributes.description: FDA classification of the resubmission following a CRL: Class 1 (2-month review goal) for minor responses, Class 2 (6-month review goal) for major responses requiring extensive review.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.110(b)(3); PDUFA VII Commitment Letter

attributes.name: resubmission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor resubmitted the application following a Complete Response Letter (CRL) or other agency deficiency communication. Null if no resubmission has occurred.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314.110(b); FDA Guidance: Complete Response Letters

attributes.name: review_division
attributes.description: FDA Office or Division (e.g., Office of Oncology Products, Division of Psychiatry) or EMA Committee (CHMP, COMP) responsible for reviewing this application. Used for regulatory relationship management and escalation routing.
attributes.references: FDA CDER/CBER Office Structure; EMA CHMP/COMP Procedures; FDA MAPP

attributes.name: rolling_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health authority has granted rolling review, allowing submission and review of completed CTD modules before the full dossier is complete. Applicable to FDA (Fast Track) and EMA rolling review procedures.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance: Expedited Programs; EMA Rolling Review Procedure; ICH M4 CTD

attributes.name: route_of_administration

The agency_code STRING field on safety_report_submission is a denormalized reference to health_authority.agency_code. Addi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id

attributes.description: Reference to the original or preceding safety report submission record when this record is a follow-up or amendment. Enables lineage tracking across submission versions for the same safety event.
attributes.references: ICH E2A, ICH E2B(R3), EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: prepared_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Safety report preparation (ICSRs, DSURs, PSURs) is a regulated activity with 7/15-day expedited timelines requiring traceable employee accountability. 'prepared_by' is a denormalized workforce employe
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sdtm_dataset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to data.sdtm_dataset. Business justification: Safety report submissions (DSURs, IND Annual Reports) are generated from a specific SDTM dataset version locked at the data cut date. Regulatory safety teams must document which dataset version underp
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this safety report is submitted. Links to the study master record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP, CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Safety reports (DSURs, IND annual reports, SUSARs) are TMF Zone 1 essential documents. Regulatory inspectors verify safety reporting compliance by reviewing TMF filings; linking safety_report_submissi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: agency_acknowledgment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the health authority formally acknowledged receipt of the safety report submission. For FDA IND submissions this is the date of the FDA acknowledgment letter; for EMA SUSAR submissions this is the EudraVigilance gateway acknowledgment date.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VI, EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: agency_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference or tracking number assigned by the health authority upon receipt or acknowledgment of the safety report (e.g., FDA case number, EudraVigilance case ID, PMDA receipt number). Used for follow-up correspondence.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VI, ICH E2B(R3)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the safety report received final internal approval for submission. Used to calculate the internal review cycle time and to verify compliance with expedited reporting timelines.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, ICH E6(R2), ALCOA+

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the qualified person, medical officer, or regulatory lead who provided final approval of the safety report prior to submission. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature and ALCOA+ requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, ICH E6(R2), ALCOA+, EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: argus_safety_case_reference
attributes.description: Case identifier in Oracle Argus Safety system that is the source of the safety data underlying this submission. Provides traceability from the regulatory submission back to the adverse event case in the pharmacovigilance system of record.
attributes.references: Oracle Argus Safety, ICH E2B(R3), 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: causality_assessment
attributes.description: Sponsor or investigator assessment of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the adverse reaction reported in this submission. Drives the reporting obligation classification.
attributes.references: ICH E2A, ICH E2D, EMA GVP Module VI, 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety report submission record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+, ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: ctis_number
attributes.description: EU Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) authorization number under EU CTR 536/2014, replacing EudraCT for trials authorized under the new regulation. Used for SUSAR submissions via the CTIS portal.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014, EMA CTIS guidance

attributes.name: data_lock_date
attributes.description: The date on which the safety database was locked for the purpose of generating this periodic safety report. No new safety data is included after this date. Equivalent to the reporting period end date for periodic reports.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), ICH E2F, EMA GVP Module VII

attributes.name: dibd
attributes.description: Development International Birth Date (DIBD) — the date of the first authorization to conduct a clinical trial with the investigational product in any country. Used as the anchor date for calculating DSUR submission deadlines (due 60 days after DIBD anniversary).
attributes.references: ICH E2F, EMA GVP Module VII

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which the safety report must be submitted to the health authority. For expedited SUSAR/IND safety reports this is typically 7 or 15 calendar days from initial awareness; for DSURs it is 60 days from the Development International Birth Date (DIBD).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32, ICH E2C(R2), EMA GVP Module VII, EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: eudract_number
attributes.description: European Union Drug Regulating Authorities Clinical Trials (EudraCT) number assigned to the clinical trial, used for EMA and EU member state safety report submissions. Format: YYYY-NNNNNN-CC.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014, EMA GVP Module VII, EudraCT database

attributes.name: expedited_report_timeline_days
attributes.description: Regulatory reporting timeline in calendar days applicable to this expedited submission (typically 7 days for fatal/life-threatening unexpected SARs or 15 days for other unexpected serious adverse reactions). Null for periodic reports.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32, ICH E2A, EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: investigational_product_name
attributes.description: Name of the investigational medicinal product (IMP) or drug substance that is the subject of this safety report. Aligns with the IND/CTA product designation.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), ICH E2F, 21 CFR Part 312, EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_expedited
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety report is an expedited submission (True) subject to 7-day or 15-day reporting timelines, as opposed to a periodic report. Expedited reports include SUSARs and IND safety reports for unexpected serious adverse reactions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32, ICH E2A, EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: is_follow_up
attributes.description: Indicates whether this submission is a follow-up (True) to a previously submitted safety report for the same event or reporting period, as opposed to an initial/original submission (False). Follow-up submissions provide updated or additional information.
attributes.references: ICH E2A, ICH E2B(R3), 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: listedness_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the adverse reaction is listed (expected) or unlisted (unexpected) in the current Investigator's Brochure (IB) or Reference Safety Information (RSI). Unlisted/unexpected reactions meeting seriousness criteria trigger SUSAR reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E2A, ICH E2F, EMA GVP Module VI, 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: meddra_pt_code
attributes.description: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) Preferred Term (PT) code for the primary adverse reaction or event described in this safety report. Standardizes event terminology for regulatory submissions and signal detection.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities), ICH E2B(R3), EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: meddra_soc_code
attributes.description: Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities (MedDRA) System Organ Class (SOC) code associated with the primary adverse reaction in this safety report. Used for aggregate safety analysis and tabulation in periodic reports.
attributes.references: MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities), ICH E2B(R3), CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: regulatory_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the regulatory action required or taken as a result of this safety report submission (e.g., IB update, protocol amendment, clinical hold notification, Dear Investigator Letter). Populated when regulatory_action_required is True.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VII

attributes.name: regulatory_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety report submission has triggered or requires a regulatory action such as a protocol amendment, IB update, informed consent revision, or clinical hold. Supports inspection readiness and CAPA tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VII, ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety report being submitted. IND_SAFETY_REPORT = expedited IND safety report (15-day/7-day); DSUR = Development Safety Update Report; PSUR_PBRER = Periodic Safety Update Report / Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report; SUSAR = Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction; IND_ANNUAL_REPORT = annual IND progress report; CIOMS = Council for International Organizations of Medical Sciences line listing.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), ICH E2F, 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VII, EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: report_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the safety report document (e.g., 1.0, 2.0, 1.1 for amendments). Tracks original submissions versus follow-up or amended versions submitted to the same agency.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), EMA GVP Module VII, 21 CFR Part 312.32

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the data collection period covered by this safety report, also known as the data lock point (DLP). Defines the cut-off date for safety data included in the report.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), ICH E2F, EMA GVP Module VII

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the data collection period covered by this safety report (e.g., the beginning of the DSUR or PSUR/PBRER data lock window). Applicable to periodic reports; may be null for expedited reports.
attributes.references: ICH E2C(R2), ICH E2F, EMA GVP Module VII

attributes.name: seriousness_criteria
attributes.description: ICH E2A seriousness criterion that triggered the expedited reporting obligation for this submission. Applicable to SUSAR and IND safety reports. FATAL = resulted in death; LIFE_THREATENING = immediately life-threatening; HOSPITALIZATION = required or prolonged inpatient hospitalization; DISABILITY = persistent or significant disability/incapacity; CONGENITAL_ANOMALY = congenital anomaly/birth defect; MEDICALLY_SIGNIFICANT = other medically important condition.
attributes.references: ICH E2A, ICH E2D, 21 CFR Part 312.32, EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: submission_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction to which the safety report is submitted (e.g., USA, GBR, JPN, CAN, AUS). Supports multi-country submission tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1, ICH E2C(R2), EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this safety report submission record. Supports audit trail integrity and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+, ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Document identifier in Veeva Vault (eTMF/regulatory submissions module) for the finalized safety report document. Enables direct traceability from this submission record to the source document in the system of record.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions, 21 CFR Part 11, ICH E6(R2) TMF

products.name: clinical_trial_authorization

Tracks CTA reference number, member state, competent authority, trial phase, authorization date, expiry date, conditions attached, substantial modification history, and current authorization status. Complements IND records for non-US regulatory coverage and enables multi-country trial authorization tracking across EU CTIS and national portals.
products.reference: CTA (EU CTR 536/2014, MHRA CTA Guidance, Health Canada CTA)

attributes.name: clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Clinical Trial Authorization record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: health_authority_id

The competent_authority_name and competent_authority_code STRING fields are denormalized references to health_authority
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parent_cta_clinical_trial_authorization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original or preceding CTA record from which this substantial modification, renewal, or extension derives. Enables reconstruction of the full authorization history chain for a trial in a given member state.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; EMA CTIS; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the national competent authority formally granted the Clinical Trial Authorization. This is the principal regulatory event date and the start of the authorized trial period. Corresponds to TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 8; ICH E6(R2); EMA

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Clinical Trial Authorization as determined by the national competent authority. Drives regulatory compliance monitoring, site activation eligibility, and inspection readiness assessments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|authorized|conditionally_authorized|refused|withdrawn|expired|suspended — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA CTIS

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Classification of the CTA record by authorization event type: initial authorization, substantial modification (protocol amendment requiring NCA approval), renewal, geographic extension, or withdrawal. Drives workflow and regulatory reporting logic.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Articles 15-19; ICH E6(R2); EMA Guidance on Substantial Modifications

attributes.name: conditions_attached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the national competent authority attached specific conditions or obligations to the Clinical Trial Authorization that must be fulfilled for the authorization to remain valid. True if conditions exist; False otherwise.
