attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: tmf_reference_model_section
attributes.business_glossary_term: DIA Trial Master File (TMF) Reference Model Section
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model zone/section identifier to which this SOP is mapped, if applicable (e.g., '01.01 - Trial Management'). Supports eTMF filing and inspection readiness alignment with the DIA TMF Reference Model.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF; EMA; FDA

attributes.name: training_completion_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from the SOP effective date within which all applicable personnel must complete the required training. Drives training assignment deadlines in MasterControl.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA GCP; SOPs for Training Compliance

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether staff must complete mandatory training on this SOP before performing the governed activities. When True, a training record must be created in MasterControl for all applicable personnel. Supports GCP training compliance.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; FDA GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Current approved version of the SOP in major.minor format (e.g., '3.0', '2.1'). Incremented upon each approved revision cycle. Critical for ALCOA+ compliance and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

products.name: workflow
products.description: Tracks the lifecycle workflow state of a document through its review, approval, and distribution process within Veeva Vault. Captures workflow instance ID, workflow template name, current workflow step, step assignee role, step due date, step completion date, workflow status (initiated, in-review, pending-approval, approved, rejected, cancelled), escalation flag, and SLA breach indicator. Supports GCP-compliant document control workflows.
products.reference: Veeva Vault Workflow Engine; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: workflow_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each document workflow instance in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the document_workflow data product.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: document_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: SOPs undergo formal review, approval, and distribution workflows governed by the document_workflow entity. Adding document_sop_id FK to document_workflow enables SOP lifecycle management within the sa
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study associated with this document workflow. Enables study-level aggregation of document control activities for inspection readiness and TMF completeness reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the controlled document record that this workflow instance governs. Links the workflow to the specific Trial Master File (TMF) or SOP document undergoing review, approval, or distribution.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_version. Business justification: Document workflows govern a specific version of a document through its review and approval lifecycle. The document_version STRING column in document_workflow is a denormalized reference to the control
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: workflow_employee_id
attributes.description: Veeva Vault user identifier of the individual currently assigned to complete the active workflow step. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature audit trail and accountability under ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: workflow_initiated_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Veeva Vault user identifier of the individual who initiated the document workflow. Required for ALCOA+ attributability and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail to establish who triggered the document control process.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the entire document workflow reached a terminal state (approved, rejected, or cancelled). Used to calculate total workflow cycle time and measure against target_completion_date for SLA performance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: archival_date
attributes.description: Date on which the document was formally archived in the eTMF system following workflow completion. Null until archival is executed. Used to confirm compliance with ICH GCP and regulatory retention period requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: archival_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document must be archived upon workflow completion per ICH GCP retention requirements. Drives post-approval archival workflow initiation in Veeva Vault for long-term TMF retention compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this document_workflow record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the system audit creation timestamp for data lineage and ETL traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: current_step_name
attributes.description: Name of the active step within the workflow at the time of record capture (e.g., 'Quality Review', 'Medical Review', 'Regulatory Approval', 'Final Sign-Off'). Identifies where in the process the document currently resides.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow API; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl

attributes.name: current_step_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of the current workflow step within the overall workflow template sequence. Enables progress tracking and percentage-complete calculations across multi-step document approval processes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: distribution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved document was distributed to all designated recipients. Populated upon completion of the distribution step. Used to confirm timely dissemination per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: distribution_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved document must be distributed to designated recipients (sites, investigators, sponsors) upon workflow completion. Triggers the distribution workflow step in Veeva Vault upon approval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document being processed (e.g., 'Protocol', 'Informed Consent Form (ICF)', 'Investigator Brochure', 'SOP', 'Regulatory Submission', 'Site File'). Aligns with DIA TMF Reference Model artifact taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: protocol|icf|investigator-brochure|sop|regulatory-submission|site-file|csr|safety-report|amendment|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA eCTD; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: electronic_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more steps in this workflow require a 21 CFR Part 11 compliant electronic signature. Drives system enforcement of e-signature capture and audit trail requirements in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU Annex 11; Veeva Vault e-Signature

attributes.name: electronic_signature_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the final binding electronic signature was applied to the document within this workflow. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance. Null if electronic_signature_required is False or signature has not yet been applied.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU Annex 11; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this workflow instance has been formally escalated due to non-response, SLA breach, or rejection requiring management intervention. True triggers escalation notifications to supervisory roles per the workflow escalation policy.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault Escalation Rules; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for workflow escalation. Supports root cause analysis of document control bottlenecks and informs process improvement initiatives for GCP-compliant document management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault; DIA TMF Reference Model; CAPA

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the workflow was formally escalated. Populated only when escalation_flag is True. Used to measure escalation response time and track resolution of escalated document control issues.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: gcp_critical_document_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Critical Document Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document is classified as a GCP essential document per ICH E6(R2) Section 8. Critical documents require mandatory workflow completion before study activities can proceed and are prioritized in inspection readiness reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: initiated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document workflow instance was first created and launched in Veeva Vault. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the workflow lifecycle and the start point for overall cycle time measurement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault; ALCOA+

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this workflow and its associated document have been reviewed and confirmed as inspection-ready per GCP and regulatory authority standards. Supports pre-inspection TMF completeness assessments by FDA, EMA, MHRA, or other regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this workflow instance, reflecting urgency of document review and approval. Critical priority is assigned to GCP essential documents, regulatory submissions with imminent deadlines, and safety-related documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document being processed through this workflow is intended for regulatory submission (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD). True triggers additional compliance checks and approval requirements per FDA/EMA submission standards.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH CTD; eCTD; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: rejection_count
attributes.description: Number of times the document has been rejected and returned for revision within this workflow instance. High rejection counts indicate document quality issues and are tracked for quality metrics and CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or categorized reason provided when a workflow step is rejected. Documents the specific deficiency identified by the reviewer, supporting document quality improvement and GCP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: sla_breach_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the workflow or any of its steps has exceeded the defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) timeframe. True when step_completion_date or actual_completion_date exceeds the corresponding due date. Drives escalation and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault SLA Configuration; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: step_action_taken
attributes.description: The specific action performed by the assignee at the current or last completed workflow step. Captures the decision outcome (approved, rejected) or process action (delegated, escalated) for audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Veeva Vault; ALCOA+

attributes.name: step_assignee_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual assigned to the current workflow step. Captured at time of assignment for audit trail integrity per ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: step_assignee_role
attributes.description: Business role responsible for completing the current workflow step (e.g., 'Principal Investigator (PI)', 'Clinical Research Associate (CRA)', 'Regulatory Affairs Manager', 'Quality Assurance (QA) Reviewer'). Role-based assignment supports GCP delegation of authority.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment or rationale provided by the step assignee when completing, rejecting, or escalating the workflow step. Supports GCP documentation requirements and provides context for rejection decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: step_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the current or most recently completed workflow step was actioned and closed. Compared against step_due_date to determine SLA compliance and cycle time analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the workflow step action was recorded in Veeva Vault. Provides sub-day granularity required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic audit trail and time-stamped electronic signature records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: step_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the current workflow step as defined by the workflow SLA configuration. Used to calculate SLA breach status and trigger escalation notifications for overdue document reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault SLA Configuration; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Overall target date by which the entire document workflow (all steps) must be completed. Derived from workflow SLA rules and used for inspection readiness tracking and TMF completeness KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault SLA

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the Veeva Vault workflow template used to instantiate this workflow (e.g., 'SOP Review and Approval', 'Regulatory Document Approval', 'ICF Review Workflow'). Identifies the standard process blueprint applied.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl SOP

attributes.name: template_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the workflow template at the time this workflow instance was initiated. Ensures reproducibility and audit traceability when templates are updated over time.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model zone classification for the document being processed. Categorizes the document into the appropriate TMF structural zone to support inspection readiness and TMF completeness assessments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trial-management|site-management|ip-management|subject-information|safety-reporting|central-laboratory|statistics|central-monitoring — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: total_steps
attributes.description: Total number of steps defined in the workflow template for this workflow instance. Used in conjunction with current_step_sequence to calculate workflow completion percentage for inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow Configuration; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this document_workflow record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Tracks the most recent state change for incremental processing and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: workflow_instance_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by Veeva Vault to this specific workflow instance. Used for cross-system traceability and audit trail correlation with the source eTMF system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Workflow API; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document workflow instance within Veeva Vault. Tracks progression from initiation through review, approval decision, and terminal states. Supports GCP-compliant document control audit trails.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workflow by its primary business purpose within the document lifecycle. Distinguishes review-only workflows from approval workflows, distribution workflows, archival workflows, and amendment workflows.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF

products.name: signature
products.description: Records electronic signatures applied to controlled documents per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Captures signer identity, signer role (author, reviewer, approver, sponsor representative), signature date and timestamp, signature meaning (reviewed, approved, acknowledged), signature method (username/password, biometric), IP address, and audit hash. Provides the legally binding e-signature audit trail for regulatory submissions and inspections.
products.reference: 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11; Veeva Vault eSignature

attributes.name: signature_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each electronic signature record applied to a controlled document. Primary key for the document_signature data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: delegation_of_authority_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delegation of authority record when the signer is acting on behalf of another party (e.g., a sub-investigator signing on behalf of the Principal Investigator). Supports sponsor oversight and GCP compliance verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §4.2; 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: signature_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the authenticated user record of the individual who applied the electronic signature. Satisfies the ALCOA+ principle of Attributability — every signature must be traceable to a unique individual.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(i); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: signature_voided_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who performed the void action on this signature record. Required for audit trail completeness when a signature is invalidated.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: sponsor_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.sponsor_contact. Business justification: Sponsor contacts are signatories on key TMF documents (protocol approvals, ICF approvals, regulatory submissions). Linking enables tracking of sponsor signatory obligations and delegation of authority
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) with which the signed document is associated. Enables study-level signature completeness reporting and TMF inspection readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8; DIA TMF Reference Model Zone/Section/Artifact taxonomy

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site associated with the signed document, where applicable (e.g., site-level ICF, site initiation documents). Supports site-level TMF completeness and inspection readiness metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8.3; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the controlled document record in the document master that this signature was applied to. Links the signature to its parent TMF/eTMF document.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault Document Object

attributes.name: workflow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.document_workflow. Business justification: Electronic signatures are applied within the context of a document workflow step (review, approval, distribution). document_signature has workflow_step_name and workflow_step_sequence as STRING/INT fi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: audit_hash
attributes.description: Cryptographic hash (e.g., SHA-256) of the signed document content and signature metadata at the time of signing. Provides tamper-evidence and integrity verification for the electronic signature record, satisfying 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a) data integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); NIST SP 800-57; FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the signer at the time of signing. May capture the signer's attestation statement, conditional approval notes, or reviewer observations. Stored as part of the immutable signature audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; Veeva Vault eSignature Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp when the signature request record was first created in the source system (Veeva Vault). Supports audit trail completeness and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: device_identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device (workstation, tablet, or mobile device) used to apply the electronic signature. Supports forensic audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 system access controls validation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(d); FDA Guidance on Electronic Records

attributes.name: digital_certificate_serial
attributes.description: Serial number of the digital certificate used when the signature method is digital_certificate or smart_card. Enables certificate chain validation and revocation checking for PKI-based electronic signatures.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.200(b); X.509 Certificate Standard; NIST SP 800-57

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the signer must apply their electronic signature, as defined in the document workflow configuration. Used for SLA tracking, escalation triggering, and inspection readiness reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.18; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: hash_algorithm
attributes.description: Cryptographic algorithm used to generate the audit hash for this signature record (e.g., SHA-256, SHA-512). Required to enable future hash verification and to document the cryptographic standard applied at the time of signing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(a); NIST FIPS 180-4

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signature record has been reviewed and confirmed as complete and compliant for regulatory inspection purposes. Used in TMF inspection readiness dashboards and GCP audit preparation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8; DIA TMF Reference Model; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the electronic signature was applied. Captured as part of the 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail to support identity verification and forensic investigation. May be considered PII under GDPR.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); GDPR Article 4(1); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_regulatory_submission_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this signature is part of a document package intended for regulatory submission (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD). When True, the signature record is subject to heightened integrity and retention requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH M4 CTD; FDA eCTD Guidance; EMA eCTD Guidance

attributes.name: last_reminder_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent automated reminder notification sent to the signer. Supports escalation management and overdue signature tracking.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eSignature Workflow; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: locale
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 locale code representing the language and regional settings active at the time of signing (e.g., en-US, de-DE, ja-JP). Relevant for multi-national trials to confirm the signer viewed the document in their preferred language.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 29; ICH E6(R2) §4.8

attributes.name: meaning
attributes.description: The legally defined meaning associated with the electronic signature, as required by 21 CFR Part 11. Specifies the intent of the signer (e.g., reviewed = content reviewed for accuracy; approved = authorized for release; acknowledged = receipt confirmed).

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the electronic signature event, as assigned by Veeva Vault or the controlling eTMF system. Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory inspection referencing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10; Veeva Vault eSignature Module

attributes.name: reminder_sent_count
attributes.description: Number of automated reminder notifications sent to the signer for a pending signature request. Used to track escalation activity and measure signature workflow efficiency in TMF completeness dashboards.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eSignature Workflow; ICH E6(R2) §5.18

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature request was initiated and sent to the signer. Used to calculate signature turnaround time and to track overdue signature tasks in inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eSignature Workflow; ICH E6(R2) §5.18

attributes.name: signature_method
attributes.description: Authentication method used to apply the electronic signature. Determines the technical compliance pathway under 21 CFR Part 11 (biometric vs. non-biometric). Required for regulatory inspection to demonstrate identity verification rigor.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.200; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 25

attributes.name: signature_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the electronic signature record. Pending = awaiting signer action; Applied = successfully executed; Voided = invalidated due to document revision or administrative action; Superseded = replaced by a newer signature; Rejected = signer declined to sign.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10; Veeva Vault Workflow Status

attributes.name: signature_type
attributes.description: Classification of the signature type per applicable regulatory framework. Electronic = standard 21 CFR Part 11 e-signature; Wet Ink Scanned = paper signature digitized; Advanced Electronic = eIDAS AES; Qualified Electronic = eIDAS QES with qualified certificate.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; EU eIDAS Regulation 910/2014; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: signed_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the electronic signature was applied by the signer. This is the principal real-world event timestamp for the signature transaction. Must be system-generated and tamper-evident per 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e).
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Contemporaneous); ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: signer_full_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the individual who applied the electronic signature, captured at the time of signing. Stored as a point-in-time snapshot to preserve the audit trail even if the user record changes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA §164.312

attributes.name: signer_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or company the signer represents at the time of signing (e.g., sponsor company name, CRO name, investigative site institution). Supports multi-party trial agreements and sponsor delegation tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50

attributes.name: signer_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the signer within the document workflow at the time of signing. Determines the legal weight and workflow position of the signature. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: author|reviewer|approver|sponsor_representative|quality_assurance|investigator|regulatory_affairs|data_manager — promote to reference product if additional roles are required]
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50(a); DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: signer_title
attributes.description: Professional title or job designation of the signer at the time of signing (e.g., Principal Investigator, Medical Monitor, Sponsor Representative, Biostatistician). Captured as a point-in-time snapshot for regulatory inspection readiness.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this signature record was sourced (primarily Veeva Vault eTMF module). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and multi-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDISC Data Governance; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10

attributes.name: source_system_signature_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of the signature record in the originating source system (e.g., Veeva Vault internal signature object ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver Layer and the operational system for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10; Veeva Vault API

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier representing the local timezone of the signer at the time of signing (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Required to accurately interpret the signed_timestamp in multi-national trial contexts and for regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); IANA Time Zone Database; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: tmf_artifact_number
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model artifact number identifying the document type being signed (e.g., 01.01.01 for Protocol, 06.02.01 for Informed Consent Form). Enables artifact-level signature completeness tracking.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.x; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model Zone classification of the document to which this signature belongs (e.g., Zone 01 - Trial Management, Zone 02 - Central Trial Documents, Zone 03 - Regulatory). Supports TMF completeness metrics and inspection readiness reporting.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.x; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp of the most recent modification to the signature record (e.g., status change, void action). Required for audit trail completeness and change detection in the Silver Layer ETL pipeline.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific version of the document at the time the signature was applied. Ensures the signature is bound to an immutable document version, satisfying 21 CFR Part 11 integrity requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the signature was voided or invalidated. Required when signature_status = 'voided' to maintain a complete and auditable record of signature lifecycle events per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+ (Attributable)

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the signature was voided or invalidated. Supports the complete lifecycle audit trail for the signature record and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+

attributes.name: workflow_step_name
attributes.description: Name of the document workflow step within which this signature was collected (e.g., 'Author Review', 'QA Approval', 'Sponsor Sign-Off'). Maps to the Veeva Vault workflow configuration and supports workflow analytics and bottleneck identification.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Workflow; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: workflow_step_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position of this signature step within the overall document approval workflow. Enables ordered reconstruction of the full signature chain for regulatory inspection and audit trail review.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Document Workflow; 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10

products.name: site_file
products.description: Master entity representing the Investigator Site File (ISF) or Regulatory Binder maintained at each investigational site. Captures site file ID, associated study, associated site, file type (ISF, regulatory binder, pharmacy binder), physical or electronic location, custodian (PI or CRC), completeness status, last review date, and inspection readiness status. Tracks the site-level essential document collection required by ICH GCP Section 8.
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 5

attributes.name: site_file_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Investigator Site File (ISF) or Regulatory Binder record in the lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (Principal Investigator or Clinical Research Coordinator) who is the designated custodian responsible for maintaining the completeness and accuracy of the site file.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study with which this site file is associated. Links the ISF to its parent protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the investigational site at which this site file is maintained. Ties the ISF to a specific site entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site file was formally activated and made available for document filing, coinciding with or following site initiation. Marks the start of the file's active lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: applicable_gcp_guideline
attributes.description: The specific GCP guideline version or regulation that governs the conduct of this site file. Determines essential document requirements, retention obligations, and inspection readiness criteria.
attributes.value_regex: ICH E6(R2)|ICH E6(R3)|21 CFR Part 312|EU CTR 536/2014|ISO 14155
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E6(R3); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 14155

attributes.name: archival_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site file was transferred to long-term archival storage per ICH GCP and sponsor retention requirements. Typically 15 years post-study completion for IND studies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58

attributes.name: archival_location
attributes.description: Physical or electronic location where the site file has been archived post-study closure (e.g., sponsor archive facility name, Veeva Vault archive vault path, or third-party archive vendor name).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the site file was formally closed following site close-out activities. After this date, no new documents should be filed except for archival or regulatory response purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.4; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: completeness_percentage
attributes.description: Numeric percentage (0.00–100.00) representing the proportion of expected essential documents that are present and current in the site file. Calculated at the time of the last completeness review. Used for KPI reporting and inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: completeness_status
attributes.description: Overall completeness assessment of the site file relative to the expected essential documents per ICH GCP Section 8 and the DIA TMF Reference Model. Drives inspection readiness scoring and CRA monitoring activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; FDA Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the site file record was first created in the system of record (Veeva Vault or CTMS). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: custodian_role
attributes.description: Role of the designated custodian responsible for the site file. PI (Principal Investigator) is the accountable party per GCP; CRC (Clinical Research Coordinator) typically manages day-to-day file maintenance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.9; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62

attributes.name: delegation_log_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Delegation of Authority Log On File Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current, signed Delegation of Authority (DoA) log is present in the site file, documenting all site staff authorized to perform study-related tasks and their qualifications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1.5; FDA Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: electronic_vault_path
attributes.description: Folder path or document library location within Veeva Vault eTMF where the electronic site file is stored. Used for direct navigation and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Indicates whether the site file is maintained electronically (eTMF via Veeva Vault), in paper form at the site, or as a hybrid of both. Drives inspection readiness procedures and retrieval workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: file_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this site file, used in regulatory correspondence, inspection readiness tracking, and eTMF cross-referencing. Typically generated by the CTMS or Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: file_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the site file. Active indicates the file is in use during the study; Under Review indicates a quality or completeness review is in progress; Archived indicates post-study archival; Closed indicates the site has been closed out; Pending Activation indicates the file is being set up prior to site initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: file_type
attributes.description: Classification of the site file by its regulatory and operational purpose. ISF (Investigator Site File) is the primary site-level essential document collection; Regulatory Binder holds IRB/IEC submissions and approvals; Pharmacy Binder tracks investigational product accountability; Laboratory Binder holds lab certifications and normal ranges; Investigator Binder holds PI-specific documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: financial_disclosure_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether signed financial disclosure forms for the investigator and sub-investigators are present in the site file, as required by FDA regulations to identify potential conflicts of interest.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 54; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.11

attributes.name: icf_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Informed Consent Form (ICF) On File Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current, IRB/IEC-approved Informed Consent Form (ICF) is present in the site file. A mandatory essential document per ICH GCP Section 8.2.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 50; OHRP Guidance; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the site file's readiness for regulatory inspection by authorities such as FDA, EMA, or MHRA. Ready indicates the file meets all GCP and regulatory requirements; Needs Remediation indicates minor gaps requiring correction; Critical Gaps indicates significant deficiencies that must be resolved before inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA Inspection Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: investigator_cv_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Investigator Curriculum Vitae (CV) On File Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current, signed curriculum vitae (CV) for the Principal Investigator and all sub-investigators is present in the site file. A mandatory essential document per ICH GCP Section 8.2.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.10; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.53

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current, valid IRB (Institutional Review Board) or IEC (Independent Ethics Committee) approval letter is present in the site file. A mandatory essential document per ICH GCP Section 8.2.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.2; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: lab_certification_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether current laboratory certifications (e.g., CLIA, CAP) and normal reference ranges for the site's clinical laboratory are present in the site file, as required by ICH GCP Section 8.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.15; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, or other authority) at which this site file was reviewed. Used for inspection history tracking and readiness planning.
attributes.references: FDA Inspection Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: last_inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome classification of the most recent regulatory inspection of the site file. NAI (No Action Indicated), VAI (Voluntary Action Indicated), and OAI (Official Action Indicated) are standard FDA classification categories. Drives CAPA requirements and sponsor oversight actions.
attributes.value_regex: No Action Indicated|Voluntary Action Indicated|Official Action Indicated|Pending|Not Applicable
attributes.references: FDA Inspection Classification Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent completeness review or quality check of the site file was performed, typically by a CRA (Clinical Research Associate) during a monitoring visit or central review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: missing_document_count
attributes.description: Number of essential documents identified as missing or outstanding from the site file at the time of the last review. Drives follow-up actions and inspection readiness remediation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; FDA Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Scheduled Site File Review Date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next completeness review or quality check of the site file. Used for scheduling CRA monitoring visits and proactive inspection readiness management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special instructions, or observations related to the site file that are not captured in structured fields. Examples include inspection preparation notes, custodian handover comments, or archival instructions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: open_action_item_count
attributes.description: Number of outstanding action items or findings related to the site file that have not yet been resolved. Derived from monitoring visit findings and quality reviews. Used for inspection readiness and site risk assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; Oracle Siebel CTMS; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: physical_location
attributes.description: Description of the physical storage location of the site file at the investigational site (e.g., room number, cabinet, shelf). Applicable for paper or hybrid files. Required for inspection readiness and retrieval.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; FDA Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: protocol_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the signed and dated study protocol (and all applicable amendments) is present in the site file. A mandatory essential document per ICH GCP Section 8.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.2.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Primary regulatory authority with jurisdiction over the investigational site and its site file requirements. Determines applicable GCP guidelines, retention periods, and inspection standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health Canada|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline; MHRA GCP Guidance; PMDA GCP Ordinance; TGA GCP Guidelines; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the mandatory regulatory retention period for the site file expires, after which the file may be destroyed per applicable regulations. Calculated based on study completion date and jurisdiction-specific retention requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: sponsor_review_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor or CRO has completed a formal review of the site file for completeness and GCP compliance. Required as part of sponsor oversight obligations under ICH GCP Section 5.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.50

attributes.name: sponsor_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the sponsor or CRO completed the most recent formal review of the site file. Supports audit trail and oversight documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.50

attributes.name: tmf_section
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model section code within the assigned zone (e.g., 06.01 for Site Initiation). Provides granular classification for document filing and completeness tracking.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: DIA TMF Reference Model zone classification under which this site file's documents are organized. Zones provide a standardized taxonomy for essential document categorization across the TMF.
attributes.value_regex: Trial Management|Investigational Product|Site Management|Subject Information and Consent|Study Procedures
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: total_expected_documents
attributes.description: Total count of essential documents expected to be present in the site file based on the study protocol, applicable regulations, and DIA TMF Reference Model requirements for this site and study phase.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: total_filed_documents
attributes.description: Actual count of documents currently filed and verified within the site file. Used in conjunction with total_expected_documents to derive completeness metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the site file record. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles for data integrity.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Unique document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault eTMF to the site file container or root document object. Enables direct cross-system traceability between the lakehouse record and the source eTMF system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

products.name: site_file_document
products.description: Association entity linking specific TMF documents to their corresponding Investigator Site File (ISF). Captures the site file, the document, the ISF section/tab, filing date, filing status (filed, missing, not-applicable), source (original, certified copy, scanned), and the CRA who verified the filing during SDV. Enables per-site document completeness tracking and supports monitoring visit preparation.
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: site_file_document_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each site file document association record in the Investigator Site File (ISF). Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) who verified the document filing during the monitoring visit or Source Data Verification (SDV) activity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18

attributes.name: site_file_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Investigator Site File (ISF) to which this document belongs. Links the document filing to a specific site's master file.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the study site (investigational site) associated with this ISF document filing, enabling per-site document completeness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: superseded_by_document_site_file_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer document record that supersedes this filing when filing_status is 'superseded'. Enables version chain traceability within the ISF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: tmf_artifact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_artifact. Business justification: Each document filed in the ISF/regulatory binder corresponds to a specific DIA TMF Reference Model artifact. tmf_artifact_number (STRING) in site_file_document is a denormalized reference to the artif
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Site file documents filed in the ISF often correspond to TMF master documents. Adding tmf_document_id enables traceability from the site-level filed copy back to the authoritative TMF record. This is
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: archival_date
attributes.description: The date this document filing was archived in the eTMF system following study close-out. Supports ICH GCP archival retention requirements (minimum 15 years for IND studies).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the site where this document is filed. Supports multi-country study document completeness reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this site file document association record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: discrepancy_description
attributes.description: Description of any discrepancy identified during SDV or document review for this ISF filing (e.g., incorrect version on file, missing signature, illegible copy). Populated when sdv_status is 'discrepancy_found'.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+ principles; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: discrepancy_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which a previously identified document discrepancy was resolved and the ISF filing was corrected or updated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date the document was authored, issued, or approved, as stated on the document itself. Distinct from the filing date. Used to confirm the document is the current effective version.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: document_source_type
attributes.description: Indicates the nature of the document copy filed in the ISF: original document, certified copy, scanned copy, fax copy, or electronic original. Critical for GCP compliance and inspection readiness per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: The official title of the document as filed in the Investigator Site File, matching the title recorded in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document type as defined in the TMF/ISF taxonomy (e.g., 'Informed Consent Form', 'IRB Approval', 'Protocol', 'Delegation Log', 'CV'). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product given large number of TMF artifact types]
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: expected_filing_date
attributes.description: The target or deadline date by which a missing or pending document is expected to be filed in the ISF. Used for follow-up tracking and monitoring visit preparation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this document expires or requires renewal (e.g., IRB/IEC approval expiry, investigator CV update due date, insurance certificate expiry). Null if the document does not have an expiry.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: The date the document was physically or electronically filed into the Investigator Site File (ISF). Supports timeliness tracking and inspection readiness assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: filing_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document was filed electronically (eTMF via Veeva Vault), in paper form, or as a hybrid (paper original with electronic scan). Relevant for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: filing_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments recorded by the CRA or document controller regarding this specific document filing, such as special circumstances, follow-up instructions, or contextual observations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current filing status of the document within the ISF. Indicates whether the document has been filed, is missing, is not applicable for this site, is overdue, has been superseded by a newer version, or is pending review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filed|missing|not_applicable|overdue|superseded|pending_review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: is_inspection_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document filing is considered inspection-ready, meaning it is complete, verified, and meets all GCP and regulatory requirements for regulatory authority review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: is_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is mandatory for the ISF based on the study protocol, regulatory requirements, and DIA TMF Reference Model. True = required; False = optional or conditional.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2

attributes.name: isf_section_code
attributes.description: The DIA TMF Reference Model section/zone code designating where this document is filed within the Investigator Site File (ISF) structure (e.g., '05.001' for Protocol and Amendments).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: isf_section_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the ISF section or tab where this document is filed, corresponding to the DIA TMF Reference Model artifact classification (e.g., 'Informed Consent Forms', 'IRB/IEC Approvals').
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code of the document (e.g., 'EN', 'DE', 'JA'). Relevant for multi-regional studies where documents may be in local languages.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: missing_document_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why a required document is currently missing from the ISF. Captured to support follow-up actions and inspection readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: not_applicable_reason
attributes.description: Justification text explaining why a document is marked as 'not_applicable' for this site. Required when filing_status is 'not_applicable' to support inspection readiness and audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority jurisdiction under which this document filing requirement applies (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA). Relevant for multi-regional studies where document requirements may differ by jurisdiction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health_Canada|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MHRA; PMDA; TGA

attributes.name: retention_end_date
attributes.description: The calculated date until which this document must be retained per applicable regulatory requirements. Based on study close-out date plus jurisdiction-specific retention period.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: sdv_date
attributes.description: The date on which the CRA completed Source Data Verification (SDV) for this document filing during a monitoring visit.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: sdv_status
attributes.description: Status of Source Data Verification (SDV) performed by the CRA for this document filing. Indicates whether the document has been verified against source, a discrepancy was found, verification is not yet performed, or SDV is not required for this document type.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this site file document association record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and ALCOA+ compliance.

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the TMF completeness assessment was performed. Represents the point-in-time snapshot date for this record.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: assessment_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period covered by this TMF completeness assessment. For periodic assessments, this defines the end of the reporting window.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: assessment_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period covered by this TMF completeness assessment. For periodic assessments, this defines the beginning of the reporting window.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: assessment_reference
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number or code assigned to this completeness assessment, used for tracking and cross-referencing in Veeva Vault eTMF and inspection-readiness reports.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the completeness assessment record within Veeva Vault: draft (initiated but not yet submitted), in_progress (actively being assessed), completed (assessment data entry finished), reviewed (QA review completed), approved (formally approved by TMF manager or QA lead).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment trigger: scheduled (routine periodic), ad_hoc (unplanned), pre_inspection (triggered by regulatory inspection notice), milestone (triggered by a study milestone such as first patient in or database lock), or close_out (triggered by study close-out activities).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the CAPA record initiated in MasterControl as a result of critical TMF completeness gaps identified in this assessment. Null if no CAPA was required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: completeness_target_pct
attributes.description: The minimum completeness percentage threshold required for this study at this point in time, as defined in the TMF plan or sponsor SOP. Used to determine whether the study is inspection-ready.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2); Sponsor SOP

attributes.name: completeness_trend
attributes.description: Directional trend of TMF completeness compared to the prior assessment: improving (percentage increased), stable (no significant change), declining (percentage decreased), or not_applicable (first assessment for this study).
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2); FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this TMF completeness assessment record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: critical_document_gap_count
attributes.description: Number of missing or overdue artifacts classified as 'critical' per the DIA TMF Reference Model or sponsor TMF plan (e.g., protocol, ethics approval, signed ICF). Critical gaps pose the highest inspection risk.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance

attributes.name: etmf_system_snapshot_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) System Snapshot ID
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the eTMF system snapshot or report generated in Veeva Vault at the time of this assessment. Enables traceability back to the source system record for audit purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: expected_artifact_count
attributes.description: Total number of TMF artifacts (documents) expected to be filed for this study at the time of assessment, based on the applicable DIA TMF Reference Model zones and study-specific TMF plan.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: filed_artifact_count
attributes.description: Total number of TMF artifacts that have been filed (uploaded and indexed) in the eTMF system (Veeva Vault) at the time of assessment.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: findings_summary
attributes.description: Free-text narrative summarizing the key findings, gaps, and observations identified during this TMF completeness assessment. Supports inspection-readiness reporting and CAPA initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_risk
attributes.description: Qualitative risk rating for inspection readiness based on completeness gaps, overdue artifacts, and zone-level deficiencies. Supports risk-based TMF monitoring and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1

attributes.name: is_inspection_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether the TMF is deemed inspection-ready based on the overall completeness percentage meeting or exceeding the completeness target. True = inspection-ready; False = not inspection-ready.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: missing_artifact_count
attributes.description: Number of expected TMF artifacts that have not yet been filed at the time of assessment. Calculated as expected_artifact_count minus filed_artifact_count, excluding overdue artifacts.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next TMF Completeness Assessment Due Date
attributes.description: The scheduled due date for the next TMF completeness assessment for this study, based on the TMF plan frequency (e.g., monthly, quarterly). Supports proactive inspection readiness monitoring.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2); Sponsor SOP

attributes.name: overall_completeness_pct
attributes.description: The overall TMF completeness percentage calculated as (number of filed artifacts / number of expected artifacts) × 100. Principal quantitative KPI for inspection readiness monitoring. Expressed as a percentage with two decimal places.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance

attributes.name: overdue_artifact_count
attributes.description: Number of TMF artifacts that are past their required filing deadline (per the TMF plan or DIA TMF Reference Model timelines) and have not yet been filed. A key inspection-readiness risk indicator.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA Inspection Readiness Guidance

attributes.name: pending_review_artifact_count
attributes.description: Number of TMF artifacts that have been filed but are awaiting QC review or approval in Veeva Vault. These are filed but not yet finalized, and may affect the effective completeness rate.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: rejected_artifact_count
attributes.description: Number of TMF artifacts that were filed but subsequently rejected during QC review (e.g., wrong version, illegible, incorrect metadata). Rejected artifacts are not counted as filed for completeness purposes.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: remediation_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assessment identified gaps requiring formal remediation actions (e.g., CAPA initiation, escalation to study team). True = remediation required; False = no remediation required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the QA reviewer completed their review of this completeness assessment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Full name of the QA reviewer or TMF lead who reviewed and approved the completeness assessment. Required for inspection-readiness documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: The clinical development phase of the study at the time of assessment (Phase 1, 2, 3, 4, or combined phases). Contextualizes completeness expectations against phase-specific TMF requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E8(R1); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_status_at_assessment
attributes.description: The operational status of the clinical study at the time this TMF completeness assessment was conducted. Used to contextualize completeness expectations — e.g., a study in close-out has higher completeness requirements than one in start-up.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1

attributes.name: tmf_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of the TMF assessed: full_study (entire sponsor TMF), sponsor_tmf (sponsor-held documents only), site_tmf (site-held documents only), or investigator_site_file (ISF at a specific site). Determines which DIA TMF Reference Model zones and artifacts are in scope.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this TMF completeness assessment record was last modified in the data platform. Supports audit trail and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: zone_1_completeness_pct
attributes.description: Completeness percentage for DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 1 (Trial Management), covering documents related to trial management, oversight, and administration.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1 Zone 1

attributes.name: zone_2_completeness_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: TMF Zone 2 (Central Trial Documents) Completeness Percentage
attributes.description: Completeness percentage for DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 2 (Central Trial Documents), covering the protocol, amendments, investigator brochure, and other central study documents.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1 Zone 2

attributes.name: zone_3_completeness_pct
attributes.description: Completeness percentage for DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 3 (Regulatory), covering regulatory submissions, approvals, and correspondence with health authorities such as FDA, EMA, and PMDA.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1 Zone 3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: zone_4_completeness_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: TMF Zone 4 (IRB/IEC and Other Approvals) Completeness Percentage
attributes.description: Completeness percentage for DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 4 (IRB/IEC and Other Approvals), covering ethics committee approvals, informed consent forms (ICF), and other site-level approvals.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1 Zone 4; ICH E6(R2); OHRP; GDPR

attributes.name: zone_5_completeness_pct
attributes.description: Completeness percentage for DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 5 (Site Management), covering site selection, initiation, monitoring, and close-out documents.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1 Zone 5; ICH E6(R2) Section 8

attributes.name: zone_6_completeness_pct
attributes.description: Completeness percentage for DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 6 (Investigational Product), covering IP manufacturing, labelling, shipping, accountability, and destruction records.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1 Zone 6; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: zone_7_completeness_pct
attributes.description: Completeness percentage for DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 7 (Safety Reporting), covering SAE reports, SUSARs, DSURs, and safety communications filed in the TMF.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1 Zone 7; ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: zone_8_completeness_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: TMF Zone 8 (Statistics and Data Management) Completeness Percentage
attributes.description: Completeness percentage for DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 8 (Statistics and Data Management), covering the Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP), Data Management Plan (DMP), randomization documentation, and database lock records.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.2.1 Zone 8; ICH E9; CDISC

attributes.description: The actual date on which the regulatory authority or sponsor inspection concluded. Used to calculate inspection duration and trigger post-inspection response workflows.

attributes.description: The timestamp when this inspection readiness record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) ALCOA+ principles.
