attributes.name: critical_gaps_count
attributes.description: Number of critical-severity document gaps or deficiencies that could result in a regulatory finding or inspection observation if not remediated prior to inspection. Subset of open_findings_count.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA BIMO; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: dia_tmf_zone_coverage
attributes.business_glossary_term: DIA TMF Reference Model Zone Coverage
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of DIA TMF Reference Model zones (e.g., Zone 1-Trial Management, Zone 2-Central Trial Documents, Zone 3-Regulatory, Zone 4-IRB/IEC, Zone 5-Site Management, Zone 6-IP, Zone 7-Safety Reporting, Zone 8-Statistics) included in the scope of this readiness assessment.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: inspecting_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority or organization conducting or expected to conduct the inspection (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA). Drives jurisdiction-specific readiness requirements and document standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health Canada|ANVISA|CFDA|sponsor|internal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA GCP Inspectorate; PMDA; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: inspection_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory authority formally notified the sponsor or CRO of the upcoming inspection. Triggers the formal inspection preparation timeline and escalation procedures.
attributes.references: FDA BIMO; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Inspectorate; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: The formal outcome classification issued by the regulatory authority following inspection closure. FDA classifications: No Action Indicated (NAI), Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI), Official Action Indicated (OAI). Populated post-inspection; null or 'pending' during active inspection.
attributes.references: FDA BIMO Classification; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_tier
attributes.description: Red-Amber-Green (RAG) traffic-light classification of overall inspection readiness. 'green' indicates ready for inspection; 'amber' indicates preparation in progress with manageable gaps; 'red' indicates significant deficiencies requiring urgent remediation before inspection.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: inspection_report_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory authority issued the formal inspection report or Form FDA 483 (for FDA inspections). Triggers the response timeline for addressing inspection observations.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; FDA BIMO; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Inspectorate

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory or sponsor inspection for which readiness is being tracked. GCP inspections are conducted by regulatory authorities (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA); TMF inspections focus on document completeness; sponsor inspections are internal quality audits; for-cause inspections are triggered by specific concerns. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gcp|tmf|sponsor|regulatory-authority|for-cause|routine — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Bioresearch Monitoring (BIMO); EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Inspectorate

attributes.name: last_readiness_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent internal TMF readiness review was conducted. Used to assess currency of the readiness assessment and trigger periodic re-reviews per SOP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: major_gaps_count
attributes.description: Number of major-severity document gaps identified during TMF readiness review. Major gaps are significant deficiencies that require remediation but are less severe than critical gaps.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: minor_gaps_count
attributes.description: Number of minor-severity document gaps or observations identified during TMF readiness review. Minor gaps are low-risk deficiencies that should be addressed but do not pose immediate inspection risk.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: missing_documents_count
attributes.description: Number of expected TMF artifacts per the DIA TMF Reference Model that are entirely absent from the eTMF system. Distinct from overdue documents which are expected but not yet filed.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: next_readiness_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the next scheduled internal TMF readiness review is planned. Supports proactive inspection readiness management and escalation when overdue.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the TMF Manager to document key observations, risk factors, remediation priorities, or contextual information relevant to the inspection readiness status of this study's TMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: open_findings_count
attributes.description: Total number of unresolved inspection readiness findings (gaps, deficiencies, or observations) identified during internal TMF reviews. A key KPI for inspection readiness dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; FDA BIMO

attributes.name: overdue_documents_count
attributes.description: Number of TMF documents that are past their expected filing deadline per the TMF filing timeline or DIA TMF Reference Model expectations. Indicates timeliness risk for inspection readiness.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: previous_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent prior regulatory inspection for this study, if applicable. Used to assess inspection history, recurrence risk, and whether prior findings have been adequately remediated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA BIMO; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: previous_inspection_outcome
attributes.description: The formal outcome of the most recent prior regulatory inspection for this study. Provides historical context for current readiness planning and risk assessment.
attributes.references: FDA BIMO Classification; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: readiness_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this inspection readiness record, used in communications with sponsors, regulatory authorities, and internal tracking systems (e.g., Veeva Vault eTMF). Format: IR-{StudyCode}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: readiness_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0.00–100.00) representing the overall inspection readiness of the study's TMF, calculated based on document completeness, quality metrics, and open findings. Sourced from Veeva Vault eTMF completeness metrics or internal scoring methodology.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8

attributes.name: readiness_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the TMF inspection readiness process for this study. 'not-started' indicates no preparation has begun; 'in-preparation' indicates active remediation; 'ready' indicates the TMF has passed internal review; 'under-inspection' indicates the regulatory authority is actively inspecting; 'closed' indicates the inspection cycle is complete.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the sponsor or CRO must submit a formal written response to the regulatory authority's inspection observations or findings. Typically 15 business days for FDA Form 483 responses.

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this archival record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles, enabling detection of unauthorized or unexpected record changes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

products.name: access_log
products.description: Business compliance audit trail recording access events to controlled documents in Veeva Vault per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements. Each record captures: user identity, user role, access action (view, download, print, edit, delete), document version accessed, timestamp, access justification (when required by document confidentiality level), and source IP. This is a regulatory-mandated business record for GCP inspection readiness — not an IT infrastructure log. Retention aligned with parent document retention period.
products.reference: 21 CFR Part 11 Section 11.10(e); EU Annex 11; Veeva Vault Audit Trail

attributes.name: access_log_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each document access event record in the audit trail. Primary key for the document_access_log table.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the regulatory inspection during which this document access occurred, if applicable. Links to the compliance inspection record. Null when inspection_context is False.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.19; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: electronic_signature_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the electronic signature applied during this access event, if the action required a signature (e.g., document approval, attestation). Links to the 21 CFR Part 11 compliant e-signature record in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The unique system identifier of the user who performed the access event, as recorded in Veeva Vault. Supports attribution requirement under ALCOA+ (Attributable) and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical study (protocol) to which the accessed document belongs. Enables study-level access audit reporting and supports regulatory inspection queries by study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investigative site associated with the accessed document, if the document is site-specific (e.g., site regulatory binder, site file document). Null for central/sponsor-level documents.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §4; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The document access log records access events to controlled documents. vault_document_id (STRING) is a Veeva Vault system reference, but there is no integer FK to tmf_document. Adding tmf_document_id
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vault_document_version_id
attributes.description: The specific version identifier of the document in Veeva Vault that was accessed (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, DRAFT). Ensures the audit trail captures exactly which version was viewed, downloaded, or modified, supporting ALCOA+ traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: access_action
attributes.description: The type of action performed on the document during this access event. Enumerated values: view (read-only display), download (file retrieved to local device), print (document sent to printer), edit (document content modified), delete (document removed or marked for deletion). Critical for GCP inspection readiness and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: access_channel
attributes.description: The interface or channel through which the document was accessed in Veeva Vault: web_browser (standard UI), vault_api (programmatic API access), mobile_app (Veeva Vault mobile), integration (system-to-system integration). Supports security monitoring and access pattern analysis.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault API; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: access_device_type
attributes.description: The category of device used to access the document (desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile, server). Supports security monitoring and access pattern analysis for GCP inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems in Clinical Investigations

attributes.name: access_justification
attributes.description: The business reason provided by the user for accessing a restricted or confidential document, as required by document confidentiality policy. Mandatory for restricted-level documents; optional for confidential. Supports GCP inspection readiness and ALCOA+ 'Attributable' requirement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) GCP; GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: access_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the access attempt: success (access granted and action completed), denied (access refused due to permissions), error (system error prevented completion), timeout (session expired before completion). Supports security monitoring and unauthorized access detection.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(d); FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems in Clinical Investigations

attributes.name: access_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) when the document access event occurred, as recorded by Veeva Vault. Satisfies the ALCOA+ 'Contemporaneous' requirement and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail timestamp mandate. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: anomaly_reason
attributes.description: A description of why this access event was flagged as anomalous, populated when is_anomalous_access is True. Examples: 'Access outside business hours', 'Bulk download detected', 'Access from unrecognized IP', 'Access to superseded document version'. Null when not anomalous.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: data_extract_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this audit record was extracted from Veeva Vault and loaded into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation for the lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ (Enduring, Available); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: document_confidentiality_level
attributes.description: The data classification level of the document at the time of access. Determines whether an access justification is required (restricted and confidential documents require justification per policy). Aligns with the business data classification levels.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 32; ICH E6(R2); HIPAA §164.312

attributes.name: document_name
attributes.description: The title or name of the controlled document at the time of access, captured as a denormalized snapshot. Ensures the audit record remains interpretable even if the document is renamed or archived.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model; ICH E6(R2) §8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: document_status_at_access
attributes.business_glossary_term: Document Status at Time of Access
attributes.description: The lifecycle status of the document at the exact moment of access. Captures whether the user accessed a draft, approved, superseded, or archived version, which is critical for GCP compliance and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §8; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification of the document accessed per the DIA TMF Reference Model or Veeva Vault document type taxonomy (e.g., Protocol, Informed Consent Form, Investigator Brochure, Site Initiation Visit Report, Regulatory Submission). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Protocol|ICF|Investigator Brochure|SOP|Regulatory Submission|Monitoring Report|Safety Report|Statistical Analysis Plan|CSR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) §8; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: document_version_number
attributes.description: The human-readable version label of the document accessed (e.g., '1.0', '2.3', 'DRAFT', 'FINAL'). Captured as a denormalized snapshot for audit readability without requiring a join to the document version table.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2) §8; ALCOA+

attributes.name: download_file_format
attributes.description: The file format in which the document was downloaded, applicable only when access_action is 'download'. Null for non-download actions. Supports data leakage monitoring and controlled document distribution tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) §8; eCTD guidance

attributes.name: inspection_context
attributes.description: Indicates whether this access event occurred in the context of a regulatory inspection (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA audit). True when the access was performed to support an active regulatory inspection. Enables inspection-specific access pattern reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §5.19; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: is_anomalous_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this access event has been flagged as anomalous by automated monitoring rules (e.g., access outside business hours, access from unusual IP, bulk download, access to superseded documents). Supports GCP compliance monitoring and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems; ICH E6(R2) §5.5

attributes.name: justification_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether the user actually provided an access justification when one was required. Used in conjunction with justification_required to identify compliance gaps where justification was mandated but not supplied.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: justification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an access justification was required for this access event based on the document's confidentiality level and access action. True when justification was mandated by policy; False otherwise. Supports compliance gap detection.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 32

attributes.name: print_copy_count
attributes.description: The number of copies printed during a print access event. Applicable only when access_action is 'print'. Null for non-print actions. Supports controlled document print tracking per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8; 21 CFR Part 11; DIA TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: prior_access_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the immediately preceding access event by the same user on the same document version. Enables detection of unusual access frequency patterns and supports forensic audit analysis.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Supports data lineage and audit trail for the lakehouse record itself, distinct from the access_timestamp which records the business event time.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this record was last updated in the Silver Layer data product. Supports data lineage tracking and identifies records that have been corrected or enriched post-initial load.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority under whose jurisdiction this access event is most relevant, particularly for inspection-context accesses. Supports multi-jurisdictional regulatory reporting (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health Canada|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); MHRA GCP; PMDA

attributes.name: retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this audit log record is eligible for archival or deletion, aligned with the retention period of the parent document. Per ICH E6(R2), TMF records must be retained for at least 2 years after the last marketing approval or study discontinuation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: signature_meaning
attributes.description: The meaning associated with the electronic signature applied during this access event, per 21 CFR Part 11 requirements (e.g., approved, reviewed, authored, witnessed). Null if no signature was applied.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.50(a); ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: source_ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the device from which the document access event originated. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail completeness and cybersecurity monitoring. May be considered PII under GDPR in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); GDPR Article 4; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: study_protocol_number
attributes.description: The sponsor-assigned protocol number of the clinical study associated with the accessed document, captured as a denormalized snapshot. Enables direct audit trail readability without requiring a join to the study table.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) §6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: tmf_section
attributes.description: The specific section identifier within the TMF zone for the accessed document per the DIA TMF Reference Model (e.g., '01.01 Trial Oversight', '03.01 Regulatory Approvals'). Enables granular TMF access pattern analysis.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: tmf_zone
attributes.description: The TMF zone classification of the accessed document per the DIA TMF Reference Model (e.g., Zone 01 - Trial Management, Zone 02 - Central Trial Documents, Zone 03 - Regulatory, Zone 04 - IRB/IEC, Zone 05 - Site Management). Supports TMF completeness and inspection readiness reporting.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: user_full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the user who performed the access event at the time of the event. Captured as a denormalized field to preserve the audit record even if the user record changes, per ALCOA+ contemporaneous and enduring requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); ALCOA+; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: user_organization
attributes.description: The organization or company affiliation of the user at the time of access (e.g., sponsor name, CRO name, investigative site name). Supports multi-sponsor and multi-site access auditing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP §5; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: user_role
attributes.description: The business role of the user at the time of the access event (e.g., Principal Investigator, Clinical Research Associate, Data Manager, Regulatory Affairs Specialist, Sponsor Representative). Captured as a snapshot to support role-based access compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PI|CRA|CRC|Data Manager|Regulatory Affairs|Sponsor Representative|QA Auditor|Biostatistician|Medical Monitor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: vault_audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: The native audit trail record identifier generated by Veeva Vault for this access event. Serves as the source system reference key enabling traceability back to the original immutable audit record in Veeva Vault for regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); Veeva Vault Audit Trail; ICH E6(R2) §8

attributes.name: vault_document_reference
attributes.description: The native document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault to the controlled document that was accessed. Serves as the primary reference to the source document record in the eTMF/regulatory system.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: vault_session_reference
attributes.description: The Veeva Vault session identifier associated with this access event. Enables correlation of multiple access events within a single user session for forensic audit analysis and inspection support.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 §11.10(e); Veeva Vault Audit Trail

products.name: etmf_exchange
products.description: Tracks eTMF document exchange transactions between CRO and sponsor organizations per the DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard. Each record represents a discrete transfer event: exchange direction (CRO-to-sponsor, sponsor-to-CRO), document package contents, exchange date, protocol version, transfer method (Veeva Vault cross-account, SFTP, API), transfer status (initiated, in-transit, received, acknowledged, rejected), and sponsor acknowledgement timestamp. Critical for demonstrating sponsor oversight obligations under ICH GCP 5.0.
products.reference: eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v1.0; DIA eTMF Working Group

attributes.name: etmf_exchange_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) Exchange ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each eTMF document exchange transaction record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.clinical_program. Business justification: Program-level eTMF transfers occur at program closeout or partnership handover (e.g., full program TMF transfer from CRO to sponsor). etmf_exchange has org_id and study_id but no program FK; program-l
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: master_agreement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sponsor Preferred Provider Agreement Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.master_agreement. Business justification: eTMF exchange protocols between sponsor and CRO are governed by master agreements (eTMF plan reference in MSA). Linking enables tracking which MSA governs each exchange. Named process: contractual eTM
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization involved in this eTMF exchange. Represents the primary counterparty in the exchange transaction. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard

attributes.name: resubmission_of_exchange_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original eTMF exchange transaction that this record is resubmitting after a prior rejection. Enables lineage tracking of rejected and corrected exchange transactions.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study (protocol) for which eTMF documents are being exchanged. Links the exchange transaction to the governing study protocol.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; DIA TMF Reference Model; CDISC

attributes.name: tmf_document_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Exchange Document Item - Tmf Document Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this exchange document item to the specific TMF document included in the exchange
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the receiving party (typically the sponsor) formally acknowledged receipt of the eTMF document package. Critical for demonstrating sponsor oversight obligations under ICH GCP 5.0 and for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: archival_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this eTMF exchange represents a final archival transfer of study documents at study close-out. True = archival transfer per ICH GCP retention requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.5; FDA 21 CFR 312.62; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: checksum_algorithm
attributes.description: The cryptographic hash algorithm used to generate the package integrity checksum (e.g., MD5, SHA-256). Supports data integrity verification per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ALCOA+

attributes.name: checksum_value
attributes.description: The computed cryptographic hash value of the eTMF document package used to verify data integrity upon receipt. Enables detection of data corruption or tampering during transfer.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ALCOA+

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this eTMF exchange record was first captured in the system. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance requirements. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; ALCOA+

attributes.name: dmp_version
attributes.description: The version of the Data Management Plan (DMP) governing the eTMF exchange procedures at the time of this transaction. Ensures traceability to the applicable procedural document.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0

attributes.name: document_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual documents included in the eTMF exchange package. Used for completeness verification and reconciliation upon receipt.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: encryption_method
attributes.description: The encryption standard applied to the eTMF document package during transfer. Ensures confidentiality of trial documents in transit per regulatory data security requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 32; HIPAA Security Rule; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: exchange_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world timestamp when the eTMF document exchange was initiated or executed. Represents the business event time of the transfer, distinct from system audit timestamps. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: exchange_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the eTMF document transfer: from the Contract Research Organization (CRO) to the sponsor, or from the sponsor to the CRO. Critical for demonstrating sponsor oversight obligations under ICH GCP 5.0.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: exchange_frequency
attributes.description: The agreed cadence for eTMF document exchanges between CRO and sponsor as defined in the eTMF exchange agreement. Used for scheduling and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: exchange_manifest_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the exchange manifest file accompanying the document package. The manifest lists all documents, metadata, and checksums included in the transfer per DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: exchange_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, instructions, or comments associated with this eTMF exchange transaction. May include special handling instructions or regulatory context.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: exchange_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the exchange transaction, typically generated by Veeva Vault or the initiating system. Used for cross-system reconciliation between CRO and sponsor. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: exchange_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exchange transaction by business purpose: routine scheduled transfer, ad hoc request, inspection-driven transfer, study close-out package, or interim milestone transfer.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: inclusion_reason
attributes.description: The business reason why this specific document was included in this exchange transaction. Supports audit trail requirements and sponsor oversight documentation under ICH GCP 5.0.
attributes.references: ICH GCP E6(R2) 5.0

attributes.name: initiating_party
attributes.description: Identifies whether the CRO or the sponsor organization initiated this eTMF exchange transaction. Distinct from exchange direction — captures who triggered the transfer.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this eTMF exchange was executed as part of an inspection readiness activity (e.g., pre-FDA inspection TMF transfer to sponsor). True = inspection-driven exchange.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; FDA 21 CFR 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: integrity_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the receiving party has verified the cryptographic checksum of the received package matches the sender's declared checksum. True = integrity confirmed; False = mismatch detected.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ALCOA+

attributes.name: package_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to the document package included in this exchange transaction. Used for identification and tracking of the transferred document bundle.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: package_size_mb
attributes.description: Total file size of the eTMF document exchange package in megabytes. Used for transfer capacity planning, SLA monitoring, and troubleshooting failed transfers.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: The version of the study protocol applicable to the documents included in this eTMF exchange package. Ensures documents are associated with the correct protocol amendment.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; DIA TMF Reference Model; FDA 21 CFR 312

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the receiving system confirmed technical receipt of the eTMF document package. Distinct from acknowledgement_timestamp which represents formal business acknowledgement.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: receiver_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the responsible individual at the receiving organization who acknowledged or processed the eTMF exchange. Used for accountability and follow-up communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: receiver_vault_reference
attributes.description: The Veeva Vault instance identifier of the receiving organization (sponsor or CRO). Used for cross-account transfer reconciliation and confirmation of receipt in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: regulatory_region
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction(s) applicable to the documents in this eTMF exchange (e.g., US, EU, JP). Determines applicable regulatory standards for document format and retention requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; PMDA; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: rejection_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the reason for rejection of the eTMF document package (e.g., MISSING_DOCS, WRONG_VERSION, METADATA_ERROR). Enables systematic tracking and trending of rejection causes.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided when the receiving party rejects the eTMF document package. Populated only when transfer_status is 'rejected'. Supports CAPA and resubmission workflows.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: scheduled_exchange_date
attributes.description: The planned date on which the eTMF document exchange was scheduled to occur per the eTMF exchange agreement or data management plan. Used for SLA monitoring and deviation tracking.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0

attributes.name: sender_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the responsible individual at the sending organization who initiated or authorized the eTMF exchange. Used for accountability and follow-up communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sender_vault_reference
attributes.description: The Veeva Vault instance identifier of the sending organization (CRO or sponsor). Used for cross-account transfer reconciliation and audit trail in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard v3.0; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sequence_order
attributes.description: The ordinal position of this document within the exchange package manifest. Used for package integrity verification and reconciliation against the exchange manifest file.
attributes.references: DIA eTMF Exchange Mechanism Standard

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: The clinical development phase of the study associated with this eTMF exchange. Used for regulatory reporting stratification and TMF completeness benchmarking.
attributes.value_regex: Phase I|Phase II|Phase III|Phase IV|Phase I/II
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 312; ICH E8; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: tmf_artifact_type
attributes.description: The DIA TMF Reference Model artifact type designation for the primary document type in this exchange package (e.g., Protocol, Informed Consent Form, Investigator Brochure). Supports TMF completeness tracking. [Moved from etmf_exchange: Artifact type is a property of the specific document being transferred, not of the exchange package as a whole. Calculated based on the last study using this template plus the required retention period (typically 15 years post-study completion per ICH GCP). Supports GDPR data minimization and regulatory archival compliance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8.1; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date on which this template version was retired or superseded and is no longer available for new document creation. Null if the template is still active. Supports lifecycle management and ensures only current templates are used.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl

attributes.name: review_frequency_months
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency in months at which this template must undergo periodic review to ensure continued regulatory compliance and business relevance (e.g., 12 for annual review, 24 for biennial). Drives automated review reminders in MasterControl and Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl periodic review SOP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code assigned to the template (e.g., ICF-TMPL-00042). Used as the business identifier across systems including Veeva Vault and MasterControl for cross-system referencing and audit trails.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: template_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the template's purpose, intended use, key sections, and any special instructions for document creators. Provides context for study teams selecting the appropriate template for their document creation needs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the document template (e.g., 'Phase III Oncology Informed Consent Form Template', 'Clinical Study Report Shell'). Serves as the primary identity label for business users in Veeva Vault and CTMS.
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: template_type
attributes.description: Classification of the template by its functional document type within clinical trial operations (e.g., ICF_TEMPLATE, PROTOCOL_TEMPLATE, CSR_SHELL, SAP_TEMPLATE, CRF_ANNOTATION, REGULATORY_COVER_LETTER, DSMB_CHARTER, SITE_AGREEMENT). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ICF_TEMPLATE|PROTOCOL_TEMPLATE|CSR_SHELL|SAP_TEMPLATE|CRF_ANNOTATION|REGULATORY_COVER_LETTER|DSMB_CHARTER|SITE_AGREEMENT|IB_TEMPLATE|DSUR_TEMPLATE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; CDISC; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: training_curriculum_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the MasterControl training curriculum or course that must be completed before using this template. Applicable when training_required is True. Links template usage to the training management system for compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl training management; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether staff must complete training on this template before using it to create documents (True) or whether no formal training is required (False). Drives training assignment workflows in MasterControl and ensures GCP-compliant use of controlled templates.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; MasterControl training management; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this document template record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH GCP ALCOA+ principles. Updated on every change to any attribute.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_number
attributes.description: Human-readable document number assigned by Veeva Vault (distinct from the internal document ID). Used for cross-referencing in regulatory submissions, audit trails, and TMF filing. Follows Veeva Vault document numbering conventions.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Platform; DIA TMF Reference Model v3.0; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Unique document identifier assigned by Veeva Vault eTMF/QMS system for this template record. Serves as the cross-system reference key linking the lakehouse silver layer record back to the authoritative source-of-record in Veeva Vault for audit trail and document retrieval.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault Platform; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Current approved version number of the template following major.minor versioning convention (e.g., 1.0, 2.3). Controlled versioning is mandatory under GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 to ensure only approved template versions are used for document creation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: title

domains.name: compliance
domains.description: Manages GCP quality assurance (QA), quality control (QC), internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, CAPA lifecycle, protocol deviation classifications, SOP compliance tracking, and audit readiness. Ensures adherence to ICH GCP, FDA, EMA, and sponsor quality standards via MasterControl.
domains.references: ICH GCP E6(R3); ISO 9001; FDA Inspections; ICH Q10

products.name: audit
products.description: Master record for all internal and external GCP audits conducted across studies, sites, systems, and vendors. Captures audit type (system, process, vendor, site, TMF), scope, lead auditor, planned and actual dates, audit status, sponsoring organization, and overall audit outcome (satisfactory, needs improvement, unsatisfactory). Includes risk-based audit prioritization score. Sourced from MasterControl audit management module. SSOT for audit identity and lifecycle within the compliance domain.
products.reference: GCP Audit (ICH E6 R2 Section 5.19)

attributes.name: checklist_template_id

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: follow_up_audit_id

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; MasterControl Audit Management; ISO 19011:2018

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization that commissioned or is subject to this audit. Relevant for sponsor-delegated audits and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.0; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.52

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which audit fieldwork actually concluded. Used to compute actual audit duration and assess deviation from planned schedule.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; MasterControl Audit Management

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which audit fieldwork actually commenced. Compared against planned_start_date to measure schedule adherence and audit program performance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; MasterControl Audit Management

attributes.name: audit_category
attributes.description: Categorization of the audit by initiating party and trigger: internal (self-initiated QA), external (sponsor or third-party), regulatory_inspection (FDA/EMA/MHRA inspector-led), for_cause (triggered by specific concern or signal), or routine (scheduled per audit plan).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA Bioresearch Monitoring (BIMO); EMA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique audit reference number assigned by MasterControl at audit creation (e.g., AUD-2024-00123). Used in regulatory correspondence, CAPA linkage, and TMF filing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl Audit Management

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of the audit scope, defining the boundaries, processes, systems, or study activities subject to evaluation. Documented in the audit plan and referenced throughout the audit lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19.3; ISO 19011:2018 Section 6.3

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audit record within MasterControl: planned (scheduled, not yet started), in_progress (fieldwork underway), completed (report issued), cancelled (audit withdrawn), or on_hold (paused pending resolution).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; MasterControl Audit Management; ISO 19011:2018

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit by the subject being evaluated: system (EDC, CTMS, safety systems), process (SOPs, workflows), vendor (CRO, lab, IRT), site (investigational site GCP), or TMF (Trial Master File completeness). Drives audit planning templates and checklist selection in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.68; EMA/INS/GCP/454280/2010

attributes.name: auditee_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the auditee location. Used for geographic risk stratification, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and cross-border audit planning.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2); EMA EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR

attributes.name: auditee_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization, department, site, or system being audited. Provides a human-readable identifier for the audit subject independent of system IDs, supporting audit register reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; ISO 19011:2018 Section 3.8

attributes.name: capa_due_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Due Date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the auditee must submit a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plan in response to audit findings. Calculated from report_issue_date per sponsor or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal CAPA plan is required as a result of this audit. Set to True when critical or major findings are identified. Triggers CAPA workflow initiation in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the audit record was first created in MasterControl. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity requirements (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: critical_finding_count
attributes.description: Number of critical GCP findings identified during the audit. Critical findings indicate conditions that may directly impact subject safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance and require immediate CAPA. Sourced from MasterControl finding records.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA BIMO Compliance Program; EMA GCP Inspection Classification

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up audit has been determined necessary to verify CAPA effectiveness or re-assess compliance after an unsatisfactory or needs_improvement outcome.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; MasterControl Audit Management; ISO 19011:2018 Section 6.8

attributes.name: gcp_standard_version
attributes.description: Version of the ICH GCP guideline applied during this audit (e.g., ICH E6(R2), ICH E6(R3)). Ensures traceability of the regulatory standard in force at the time of audit execution.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E6(R3) Draft; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: inspection_type
attributes.description: Classification of regulatory inspection by trigger: routine (scheduled surveillance), for_cause (triggered by safety signal or complaint), pre_approval (NDA/BLA/MAA submission review), or post_approval (post-marketing commitment). Populated only for regulatory_inspection category audits.
attributes.references: FDA BIMO Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: Modality of audit execution: on_site (auditor physically present at auditee location), remote (conducted via video conference and electronic document review), or hybrid (combination of both). Relevant for resource planning and post-COVID audit program management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum; EMA Guidance on Remote GCP Inspections; FDA Remote Regulatory Assessment

attributes.name: major_finding_count
attributes.description: Number of major GCP findings identified during the audit. Major findings represent significant non-compliance that could affect subject rights, safety, or data reliability but are not immediately life-threatening.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA BIMO Compliance Program; EMA GCP Inspection Classification

attributes.name: minor_finding_count
attributes.description: Number of minor GCP findings identified during the audit. Minor findings represent isolated deviations that do not significantly impact subject safety or data integrity but require corrective action.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA BIMO Compliance Program; EMA GCP Inspection Classification

attributes.name: observation_count
attributes.description: Number of audit observations (non-findings) documented during the audit. Observations are areas for improvement that do not constitute formal GCP non-compliance but are noted for quality enhancement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; MasterControl Audit Management; ISO 19011:2018

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Overall quality determination issued at audit close: satisfactory (no significant findings), needs_improvement (minor findings requiring corrective action), or unsatisfactory (critical/major findings indicating systemic GCP non-compliance). Drives CAPA initiation and escalation decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA Guidance for Industry: Oversight of Clinical Investigations; EMA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the audit plan document used to conduct this audit (e.g., v1.0, v2.1). Supports document control traceability and links to the approved audit plan in Veeva Vault eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault eTMF; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date on which audit fieldwork is planned to conclude. Used to calculate planned audit duration and monitor schedule adherence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; ISO 19011:2018 Section 6.4

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date on which audit fieldwork is planned to commence, as documented in the annual audit plan or risk-based audit schedule. Used for resource planning and audit readiness tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; ISO 19011:2018 Section 6.4

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority conducting or overseeing the inspection (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). Populated for regulatory_inspection category audits; nullable for internal audits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health Canada|ANVISA|COFEPRIS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2); MHRA GCP Inspections; PMDA

attributes.name: report_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final audit report was formally issued to the auditee and sponsor. Triggers the CAPA response timeline and is a key metric for audit cycle time KPIs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: risk_priority_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk prioritization score (typically 1–100) calculated from risk factors such as subject safety criticality, protocol complexity, site performance history, and time since last audit. Drives risk-based audit scheduling per ICH E6(R2) R2 addendum requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum Section 5.0; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based QM

attributes.name: risk_tier
attributes.description: Categorical risk classification derived from risk_priority_score: critical, high, medium, or low. Used for audit frequency determination, resource allocation, and escalation thresholds in the quality management system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2013; EMA Reflection Paper on Risk-Based QM

attributes.name: sponsor_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sponsor has been formally notified of the audit outcome and findings. Required for sponsor oversight obligations under ICH E6(R2) and FDA guidance on oversight of clinical investigations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; FDA Guidance on Oversight of Clinical Investigations; 21 CFR Part 312.52

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Executive summary narrative of the audit outcome, key findings, and overall GCP compliance assessment as documented in the final audit report. Supports audit readiness reviews and regulatory inspection preparation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19.3; FDA BIMO Compliance Program; ISO 19011:2018 Section 6.7

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title of the audit as recorded in MasterControl (e.g., 'GCP Site Audit – Site 1042 – Protocol XYZ-001'). Used in audit registers, dashboards, and TMF filing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 5.19; MasterControl Audit Management

attributes.name: tmf_reference_number
attributes.description: Document reference number assigned to the audit report and supporting documentation filed in the eTMF (Veeva Vault). Enables direct retrieval of audit artifacts during regulatory inspections per DIA TMF Reference Model.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault eTMF; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the audit record in MasterControl. Required for audit trail integrity under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data governance standards.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles

products.name: audit_finding

Each finding is linked to a parent audit record and may trigger a CAPA. Distinct from inspection_finding: audit findings are internally generated, managed through internal quality processes, and do not carry formal regulatory response obligations. Sourced from MasterControl.

attributes.name: auditee_name

attributes.name: auditee_role

attributes.name: auditor_organization

attributes.name: capa_required_flag

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: The date on which the QA team formally verified and closed the finding after confirming that the corrective action was implemented and effective. Null if the finding remains open.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit finding record was first created in MasterControl and ingested into the Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ attributability requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the finding has a confirmed, potential, or no impact on clinical trial data integrity. Relevant to ALCOA+ principles and regulatory submission reliability.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the finding was formally escalated. Null if escalation_flag is False. Used to measure escalation timeliness and response.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding has been escalated to senior management, the sponsor, or a regulatory authority due to severity, recurrence, or patient safety risk.

attributes.name: finding_category
attributes.description: Severity classification of the finding per GCP audit standards. Critical: systemic failure with patient safety or data integrity risk. Major: significant GCP deviation. Minor: low-risk procedural gap. Observation: noted for improvement without formal deviation.

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the finding as documented by the auditor. Describes the observed deficiency, evidence reviewed, and the specific GCP or regulatory requirement that was not met.

attributes.name: finding_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the finding at the time of audit. Used in audit reports, management responses, and CAPA tracking. Format: AF-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the finding within the quality management workflow. Tracks progression from identification through resolution and closure verification.

attributes.name: finding_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title summarizing the nature of the finding. Used in audit reports, dashboards, and management communications.

attributes.name: ich_gcp_clause_reference

attributes.name: identified_date

attributes.name: patient_safety_impact

attributes.name: prior_finding_reference_number

attributes.name: process_area

attributes.name: response_received_date

attributes.name: sop_version
