attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal CAPA is required to address this inspection finding. Critical findings and major findings typically mandate a CAPA; 'other' findings may be addressed through a written commitment without a full CAPA.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority formally accepted the response and closed the inspection finding. Null if the finding remains open or under review. Used for regulatory commitment tracking and audit readiness metrics.
attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; FDA Warning Letter Closure Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inspection finding record was first created in the system (MasterControl or Databricks Silver Layer). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the finding compromises the integrity of clinical trial data submitted or to be submitted to regulatory authorities. 'Confirmed' data integrity findings may invalidate study data and affect regulatory submissions. Aligns with ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA Data Integrity Guidance (2018); MHRA Data Integrity Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: escalation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inspection finding has escalated to a formal regulatory enforcement action. 'Warning_letter' indicates FDA has issued a Warning Letter. 'Consent_decree' indicates a legal agreement with FDA. 'Import_alert' indicates an FDA import restriction. 'Clinical_hold' indicates FDA has placed a clinical hold on the study. Null or 'none' if no escalation has occurred.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Program; FDA Consent Decree Guidance; FDA Clinical Hold Guidance 21 CFR 312.42; EMA Enforcement Actions

attributes.name: finding_category
attributes.description: Thematic or process category to which the finding belongs, used for trend analysis and CAPA prioritization (e.g., Informed Consent, Adverse Event Reporting, Protocol Compliance, Data Integrity, Investigational Product Management, Monitoring, Regulatory Submissions). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: informed_consent|adverse_event_reporting|protocol_compliance|data_integrity|investigational_product|monitoring|regulatory_submissions|subject_safety|record_keeping|staff_training — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC CDASH; FDA GCP Inspection Classification

attributes.name: finding_classification
attributes.description: Regulatory severity classification of the inspection finding as assigned by the inspecting authority. 'Critical' indicates a condition that poses significant risk to subject safety or data integrity and may result in a Warning Letter or consent decree. 'Major' indicates a significant deficiency requiring corrective action. 'Other' (also termed 'minor' or 'observation' by some authorities) indicates a lesser deficiency. Aligns with EMA GCP inspection classification and FDA enforcement terminology.
attributes.references: EMA GCP Inspection Classification; FDA Warning Letter Guidance; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: finding_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory authority formally issued or documented this finding during the inspection. This is the principal real-world event date (TRANSACTION_HEADER: BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP at date granularity), distinct from the inspection start date and the response deadline.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; EMA GCP Inspection Report; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: finding_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the inspection finding as documented by the regulatory authority, including the specific deficiency observed, the regulatory standard violated, and any factual basis cited (e.g., verbatim text from FDA Form 483 observation or EMA GCP inspection report).
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; EMA GCP Inspection Report; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: finding_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned sequential identifier for this finding within the inspection, as issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA Form 483 observation number, EMA GCP inspection finding reference). Serves as the business-facing identifier for regulatory correspondence and response tracking.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: finding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection finding from issuance through resolution. 'Open' indicates the finding has been issued and awaits a formal response. 'Response_submitted' indicates the sponsor/CRO has submitted a written response. 'Under_review' indicates the authority is evaluating the response. 'Closed' indicates the authority has accepted the response and closed the finding. 'Escalated' indicates the finding has progressed to a Warning Letter, consent decree, or equivalent enforcement action.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: finding_title
attributes.description: Short, human-readable title or headline summarizing the nature of the inspection finding, as recorded in MasterControl. Used for executive dashboards and regulatory commitment registers.
attributes.references: MasterControl Quality Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: gcp_principle_violated
attributes.description: The specific ICH GCP principle or section that the finding determines was violated (e.g., 'ICH E6(R2) 4.8 - Informed Consent', 'ICH E6(R2) 5.18 - Monitoring', 'ICH E6(R2) 6.4 - Protocol Amendments'). Supports regulatory submission quality and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Inspection Classification; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: inspection_authority
attributes.description: Regulatory authority that issued the inspection finding (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). Determines the applicable response format, deadline, and escalation pathway. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health_Canada|ANVISA|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; MHRA GCP Guidance; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada

attributes.name: inspection_finding_source
attributes.description: The type of regulatory document in which this finding was formally issued. 'Form_483' refers to FDA Inspectional Observations. 'Warning_letter' refers to an FDA Warning Letter. 'EIR' refers to an FDA Establishment Inspection Report. 'GCP_inspection_report' refers to an EMA or MHRA GCP inspection report.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483; FDA Warning Letter Program; FDA EIR; EMA GCP Inspection Report; MHRA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory inspector or lead inspector who identified and documented this finding. Recorded for correspondence and response addressing purposes. Classified as confidential as it identifies a government official in a regulatory context.
attributes.references: FDA GCP Inspection Program; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inspection finding is directly related to a protocol deviation or series of protocol deviations. Enables cross-domain linkage between compliance findings and protocol deviation management.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA Protocol Deviation Guidance; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: record_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual (typically a QA manager or Regulatory Affairs lead) responsible for managing the response and resolution of this inspection finding within the sponsor or CRO organization. Supports accountability tracking in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl Quality Management; FDA GCP Inspection Program

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: Specific regulatory reference cited by the inspecting authority as the basis for the finding (e.g., '21 CFR 312.62(b)', 'ICH E6(R2) Section 4.9.0', 'EU CTR 536/2014 Article 47'). Critical for formal response drafting and legal review.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ISO 14155

attributes.name: repeat_finding
attributes.description: Indicates whether this finding is a recurrence of a previously identified deficiency at the same site or sponsor level. Repeat findings signal systemic quality failures and may trigger escalated regulatory enforcement action.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: response_adequacy_assessment
attributes.description: The regulatory authority's assessment of whether the sponsor's formal response to the finding is adequate. 'Adequate' results in finding closure. 'Inadequate' or 'Partially_adequate' requires a supplemental response. 'Pending_review' indicates the authority has not yet issued its assessment.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Formal deadline by which the sponsor or CRO must submit a written response to the regulatory authority. For FDA Form 483 observations, this is typically 15 business days from the last day of inspection. For EMA GCP findings, deadlines vary by classification. Drives executive-level regulatory commitment management.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance (15 business days); EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: response_submitted_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the formal written response to the inspection finding was submitted to the regulatory authority. Used to calculate response timeliness and compliance with regulatory deadlines.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the root cause to enable trend analysis across findings. 'Process' indicates a procedural gap; 'Training' indicates inadequate staff training; 'System' indicates an EDC, CTMS, or IT system failure; 'Communication' indicates a breakdown in information flow; 'Resource' indicates insufficient staffing or budget; 'Oversight' indicates inadequate monitoring or QA oversight.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl; ISO 9001

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Documented root cause of the deficiency identified in the inspection finding, as determined through the CAPA investigation process. Supports systemic quality improvement and recurrence prevention.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module; ISO 9001

attributes.name: sponsor_response_summary
attributes.description: Executive summary of the sponsor's or CRO's formal written response to the inspection finding, including the root cause identified, immediate corrective actions taken, and preventive measures committed. Stored in MasterControl and linked to the eTMF in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Assessment of whether the finding has a direct or potential impact on subject safety. 'None' indicates no subject safety risk. 'Potential' indicates a theoretical risk that has not materialized. 'Confirmed' indicates documented harm or risk to enrolled subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP Guidance

attributes.name: supplemental_response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline for submission of a supplemental or follow-up response when the initial response was assessed as inadequate or partially adequate by the regulatory authority. Null if no supplemental response is required.
attributes.references: FDA Form 483 Response Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this inspection finding record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: warning_letter_reference
attributes.description: Official reference number of the FDA Warning Letter or equivalent regulatory enforcement communication issued in connection with this finding. Populated only when escalation_status is 'warning_letter'. Used for regulatory commitment tracking and legal response management.
attributes.references: FDA Warning Letter Program; FDA Enforcement Actions Database

products.name: compliance_capa
products.description: Master record for Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) initiated in response to audit findings, inspection findings, protocol deviations, QC failures, or self-identified quality issues. Captures CAPA reference number, root cause category, root cause description, corrective action plan, preventive action plan, responsible owner, target completion date, actual completion date, effectiveness check date, and CAPA status (open, in-progress, closed, overdue). Sourced from MasterControl CAPA module. SSOT for CAPA lifecycle.
products.reference: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action — ICH Q10; 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl)

attributes.name: compliance_capa_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the CAPA record. Primary key for the CAPA lifecycle master record sourced from MasterControl CAPA module.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal or external audit that generated the finding triggering this CAPA. Null if the CAPA was not initiated from an audit. Enables audit-to-CAPA traceability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl Audit Module

attributes.name: compliance_inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_inspection. Business justification: A CAPA can be initiated directly from a regulatory inspection (source_type='inspection'). While inspection_finding->compliance_capa links findings to CAPAs, a CAPA may also reference the inspection it
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sop. Business justification: capa.sop_reference is a free-text string identifying the SOP associated with the CAPA. Replacing it with a FK to sop.sop_id enables structured linkage between CAPAs and the SOPs they address or update
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.organization. Business justification: CAPAs with sponsor_notified_flag=true require routing notifications to the correct sponsor org. Sponsor-facing CAPA reporting and regulatory submissions depend on identifying the sponsor organization
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_compliance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member or role accountable for executing and closing the CAPA. Maps to the workforce record in Workday HCM. Drives task assignment and escalation notifications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module; Workday HCM

attributes.name: quaternary_compliance_responsible_owner_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quaternary Compliance Responsible Owner Employee Id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: sponsor_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sponsor.engagement. Business justification: CAPAs arising from sponsor-facing quality events are tracked per engagement for account health reporting and governance reviews. Sponsor satisfaction scores and escalation counts in engagement records
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical study associated with this CAPA. Links the CAPA to the relevant study protocol for study-level quality tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC SDTM; FDA IND Regulations 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investigational site associated with this CAPA, if site-specific. Null for sponsor-level or cross-site CAPAs. Supports site-level quality performance analytics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: tertiary_compliance_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the QA manager or authorized approver who reviewed and approved the CAPA plan in MasterControl. Required for GCP compliance and electronic signature audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: training_curriculum_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.training_curriculum. Business justification: CAPAs with training_required_flag=true must specify the exact training curriculum assigned as corrective/preventive action. This link supports QMS-to-LMS integration, CAPA effectiveness checks, and GC
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which all corrective and preventive actions were completed and verified. Null until CAPA is closed. Used to calculate cycle time and on-time closure rate KPIs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CAPA plan was formally approved by the authorized QA approver in MasterControl. Marks the transition from initiation to active execution phase.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: capa_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the action is corrective (addressing an existing non-conformance), preventive (addressing a potential non-conformance), or both. Drives workflow routing in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155

attributes.name: closure_justification
attributes.description: Narrative justification provided by the responsible owner and QA approver at the time of CAPA closure, summarizing evidence that all actions were completed and the root cause was resolved. Required for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: compliance_capa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the CAPA record. Drives workflow routing, escalation triggers, and regulatory reporting. 'Overdue' is system-set when target completion date is passed without closure.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective actions planned or implemented to address the identified root cause and prevent recurrence of the quality issue. Core CAPA deliverable per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the CAPA record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality issue underlying this CAPA had or could have had an impact on clinical data integrity. Triggers data review, potential database query, and regulatory notification workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; EMA Data Integrity Guidance; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which the effectiveness of the implemented corrective and preventive actions will be or was verified. Required by GCP to confirm the CAPA resolved the root cause.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the methodology and findings from the effectiveness check, including evidence reviewed and conclusions drawn. Supports regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the effectiveness verification assessment confirming whether the implemented CAPA actions successfully resolved the root cause and prevented recurrence. Drives CAPA closure or re-opening decisions.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: gcp_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Assessment of the impact of the underlying quality issue on GCP compliance and data integrity. Drives CAPA priority, escalation, and regulatory reporting decisions. Aligned with FDA and EMA GCP inspection classification standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA GCP Inspections; EMA GCP Inspections; MHRA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: immediate_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of any immediate containment or interim actions taken at the time of CAPA initiation to mitigate the impact of the quality issue before the full corrective action is implemented.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: initiation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the CAPA was formally initiated and entered into MasterControl. Serves as the start of the CAPA lifecycle clock for overdue tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: mastercontrol_record_number
attributes.description: Native record identifier assigned by the MasterControl CAPA module. Used for source system traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: preventive_action_plan
attributes.description: Detailed description of the preventive actions planned to eliminate the potential for recurrence of similar quality issues across the organization or study portfolio.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Risk-based priority level assigned to the CAPA, reflecting the severity and urgency of the underlying quality issue. Drives escalation timelines and resource allocation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: problem_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the quality issue, non-conformance, or finding that triggered the CAPA. Captures the 'what happened' narrative for audit trail and regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module; ALCOA+

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA addresses a recurring quality issue that has been the subject of a prior CAPA. True signals a systemic quality problem requiring escalated management attention.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Reference Number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable CAPA reference number assigned by MasterControl upon initiation (e.g., CAPA-2024-00123). Used in audit trails, regulatory submissions, and sponsor communications.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this CAPA is associated with a finding that requires regulatory reporting to FDA, EMA, MHRA, or other health authority. Drives regulatory submission workflow in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Inspections; EU CTR 536/2014; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or functional area accountable for CAPA execution (e.g., Clinical Operations, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance). Used for departmental quality KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized category classifying the root cause of the quality issue (e.g., training deficiency, process gap, system failure, communication breakdown, resource constraint). Used for trend analysis and systemic quality improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: training_deficiency|process_gap|system_failure|communication_breakdown|resource_constraint|documentation_error|oversight_failure — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 14155; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the identified root cause of the quality issue, as determined through root cause analysis (RCA). Supports regulatory inspection readiness and CAPA justification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; EMA GCP Inspections; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: source_reference_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the originating record that triggered this CAPA (e.g., audit finding ID, inspection finding ID, protocol deviation ID, or QC failure ID). Enables traceability back to the root triggering event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Category of the triggering event that initiated the CAPA. Classifies whether the CAPA originated from an internal audit, regulatory inspection, protocol deviation, QC failure, self-identified quality issue, complaint, or safety signal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: audit_finding|inspection_finding|protocol_deviation|qc_failure|self_identified|complaint|safety_signal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; EMA GCP Inspections; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the study sponsor was formally notified of this CAPA. Null if sponsor_notified_flag is False. Supports sponsor oversight audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: sponsor_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this CAPA. Required for CRO-managed studies where sponsor oversight obligations apply per ICH E6(R2) GCP.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality issue underlying this CAPA had or could have had a direct impact on subject safety. Triggers expedited review and potential safety reporting obligations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014; ISO 14155

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which all corrective and preventive actions must be completed and the CAPA closed. Used for overdue status calculation, escalation triggers, and sponsor/regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the quality issue or finding that triggered the CAPA. Used for identification in dashboards, reports, and audit-readiness reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the corrective or preventive action includes a mandatory training component. When True, triggers training assignment workflow in MasterControl training management module.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the CAPA record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail integrity, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: quaternary_capa_assigned_owner_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quaternary Capa Assigned Owner Employee Id

attributes.name: tertiary_capa_escalated_to_employee_id

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module; Workday HCM

attributes.name: training_curriculum_id

attributes.name: action_item_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this action item within MasterControl (e.g., CAPA-AI-2024-0042). Used in audit trails, regulatory inspection responses, and cross-system references. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this line record.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: action_item_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the action item within the CAPA execution lifecycle. Drives CAPA closure eligibility — all action items must reach 'completed' or 'cancelled' before the parent CAPA can be closed. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|in_progress|completed|overdue|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: action_item_type
attributes.description: Classification of the action item by its nature within the CAPA framework: corrective (addresses the identified nonconformance), preventive (prevents recurrence), effectiveness check (verifies the CAPA resolved the issue), root cause analysis, training, process change, or documentation update. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: corrective|preventive|effectiveness_check|root_cause_analysis|training|process_change|documentation_update — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the action item was actually completed and evidence was submitted. Compared against planned_completion_date to measure CAPA execution timeliness. Null until the action item reaches 'completed' status.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: assigned_owner_department
attributes.description: Organizational department or functional unit of the assigned owner (e.g., Quality Assurance, Data Management, Clinical Operations). Used for workload analysis, departmental CAPA metrics, and escalation routing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: capa_action_item_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the specific action to be taken, including scope, methodology, and expected outcome. Provides the full context required for the assigned owner to execute the action and for auditors to assess adequacy of the response.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this action item was formally closed in MasterControl following successful completion and verification. Null until the item reaches a terminal state (completed or cancelled). Used to calculate cycle time metrics.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, progress updates, or contextual information entered by the action item owner or QA reviewer during the execution lifecycle. Supports ongoing communication and audit trail within MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this action item record was first created in MasterControl. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this entity. Supports ALCOA+ auditability and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: days_open
attributes.description: Number of calendar days this action item has been open, calculated from opened_timestamp to either actual_completion_date (if closed) or the current date (if still open). Used as a KPI for CAPA execution timeliness and audit readiness dashboards. Note: this is a business-captured operational metric from MasterControl, not a derived aggregate.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: due_date_extension_count
attributes.description: Number of times the planned completion date has been extended for this action item. A high extension count is a quality risk indicator and may trigger escalation or QA review. Tracked per MasterControl audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the effectiveness check for this action item must be completed. Null if effectiveness_check_required is False. Used to schedule and track post-implementation reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a post-completion effectiveness check is required for this action item to confirm the corrective or preventive action achieved its intended outcome. Typically mandated for critical or repeat findings per GCP quality standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_status
attributes.description: Current status of the post-completion effectiveness check for this action item. 'Effective' confirms the action resolved the root cause; 'ineffective' triggers re-opening of the CAPA or creation of a new CAPA.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this action item was formally escalated. Null if escalation_flag is False. Used to measure escalation response time and management accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action item has been escalated to senior management or QA leadership due to overdue status, repeated extensions, or high risk. Triggers escalation notifications and management review workflows in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: evidence_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the evidence provided to demonstrate completion of the action item (e.g., 'Updated SOP-QA-012 v3.0 attached; training records for 12 staff members uploaded'). Supports QA verification and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ALCOA+ principles; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: evidence_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the supporting evidence document stored in Veeva Vault or MasterControl (e.g., document ID, eTMF reference, SOP version number). Links the action item completion to the formal document management system.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault; MasterControl

attributes.name: extension_justification
attributes.description: Narrative explanation provided by the action item owner or QA approver when the planned completion date is extended. Required for audit trail completeness and regulatory inspection readiness. Null if no extension has been granted.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this action item record in MasterControl. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this entity. Required for change tracking and audit trail completeness per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: mastercontrol_record_number
attributes.description: Native record identifier assigned by MasterControl to this action item in the source system. Used for cross-system traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the Databricks Silver layer and the MasterControl operational system of record.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: opened_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this action item was formally opened and assigned to an owner. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for this TRANSACTION_LINE entity. Distinct from created_timestamp, which reflects system record creation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the action item is expected to be completed, as agreed upon during CAPA planning. Used to calculate overdue status, track CAPA execution timeliness, and report on compliance with committed timelines to sponsors and regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this action item, reflecting urgency and risk impact. Critical and high-priority items are subject to expedited review and escalation procedures. Drives resource allocation and monitoring frequency.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The regulatory authority to which this action item represents a formal commitment, if regulatory_commitment is True (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA). Null if this is an internal CAPA action item without a regulatory commitment dimension. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health_Canada|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; EMA GCP Inspections; ICH E6(R2); MHRA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: regulatory_commitment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action item represents a formal commitment made to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) during an inspection or in a regulatory submission response. Regulatory commitment items are subject to heightened monitoring and escalation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; EMA GCP Inspections; ICH E6(R2); EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this action item within the parent CAPA plan (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Enables ordered display and reporting of action items within a CAPA. Serves as the LINE_SEQUENCE for this TRANSACTION_LINE entity.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: source_finding_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the specific audit finding, inspection observation, protocol deviation, or nonconformance that this action item directly addresses (e.g., audit finding number, deviation ID). Provides traceability from action item back to the originating quality event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title summarizing the action item (e.g., 'Revise SOP-QA-012 to include double-check step'). Used in dashboards, reports, and inspection-ready summaries within MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which all required training associated with this action item was completed and documented in MasterControl. Null if training_required is False or training has not yet been completed. Required as part of completion evidence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of this action item requires associated staff training (e.g., training on a revised SOP). When True, training completion records in MasterControl must be linked as evidence before the action item can be verified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: verification_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the QA verifier during the evidence review, including rationale for rejection or conditions for acceptance. Provides the audit trail narrative required for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the QA verifier confirmed the completion evidence was adequate and the action item was satisfactorily executed. Null until verification is completed. Required for regulatory inspection audit trail.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: verification_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the QA verification review of the action item completion evidence. 'Accepted' closes the verification loop; 'rejected' returns the item to the owner for rework; 'pending_revision' indicates partial acceptance with required amendments.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether independent QA verification of completion evidence is required before this action item can be marked as completed. True for high-risk or critical action items per the CAPA procedure. Drives the QA review workflow in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 820.100; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.description: Assessment of whether the deviation compromised the integrity, reliability, or interpretability of study data. Informs decisions on data exclusion, sensitivity analyses, or database lock.

Indicates whether it was found during CRA monitoring visit, site self-identification, sponsor audit, regulatory inspection, central data review, or subject report. Used for monitoring effectiveness metrics. attributes.name: deviation_category

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; EMA Guideline on GCP Inspection; FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the protocol deviation, including what protocol requirement was not met, the circumstances under which it occurred, and any immediate actions taken. Sourced from the eCRF or CTMS deviation entry.

attributes.name: deviation_ref_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number assigned to the protocol deviation record, typically generated by the CTMS (Oracle Siebel CTMS) or EDC (Medidata Rave). Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312.62; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: deviation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the deviation record. 'Open' indicates newly identified; 'under_review' indicates active investigation; 'resolved' indicates corrective action completed; 'closed' indicates fully adjudicated and archived; 'escalated' indicates elevated to sponsor or regulatory authority; 'voided' indicates entered in error.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; MasterControl; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: deviation_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the deviation describing which protocol requirement was violated. Common types include: eligibility, dosing, visit_window, prohibited_medication, consent, randomization, assessments, sample_collection, concomitant_medication, data_collection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: eligibility|dosing|visit_window|prohibited_medication|consent|randomization|assessments|sample_collection|concomitant_medication|data_collection — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM DV Domain; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Protocol Deviations

attributes.name: discovery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the protocol deviation was first identified or discovered, which may differ from the occurrence date. Used to calculate detection lag and assess monitoring effectiveness.

attributes.name: ecrf_form_ref

attributes.name: include_in_csr_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Include in Clinical Study Report (CSR) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be listed or summarized in the Clinical Study Report (CSR) per ICH E3 requirements. Major and important deviations are typically included.
attributes.references: ICH E3 Section 10.2; ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on CSR

attributes.name: irb_iec_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally submitted to the IRB/IEC. Used to verify compliance with reporting timelines and to support audit readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108; ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: irb_iec_reporting_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reporting Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) per applicable regulations and the IRB/IEC-approved protocol.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56.108; ICH E6(R2) Section 3.3; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: The date on which the protocol deviation actually occurred (i.e., the date the protocol requirement was not met). This is the principal real-world event date per CDISC SDTM DVSTDTC.

attributes.name: pi_notified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was formally notified of the deviation. Required for GCP compliance and site management accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.5; 21 CFR Part 312.53; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: protocol_requirement_ref
attributes.description: Specific section, clause, or criterion number within the study protocol that was deviated from (e.g., 'Section 5.3 Inclusion Criterion 2'). Enables precise traceability to the protocol document.

attributes.name: protocol_version

attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 6; 21 CFR Part 312.23

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deviation was formally submitted to the applicable regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.), where regulatory reporting was required.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA) as part of IND safety reporting or clinical trial notification obligations.
