attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); ISO 9001

attributes.name: review_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the SOP owner must initiate a periodic review to confirm continued applicability and accuracy. May precede the expiry date to allow time for revision and approval before expiry.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: revision_summary
attributes.description: Brief narrative describing the nature and rationale of changes made in this version relative to the superseded version (e.g., 'Updated to reflect ICH E6(R3) requirements; added remote monitoring guidance'). Required for change control documentation.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the scope and applicability of the SOP, including which studies, sites, roles, or geographies it applies to. Sourced from the SOP document's scope section. Critical for determining applicability during inspections.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sop_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable document control number assigned to the SOP within MasterControl (e.g., QA-GCP-001). Serves as the business identifier used in audit trails, regulatory submissions, and training records. Unique per SOP title across all versions.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) Section 8; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sox_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOP governs financial reporting or internal control processes subject to SOX compliance requirements (e.g., finance, procurement, project accounting SOPs). Relevant for publicly-listed sponsors and CROs.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302, 404; SAP S/4HANA Financial Controls; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: superseded_version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the immediately preceding SOP version that this current version replaces. Enables version lineage tracing and ensures retired versions are correctly linked in the document control audit trail.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Full descriptive title of the SOP as it appears on the document cover page and in the quality management system. Used for search, display, and regulatory filing purposes.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ISO 9001

attributes.name: training_completion_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from the SOP effective date within which all applicable staff must complete the required training. Used by MasterControl to auto-calculate individual training due dates and trigger overdue notifications.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of a formal training event is mandatory for all applicable staff before they may operate under this SOP. When True, a training assignment must be created in MasterControl for each in-scope role upon SOP approval.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; GCP

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Current version identifier of the SOP document (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0). Incremented upon each approved revision cycle. Used to ensure staff are trained on and referencing the correct version.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: sop_training_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing individual staff training completions against required SOPs. Captures staff member identifier, SOP version trained on, training method (read-and-understand, classroom, e-learning, OJT), training completion date, assessment score (if applicable), trainer identifier, and training status (completed, overdue, waived). Enables SOP compliance tracking and training currency verification for GCP inspections. Sourced from MasterControl training management module.
products.reference: GCP Training Record (ICH E6 R2 Section 5.1; 21 CFR Part 11)

attributes.name: sop_training_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Training Record ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SOP training record in the MasterControl training management module. Primary key for this transactional entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — captures a discrete training completion event with its own lifecycle.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: compliance_capa_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the CAPA record that triggered this retraining event, if applicable. Links training records to quality events such as protocol deviations, audit findings, or inspection observations that required corrective retraining. Null for routine training.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA Tracking; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ISO 9001

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SOP document that this training record is associated with. References the controlled SOP document in MasterControl document control module.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.13; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: electronic_signature_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the 21 CFR Part 11-compliant electronic signature applied by the staff member to confirm training completion. Mandatory for GCP-regulated training records. Links to the electronic signature audit trail in MasterControl.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the investigational site associated with this training record, if the training is site-specific. Null for sponsor/CRO staff training not tied to a specific site. Enables site-level training compliance tracking for site activation and monitoring.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1

attributes.name: primary_sop_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the staff member (employee, contractor, or investigator) who completed or is required to complete the SOP training. Links to the workforce party record. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sop_training_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sop_training_requirement. Business justification: A training record documents the completion of a training requirement. Linking sop_training_record.sop_training_requirement_id → sop_training_requirement.sop_training_requirement_id creates the critica
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the clinical study for which this training is required, if the SOP training is study-specific or protocol-specific. Null for organization-wide SOPs applicable to all studies. Enables study-level training compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: training_curriculum_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.training_curriculum. Business justification: SOP training records must be associated with the training curriculum they fulfill to support curriculum completion tracking, GCP compliance reporting, and automated curriculum gap analysis. training_p
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: training_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the training plan or curriculum that mandated this SOP training record. Links to the role-based or study-specific training plan in MasterControl that defines required SOPs for a given staff role or study assignment.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: assessment_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staff member achieved a passing score on the training assessment. True if assessment_score >= passing_score_threshold; False if below threshold; Null if no assessment was required for this training method.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score achieved by the staff member on the post-training assessment or quiz, expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Applicable only for training methods that include a formal assessment (e-learning, classroom). Null for read-and-understand method. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER QUANTITATIVE_RESULT category.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential attempt number for this training record, indicating how many times the staff member has attempted the training or assessment for this SOP version. First attempt = 1. Supports quality metrics and identification of staff requiring additional support.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or observations related to this training record, such as trainer observations, special circumstances, or quality notes. Supports audit trail completeness and GCP inspection documentation.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the staff member completed the SOP training. For read-and-understand, this is the date the staff member signed off. For e-learning, this is the date the module was completed. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category (date precision appropriate for training compliance).
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the training was electronically recorded as completed in MasterControl. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation standards. Distinct from completion_date which captures the business event date.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles; MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this training record was first created in the system. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Training Management; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department or functional unit of the staff member at the time of training (e.g., Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics, Quality Assurance). Used for departmental training compliance reporting and gap analysis.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the staff member is required to complete the SOP training. Calculated based on SOP effective date plus the organization's training grace period policy. Used to determine overdue status and drive compliance escalations.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this training record expires and retraining or refresher training is required. Applicable for SOPs with periodic recertification requirements (e.g., annual GCP training). Null for SOPs with no expiry requirement.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: is_current_version_training
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training record corresponds to the currently effective version of the SOP. True if the sop_version matches the current approved version; False if the staff member was trained on a superseded version. Critical for GCP inspection readiness checks.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum assessment score percentage required to achieve a passing result for this SOP training (e.g., 80.00%). Enables determination of pass/fail outcome and supports quality metrics on training effectiveness.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: signature_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the staff member applied their electronic signature to confirm training completion. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation. Distinct from completion_timestamp which records system processing time.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Training Management; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sop_category
attributes.description: Functional category of the SOP being trained on (e.g., Clinical Operations, Data Management, Safety Reporting, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Laboratory). Enables category-level compliance reporting and training gap analysis by functional area. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clinical_operations|data_management|safety_reporting|regulatory_affairs|quality_assurance|laboratory|finance|it_systems|human_resources — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sop_version
attributes.description: Version number of the SOP document on which the staff member was trained (e.g., '2.0', '3.1'). Critical for GCP compliance verification — training must be on the current approved version. Enables identification of staff trained on superseded versions.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.13; 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: source_record_number
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the source operational system (e.g., MasterControl internal training record ID). Enables traceability back to the originating system for audit and reconciliation purposes per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this training record was sourced (e.g., MasterControl for system-generated records, Workday for HR-driven training, manual for paper-based records migrated to the lakehouse). Supports data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; Workday HCM; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles

attributes.name: staff_full_name
attributes.description: Full name of the staff member who completed or is required to complete the training. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and GCP inspection readiness per ALCOA+ principles. Supports historical record integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: staff_role
attributes.description: The job role or function of the staff member at the time of training (e.g., Clinical Research Associate, Principal Investigator, Data Manager, Biostatistician). Captured at training time for historical accuracy. Used to verify role-appropriate SOP training coverage during GCP inspections.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: trainer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the qualified trainer who delivered the training. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and GCP inspection readiness. Supports historical record integrity even if trainer record is modified.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: training_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The actual time in minutes spent by the staff member completing the training. Captured automatically by e-learning systems or recorded manually for classroom and OJT sessions. Used for training effort reporting and curriculum planning.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: training_method
attributes.description: The instructional delivery method used for this SOP training event. Read-and-understand (R&U) is the most common GCP method; classroom and e-learning are used for complex SOPs; on-the-job training (OJT) is used for procedural skills. Drives assessment requirements and documentation standards.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: training_record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for this training record as assigned by MasterControl (e.g., TR-2024-000123). Used for audit trail references, GCP inspection documentation, and regulatory correspondence. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: training_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this training record indicating whether the staff member has completed, is overdue, has been granted a waiver, is in progress, or has not yet started the required SOP training. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: training_type
attributes.description: Classification of the training event indicating whether it is initial training (first time on this SOP), retraining (following a failed assessment or deviation), refresher (periodic recertification), or change-control training (triggered by a new SOP version release).
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this training record was last modified. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail integrity and change tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl Training Management; ALCOA+ principles; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the Quality Assurance (QA) manager or authorized approver who granted the training waiver. Required for audit trail and GCP inspection documentation when training_status is 'waived'.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signatures

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: The date on which the training waiver was formally approved and recorded. Applicable only when training_status is 'waived'. Supports audit trail completeness per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Documented justification for granting a training waiver when training_status is 'waived'. Examples include equivalent prior training, role change making SOP non-applicable, or temporary exemption with documented rationale. Required for audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ principles

products.name: sop_training_requirement
products.description: Master record defining which SOPs are required training for which roles, departments, or study assignments. Captures role or job function, SOP identifier, training frequency (initial, annual, on-change), grace period days, and whether training is mandatory for study participation. Drives automated training assignment and compliance gap identification in MasterControl. Distinct from the training record (which captures completion) — this defines the obligation.
products.reference: Training Requirement Matrix (MasterControl; ICH E6 R2)

attributes.name: sop_training_requirement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Training Requirement ID
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the SOP training requirement record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SOP document that this training requirement is based upon. Links to the controlled SOP document record in the document management system.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.13

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job role or function for which this SOP training is required. Drives automated training assignment in MasterControl based on role assignment.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; Workday HCM Job Profile

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Training requirements in GCP-regulated environments are driven by specific regulatory obligations (e.g., ICH E6 GCP requires training on GCP principles, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 requires training on electro
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department for which this SOP training requirement applies. Null if the requirement is role-based rather than department-based.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Unit; MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this training requirement applies. Null if the requirement is global (not study-specific). Enables study-specific training obligation tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: training_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_plan. Business justification: A training requirement defines WHAT training is needed; a training plan defines HOW it is delivered. Linking requirements to plans enables tracking which requirements are fulfilled by which plans. The
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: applicability_scope
attributes.description: Defines the organizational scope at which this training requirement applies. 'global' = all staff; 'study_specific' = only staff assigned to a particular study; 'department_specific' = only a department; 'role_specific' = only a job role; 'site_specific' = only staff at a particular investigational site.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this training requirement was formally approved by the QA or training manager. Part of the electronic approval audit trail required under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the QA or training manager who approved this training requirement definition in MasterControl. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature compliance.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: auto_assign_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether MasterControl should automatically assign this training requirement to qualifying personnel when they are assigned to the applicable role, department, or study. When False, manual assignment by a training coordinator is required.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: capa_required_on_overdue
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required on Overdue Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal CAPA must be initiated when this training requirement becomes overdue beyond the grace period. Distinct from escalation_required — CAPA is a formal quality system record with root cause analysis obligations.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA Tracking Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SOP training requirement record was first created in the system. Part of the ALCOA+ audit trail required for GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP ALCOA+

attributes.name: curriculum_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the training curriculum or learning path in MasterControl to which this SOP training requirement belongs. Enables grouping of related SOP requirements into structured training programs (e.g., GCP Onboarding Curriculum, Annual Refresher Curriculum).
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this training requirement becomes enforceable. Personnel assigned to the applicable role, department, or study on or after this date are subject to this requirement.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: escalation_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a compliance escalation notification must be triggered if training is not completed within the grace period. When True, MasterControl generates a CAPA or non-conformance record and notifies the QA manager.
attributes.references: MasterControl CAPA Tracking Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this training requirement is no longer enforceable, typically when the SOP is retired or superseded. Null for open-ended requirements. Used to automatically deactivate requirements in MasterControl.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: gcp_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training requirement is classified as a GCP training obligation under ICH E6(R2). GCP-applicable requirements are subject to heightened audit scrutiny and must be documented in the Trial Master File (TMF).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: geographic_applicability
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code(s) or region identifier indicating the geographic jurisdiction(s) where this training requirement applies. Supports multi-regional regulatory compliance (e.g., FDA requirements for USA, EMA requirements for EU member states).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; MHRA; PMDA; TGA; Health Canada; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after the training due date during which the training may still be completed without triggering a compliance violation or non-conformance. Typically 0–30 days depending on SOP criticality and sponsor requirements.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SOP training is mandatory (True) or optional/recommended (False) for the assigned role, department, or study. Mandatory training must be completed before study participation or role activation per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: is_study_participation_prerequisite
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of this SOP training is a prerequisite for a staff member to be activated on a clinical study. When True, the system blocks study assignment until training is recorded as complete.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: job_function
attributes.description: The specific job function or functional area for which this training requirement applies (e.g., Clinical Research Associate, Data Manager, Biostatistician, Principal Investigator). Complements role_id with a human-readable functional label for reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this SOP training requirement record was most recently updated. Part of the ALCOA+ audit trail. Any modification must be accompanied by a reason for change per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP ALCOA+

attributes.name: max_attempts_allowed
attributes.description: Maximum number of times a trainee may attempt the training assessment before escalation or remediation is required. Null if unlimited attempts are permitted.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or clarifications related to this SOP training requirement. May include sponsor-specific instructions, exceptions, or implementation guidance for training coordinators.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: passing_score_pct
attributes.description: Minimum percentage score required to pass the training assessment associated with this SOP requirement. Applicable when training_delivery_method includes an assessment component. Null if no scored assessment is required.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: phase_applicability
attributes.description: Specifies the clinical trial phase(s) for which this SOP training requirement is applicable. Enables phase-specific training assignment for staff transitioning between study phases.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: reason_for_change
attributes.description: Free-text justification for the most recent modification to this training requirement record. Mandatory for any update per 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP ALCOA+; MasterControl Training Management Module

attributes.name: recurrence_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between required retraining cycles for recurring training types (e.g., 365 for annual). Null for one-time training types such as 'initial'. Used by MasterControl to auto-generate the next training due date.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.8

attributes.name: regulatory_basis
attributes.description: The specific regulatory citation, guideline, or standard that mandates or supports this training requirement (e.g., 'ICH E6(R2) Section 2.8', '21 CFR Part 312.53', 'EU CTR 536/2014 Article 49'). Used for regulatory inspection readiness and audit documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP; ISO 14155

attributes.name: reminder_days_before_due
attributes.description: Number of days before the training due date that an automated reminder notification should be sent to the trainee and their manager. Configurable per SOP criticality to drive proactive compliance.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: requirement_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the SOP training requirement record, used for cross-system referencing and audit trail. Follows the format TRQ-[alphanumeric]. Serves as the externally-known identifier in MasterControl.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SOP training requirement record. 'active' = currently enforced; 'inactive' = no longer enforced; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer version requirement; 'draft' = under review; 'pending_approval' = awaiting QA sign-off.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sop_version
attributes.description: Version of the SOP document for which this training requirement was defined. Critical for tracking whether personnel have been trained on the current version versus a superseded version.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control Module; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.13

attributes.name: sponsor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training requirement was mandated by the study sponsor as a condition of the clinical trial agreement. Sponsor-required training may have additional documentation and audit trail obligations.

True: record is audit-ready. False: record requires additional documentation or review before inspection. Supports TMF/eTMF completeness and inspection readiness programs.

attributes.name: capa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) has been determined to be required for this quality event. True: CAPA must be initiated in MasterControl. False: event can be resolved without formal CAPA. This is the primary escalation decision field in the quality event triage workflow.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the quality event record was first created in MasterControl. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements and ALCOA+ attributability. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: data_integrity_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality event has compromised or potentially compromised the integrity of clinical trial data in the EDC or source documents. True: data integrity affected. False: no data integrity impact. Drives data review, query management, and potential database lock delay decisions.
attributes.references: FDA Data Integrity Guidance 2018; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: error_count
attributes.description: Number of errors, discrepancies, or non-conformances identified within the QC sample reviewed. Used in conjunction with sample_size to compute error rate for quality trending and threshold monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP Guidelines; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: error_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of errors identified relative to the total sample size (error_count / sample_size). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Used for quality threshold monitoring, KPI reporting, and CAPA escalation triggers. Null if sample_size is zero or not applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA Data Integrity Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the quality event, including what was observed, where it occurred, and the potential impact on subject safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance. Captured at time of identification per ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation standards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: event_reference_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-visible reference number assigned to the quality event upon creation in MasterControl. Used in audit trails, regulatory correspondence, and CAPA linkage. Format: QE-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quality event within the MasterControl workflow. Open: newly identified, awaiting triage. Under Review: QA/QC team actively investigating. Pending CAPA: CAPA determination made, awaiting CAPA initiation. Closed: event resolved and verified. Cancelled: event determined to be invalid or duplicate.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quality event by its nature. Drives routing, escalation rules, and CAPA determination logic. Values: data_quality_issue (EDC/eCRF data errors), process_non_compliance (GCP/SOP deviation), system_failure (EDC, CTMS, or IRT system outage/error), vendor_quality_issue (CRO, lab, or third-party vendor failure), qc_review_finding (finding from a formal QC review activity).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: identification_source
attributes.description: The activity or mechanism through which the quality event was detected. Drives root cause analysis and process improvement analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: qc_review|self_inspection|routine_monitoring|sdv|audit|regulatory_inspection|proactive_surveillance|system_alert — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the quality event was first identified or detected. This is the principal real-world event date per ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements. Distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: immediate_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of any immediate containment or corrective actions taken at the time of quality event identification, prior to formal CAPA initiation. Examples: data query raised in EDC, site notified, process halted. Supports ALCOA+ and GCP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: irb_iec_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality event must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study. True: IRB/IEC notification required. False: not required. Driven by protocol deviation severity and subject safety impact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.3; FDA 21 CFR Part 56; OHRP Regulations; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: protocol_deviation_category
attributes.description: Classification of the quality event as a protocol deviation per ICH E6(R2) and sponsor requirements. Major: deviation that may affect subject safety or data integrity. Minor: deviation with minimal impact. Not Applicable: event is not a protocol deviation (e.g., system failure, vendor issue). Required for regulatory submission deviation summaries.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: qc_outcome
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the QC review activity that generated this quality event. Pass: quality threshold met, no significant issues. Fail: quality threshold exceeded, formal action required. Conditional Pass: threshold borderline, enhanced monitoring required. Applicable when identification_source is qc_review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP Guidelines; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality event represents a recurrence of a previously identified and closed quality event of the same type at the same site or study. True: recurrence identified. False: first occurrence. Recurrences trigger mandatory CAPA escalation and may indicate CAPA ineffectiveness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notified
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada) notified of this quality event, if applicable. Null if regulatory_reportability is not_reportable. Supports regulatory submission tracking and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: regulatory_reportability
attributes.description: Assessment of whether this quality event requires reporting to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) or to the sponsor. Reportable: must be submitted to regulatory body. Not Reportable: no regulatory notification required. Under Assessment: reportability determination pending QA review.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the quality event was formally resolved and closed in MasterControl. Populated when event_status transitions to closed. Used to calculate time-to-resolution KPIs and assess compliance with quality SLA targets.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: resolution_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of how the quality event was resolved, including actions taken, verification of effectiveness, and confirmation that the issue has been addressed. Required for event closure in MasterControl and supports regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the QA reviewer formally assessed and triaged the quality event in MasterControl. Used to measure triage cycle time and compliance with internal quality SLA targets for event review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; MasterControl QMS; FDA GCP Inspection Guidance

attributes.name: reviewed_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the Quality Assurance (QA) professional who reviewed and assessed the quality event in MasterControl. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature audit trail and GCP oversight accountability.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.1; 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause identified during quality event investigation. Used for systemic quality trending, SOP improvement prioritization, and CAPA effectiveness analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: training_gap|process_gap|system_error|communication_failure|resource_constraint|vendor_failure|protocol_complexity|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; ISO 9001 Root Cause Analysis

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the root cause identified through investigation of the quality event. Captured by the QA investigator following root cause analysis. Supports CAPA development and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA CAPA Guidance; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: sample_size
attributes.description: Total number of records, data points, or items reviewed during the QC activity that identified this quality event. Used to calculate error rate and assess the statistical significance of the finding. Applicable when the event originates from a QC review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC DMP Guidelines; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Risk-based severity classification of the quality event per GCP quality standards. Critical: may impact subject safety or data integrity requiring immediate action. Major: significant GCP deviation with potential regulatory impact. Minor: low-risk deviation with limited impact. Observation: informational finding with no immediate compliance risk.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA GCP Inspection Findings Classification; FDA Guidance on GCP Inspections

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this quality event was originated or imported into the data lakehouse. Supports data lineage tracking and cross-system quality event reconciliation. Primary source is MasterControl quality management module.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS

attributes.name: sponsor_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the study sponsor was formally notified of this quality event. Populated when sponsor_notified is True. Used to verify compliance with contractual and regulatory notification timelines.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; FDA GCP Guidance; Sponsor Quality Agreement

attributes.name: sponsor_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this quality event. True: sponsor notification sent. False: sponsor not yet notified. Required for CRO-sponsor quality agreement compliance and sponsor oversight obligations under ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.2; FDA GCP Guidance; Sponsor Quality Agreement

attributes.name: subject_safety_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the quality event has a direct or potential impact on the safety of enrolled study subjects. True: subject safety may be or has been affected. attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: identified_gaps
attributes.description: Narrative description of quality gaps, process deficiencies, or compliance vulnerabilities identified during the risk assessment (e.g., missing SDV documentation, incomplete ICF versions, delayed SAE reporting). Drives CAPA initiation and remediation planning.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2); FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: inherent_detectability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the ability to detect the risk before it causes harm, prior to control measures. Used in FMEA-style risk scoring (Risk Priority Number = Likelihood × Impact × Detectability).
attributes.references: ICH Q9 FMEA Methodology; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: inherent_impact_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the severity of impact on patient safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance if the risk materializes before controls are applied. Component of the inherent risk score calculation.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: inherent_likelihood_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the probability of the risk occurring before any control measures are applied. Component of the inherent risk score calculation per ICH Q9 risk estimation methodology.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: inherent_risk_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative risk rating derived from the inherent risk score before controls: critical, high, medium, or low. Used for risk prioritization, escalation thresholds, and sponsor/QA reporting dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: inherent_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric risk score calculated before control measures are applied, typically derived from likelihood, impact, and detectability scores (e.g., product or weighted sum). Establishes the baseline risk level for prioritization.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on RBQM

attributes.name: inspection_readiness_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk assessment was conducted specifically in preparation for a regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, or sponsor audit). Enables filtering of inspection-readiness assessments for pre-inspection reporting.
attributes.references: FDA Inspection Guidance; EMA GCP Inspection Procedure; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: mastercontrol_record_number
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by MasterControl (the system of record for this data product) to the risk assessment document. Enables direct traceability back to the source system for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this risk assessment, based on the defined review frequency. Supports proactive risk monitoring and inspection readiness. Calculated from assessment_date and review_frequency_days.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on RBQM

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number assigned to the risk assessment record in MasterControl (e.g., RA-2024-00123). Used for cross-system traceability, audit trails, and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: MasterControl Document Control; ICH Q9; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: The primary regulatory authority whose standards and guidelines govern this risk assessment (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). Determines applicable GCP framework and reporting obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA|EMA|MHRA|PMDA|TGA|Health_Canada|Other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline; ICH E6(R2); MHRA GCP Guidance

attributes.name: remediation_plan
attributes.description: Documented plan for addressing identified gaps and reducing residual risk, including specific actions, responsible parties, and target timelines. Distinct from CAPA (which is a formal corrective/preventive action record); this is the risk-level remediation narrative.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation activities for identified gaps: not_started, in_progress, completed, or overdue. Supports inspection readiness dashboards and QA oversight reporting.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; MasterControl Workflow

attributes.name: remediation_target_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the remediation actions identified in the risk assessment. Used for tracking remediation progress and escalation when overdue.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; MasterControl CAPA Tracking

attributes.name: residual_detectability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the ability to detect the risk after control measures are in place. Component of the residual risk score calculation.
attributes.references: ICH Q9 FMEA Methodology; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: residual_impact_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the severity of impact after control measures have been applied. Used to calculate the residual risk score.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: residual_likelihood_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the probability of the risk occurring after control measures have been applied. Used to calculate the residual risk score.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: residual_risk_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative risk rating after control measures are applied: critical, high, medium, or low. Drives risk acceptance decisions, escalation to DSMB/DMC, and CAPA initiation. A residual rating of critical or high typically triggers mandatory CAPA.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: residual_risk_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric risk score calculated after control measures are applied. Represents the remaining risk exposure. Compared against risk acceptance thresholds to determine if further mitigation is required.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA Reflection Paper on RBQM

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Defined interval in calendar days between periodic re-assessments of this risk (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 180 days). Drives scheduling of next_review_date and ensures ongoing risk monitoring per ICH Q9 principles.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: risk_acceptance_decision
attributes.description: Formal decision on whether the residual risk level is acceptable: accepted (risk within tolerance), not_accepted (requires further mitigation or CAPA), or conditionally_accepted (accepted with defined monitoring conditions). Documented per ICH Q9 risk acceptance principles.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; FDA RBQM Guidance; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the risk domain being assessed: data_integrity (ALCOA+ violations, EDC issues), patient_safety (adverse event under-reporting, protocol deviations), regulatory_compliance (GCP, ICH, FDA/EMA non-compliance), or operational (site performance, resource, supply chain). Drives escalation and reporting pathways.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the identified risk, including the potential failure mode, root cause hypothesis, and potential impact on study quality, patient safety, or regulatory compliance. Sourced from MasterControl risk assessment form.
attributes.references: ICH Q9; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA RBQM Guidance

attributes.name: risk_owner_department
attributes.description: Organizational department of the risk owner (e.g., Quality Assurance, Data Management, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs). Used for departmental risk reporting and workload analysis.

attributes.name: risk_subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the risk category (e.g., 'Source Data Verification', 'Informed Consent Process', 'SAE Reporting Timeliness', 'Protocol Deviation Management'). Enables detailed risk trending and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: scope

attributes.name: obligation_category

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which enrollment of subjects from this vulnerable population category was closed or completed at the study or site level. Null if enrollment is ongoing.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: enrollment_justification
attributes.description: Documented scientific and ethical justification for enrolling subjects from this vulnerable population, including why the research cannot be conducted in non-vulnerable populations and how the study addresses the specific health needs of this group. Required for IRB/IEC submission and regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 46.111; OHRP 45 CFR 46; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 10; Declaration of Helsinki

attributes.name: enrollment_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which enrollment of subjects from this vulnerable population category commenced at the study or site level. Must be on or after IRB/IEC approval date and all required safeguards being in place.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 312.62; EU CTR 536/2014; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: gdpr_special_category_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Special Category Data Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether data collected from this vulnerable population subject constitutes GDPR Article 9 special category data (health data, genetic data, biometric data). Triggers enhanced data protection measures, explicit consent requirements, and Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA) obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; GDPR Article 35 (DPIA); HIPAA 45 CFR 164; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 56

attributes.name: hipaa_phi_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Protected Health Information (PHI) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Protected Health Information (PHI) under HIPAA is involved in data collection for this vulnerable population subject. Triggers HIPAA-compliant data handling, de-identification, and authorization requirements for U.S.-based sites.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164; 21 CFR Part 11; OHRP 45 CFR 46; FDA Guidance on Computerized Systems

attributes.name: impairment_type
attributes.description: Specific type of cognitive or decisional impairment affecting the subject's consent capacity (e.g., dementia, intellectual disability, acute psychiatric condition, traumatic brain injury). Applicable when population_category is 'cognitively_impaired'. Informs capacity assessment methodology and safeguard design.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.9; 21 CFR Part 50.20; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; OHRP 45 CFR 46

attributes.name: independent_advocate_name
attributes.description: Name of the independent advocate or patient representative assigned to this vulnerable population subject. Populated when independent_advocate_required is True.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.9; Declaration of Helsinki

attributes.name: independent_advocate_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an independent patient advocate or subject representative (independent of the research team) is required to be present during the consent process for this vulnerable subject. Applicable in certain jurisdictions and for specific vulnerable categories.
attributes.references: EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.9; OHRP 45 CFR 46; Declaration of Helsinki Paragraph 29

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB or IEC granted approval for enrollment of this vulnerable population category. Must precede first subject enrollment per GCP requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 10

attributes.name: irb_iec_approval_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institutional Review Board / Independent Ethics Committee (IRB/IEC) Approval Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific IRB/IEC approval is required for enrollment of this vulnerable population category beyond the standard study approval. Certain vulnerable populations (e.g., prisoners, neonates) require additional ethics committee review per 21 CFR Part 46 Subparts B/C/D.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 46 Subparts B/C/D; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1; OHRP 45 CFR 46; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 10

attributes.name: irb_iec_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRB/IEC approval for this vulnerable population enrollment expires. Triggers renewal workflow in MasterControl to ensure continuous compliance coverage.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56.109; OHRP 45 CFR 46.109

attributes.name: lar_consent_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) Consent Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether consent from a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) is required because the subject lacks capacity to provide independent informed consent. Applicable to pediatric, cognitively impaired, and other incapacitated populations.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 50.3(l); ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.12; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 31; GDPR Article 8

attributes.name: mastercontrol_record_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding quality management record in MasterControl for this vulnerable population protection record. Enables traceability between the compliance data product and the document control system for SOP compliance, training, and CAPA linkage.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl QMS; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency of enhanced monitoring visits required for this vulnerable population subject. Applicable when enhanced_monitoring_required is True. Drives CRA scheduling in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.18; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2013; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: pediatric_age_band
attributes.description: ICH E11-defined age band classification for pediatric subjects. Applicable only when population_category is 'pediatric'. Drives age-appropriate dosing, formulation, and consent/assent requirements. Values: neonate (0-27 days), infant (28 days-23 months), toddler/child (2-11 years), adolescent (12-17 years).
attributes.references: ICH E11(R1) Clinical Investigation of Medicinal Products in the Pediatric Population; EMA Paediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006; FDA Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA)

attributes.name: population_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the vulnerable population type as defined by ICH E6(R2) and applicable regulations. Drives the specific ethical safeguards, consent requirements, and regulatory reporting obligations applicable to this subject. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pediatric|pregnant|cognitively_impaired|prisoner|elderly|economically_disadvantaged|terminally_ill — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 1.61; 21 CFR Part 50 Subpart D; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 10; OHRP 45 CFR 46 Subparts B/C/D

attributes.name: population_subcategory
attributes.description: Further granular classification within the primary population category (e.g., neonates, infants, adolescents within pediatric; first trimester, third trimester within pregnant; mild, moderate, severe within cognitively impaired). Aligns with ICH E11 pediatric age bands and CTCAE severity grading where applicable.
attributes.references: ICH E11(R1) Pediatric Studies; ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 50.55; EMA Paediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006

attributes.name: pregnancy_trimester
attributes.description: Trimester classification for pregnant subjects at time of enrollment or identification. Applicable only when population_category is 'pregnant'. Relevant for teratogenicity risk assessment, fetal safety monitoring, and regulatory reporting under ICH S5.
attributes.references: ICH S5(R3) Reproductive Toxicology; 21 CFR Part 46 Subpart B; EU CTR 536/2014; FDA Guidance on Pregnant Women in Clinical Trials

attributes.name: protection_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ethical protection and safeguard record for this vulnerable population subject. 'Active' indicates safeguards are in force; 'under_review' indicates a triggered reassessment; 'suspended' indicates enrollment or participation is paused pending review; 'waived' indicates IRB/IEC-approved waiver of specific protections; 'closed' indicates the subject has exited the study.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 3.1; 21 CFR Part 56; EU CTR 536/2014; OHRP 45 CFR 46

attributes.name: protocol_section_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific section(s) of the study protocol that address vulnerable population inclusion criteria, special safeguards, and ethical considerations. Enables traceability between this protection record and the governing protocol document.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 6.9; ICH E8(R1); 21 CFR Part 312.23; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for this vulnerable population protection record, used in regulatory submissions, audit trails, and TMF cross-referencing. Format: VP-{StudyCode}-{Sequence}.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8; 21 CFR Part 50 Subpart D; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 10

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicable regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.) must be notified of the enrollment of this vulnerable population category, beyond standard IND/CTA reporting. Applicable for certain pediatric studies under PREA or EU Paediatric Regulation.
attributes.references: FDA Pediatric Research Equity Act (PREA); EMA Paediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006; PMDA Pediatric Guidelines; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: regulatory_authority_notified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the applicable regulatory authority was notified of the enrollment of this vulnerable population subject or cohort. Populated when regulatory_authority_notification_required is True.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA Paediatric Regulation (EC) No 1901/2006; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42

attributes.name: risk_benefit_assessment_documented
attributes.description: Indicates whether a documented risk-benefit assessment specific to this vulnerable population category has been completed and filed in the TMF. Required by ICH E6(R2) and applicable regulations before enrollment of vulnerable subjects.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.8.2; 21 CFR Part 50.55; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 10; ISO 14155:2020 Section 6.2

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Regulatory risk classification for the research procedures applied to this vulnerable population subject, as assessed by the IRB/IEC. Determines permissibility of enrollment under 21 CFR Part 46 Subparts B/C/D and OHRP guidance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 46.404-407; OHRP 45 CFR 46; ICH E6(R2) GCP; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 10

attributes.name: safety_reporting_expedited
attributes.description: Indicates whether expedited adverse event and SAE reporting timelines apply to this vulnerable population subject due to heightened safety concerns. When True, AE/SAE events for this subject are subject to accelerated reporting to Oracle Argus Safety and regulatory authorities.
attributes.references: ICH E2A Clinical Safety Data Management; 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 42; EMA GVP Module VI

attributes.name: tmf_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the TMF document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF for the vulnerable population protection documentation, including IRB/IEC approvals, risk-benefit assessments, and special safeguard records. Supports inspection readiness and audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; EU CTR 536/2014 Article 58; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.62; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vulnerable population protection record was most recently modified. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 8; ALCOA+ Principles; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: parent_vulnerable_population_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on vulnerable_population (parent_vulnerable_population_id)

attributes.description: Externally-known reference number assigned to the single-IRB reliance or authorization agreement, used for cross-institutional tracking and regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: execution_date

attributes.name: exempt_category

Null for non-exempt research. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: category_1|category_2|category_3|category_4|category_5|category_6 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.104(d); Revised Common Rule 2018

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reliance agreement ceases to be in force. Null for open-ended agreements. Triggers renewal workflow when approaching.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.114; NIH Single IRB Policy

attributes.name: fda_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the research covered by this reliance agreement is subject to FDA regulations (e.g., IND or IDE studies), which may impose additional IRB requirements beyond the Common Rule.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 56; 21 CFR 312; FDA Guidance on IRB Reliance

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR data protection requirements apply to the reliance agreement, relevant when the relying institution or reviewing IRB operates within the European Economic Area.
attributes.references: GDPR (EU) 2016/679; EU Clinical Trials Regulation 536/2014

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether HIPAA Privacy Rule requirements apply to the research covered by this reliance agreement, relevant for U.S.-based studies involving protected health information.
attributes.references: HIPAA Privacy Rule 45 CFR Parts 160 and 164; OHRP

attributes.name: ind_number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned IND application number for the investigational product under study, required for FDA-regulated research covered by this reliance agreement.
attributes.references: 21 CFR 312.23; FDA IND Regulations

attributes.name: initial_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reviewing IRB granted initial approval for the protocol at the relying institution under this reliance agreement.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.109; 21 CFR 56.109; ICH E6(R2) Section 3

attributes.name: inspection_ready_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reliance agreement documentation is complete and inspection-ready per GCP and regulatory authority requirements (FDA, EMA, MHRA). Set to True when all required documents are filed in the eTMF.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 56; EMA GCP Inspections

attributes.name: irb_submission_number
attributes.description: Submission tracking number assigned by the reviewing IRB for the initial protocol submission or reliance request, used to cross-reference IRB correspondence and approval letters.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.109; 21 CFR 56.108; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: last_continuing_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent continuing review approval granted by the reviewing IRB for the protocol covered under this reliance agreement.

attributes.name: multi_site_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reliance agreement covers multiple clinical trial sites (True) or a single site (False), relevant for NIH-mandated single IRB requirements for multi-site studies.
attributes.references: NIH Single IRB Policy NOT-OD-16-094; 45 CFR 46.114

attributes.name: nih_funded_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the study covered by this reliance agreement is funded by the National Institutes of Health (NIH), triggering mandatory single IRB requirements under the NIH sIRB policy.
attributes.references: NIH Single IRB Policy NOT-OD-16-094; 45 CFR 46.114(b)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special conditions, or operational notes related to the reliance agreement that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: pi_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the Principal Investigator at the relying institution, used for reliance agreement notifications, amendment communications, and IRB correspondence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 4; HIPAA

attributes.name: pi_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Principal Investigator at the relying institution site who is conducting research under the oversight of the reviewing IRB per this reliance agreement.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4; 21 CFR 312.53; 45 CFR 46.114

attributes.name: reliance_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of oversight transferred to the reviewing IRB: full study oversight, specific procedures only, specific sites only, or amendments only.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.114(b); NIH Single IRB Policy

attributes.name: relying_institution_fwa_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Relying Institution Federal Wide Assurance (FWA) Number
attributes.description: OHRP-issued Federal Wide Assurance number for the relying institution, confirming its commitment to the Common Rule and eligibility to enter into a reliance agreement.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.103; OHRP FWA Requirements

attributes.name: relying_institution_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the institution that cedes IRB oversight to the reviewing IRB under this reliance agreement. For multi-site agreements, this may represent the primary relying institution.
attributes.references: 45 CFR 46.114(b)(1); NIH Single IRB Policy

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Category of IRB review applicable to the protocol under this reliance agreement: full board review, expedited review, exempt determination, or not human subjects research determination.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reliance agreement was formally terminated prior to its scheduled expiration date, if applicable.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for termination of the reliance agreement when status is terminated or expired. Captures whether termination was due to study completion, mutual agreement, IRB withdrawal, institution withdrawal, regulatory action, or sponsor termination.

attributes.name: tmf_section_reference
attributes.description: TMF Reference Model section code where the reliance agreement document is filed (e.g., 06.02 for IRB/IEC correspondence), supporting inspection readiness and eTMF completeness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; TMF Reference Model v3.0

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_number
attributes.description: Document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF where the executed reliance agreement and associated correspondence are archived, enabling direct TMF cross-reference.

attributes.name: completion_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from assignment date within which the trainee must complete the training plan to remain compliant.

attributes.name: curriculum_description

Supports SOX financial reporting controls.
domains.references: SOX; GAAP/IFRS; SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting Standards

products.name: study_budget
products.description: Master record for the total approved financial budget allocated to a clinical study, including versioned amendments and granular line-item breakdown by cost category, WBS element, and fiscal period. Captures the overall budget envelope (direct costs, indirect costs, overhead, pass-through estimates), version history with amendment reasons and approval status, and line-level planned quantities and unit costs. Serves as the financial baseline for all study-level cost tracking, variance analysis, sponsor invoicing, and SOX-compliant budget change audit trails. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA project accounting module.
products.reference: Study Budget / Project Budget (SAP S/4HANA PS)
