attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the business justification for the budget amendment, such as protocol change, scope expansion, site addition, or regulatory requirement. Required for SOX-compliant change audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of this budget version. Tracks the formal sign-off process required before the budget becomes financially active. Supports SOX internal control documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Workflow; SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this budget version received formal financial approval. Captured per 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature requirements and SOX audit trail standards.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA Workflow

attributes.name: budget_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this budget version becomes financially binding and active for cost tracking and sponsor invoicing purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Dates; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: budget_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget version expires or is superseded by a new amendment. Null for the currently active version. Supports version history management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Dates; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable budget reference number assigned by SAP S/4HANA project accounting. Used in sponsor invoicing, financial reporting, and SOX audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the study budget record. Drives workflow approvals, financial controls, and SOX-compliant change management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|amended|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Status; SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget record indicating whether it represents the original approved budget, a formal amendment, a supplemental allocation, or a contingency reserve.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; GAAP ASC 808

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Sequential integer version number of the budget, incremented with each approved amendment. Version 1 represents the original approved budget; subsequent versions reflect contract amendments or scope changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Version Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code representing the legal entity responsible for this study budget. Used for financial consolidation, intercompany accounting, and SOX entity-level reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI); SOX Section 302/404; GAAP

attributes.name: contingency_amount
attributes.description: Budgeted contingency reserve amount set aside for unforeseen study costs, protocol deviations, or scope changes. Typically expressed as a percentage of total direct costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Budget Supplement; GAAP; PMI PMBOK Risk Reserve

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the budget cost type. Distinguishes direct study costs, indirect/overhead allocations, pass-through expenses billed to sponsor, investigator grants, and patient stipends for granular financial analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Element Accounting; GAAP ASC 730; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this study budget record was first created in the source system. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Enables multi-currency study financial management.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Currency Configuration; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: direct_cost_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total approved budget allocated to direct study costs, including clinical operations, site management, data management, and biostatistics activities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Element Accounting; GAAP ASC 730

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency to the company code currency at the time of budget approval. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA exchange rate tables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Exchange Rate Management; GAAP ASC 830; IAS 21

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month 1–12) within the fiscal year to which this budget allocation applies. Supports monthly accrual calculations and period-level variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Period; GAAP ASC 420; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget record or line item applies. Used for annual financial planning, accrual management, and SOX period-end reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: indirect_cost_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total approved budget allocated to indirect costs such as administrative overhead, facility costs, and shared service allocations not directly attributable to a single study activity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Overhead Accounting; GAAP ASC 808

attributes.name: investigator_grant_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount for investigator grants payable to Principal Investigators (PIs) and clinical sites for conducting study procedures per the site payment schedule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Payments; ICH E6(R2) GCP; OIG Compliance Guidance

attributes.name: is_pass_through_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether pass-through costs in this budget are contractually billable to the sponsor at cost without markup. Drives accounts receivable and sponsor invoicing logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Billing; GAAP ASC 606; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_sox_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this study budget is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) financial reporting controls. True for budgets associated with publicly-reported financial obligations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SEC Regulation S-X

attributes.name: overhead_amount
attributes.description: Overhead allocation applied to the study budget, typically calculated as a percentage of direct costs per the CRO's overhead rate agreement with the sponsor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Overhead Costing Sheet; GAAP; OMB Circular A-21

attributes.name: pass_through_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Estimated amount for pass-through costs to be billed directly to the sponsor at cost, including central lab fees, imaging, specialty vendors, and IRB/IEC fees. Tracked separately from CRO service fees.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2); GAAP ASC 808

attributes.name: patient_stipend_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount for patient stipends and reimbursements, including travel, parking, and participation compensation paid to study subjects per IRB/IEC-approved amounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable; ICH E6(R2); IRB/IEC Guidelines; OHRP

attributes.name: planned_site_count
attributes.description: Number of investigational sites planned for the study as reflected in the budget assumptions. Drives site activation costs, monitoring visit budgets, and investigator grant totals.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS; SAP S/4HANA Project Planning

attributes.name: planned_subject_count
attributes.description: Total number of study subjects (patients) planned for enrollment as reflected in the budget assumptions. Key driver for per-patient cost calculations and investigator grant milestones.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; SAP S/4HANA Project Planning

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA profit center code for the business unit or therapeutic area responsible for this study budget. Enables profitability analysis by business segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Profit Center Accounting (EC-PCA); GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this budget record was sourced. Primarily SAP S/4HANA project accounting, but may include CTMS or manual uploads for legacy studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Data Integration; ALCOA+ Principles

attributes.name: sponsor_contract_number
attributes.description: The sponsor-assigned contract or work order number associated with this study budget. Used for sponsor invoicing reconciliation and contract management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Sales Order Management; ICH E6(R2); GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: study_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual end date of the clinical study as reflected in the budget planning horizon. Used for financial close-out planning and final accrual calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA Project Dates; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: study_start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual start date of the clinical study as reflected in the budget planning horizon. Used for fiscal period allocation and accrual scheduling.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA Project Dates; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: total_budget_amount
attributes.description: The total approved financial budget envelope for the clinical study in the transaction currency. Represents the gross budget including direct costs, indirect costs, overhead, and pass-through estimates. Serves as the financial baseline for variance analysis and sponsor invoicing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Budget; GAAP ASC 808; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this study budget record was last modified in the source system. Supports change detection, incremental data loading, and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Work Breakdown Structure element code that uniquely identifies the project node to which this budget is assigned. Enables hierarchical cost tracking and project accounting roll-up.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS); PMI PMBOK WBS Standard

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Master reference for SAP S/4HANA cost centers used to allocate and track clinical trial expenditures by organizational unit, therapeutic area, or functional department. Captures cost center code, hierarchy level, responsible manager, valid-from/to dates, and currency. Serves as the organizational dimension for all financial postings and project accounting within the CRO.
products.reference: Cost Center (SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cost center record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key generated by the lakehouse ingestion pipeline from SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the manager responsible for this cost center's budget and expenditures. Sourced from Workday HCM. Used for budget approval workflows, SOX segregation of duties controls, and financial accountability reporting. The manager is the primary approver for purchase orders and expense postings against this cost center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; Workday HCM; SOX Section 302 Management Certification; ICH E6(R2) 5.0 Sponsor Responsibilities

attributes.name: tertiary_cost_responsible_manager_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tertiary Cost Responsible Manager Employee Id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee

attributes.name: activity_type_group
attributes.description: SAP activity type group (LGRUPPE) associated with this cost center, defining the types of internal activities (e.g., CRA monitoring hours, biostatistician hours, regulatory writing hours) that can be planned and allocated. Used for activity-based costing in clinical trial project accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-ACT Activity Types; ICH E6(R2) Resource Planning

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total approved annual budget allocated to this cost center in the cost center's primary currency. Represents the planned expenditure ceiling for the fiscal year as approved through the SAP CO planning cycle. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis and sponsor cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Planning; SOX Section 404 Budget Controls; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Business Area (GSBER) associated with this cost center. Represents a distinct area of operations for which an internal balance sheet and P&L can be produced. Used for cross-company-code financial reporting in multi-entity CRO structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP; IFRS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP Company Code (BUKRS) representing the legal entity to which this cost center is assigned. Determines the chart of accounts, fiscal year, and local currency for financial reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area (KOKRS) to which this cost center belongs. Defines the organizational unit within which cost accounting is performed. All cost centers within a controlling area share the same fiscal year variant and currency settings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate or distribute costs from this cost center to other cost objects (studies, projects, sponsors). 'direct' = direct assignment; 'assessment' = SAP assessment cycle; 'distribution' = SAP distribution cycle; 'activity_based' = activity type-based allocation; 'statistical' = statistical key figure-based. Critical for accurate sponsor invoicing and pass-through cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Allocation; GAAP ASC 730 R&D; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: SAP cost center category (KOSAR) that determines which activity types and statistical key figures can be posted. Common categories in clinical research include: E (Production/Operations), F (Research & Development), G (General & Administrative), H (Human Resources), V (Sales & Marketing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: E|F|G|H|V|M|N|P — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to the cost center in SAP S/4HANA (e.g., CC-FIN-001, CC-CRA-ONCOLOGY). Used as the primary business identifier on all financial postings, purchase orders, and project accounting entries. Corresponds to the KOSTL field in SAP CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; ICH E6(R2) GCP Financial Accountability

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the cost center (e.g., 'Oncology Clinical Operations', 'Regulatory Affairs – EU', 'Biostatistics & Data Management'). Displayed in financial reports, dashboards, and sponsor invoicing summaries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; CDISC Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. 'active' — open for postings; 'inactive' — temporarily suspended; 'locked' — blocked for new postings pending review; 'pending_activation' — created but not yet approved; 'closed' — permanently deactivated after study close-out or organizational restructuring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Internal Controls; ICH E6(R2) Study Close-Out

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by its cost allocation behavior. 'direct' centers accumulate costs directly attributable to clinical trial studies or sponsors; 'indirect' centers hold shared service costs; 'overhead' centers capture organizational overhead; 'project' centers align to specific study projects; 'administrative' centers cover G&A functions. Drives cost allocation methodology in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; GAAP ASC 730 R&D Cost Allocation; IFRS 15

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where this cost center's organizational unit is domiciled (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, JPN). Determines applicable tax jurisdiction, regulatory reporting requirements (FDA, EMA, PMDA), and GDPR/HIPAA data residency obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 44 Data Transfers; HIPAA; FDA 21 CFR; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID (ERNAM) of the person who created this cost center record in SAP S/4HANA. Required for SOX audit trail, segregation of duties validation, and ALCOA+ (Attributable) compliance for financial records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA CSKS.ERNAM; SOX Section 404; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records; ALCOA+

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was first created in SAP S/4HANA (ERDAT + ERZET fields). Provides the audit trail start point for SOX compliance and financial record retention requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA CSKS.ERDAT; SOX Section 404; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Attributable

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the primary transaction currency for this cost center (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Determines the currency in which budgets are set and actuals are reported. Multi-currency cost centers in global CRO operations require explicit currency assignment per SAP CO configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; IFRS IAS 21 Foreign Currency; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Internal department code from Workday HCM organizational structure mapped to this cost center. Enables reconciliation between HR workforce cost data (Workday) and financial cost center data (SAP S/4HANA) for headcount-based cost allocation and labor cost reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organizational Structure; SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX HR-Finance Integration Controls

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (GJAHR) for which the annual budget and planning data on this cost center record applies. Enables year-over-year budget comparison and multi-year financial trend analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; GAAP Fiscal Year Reporting; SOX Annual Reporting

attributes.name: fiscal_year_variant
attributes.description: SAP fiscal year variant (PERIV) defining the fiscal year calendar structure for this cost center (e.g., K4 = calendar year Jan-Dec, V3 = April-March). Determines period mapping for financial postings and regulatory reporting timelines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Organizational functional department associated with this cost center (e.g., Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Data Management, Safety, Finance, IT). Used for cross-functional cost allocation and departmental P&L reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Clinical Operations|Regulatory Affairs|Biostatistics|Data Management|Safety|Finance|IT|HR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; GAAP Functional Expense Reporting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Primary General Ledger (GL) account code in SAP FI associated with this cost center for default cost postings. Ensures financial transactions are recorded to the correct GL account in the chart of accounts for GAAP/IFRS financial statement preparation and SOX controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP Chart of Accounts; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: hierarchy_area
attributes.description: The node within the standard cost center hierarchy (SAP standard hierarchy SEGH) to which this cost center is assigned. Enables roll-up reporting by organizational unit, therapeutic area, or functional department. Examples: 'CLINICAL-OPS', 'REGULATORY', 'BIOSTATISTICS'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Standard Hierarchy; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this cost center within the organizational cost center hierarchy (1 = top-level division, higher numbers = more granular sub-units). Used for hierarchical roll-up in financial reporting and budget consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; GAAP Segment Reporting ASC 280

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is used for intercompany transactions between legal entities within the CRO group (True) or is a standard intra-company cost center (False). Intercompany cost centers require transfer pricing documentation and elimination in consolidated financial statements per IFRS 10 and SOX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financials; SOX Transfer Pricing Controls; OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: is_statistical
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical cost center (True) used only for informational/reporting purposes without actual cost postings, or a real cost center (False) that receives actual financial transactions. Statistical cost centers are used for headcount tracking and KPI reporting in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Statistical Key Figures

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this cost center record. Required for SOX audit trail and ALCOA+ (Attributable) compliance. Enables identification of unauthorized changes during internal and external audits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cost center record in SAP S/4HANA. Used for change detection in ETL pipelines, audit trail maintenance, and SOX change management controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA; SOX Section 404 Change Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is locked for actual postings (True = locked, no new financial transactions permitted). Corresponds to the SPERRZ field in SAP CSKS. Used during period-end close, audit periods, or when a cost center is under SOX review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA CSKS.SPERRZ; SOX Section 404 Period-End Controls

attributes.name: overhead_rate_pct
attributes.description: Overhead surcharge rate (as a percentage) applied to direct costs posted to this cost center for indirect cost recovery. Used in SAP CO overhead calculation schemes to compute fully-loaded project costs for sponsor invoicing and contract budget management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-OPA Overhead; GAAP ASC 730; FAR 31.2 Indirect Cost Rates (if US government-sponsored trials)

attributes.name: plan_lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is locked for planning/budget postings (True = planning locked). Corresponds to the SPERP field in SAP CSKS. Prevents budget modifications after the annual planning cycle is finalized.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA CSKS.SPERP; SOX Budget Controls

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Profit Center (PRCTR) to which this cost center is assigned for internal profitability analysis. Enables management reporting of revenues and costs by business segment, therapeutic area, or sponsor relationship. Required for IFRS 8 and ASC 280 segment disclosures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA EC-PCA; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; GAAP ASC 280; SOX

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for this cost center (e.g., AMER, EMEA, APAC). Used for regional financial consolidation, multi-regional clinical trial cost allocation, and regulatory reporting segmentation across FDA, EMA, PMDA, TGA, and Health Canada jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM; ICH E6(R2) Multi-Regional Trials; EMA EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: sap_object_class
attributes.description: SAP object class (OBART) assigned to this cost center, determining which cost accounting objects can receive allocations from it. OCCA = Cost Centers; OACC = Orders; OPRO = Projects/WBS; OSTA = Statistical Objects. Governs the allocation rules in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA Object Class Configuration

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name of the cost center used in SAP S/4HANA reporting layouts and condensed financial statements where space is limited. Corresponds to the KTEXT field in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this cost center record was ingested (e.g., SAP_S4HANA_PROD, SAP_S4HANA_QA). Supports data lineage tracking, multi-system reconciliation, and Silver Layer data provenance in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: DAMA DMBOK Data Lineage; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Audit Trail; ALCOA+ Available

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: Clinical therapeutic area associated with this cost center (e.g., Oncology, Neurology, Cardiovascular, Immunology, Rare Disease). Enables financial reporting and budget tracking by therapeutic area, which is a primary dimension for CRO sponsor billing and internal P&L analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Oncology|Neurology|Cardiovascular|Immunology|Rare Disease|Infectious Disease|Metabolic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA IND/NDA Therapeutic Classification; CDISC SDTM TA Domain

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cost center is active and available for financial postings in SAP S/4HANA. Corresponds to the DATAB (valid-from date) field in SAP CSKS table. Financial transactions cannot be posted to this cost center before this date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA CSKS Table; SOX Financial Period Controls

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The date after which this cost center is no longer active for financial postings in SAP S/4HANA. Corresponds to the DATBI (valid-to date) field in SAP CSKS table. A value of 9999-12-31 indicates an open-ended cost center with no planned expiry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OM-CCA CSKS Table; SOX Financial Period Controls

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: SAP Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code (POSID) associated with this cost center for project accounting. Links cost center expenditures to specific clinical trial project structures in SAP PS (Project System), enabling study-level cost tracking and sponsor billing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS-WBS; ICH E6(R2) Financial Management; PMBOK WBS Standards

products.name: gl_account
products.description: Master reference for General Ledger accounts used in clinical trial financial postings. Captures account number, account type (P&L vs balance sheet), account group, description, currency, and controlling area assignment per SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts. Provides the financial classification backbone for all journal entries, accruals, and financial reporting across studies.
products.reference: G/L Account Master (SAP S/4HANA FI-GL)

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the General Ledger account record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this master reference entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code assigned to the GL account (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). When set, all postings to this account must be in this currency. Relevant for multi-currency clinical trial sponsor invoicing and site payments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.WAERS; ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: SAP account group code (KTOKS) that controls the number range and field selection for GL master data maintenance. Groups accounts by functional category such as balance sheet accounts, P&L accounts, cost accounts, or clinical trial-specific categories like investigator grants or pass-through costs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.KTOKS; T077S

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_node
attributes.description: Node identifier within the GL account hierarchy (e.g., SAP Financial Statement Version node or account group hierarchy) that positions this account in the reporting structure. Enables roll-up reporting of clinical trial costs by category such as direct study costs, overhead, and pass-through expenses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA T011; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_long_description
attributes.description: Extended narrative description of the GL account purpose, providing additional context for financial analysts, auditors, and SOX compliance reviewers beyond the short account name.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKAT; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the GL account as maintained in SAP S/4HANA (SKAT table). Used as the human-readable label in financial reports, trial balance, and study cost allocations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKAT; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known GL account number as defined in the SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts (SKA1/SKB1). This is the primary business identifier used in all journal entries, accruals, and financial postings across clinical trial studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts (SKA1); GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account indicating whether it is available for financial postings (active), temporarily blocked from postings (blocked), or flagged for removal from the chart of accounts (marked_for_deletion). Maps to SAP SKB1 blocking indicators.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Fundamental financial classification of the GL account indicating whether it is a balance sheet account (asset, liability, equity) or an income statement account (revenue, expense). Drives financial statement presentation and period-end closing behavior in SAP S/4HANA (field: KTOKS mapped to GVTYP).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.GVTYP; GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: accrual_engine_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account participates in SAP Accrual Engine processing for automated period-end accruals. Highly relevant for clinical trial study cost accruals such as investigator fees earned but not yet invoiced, CRO milestone accruals, and pass-through cost estimates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Accrual Engine; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Country-specific or group-level alternative account number (SAP SKA1.ALTKT) used for local statutory reporting or consolidation mapping. Enables clinical trial entities operating in multiple jurisdictions to map to local chart of accounts requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.ALTKT; IFRS IAS 1; Local GAAP

attributes.name: balance_in_local_currency
attributes.business_glossary_term: Balance in Local Currency Only Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account only manages balances in local (company code) currency (SAP SKB1.XSALH). When True, foreign currency transaction details are not separately tracked, which may apply to certain internal clearing accounts used in clinical trial intercompany settlements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.XSALH; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: Four-character SAP Chart of Accounts key (e.g., INT, YCOA) that groups GL accounts under a common numbering scheme. Determines the account structure applicable across all company codes in the clinical trials enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA T004; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: clinical_cost_category
attributes.description: Clinical research industry-specific cost classification applied to this GL account for study financial reporting and sponsor invoicing. Categorizes accounts into clinical trial cost buckets such as investigator grants, site management, pass-through costs, patient stipends, laboratory fees, regulatory fees, and CRO management fees. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: investigator_grant|site_management|pass_through|patient_stipend|laboratory|regulatory|cro_management_fee|data_management|biostatistics|overhead — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; GAAP ASC 730

attributes.name: commitment_item
attributes.description: Funds management commitment item linked to this GL account for budget availability control. Used in clinical trial project accounting to track committed expenditures against approved study budgets before actual invoices are posted.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FMCI; SAP Public Sector / Grants Management

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP four-character company code representing the legal entity for which this GL account is active. Determines the applicable accounting principles, currency, and fiscal year variant for clinical trial financial postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA T001; SOX Section 404; GAAP

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area identifier to which this GL account is assigned. The controlling area defines the organizational unit for management accounting, enabling cost center allocations, internal orders, and project accounting for clinical trial studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TKA01; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: cost_element_category
attributes.description: Controlling module classification indicating whether this GL account is a primary cost element (originating from FI postings such as investigator fees, pass-through costs) or secondary cost element (internal allocations between cost centers). Drives management accounting behavior in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CSKA; IFRS IAS 1; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: created_on
attributes.description: Date on which this GL account master record was first created in SAP S/4HANA (SKA1.ERDAT). Provides the audit trail start point for the account lifecycle, supporting SOX change management controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.ERDAT; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: SAP field status group (SKB1.FSTAG) that controls which fields are required, optional, or suppressed during document entry for this GL account. Ensures mandatory fields such as cost center, internal order, or WBS element are captured for clinical trial project accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.FSTAG; T004F

attributes.name: financial_statement_version
attributes.description: SAP Financial Statement Version key that determines how this GL account is grouped and presented in statutory financial statements (balance sheet, income statement). Critical for SOX-compliant financial reporting and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA T011; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: SAP functional area (SKA1.FUNC_AREA) that classifies the GL account by business function such as research and development, general and administrative, or sales. Supports cost-of-sales accounting and functional reporting for clinical trial financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.FUNC_AREA; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: house_bank
attributes.description: SAP house bank identifier (SKB1.HBKID) linked to this GL account for bank accounts. Relevant for clinical trial treasury accounts used to manage sponsor fund receipts and investigator site payment disbursements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.HBKID; T012

attributes.name: ifrs_account_mapping
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) Account Mapping Code
attributes.description: Mapping code linking this GL account to the corresponding IFRS disclosure line item or standard. Supports dual GAAP/IFRS reporting requirements for clinical trial organizations operating across US and international jurisdictions.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1; IFRS 15; IFRS 16; EMA regulatory financial reporting

attributes.name: interest_indicator
attributes.description: SAP interest indicator (SKB1.ZINRT) that determines whether and how interest is calculated on balances in this GL account. Applicable to clinical trial escrow accounts or deferred revenue accounts holding sponsor advance payments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.ZINRT; IFRS IAS 39

attributes.name: is_planning_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether cost planning is blocked for this GL account (SAP SKB1.XSPEP). When True, the account cannot be used in financial forecasting or study budget planning activities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.XSPEP

attributes.name: is_posting_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial postings to this GL account are currently blocked at the company code level (SAP SKB1.XSPEB). When True, no journal entries, accruals, or study cost allocations can be posted to this account.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.XSPEB; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: is_reconciliation_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a reconciliation account for a subledger (e.g., accounts payable for investigator site payments, accounts receivable for sponsor invoicing). Reconciliation accounts cannot receive direct manual postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.XBILK; GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: is_tax_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this GL account are subject to tax determination. When True, a valid tax code must be entered for all financial transactions posted to this account, supporting VAT/GST compliance for international clinical trial operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1; EU VAT Directive; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: last_changed_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Last Changed By User
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified this GL account master record. Supports segregation of duties and SOX audit trail requirements for chart of accounts change management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: last_changed_on
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Last Changed Date
attributes.description: Date on which this GL account master record was most recently modified in SAP S/4HANA (SKA1.LAEDA). Tracks the currency of the account definition for audit and change management purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.LAEDA; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: line_item_display
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items are stored and displayable for this GL account (SAP SKB1.XKRES). When True, detailed transaction-level audit trails are maintained, supporting SOX compliance and clinical trial cost transparency requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.XKRES; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: open_item_management
attributes.description: Indicates whether open item management is activated for this GL account (SAP SKB1.XOPVW). When True, individual line items remain open until cleared, enabling tracking of outstanding investigator grant payments, sponsor invoice receivables, and unreconciled accruals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.XOPVW; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: profit_loss_statement_account
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profit and Loss (P&L) Statement Account Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is a profit and loss (income statement) account as opposed to a balance sheet account. P&L accounts are reset to zero at fiscal year-end during the closing process. Critical for correct financial statement classification in clinical trial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.XBILK; GAAP ASC 205; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_type
attributes.description: Specifies the subledger type for which this account serves as a reconciliation account. 'vendor' applies to accounts payable for site and investigator payments; 'customer' applies to accounts receivable for sponsor invoicing; 'asset' applies to fixed asset subledger reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.MITKZ; GAAP ASC 210

attributes.name: revaluation_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether open items or balances in this GL account are subject to foreign currency revaluation at period-end. Applicable to clinical trial accounts holding balances in non-functional currencies such as EUR-denominated site payments or GBP-denominated CRO contracts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FAGL_FC_VAL; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: SAP sort key (SKB1.ZUAWA) that determines the allocation field populated in line items when posting to this account. Controls how line items are sorted and displayed in the GL account line item display for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1.ZUAWA; T008

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational source system from which this GL account record was extracted (e.g., SAP S/4HANA instance ID or client number). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer for multi-system clinical trial financial environments.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sox_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GL account is within scope for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) internal controls over financial reporting. SOX-relevant accounts require documented controls, periodic reconciliation, and management sign-off as part of the clinical trials organization's SOX compliance program.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: SAP tax category indicator (SKA1.MWSKZ) that controls whether and how tax codes can be entered during posting to this account. Relevant for VAT/GST compliance on cross-border clinical trial site payments and sponsor invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.MWSKZ; EU VAT Directive; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: tolerance_group
attributes.description: SAP tolerance group assigned to this GL account that defines acceptable variance thresholds for payment differences and clearing. Relevant for managing small discrepancies in investigator site payment reconciliations and sponsor invoice settlements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA T043; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Valid From Date
attributes.description: Date from which this GL account is effective and available for financial postings. Supports time-dependent account validity for clinical trial programs that introduce new cost categories at specific study phases or fiscal periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Valid To Date
attributes.description: Date after which this GL account is no longer available for financial postings. Nullable for open-ended accounts. Supports controlled retirement of obsolete clinical trial cost accounts during study close-out and archival.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKB1; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Ledger (GL) Account Created By User
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created this GL account master record (SKA1.ERNAM). Supports segregation of duties controls and SOX audit trail requirements for chart of accounts maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SKA1.ERNAM; SOX Section 404; 21 CFR Part 11

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: Transactional record for every financial journal entry posted in SAP S/4HANA for clinical trial operations. Captures document number, posting date, fiscal period, document type (original, reversal, accrual), debit/credit line items, cost center, GL account, reference document, posting user, and approval status. Supports SOX financial controls, period-end close, and audit trail requirements.
products.reference: Journal Entry / FI Document (SAP S/4HANA FI-GL)

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each journal entry record in the clinical trial finance data product. Primary key for the journal_entry table in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entries are posted to SAP cost centers for clinical trial cost allocation. journal_entry.cost_center_code is a denormalized string; adding cost_center_id FK normalizes this to the authoritativ
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Every journal entry line posts to a General Ledger account — this is a fundamental SAP FI relationship. journal_entry.gl_account_code and gl_account_description are denormalized strings; adding gl_acc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.payroll_record. Business justification: Payroll journal entries must be traceable to their source payroll records for payroll posting reconciliation and SOX controls. This link supports the named payroll-to-GL reconciliation process and aud
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA user ID of the individual who posted the journal entry. Mandatory for SOX segregation of duties controls, ALCOA+ attributability requirements, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records audit trail. Classified confidential as it identifies internal system users.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: sponsor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.sponsor_invoice. Business justification: Journal entry line items for AR postings (sponsor invoice issuance, payment receipts) reference the originating sponsor invoice. Multiple JE lines are created per sponsor invoice (debit AR, credit rev
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.vendor_invoice. Business justification: Journal entry line items for AP postings (vendor invoice receipts, goods receipts) reference the originating vendor invoice. Multiple JE lines are created per vendor invoice (debit expense/asset, cred
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accrual_basis
attributes.description: Indicates the basis on which an accrual journal entry was generated in SAP S/4HANA. Distinguishes manually entered accruals from system-generated recurring accruals and milestone-based accruals tied to clinical trial site payment schedules. Relevant for period-end close and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 37; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the journal entry in SAP S/4HANA. Tracks whether the entry has been reviewed and approved by an authorized approver as required by SOX internal controls and clinical trial financial governance policies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the journal entry was approved by the authorized approver in SAP S/4HANA. Supports SOX audit trail, segregation of duties reporting, and period-end close timeliness monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code representing the legal entity or organizational unit within the clinical trials enterprise that owns this journal entry. Enables multi-entity financial consolidation and legal entity reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 810; IFRS IAS 27; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the clinical trial cost type captured in this journal entry. Enables sponsor invoicing, budget vs. actuals analysis, and pass-through cost tracking across study sites. Aligns with clinical trial financial management taxonomy.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 730

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the journal entry record was first created in SAP S/4HANA. Supports ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) audit trail requirements and SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: The gross credit amount posted on this journal entry line in the transaction currency. Represents decreases to asset/expense accounts or increases to liability/revenue accounts. Core component of double-entry bookkeeping for clinical trial financial operations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: The gross debit amount posted on this journal entry line in the transaction currency. Represents increases to asset/expense accounts or decreases to liability/revenue accounts. Core component of double-entry bookkeeping for clinical trial financial operations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA debit/credit indicator for the journal entry line item. 'D' denotes a debit posting; 'C' denotes a credit posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and financial statement preparation for clinical trial operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the originating source document (e.g., invoice date, contract date, accrual date) that triggered the journal entry. May differ from posting_date when documents are processed after the originating event. Used for aging analysis and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP S/4HANA financial document number assigned at posting time. Serves as the primary business identifier for the journal entry and is used for cross-referencing in audit trails, regulatory submissions, and SOX controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: document_type_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA document type code classifying the nature of the journal entry (e.g., SA=General Ledger, KR=Vendor Invoice, DR=Customer Invoice, AB=Accounting Document, ZP=Payment Posting). Determines number range assignment and posting rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|KR|DR|AB|ZP|RE|KZ|DZ|AA|WA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the journal entry indicating its purpose in the financial close process. Distinguishes original postings from period-end accruals, reversals, adjustments, reclassifications, and intercompany eliminations for clinical trial cost management.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 250; IFRS IAS 8; SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied at posting time to translate transaction currency amounts to local currency. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA exchange rate tables. Critical for multi-currency clinical trial financial reporting and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month 1–12, or 13–16 for special periods) within the fiscal year to which the journal entry is assigned. Drives period-end close, accrual reversal scheduling, and monthly financial reporting for clinical trial operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 250; IFRS IAS 34; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which the journal entry is assigned in SAP S/4HANA. Used for annual financial reporting, budget vs. actuals analysis, and SOX period-end close controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 250; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the journal entry header level in SAP S/4HANA providing business context for the posting (e.g., 'Q3 site payment accrual - Study XYZ', 'Investigator grant milestone 2 - Site 001'). Supports audit review and financial reporting narrative.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; ALCOA+

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA internal order number used to collect costs for a specific clinical trial activity, investigator grant, or pass-through cost category. Complements WBS elements for granular cost tracking at the study or site level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-OPA Module; GAAP ASC 730; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: is_reversed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this journal entry has been reversed in SAP S/4HANA. True if a reversal document exists; False otherwise. Used to exclude reversed entries from financial reporting and to identify correcting entry pairs for SOX controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 250; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the journal entry document in SAP S/4HANA. Uniquely identifies each debit or credit posting line within a multi-line journal entry. Required for line-level audit trail and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Free-text description at the individual line item level in SAP S/4HANA providing specific context for the debit or credit posting (e.g., 'Pass-through lab cost - Site 005', 'Patient stipend accrual - Period 6'). Supports granular audit trail and cost analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; ALCOA+

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: The net journal entry amount translated into the company code local currency (functional currency) using the exchange rate applied at posting time. Used for statutory financial reporting and local regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the company code local (functional) currency into which the transaction currency amounts are translated. Required for multi-currency consolidation and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world financial event date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA. Determines the fiscal period and year to which the entry belongs. Critical for period-end close and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 250; SOX Section 302/404; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: posting_status

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: functional_currency_code

attributes.name: accrual_amount

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI); SOX Section 302/404; US GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Specific clinical trial activity associated with this budget line (e.g., 'Site Initiation Visit', 'Monitoring Visit', 'Database Lock', 'Regulatory Submission', 'Patient Screening', 'SAE Reporting'). Aligns with Oracle Siebel CTMS visit and activity tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA Activity-Based Costing

attributes.name: actual_amount
attributes.description: Total actual costs incurred against this budget line item to date in the transaction currency, as posted in SAP S/4HANA. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this budget line was formally approved by the authorized financial approver. Required for SOX financial controls documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Workflow Approval

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the budget to which this line belongs (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.0-Amendment-1'). Supports budget versioning for contract amendments, scope changes, and sponsor re-negotiations. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA budget version management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Amount committed via purchase orders or contracts against this budget line but not yet invoiced or paid. Represents financial obligations that reduce available budget. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA commitment management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Commitment Management; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the cost type for this budget line. Drives financial reporting segmentation and sponsor invoicing. Values: direct_labor (CRO staff effort), pass_through (third-party vendor costs billed at cost), investigator_grant (site/PI payments per protocol activity), overhead (indirect/facility costs), patient_stipend (subject reimbursement payments). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct_labor|pass_through|investigator_grant|overhead|patient_stipend|other — promote to reference product if additional categories are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Element Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: cost_subcategory
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the cost category (e.g., 'Clinical Monitoring', 'Data Management', 'Biostatistics', 'Central Lab', 'Imaging', 'RTSM', 'eCRF License'). Enables detailed cost tracking and variance analysis at the activity level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Accounting; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget line record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record origination. Conforms to 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records requirements and SOX audit trail standards.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this budget line (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'JPY'). Supports multi-currency clinical trial budgets for global studies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Accounting

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the functional currency. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA exchange rate tables. Required for multi-currency budget reporting and variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Exchange Rate Management; US GAAP ASC 830; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal accounting period (1–12 or 1–13 depending on fiscal year variant) within the fiscal year to which this budget line is allocated. Enables monthly budget tracking and period-end accrual management in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this budget line is allocated (e.g., 2024, 2025). Used for annual budget planning, financial period reporting, and SOX financial controls alignment in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Fiscal Year Variant; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Planned amount converted to the company's functional currency (typically USD) using the applicable exchange rate. Required for consolidated financial reporting and SOX compliance across multi-currency global studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Multi-Currency Accounting; SOX Section 302/404; US GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: is_milestone_based
attributes.description: Indicates whether payment for this budget line is triggered by achievement of a defined clinical milestone (True) rather than time-and-materials or unit-based billing (False). Drives milestone payment scheduling and sponsor invoicing logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP; US GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: is_pass_through
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line represents a pass-through cost that is billed to the sponsor at cost without CRO markup (True) or a CRO-managed cost subject to margin (False). Critical for sponsor invoicing and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP; US GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: line_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the budget line item activity or cost element (e.g., 'Site Initiation Visit - Site 001', 'Investigator Grant - Per Patient Enrolled', 'Central Lab Processing Fee'). Used in sponsor budget reports and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number ordering this item within the parent budget. Enables ordered display and navigation of budget line items in sponsor budget reports and SAP S/4HANA project accounting views.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget line item. Controls whether the line is available for cost posting and sponsor invoicing. Draft: under preparation; Approved: authorized for spend; Active: costs being incurred; On Hold: temporarily suspended; Cancelled: removed from scope; Closed: fully reconciled.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: milestone_description
attributes.description: Description of the clinical or contractual milestone that triggers payment for this budget line when is_milestone_based is True (e.g., 'First Patient First Visit', 'Database Lock', 'Last Patient Last Visit', 'Regulatory Submission'). Null when not milestone-based.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context for this budget line item (e.g., assumptions, scope clarifications, amendment rationale, vendor quotes). Supports financial review and audit documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the time period covered by this budget line item. Defines the temporal boundary for cost incurrence and accrual cutoff. Used in time-phased budget reporting and study close-out.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the time period covered by this budget line item. Defines the temporal scope for cost incurrence and accrual recognition. Used in time-phased budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: planned_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount for this line item in the transaction currency (planned_quantity × unit_cost). Represents the authorized spend ceiling for this activity. Used for variance analysis and sponsor budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Budgeted quantity of units for this line item (e.g., number of monitoring visits, number of patients enrolled, number of lab kits, number of FTE hours). Combined with unit_cost to derive the total planned amount.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP profit center code associated with this budget line for internal profitability reporting. Enables study-level and sponsor-level margin analysis within SAP S/4HANA Controlling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO-PCA); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sap_company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity responsible for this budget line. Required for multi-entity financial consolidation, intercompany accounting, and SOX entity-level financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI); SOX Section 302/404; US GAAP

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA financial document number associated with the budget posting for this line item. Provides direct traceability from the lakehouse Silver layer back to the source system transaction for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI); SOX Section 302/404; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: sap_internal_order
attributes.description: SAP internal order number used for detailed cost collection and monitoring for this budget line, particularly for pass-through costs and investigator grants. Supplements WBS element for granular cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO-OPA); SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: sponsor_line_ref
attributes.description: Sponsor's own reference code or line identifier for this budget item as defined in the contract or sponsor budget template. Enables cross-referencing between CRO internal budget and sponsor-facing budget documentation for reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Negotiated or standard cost per unit for this budget line item in the transaction currency. Multiplied by planned_quantity to derive planned_amount. Commercially sensitive as it reflects CRO pricing and investigator grant rates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the planned quantity (e.g., 'visit', 'patient', 'hour', 'FTE', 'kit', 'sample', 'page', 'month'). Required for accurate cost calculation and sponsor budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Material Management; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this budget line record. Supports change detection, incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer, and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP Work Breakdown Structure element code that classifies this budget line within the project hierarchy (e.g., study phase, activity, task). Drives cost allocation, project accounting, and financial reporting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project System (PS); PMI PMBOK WBS Standard

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master reference table for vendor. Referenced by vendor_id.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vendor

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the vendor's registered business location used for correspondence and payment remittance.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, floor, building, or additional location details of the vendor.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor's bank account number used for electronic fund transfers and payment remittance. Encrypted at rest per PCI-DSS requirements.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing or SWIFT/BIC code used to identify the vendor's financial institution for payment processing.

attributes.name: category
attributes.description: Tiered classification of the vendor based on strategic importance, qualification status, and procurement preference level.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current master service agreement or framework contract with the vendor became effective.

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current master service agreement or framework contract with the vendor expires and requires renewal.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Default cost center assignment for expenses incurred with this vendor, supporting project accounting and financial allocation.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the vendor's registered business location, used for tax jurisdiction and regulatory compliance determination.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor master record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the vendor's preferred transaction and invoicing currency.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: The trade name or doing-business-as name under which the vendor operates, if different from the legal name.

attributes.name: diversity_classification
attributes.description: Diversity certification classification of the vendor for supplier diversity reporting and compliance with corporate social responsibility programs.

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: The Dun & Bradstreet unique nine-digit identifier for the vendor entity, used for credit assessment and supplier qualification.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default general ledger account code for posting vendor-related transactions in the financial accounting system.

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vendor's certificate of insurance, ensuring adequate liability coverage for clinical trial services.

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether payments to this vendor are subject to IRS 1099 reporting requirements for US tax compliance.

attributes.name: is_gcp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has demonstrated compliance with ICH Good Clinical Practice guidelines through audit or self-assessment.

attributes.name: is_minority_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise for diversity tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The official registered legal name of the vendor organization used in contracts, invoices, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the next scheduled quality audit or vendor oversight review as required by GCP vendor management procedures.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor was initially onboarded and approved in the vendor master system for clinical trial engagements.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred method of payment disbursement to the vendor for settled invoices and milestone payments.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms agreed with the vendor specifying the number of days within which invoices must be settled or milestone-based payment structure.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the vendor's registered business address used for mail delivery and geographic classification.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact at the vendor organization used for official correspondence and invoice communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the vendor organization for day-to-day communications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact at the vendor organization for urgent communications and escalations.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: The organizational unit responsible for procurement activities and contract negotiations with this vendor.

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor was most recently qualified or re-qualified per clinical trial vendor oversight requirements.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current qualification status of the vendor per GCP vendor qualification requirements, indicating whether the vendor meets quality and regulatory standards for clinical trial work.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk classification assigned to the vendor based on the criticality of services provided, regulatory impact, and historical performance in clinical trial operations.

attributes.name: service_scope
attributes.description: Description of the primary services or goods the vendor provides to clinical trial operations, such as data management, biostatistics, monitoring, lab services, or drug supply.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the vendor's registered business address.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the vendor in the master data system indicating whether the vendor is eligible for new engagements and payments.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: The vendor's government-issued tax identification number used for tax reporting, 1099 filings, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor relationship was terminated or deactivated, if applicable. Null for active vendors.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor by the nature of services or goods provided to clinical trial operations. Includes Contract Research Organizations (CROs), central laboratories, investigator sites, material suppliers, consultants, and technology providers.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor master record was last modified, supporting change tracking and SOX audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric business code assigned to the vendor for identification in financial systems and purchase orders.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Tax withholding code applicable to payments made to this vendor, determining the withholding rate per tax jurisdiction rules.

attributes.name: parent_vendor_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on vendor (parent_vendor_id)

domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Manages the clinical research workforce including CRAs, CRCs, biostatisticians, data managers, medical monitors, and regulatory specialists. Owns employee profiles, GCP training and certification records, delegation logs, resource allocation to studies, capacity planning, and payroll managed through Workday HCM.
domains.references: ICH GCP E6(R3) Section 5.6; ISO 14155; Workday HCM Standards

products.name: employee
products.description: Master record for every clinical research workforce member employed by or contracted to the CRO, sourced from Workday HCM.
