Captures full employee identity, job profile assignment, organizational unit, employment type (full-time, part-time, contractor), hire date, termination date, employment status, cost center, reporting manager, work location, and GCP role designation (CRA, CRC, Biostatistician, Data Manager, Medical Monitor, Regulatory Specialist). This is the SSOT for workforce identity — all training records, study assignments, delegation logs, and certifications reference this entity.
products.reference: Workday HCM Worker

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each workforce member in the Clinical Trials organization. Primary key for the employee master record and the single source of truth (SSOT) for workforce identity referenced by training records, study assignments, delegation logs, and certifications.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Object

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.job_profile. Business justification: employee.job_profile_code is a denormalized STRING reference to job_profile. Adding a proper FK employee.job_profile_id → job_profile.job_profile_id normalizes this relationship. Many employees share
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the direct reporting manager for this workforce member, establishing the organizational hierarchy. Used for approval workflows in MasterControl (CAPA, training sign-off), delegation authority chains, and workforce planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Supervisory Organization; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.6

attributes.name: billing_rate_usd
attributes.description: The standard hourly or daily billing rate for this workforce member in US dollars, used for sponsor invoicing, study budget calculations, and scope-of-work costing. Confidential financial data managed in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cdisc_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the workforce member holds a current CDISC certification (e.g., CDISC SDTM, ADaM). Relevant for Data Managers and Biostatisticians assigned to CDISC-compliant submission deliverables.
attributes.references: CDISC Certification Program; FDA Study Data Technical Conformance Guide

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA cost center to which the employee's labor costs are charged. Enables project accounting, study-level cost allocation, and financial reporting for sponsor invoicing and internal P&L analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Object; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: ctms_user_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) User ID
attributes.description: The user account identifier for this workforce member in Oracle Siebel CTMS. Used to link employee records to site monitoring visits, study assignments, and delegation log entries within the CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS User Object; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Organizational department code from Workday HCM to which the workforce member is assigned (e.g., Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs). Used for resource allocation reporting and capacity planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization Object; SAP S/4HANA Cost Center Hierarchy

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the organizational department to which the workforce member belongs. Complements department_code for reporting and display purposes in CTMS and workforce dashboards.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Organization Object

attributes.name: edc_user_code
attributes.description: The user account identifier for this workforce member in Medidata Rave EDC. Required for audit trail attribution of data entry, query management, and SDV activities per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: Medidata Rave User Management; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the workforce member's employment. Controls access to EDC systems (Medidata Rave), CTMS (Oracle Siebel), eTMF (Veeva Vault), and determines eligibility for new study assignments. Active status is required for delegation log entries per ICH E6(R2).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employment Status; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the workforce member's engagement model with the CRO. Drives payroll processing rules in Workday HCM, cost allocation in SAP S/4HANA, and eligibility for study assignment roles under GCP.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.6

attributes.name: etmf_user_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) User ID
attributes.description: The user account identifier for this workforce member in Veeva Vault eTMF. Used to attribute document uploads, approvals, and access events in the trial master file audit trail per ICH E6(R2) and 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault User Management; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal given name of the workforce member as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for identity verification, delegation logs, and regulatory documentation including GCP training certificates.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: fte_percentage
attributes.description: The proportion of a full-time equivalent that this workforce member represents, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 100.00 for full-time, 50.00 for half-time). Used for capacity planning, resource allocation to studies, and payroll cost calculations in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Workday HCM FTE; SAP S/4HANA HR Integration

attributes.name: gcp_certification_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: The date on which the workforce member's current GCP certification expires. Used to trigger renewal training workflows in MasterControl and to flag employees approaching expiry for study assignment eligibility checks.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.8; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: gcp_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the workforce member currently holds a valid GCP certification as required by ICH E6(R2). A value of True is a prerequisite for assignment to study roles involving direct patient data or site oversight. Derived from the most recent active GCP training record.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 2.8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

attributes.name: gcp_role
attributes.description: The primary GCP-defined functional role of the workforce member within clinical research operations. Determines which study activities the employee may be delegated to perform, which training curricula apply in MasterControl, and which CTMS access profiles are provisioned. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CRA|CRC|Biostatistician|Data_Manager|Medical_Monitor|Regulatory_Specialist|PI|Project_Manager|Safety_Physician|QA_Auditor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

attributes.name: highest_education_level
attributes.description: The highest academic qualification attained by the workforce member, as recorded in Workday HCM. Used for role eligibility checks (e.g., Medical Monitor requires MD/PhD), regulatory submission CVs, and sponsor qualification packages.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Education Object; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.6

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: The date on which the workforce member officially commenced employment or engagement with the CRO, as recorded in Workday HCM. Used to calculate tenure, GCP training due dates, and eligibility windows for study assignments.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employment Start Date; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: is_key_personnel
attributes.description: Indicates whether this workforce member is designated as key personnel on one or more active study contracts or regulatory submissions. Key personnel changes may require sponsor notification and regulatory amendment per ICH E6(R2) and FDA guidance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.6; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.53; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the workforce member as defined in Workday HCM. Appears on delegation logs, regulatory submissions, and sponsor-facing documentation. Examples: Senior Clinical Research Associate, Principal Biostatistician, Data Manager II.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Object; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal family name of the workforce member as recorded in Workday HCM. Used in combination with first_name for full identity across regulatory submissions, delegation logs, and site monitoring documentation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; HIPAA 45 CFR §164.514; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: nationality_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the workforce member's nationality. Used for visa and work authorization tracking, international study assignment eligibility, and regulatory authority jurisdiction compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Article 9; Workday HCM Worker Profile

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade band assigned to the workforce member in Workday HCM, defining the salary range and benefits tier. Confidential HR data used for compensation equity analysis and workforce cost modeling.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the workforce member prefers to be addressed by in operational communications and CTMS displays. May differ from legal name; does not replace legal name for regulatory documents.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Profile; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: professional_license_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction that issued the workforce member's professional license. Used to validate regulatory eligibility for study roles in specific geographies.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: professional_license_number
attributes.description: Professional license or registration number for regulated roles (e.g., medical license for Medical Monitors, nursing license for CRCs). Required for regulatory submissions and delegation log validation. Confidential business data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Directive 2005/28/EC

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the employee master record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer, sourced from Workday HCM onboarding completion. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the employee master record in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for change data capture, data lineage tracking, and audit trail completeness per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: region_assignment
attributes.description: The geographic region to which the workforce member is primarily assigned for study operations (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific). Used for regional capacity planning, CRA territory management, and sponsor reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS Territory Management; Workday HCM Location Hierarchy

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the workforce member's employment or engagement ended, as recorded in Workday HCM. Null for active employees. Triggers deprovisioning of EDC, CTMS, and eTMF system access and flags open delegation log entries for reassignment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employment End Date; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1.5

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for the workforce member's departure from the CRO, sourced from Workday HCM. Used for attrition analytics, workforce planning, and audit trail completeness for regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Termination Reason; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: therapeutic_area_expertise
attributes.description: Primary therapeutic area(s) in which the workforce member has documented expertise (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for study assignment matching, resource allocation, and sponsor capability presentations. Free-text or controlled vocabulary from the CRO's competency framework.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Skills and Experience; Oracle Siebel CTMS Resource Profile

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the workforce member's primary work location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for scheduling site monitoring visits, DSMB meetings, and regulatory submission deadlines.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: work_authorization_status
attributes.description: Current work authorization status of the workforce member for their primary work country. Determines eligibility for international study assignments and site visits. Managed in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Work Authorization; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: work_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the workforce member's primary work location. Determines applicable labor law, data privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA), and regulatory authority jurisdiction for GCP compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Article 4; HIPAA; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: Primary corporate email address for the workforce member, used for system access provisioning, eTMF notifications, EDC account creation in Medidata Rave, and regulatory correspondence routing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary physical or virtual work location of the workforce member (e.g., office site, home-based, field-based). Used for resource allocation, travel cost planning, and site monitoring coverage mapping.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Location Object

attributes.name: work_phone
attributes.description: Primary work telephone number for the workforce member, used for site monitoring coordination, SAE escalation contact chains, and sponsor communication.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: workday_worker_code
attributes.description: The native worker identifier assigned by Workday HCM, used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational HR system of record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Object

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total number of years of clinical research industry experience for the workforce member, as recorded in Workday HCM or the CTMS resource profile. Used for study assignment eligibility, seniority-based billing rates, and sponsor qualification documentation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Profile; ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 5.6

products.name: job_profile
products.description: Reference master defining standardized job profiles and role classifications used across the clinical research workforce. Captures job family (Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs), job level (Associate, Senior, Principal, Director), required competencies, GCP role category, CDISC role alignment, and salary band. Sourced from Workday HCM job catalog. Enables workforce planning and competency gap analysis.
products.reference: Workday HCM Job Profile

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the job profile record in the workforce data product. Primary key for the job_profile entity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: billable_role
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees in this job profile are billable to sponsors under study contracts. Drives project accounting in SAP S/4HANA and financial forecasting for study budgets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Accounting; Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: billing_rate_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard billing rate (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR'). Required for multi-currency sponsor billing and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: billing_rate_unit
attributes.description: Time unit basis for the standard billing rate (hourly, daily, or monthly). Ensures consistent financial calculations across study budgets and sponsor invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; Workday HCM

attributes.name: cdisc_role_alignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Data Interchange Standards Consortium (CDISC) Role Alignment
attributes.description: Maps the job profile to a recognized CDISC role designation (e.g., 'SDTM Programmer', 'ADaM Statistician', 'Data Manager'). Supports CDISC-compliant study team composition and submission readiness assessments.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM Implementation Guide; CDISC ADaM Implementation Guide

attributes.name: competency_framework_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the competency framework applied to this job profile (e.g., 'CF-2024-v2.1'). Enables tracking of competency model evolution and gap analysis over time.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Workday HCM

attributes.name: ctms_access_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Access Level
attributes.description: Standard CTMS access level assigned to employees in this job profile within Oracle Siebel CTMS. Controls visibility of site, subject, and monitoring data.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: delegation_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees in this job profile are eligible to appear on a study delegation log as a delegated task performer. Critical for GCP compliance and site inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: edc_access_level
attributes.description: Standard EDC system access level assigned to employees in this job profile within Medidata Rave. Drives system access provisioning and audit trail compliance per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; Medidata Rave EDC; ALCOA+

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this job profile definition became active and available for workforce assignments. Used to track profile versioning and ensure historical accuracy in workforce records.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Defines the standard employment arrangement associated with this job profile. Drives benefits eligibility, payroll configuration, and resource allocation planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: exempt_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the job profile is classified as exempt or non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) or equivalent local labor law. Determines overtime eligibility and payroll processing rules in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile definition is scheduled to expire or be retired. Null indicates an open-ended profile with no planned retirement date.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: gcp_role_category
attributes.description: Categorizes the job profile according to its GCP-defined role in clinical trial conduct. Drives GCP training requirements, delegation log eligibility, and regulatory inspection readiness. Values align with ICH E6(R2) role definitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PI|CRA|CRC|Medical Monitor|Data Manager|Biostatistician|Regulatory Specialist|Other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice (GCP); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: gcp_training_frequency_months
attributes.description: Required recertification interval in months for GCP training associated with this job profile (e.g., 24 months). Used to schedule training renewals and flag compliance gaps in MasterControl.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines

attributes.name: gcp_training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether GCP training is mandatory for employees assigned to this job profile. Drives training compliance workflows in MasterControl and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines; OHRP

attributes.name: job_category
attributes.description: Classifies the job profile as an individual contributor, people manager, director, or executive. Used for span-of-control analysis and leadership pipeline planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad functional grouping to which this job profile belongs within the clinical research organization. Drives workforce planning, competency frameworks, and organizational reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Clinical Operations|Biostatistics|Data Management|Regulatory Affairs|Medical Affairs|Finance|Workforce|Laboratory|Supply Chain|Compliance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: job_family_group
attributes.description: Higher-level grouping above job family used for enterprise-wide workforce analytics and organizational hierarchy reporting in Workday HCM (e.g., 'Research & Development', 'Corporate Functions').
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Seniority tier of the job profile within its job family. Determines scope of responsibilities, delegation authority, and salary band eligibility. Values: Associate, Senior, Principal, Director, Executive.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: key_competencies
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of core competencies required for this job profile (e.g., 'Protocol Deviation Management, SDV, eCRF Review, Site Relationship Management'). Used in competency gap analysis and talent development planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this job profile was last reviewed and approved by HR or the relevant business owner. Supports periodic review compliance and ensures profiles remain current with regulatory and business requirements.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog; MasterControl Document Control; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: management_level
attributes.description: Numeric management tier within the organizational hierarchy (e.g., 1 = individual contributor, 2 = team lead, 3 = manager, 4 = director). Supports org chart rendering and reporting chain analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the job profile across the organization. Used in workforce planning, delegation logs, and resource allocation systems.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the job profile as defined in the Workday HCM job catalog (e.g., 'Senior Clinical Research Associate', 'Principal Biostatistician').
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: profile_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the HR business partner or functional leader responsible for maintaining this job profile definition. Provides accountability for profile accuracy and timely review.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job profile. 'active' profiles are available for staffing; 'inactive' profiles are retired from use; 'draft' profiles are under review; 'archived' profiles are retained for historical reference.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile is authorized to access and contribute to regulatory submission documents in Veeva Vault. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records access controls.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile is approved for remote or hybrid work arrangements. Used in workforce planning and resource allocation decisions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: required_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of mandatory professional certifications for this job profile (e.g., 'GCP Certificate, ACRP CCRA, CCDM'). Drives training compliance tracking in MasterControl and Workday HCM.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ACRP; CDISC; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: required_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum academic qualification required for this job profile. Used in talent acquisition screening, competency gap analysis, and regulatory inspection readiness for GCP-critical roles.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: required_years_experience
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for this job profile. Used in recruitment screening and workforce planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: safety_reporting_role
attributes.description: Indicates whether this job profile carries responsibilities for adverse event (AE) or serious adverse event (SAE) reporting. Drives access provisioning in Oracle Argus Safety and regulatory notification workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EMA GVP Module VI; Oracle Argus Safety

attributes.name: salary_band_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the compensation band assigned to this job profile (e.g., 'G5', 'M3'). Determines the approved salary range for workforce planning and compensation benchmarking. Classified as confidential business data.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: salary_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the salary range values (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Required for multi-currency workforce planning and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: salary_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum base salary (in local currency) approved for this job profile within its salary band. Used for compensation planning, offer management, and equity analysis. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: salary_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum base salary (in local currency) approved for this job profile within its salary band. Used for compensation planning, offer management, and equity analysis. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: sop_training_curriculum
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the SOP training curriculum assigned to this job profile in MasterControl. Defines the set of SOPs that employees must complete upon onboarding and at defined intervals.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: standard_billing_rate
attributes.description: Standard hourly or daily billing rate for this job profile when charged to sponsor study contracts. Used in financial forecasting, budget line creation, and invoice generation in SAP S/4HANA. Classified as confidential.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: travel_requirement
attributes.description: Expected travel frequency for employees in this job profile. Particularly relevant for CRA and site monitoring roles requiring regular site visits.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog; Oracle Siebel CTMS Site Monitoring

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this job profile record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail compliance, and Silver layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; Workday HCM

attributes.name: work_shift
attributes.description: Standard work shift pattern associated with this job profile. Relevant for site monitoring roles and laboratory positions requiring non-standard hours.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

attributes.name: workday_job_profile_code
attributes.description: The native identifier assigned to this job profile within Workday HCM job catalog. Used for system-of-record traceability and integration reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Catalog

products.name: gcp_training_record
products.description: Transactional record of GCP (Good Clinical Practice) training completions for each workforce member, sourced from MasterControl training management module. Captures training course name, ICH E6(R2) GCP version, training type (initial, refresher, protocol-specific), completion date, expiry date, training provider, assessment score, pass/fail status, and certificate reference. Critical for regulatory compliance — GCP training currency is required for all trial personnel per FDA 21 CFR Part 312 and ICH E6.
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) GCP Training; MasterControl Training Record

attributes.name: gcp_training_record_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Training Record ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each GCP training record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this transactional entity. TRANSACTION_HEADER role — captures a discrete training completion event for a workforce member.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl Training Management

attributes.name: certificate_document_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scanned or electronic training certificate stored in Veeva Vault eTMF or MasterControl document management. Enables direct access to the source certificate for audit and inspection purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; MasterControl; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: electronic_signature_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the electronic signature applied to this training record in MasterControl, confirming the workforce member's acknowledgment of training completion. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance for electronic records.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures; MasterControl; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 25

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce member (CRA, CRC, biostatistician, data manager, medical monitor, regulatory specialist, etc.) who completed this GCP training. Sourced from Workday HCM employee record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1 — Investigator Qualifications and Agreements

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical trial site for which this site-specific or protocol-specific GCP training was completed. Null for general GCP training not tied to a specific site. Used for site-level compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: study_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.study_assignment. Business justification: gcp_training_record already has employee_id and study_id, but linking to the specific study_assignment provides richer context — it ties the GCP training completion to the formal assignment record for
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study for which this protocol-specific GCP training was completed. Null for general GCP training not tied to a specific study. Used to verify study-specific training compliance on delegation logs.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8 — Essential Documents; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: training_course_id
attributes.description: Reference to the training course master record in MasterControl that defines the course curriculum, version, and requirements for this GCP training.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: training_curriculum_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.training_curriculum. Business justification: gcp_training_record has is_curriculum_required (BOOLEAN) indicating it may be part of a structured curriculum, but lacks a FK to training_curriculum. training_curriculum.gcp_training_included (BOOLEAN
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numeric score achieved by the workforce member on the GCP training assessment, expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Null if no assessment was administered (read-and-acknowledge training type). Used for quality monitoring and remedial training decisions.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GCP training was formally assigned to the workforce member in MasterControl. Used to calculate time-to-completion and overdue status.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: certificate_issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the training certificate was formally issued by the training provider. May differ from completion_date if certificate issuance involves a processing delay. Required for TMF documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate or credential reference number issued upon successful completion of the GCP training. Used for regulatory inspection readiness, TMF filing, and delegation log verification. Aligns with ALCOA+ original documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+; MasterControl; eTMF (Veeva Vault)

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes or context related to this GCP training record (e.g., special circumstances, remedial training context, inspector observations). Supports ALCOA+ completeness principle.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the workforce member successfully completed the GCP training. This is the principal business event date for this transaction record. Used to calculate training currency and expiry. Aligns with ALCOA+ principle of contemporaneous documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate); MasterControl

attributes.name: course_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the training course in MasterControl (e.g., 'TRN-GCP-001'). Used for structured reporting, filtering, and integration with CTMS and eTMF systems.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; SOP naming conventions

attributes.name: course_name
attributes.description: Full name of the GCP training course as defined in MasterControl (e.g., 'ICH E6(R2) GCP Fundamentals', 'GCP Refresher Training', 'Protocol-Specific GCP Training — Study XYZ-001'). Used for reporting and compliance verification.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.53

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this GCP training record was first created in the source system (MasterControl). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and ALCOA+ compliance verification.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; MasterControl; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the workforce member must complete this GCP training as defined in MasterControl. Used for compliance monitoring, overdue tracking, and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GCP training certification expires and a refresher training is required. Typically 2–3 years from completion date per sponsor and regulatory requirements. Null if the training does not expire (e.g., one-time protocol-specific training).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Sponsor SOPs; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: gcp_guideline_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Guideline Version
attributes.description: The specific version of the GCP guideline covered by this training (e.g., ICH E6(R2), ICH E6(R3)). Critical for regulatory compliance verification — regulators require training to be current with the applicable guideline version.
attributes.value_regex: ICH E6(R1)|ICH E6(R2)|ICH E6(R3)|21 CFR Part 312|ISO 14155
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice; ICH E6(R3) Draft; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline

attributes.name: is_curriculum_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training record was generated from a mandatory curriculum assignment (True) or was voluntarily completed outside of a formal curriculum (False). Used to distinguish mandatory compliance training from elective training.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: is_gcp_current
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training record represents a currently valid (non-expired) GCP certification (True) or has expired (False). Derived from expiry_date vs. current date but stored as a business flag for efficient compliance queries and delegation log validation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guideline; OHRP

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this GCP training record was most recently modified in the source system (MasterControl). Used for change tracking, audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; MasterControl; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: mastercontrol_record_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique identifier assigned by MasterControl training management system to this training completion record. Used for cross-system traceability and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management Module; 21 CFR Part 11 — Electronic Records and Signatures

attributes.name: max_attempts_allowed
attributes.description: The maximum number of assessment attempts permitted for this GCP training course as configured in MasterControl. Captured at training time to preserve the applicable policy.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; Sponsor Training SOPs

attributes.name: number_of_attempts
attributes.description: Total number of attempts the workforce member made on the GCP training assessment before achieving a pass or exhausting allowed attempts. Used for quality monitoring and identifying personnel who may need additional support.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); Sponsor Training SOPs

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the training assessment: 'pass' (met or exceeded minimum passing score), 'fail' (did not meet minimum passing score — remedial training required), 'not_applicable' (no assessment required for this training type, e.g., read-and-acknowledge only).
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312.53

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum assessment score percentage required to pass this GCP training course (e.g., 80.00%). Captured at the time of training completion to preserve the applicable standard even if the course threshold changes in future.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); Sponsor Training SOPs

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this training record has been included in a regulatory submission package (e.g., IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, eCTD) as evidence of GCP-trained personnel. True if included in at least one submission; False otherwise.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E6(R2); EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH M4 CTD; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: role_at_training
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workforce Role at Time of Training
attributes.description: The workforce role of the employee at the time of training completion (e.g., 'CRA', 'CRC', 'PI', 'Sub-Investigator', 'Data Manager', 'Biostatistician', 'Medical Monitor', 'Regulatory Affairs Specialist'). Captured at training time to preserve historical accuracy even if the employee's role changes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CRA|CRC|PI|sub_investigator|data_manager|biostatistician|medical_monitor|regulatory_specialist|study_coordinator|project_manager — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Workday HCM

attributes.name: signature_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the workforce member applied their electronic signature to acknowledge completion of the GCP training in MasterControl. Required for 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; MasterControl; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this GCP training record was sourced (e.g., 'MasterControl' for training management records, 'Workday' for HR-managed training records, 'Manual' for paper-based records digitized into the lakehouse).
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; Workday HCM; 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: tmf_filing_reference
attributes.description: The TMF artifact reference number or section code where this training record is filed in the eTMF (e.g., Veeva Vault TMF section '05.01 — Curriculum Vitae and GCP Training'). Enables direct traceability between training records and TMF documentation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8; DIA TMF Reference Model; Veeva Vault eTMF; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: trainer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the instructor or trainer who delivered the GCP training (for classroom, webinar, or on-the-job training types). Null for self-paced e-learning. Required for regulatory documentation per ALCOA+ attributability principle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; MasterControl Training Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: trainer_qualification
attributes.description: Qualifications or credentials of the trainer who delivered the GCP training (e.g., 'Certified GCP Trainer', 'CCRP', 'MD', 'PhD'). Documents trainer competency as required for regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; OHRP GCP Training Requirements

attributes.name: training_delivery_method
attributes.description: The modality through which the GCP training was delivered: 'e_learning' (self-paced online module in MasterControl), 'classroom' (in-person instructor-led), 'webinar' (live virtual instructor-led), 'on_the_job' (supervised practical training), 'blended' (combination of modalities).
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA GCP Training Guidance

attributes.name: training_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the GCP training course in hours (e.g., 2.50 for a 2.5-hour e-learning module). Used for workforce capacity planning, training hour reporting, and regulatory documentation of training effort.
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); Workday HCM

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: Name of the organization or entity that delivered the GCP training (e.g., 'CITI Program', 'TransCelerate', 'Internal Training Department', 'ACRP', 'SOCRA', 'External CRO Training Vendor'). Required for regulatory documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; OHRP GCP Training Requirements; MasterControl

attributes.name: training_provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the training provider: 'internal' (delivered by the CRO's own training department), 'external' (third-party training vendor), 'sponsor' (delivered by the pharmaceutical/biotech sponsor), 'regulatory_body' (delivered by FDA, EMA, ICH, or equivalent).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl Training Management; Sponsor SOPs

attributes.name: training_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this training record: 'completed' (training finished and passed), 'in_progress' (training assigned and started but not yet finished), 'overdue' (past due date without completion), 'waived' (formally waived with documented justification), 'cancelled' (training assignment cancelled).
attributes.references: MasterControl Training Management; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: training_type
attributes.description: Classification of the training event: 'initial' (first-time GCP certification), 'refresher' (periodic renewal), 'protocol_specific' (study-specific GCP requirements), 'role_specific' (role-based GCP training for CRA, CRC, PI, etc.), 'remedial' (corrective training following a deviation or finding).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; OHRP GCP Training Requirements

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized person (e.g., QA Manager, Training Manager) who approved the training waiver. Null if training_status is not 'waived'. Required for regulatory accountability per ALCOA+ attributability principle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: waiver_date
attributes.description: The date on which the training waiver was formally approved. Null if training_status is not 'waived'. Required for audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Documented justification for waiving this GCP training requirement (e.g., 'Equivalent training completed at prior employer within validity period', 'Regulatory authority-recognized equivalent certification held'). Null if training_status is not 'waived'. Required for audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl; ALCOA+

products.name: certification
products.description: Master record for professional certifications and credentials held by clinical research workforce members. Captures certification type (ACRP CCRC, ACRP CCRA, SOCRA CCRP, RAC, SAS Certified, etc.), issuing body, certification number, issue date, expiry date, renewal status, and continuing education credits earned. Distinct from GCP training records — these are externally awarded professional credentials with their own renewal lifecycle.
products.reference: ACRP/SOCRA Professional Certification

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each professional certification record held by a clinical research workforce member. Primary key for the certification data product.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Worker Certification Object

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce member (CRA, CRC, biostatistician, data manager, medical monitor, regulatory specialist, etc.) who holds this certification. Links to the employee/worker master record in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Worker Profile

attributes.name: ce_credits_earned
attributes.description: Total number of continuing education (CE) credits earned by the workforce member in the current renewal cycle toward maintaining or renewing this certification. Compared against ce_credits_required to assess compliance gap.
attributes.references: ACRP CE Requirements; SOCRA CE Requirements; RAPS CE Requirements; Workday HCM Learning

attributes.name: ce_credits_required
attributes.description: Total number of continuing education (CE) credits required by the issuing body to maintain or renew the certification within the current renewal cycle. Used to track workforce compliance with professional development obligations.
attributes.references: ACRP CE Requirements; SOCRA CE Requirements; RAPS CE Requirements; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: ce_cycle_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current continuing education (CE) credit accumulation cycle for this certification. CE credits must be earned by this date to satisfy the renewal requirement.
attributes.references: ACRP CE Cycle Policy; SOCRA CE Cycle Policy; RAPS CE Cycle Policy

attributes.name: ce_cycle_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current continuing education (CE) credit accumulation cycle for this certification. CE credits earned before this date do not count toward the current renewal requirement.
attributes.references: ACRP CE Cycle Policy; SOCRA CE Cycle Policy; RAPS CE Cycle Policy

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the professional certification or credential (e.g., 'Certified Clinical Research Coordinator', 'Certified Clinical Research Associate', 'Regulatory Affairs Certification', 'SAS Certified Base Programmer'). Serves as the primary display label for reporting and dashboards.
attributes.references: ACRP; SOCRA; RAPS; SAS Institute; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Externally issued unique credential number assigned by the certifying body (e.g., ACRP certificate number, SOCRA CCRP number, RAC registration number). Used for verification with the issuing organization and regulatory audit purposes.
attributes.references: ACRP Certification Standards; SOCRA Certification Program; RAPS RAC Program; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification record. 'active' = valid and in good standing; 'expired' = past expiry date without renewal; 'suspended' = temporarily suspended by issuing body; 'revoked' = permanently withdrawn by issuing body; 'pending' = awarded but not yet confirmed/verified.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ACRP; SOCRA; RAPS

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the professional credential by type, indicating the credential program category (e.g., clinical research coordinator, clinical research associate, regulatory affairs, biostatistics, data management). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CCRC|CCRA|CCRP|RAC|SAS_CERTIFIED|CCDM|CPIA|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ACRP; SOCRA; RAPS; SAS Institute; SCDM; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary cost incurred by the organization for this certification, including examination fees, application fees, and renewal fees paid to the issuing body. Expressed in the currency specified by cost_currency. Used for workforce development budget tracking in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; ICH E6(R2); SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and budget consolidation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5; HIPAA

attributes.name: credential_scope
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational scope of the certification's recognition and applicability. 'global' = recognized internationally (e.g., ICH-aligned); 'regional' = recognized within a regulatory region (e.g., EU, Asia-Pacific); 'national' = recognized within a single country; 'institutional' = recognized only within a specific organization.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR; EMA Guidelines; PMDA; MHRA; Health Canada

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the scanned certificate document stored in the eTMF or document management system (Veeva Vault / MasterControl). Enables direct retrieval of the credential document for regulatory inspections and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; MasterControl; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 11; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: exam_date
attributes.description: Date on which the workforce member sat the certification examination. Distinct from issue_date (when the credential was formally awarded). Null if no examination was required for this credential.
attributes.references: ACRP; SOCRA; RAPS; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: exam_location
attributes.description: Name or description of the testing center, proctored online platform, or venue where the certification examination was administered (e.g., 'Prometric Testing Center - Chicago', 'Online - ProctorU'). Supports audit trail and verification.
attributes.references: ACRP; SOCRA; RAPS; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: exam_score
attributes.description: Numeric score achieved by the workforce member on the certification examination, as reported by the issuing body. Expressed as a percentage or raw score per the issuing body's scale. Null if the certification does not require an examination.
attributes.references: ACRP Exam Standards; SOCRA Exam Standards; RAPS Exam Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the certification expires and is no longer valid unless renewed. Null indicates a lifetime or non-expiring credential. Used for automated renewal alerts, resource allocation eligibility checks, and regulatory compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ACRP Renewal Policy; SOCRA Renewal Policy; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: is_gcp_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification satisfies or is required as part of the workforce member's Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training and qualification obligations for study delegation. True = this credential is a GCP-required qualification; False = professional credential not tied to GCP mandate.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines; OHRP

attributes.name: is_regulatory_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is mandated by a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada, TGA) as a prerequisite for performing specific clinical research activities. True = regulatory mandate; False = professional credential without direct regulatory mandate.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA GCP Guidelines; ICH E6(R2); PMDA; MHRA; Health Canada; TGA

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the certifying body officially awarded the certification to the workforce member. Establishes the start of the certification's validity period and is required for regulatory audit trails and delegation log verification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: Name of the external organization that awarded and administers the certification (e.g., ACRP - Association of Clinical Research Professionals, SOCRA - Society of Clinical Research Associates, RAPS - Regulatory Affairs Professionals Society, SAS Institute, SCDM - Society for Clinical Data Management). Critical for verification and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ACRP; SOCRA; RAPS; SAS Institute; SCDM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: issuing_body_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the certifying body is headquartered or where the certification was issued. Relevant for multi-jurisdictional regulatory compliance (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA, Health Canada).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR; EMA Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, conditions, or remarks about the certification record (e.g., 'Renewal pending sponsor approval', 'Exam waived per equivalency policy', 'Certificate copy on file in Veeva Vault'). Not used for structured data.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; Workday HCM

attributes.name: passing_score
attributes.description: Minimum passing score required by the issuing body to achieve the certification. Used to contextualize the exam_score and confirm the workforce member met the threshold. Null if no examination is required.
attributes.references: ACRP Exam Standards; SOCRA Exam Standards; RAPS Exam Standards

attributes.name: reimbursement_amount
attributes.description: Actual monetary amount reimbursed to the workforce member for this certification, in the currency specified by cost_currency. May differ from cost_amount if partial reimbursement applies per company policy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; SAP S/4HANA AP; SOX

attributes.name: reimbursement_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organization reimburses the workforce member for the cost of obtaining or renewing this certification under the company's professional development or tuition reimbursement policy. True = eligible for reimbursement; False = not eligible.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Policy; SAP S/4HANA; SOX

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the certification was most recently renewed by the issuing body. Distinct from issue_date (original award) and expiry_date (end of validity). Tracks the renewal lifecycle for credentials that require periodic recertification.
attributes.references: ACRP Renewal Policy; SOCRA Renewal Policy; RAPS RAC Renewal; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before the expiry_date at which automated renewal reminder notifications should be triggered for the workforce member and their manager. Configurable per certification type to align with issuing body renewal windows (e.g., 90 days for ACRP CCRC).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Notification Configuration; ACRP Renewal Policy; SOCRA Renewal Policy

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the certification renewal process. 'not_due' = renewal period has not yet opened; 'in_progress' = renewal application being prepared; 'submitted' = renewal application submitted to issuing body; 'renewed' = renewal confirmed by issuing body; 'lapsed' = certification expired without renewal.
attributes.references: ACRP; SOCRA; RAPS; Workday HCM Certification Tracking; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this certification record was sourced or ingested into the lakehouse (e.g., Workday HCM worker certification object, MasterControl training/credential module, or manually entered). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating operational system (Workday HCM certification object ID or MasterControl record ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: specialty_area
attributes.description: Clinical research functional specialty area covered by the certification (e.g., oncology, pharmacovigilance, biostatistics, data management, regulatory affairs, GCP monitoring, pharmacokinetics). Used for resource allocation matching and capability gap analysis.
attributes.references: CDISC; ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR; CTCAE; MedDRA

attributes.name: sponsor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is specifically required by a pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor as a contractual condition for assigning the workforce member to their study. True = sponsor-mandated credential; False = not sponsor-mandated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); Study Contract / Scope of Work; CRO Sponsor Agreement

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this certification record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); GDPR Article 5; HIPAA

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the organization last verified the certification's validity with the issuing body. Used to determine when re-verification is due and to support regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; OHRP; ISO 14155; ALCOA+

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the organization's independent verification of the certification with the issuing body. 'unverified' = not yet checked; 'verified' = confirmed valid with issuing body; 'failed_verification' = issuing body could not confirm; 'pending_verification' = verification request submitted, awaiting response. Required for GCP compliance and delegation log integrity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; OHRP; ISO 14155

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal staff member (e.g., HR specialist, QA officer) who performed the verification of this certification with the issuing body. Supports audit trail requirements under GCP and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; OHRP

products.name: study_assignment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the formal assignment of a workforce member to a clinical study in a defined role, with FTE allocation percentage. Sourced from CTMS and Workday HCM project assignments. Captures employee, study reference, assigned role (CRA, CRC, Data Manager, Biostatistician, Medical Monitor, Regulatory Lead, Project Manager), assignment start and end dates, FTE allocation percentage, assignment status (active, on-hold, completed), and authorizing manager. This is the SSOT for study-level resource allocation and the primary input for capacity utilization calculations.
products.reference: CTMS Resource Assignment; Workday HCM Project Staffing

attributes.name: study_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the study assignment record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the financial cost center to which the workforce member's time on this study is charged. Links to SAP S/4HANA cost center master for project accounting and accrual processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; SOX; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: investigational_site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary clinical site to which this workforce member is assigned within the study. Relevant for CRAs and CRCs whose work is site-specific. Nullable for central roles (e.g., Biostatistician, Data Manager).
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor organization funding the study. Used for sponsor-level workforce reporting and billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: primary_study_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workforce member being assigned to the study. Links to the employee master record in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: study_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.study_budget. Business justification: Study assignments carry billing_rate and FTE allocation that must be tracked against the study budget. Clinical trial finance uses this link for labor cost actuals vs. budget reporting and investigato
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: study_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical study to which the workforce member is assigned. Links to the study master record in Oracle Siebel CTMS.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: workforce_delegation_log_id
attributes.description: Reference to the delegation of authority log entry in the site delegation log that formally authorizes this workforce member's tasks on the study. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; Veeva Vault eTMF

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the assignment was formally approved by the authorizing manager. Distinct from record creation; represents the business event of managerial authorization. Required for GCP delegation audit trail.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11; Workday HCM

attributes.name: assigned_role
attributes.description: The functional role the workforce member performs on this study. Drives GCP training requirements, delegation log entries, and capacity utilization calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CRA|CRC|Data Manager|Biostatistician|Medical Monitor|Regulatory Lead|Project Manager — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; CDISC; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: assignment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the assignment, generated by Oracle Siebel CTMS or Workday HCM project assignment module. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail references.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the study assignment. Drives capacity utilization reporting and resource availability calculations. Active = currently working; on-hold = temporarily suspended; completed = assignment concluded; cancelled = assignment voided; pending = awaiting activation.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assignment nature. Primary = main role holder; backup = coverage resource; ad-hoc = short-term task-based; interim = temporary gap coverage; consultant = external contractor assignment.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday HCM

attributes.name: billing_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or daily billing rate applied to this workforce member for this study assignment, in the contract currency. Used for study budget tracking and sponsor invoicing. Classified confidential as it reflects contractual pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; SOX; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: billing_rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the billing rate (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency study budget management and sponsor invoicing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA; SOX

attributes.name: billing_rate_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the billing rate (hourly, daily, monthly, or fixed fee). Determines how FTE allocation translates to billable amounts for sponsor invoicing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: completion_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for assignment completion or cancellation. Used for workforce attrition analysis and study continuity risk management.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the workforce member is based for this assignment. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination and GDPR/HIPAA compliance scoping.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; HIPAA; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this study assignment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: ctms_assignment_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) Assignment ID
attributes.description: The native assignment identifier from Oracle Siebel CTMS. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational CTMS source system.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp at which the assignment became operationally effective (distinct from start_date which is day-level). Used for intra-day capacity calculations and audit trail precision per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: The employment classification of the workforce member at the time of assignment. Relevant for billing rate determination, GCP oversight requirements, and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual date on which the workforce member's assignment to the study concludes. Nullable for open-ended assignments. Used for capacity planning and study close-out activities.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Workday HCM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: fte_allocation_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the workforce member's full-time equivalent capacity formally allocated to this study. Range 0.00–100.00. Primary input for capacity utilization calculations and resource planning. A value of 50.00 indicates half of the employee's working time is committed to this study.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: gcp_certification_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: The expiry date of the workforce member's GCP certification. Used to trigger re-training alerts and to flag non-compliant assignments during regulatory inspections.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; MasterControl

attributes.name: gcp_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the workforce member holds a valid GCP certification at the time of assignment. Mandatory compliance check per ICH E6(R2) before assignment activation. True = certified; False = not certified or expired.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: The geographic region (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific) in which the workforce member operates for this assignment. Used for regional capacity planning and regulatory jurisdiction tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014; GDPR

attributes.name: is_pi_oversight_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this assignment requires direct oversight by the Principal Investigator per the study delegation log. True = PI oversight required; False = independent execution permitted within delegated authority.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP Section 4.1; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information related to the assignment. Not used for regulatory documentation; supplementary operational context only.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: on_hold_date
attributes.description: The date on which the assignment was placed on hold. Populated only when assignment_status = 'on-hold'. Used for capacity planning and timeline impact analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday HCM

attributes.name: on_hold_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the assignment was placed on hold. Populated only when assignment_status = 'on-hold'. Supports operational decision-making and audit trail.
attributes.references: Oracle Siebel CTMS; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: phase
attributes.description: The clinical development phase of the study to which the workforce member is assigned. Used for workforce competency matching and regulatory oversight level determination.
attributes.value_regex: Phase I|Phase II|Phase III|Phase IV|Phase I/II
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; ICH E8; EMA Clinical Trials Regulation EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: planned_fte_allocation_pct
attributes.description: The originally planned FTE allocation percentage at the time of assignment creation, before any revisions. Enables variance analysis between planned and actual resource utilization.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: The version of the study protocol in effect at the time of assignment. Ensures the workforce member is trained on the correct protocol version and supports audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; CDISC

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this assignment record originated. CTMS = Oracle Siebel CTMS; Workday = Workday HCM project assignment; Manual = entered directly into the lakehouse. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2) GCP

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the workforce member formally begins their assignment to the study. Used as the effective-from date for FTE allocation and capacity planning calculations.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; Workday HCM; Oracle Siebel CTMS

attributes.name: therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area of the assigned study (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology). Captured at assignment level to support workforce competency matching and therapeutic area capacity reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC SDTM; MedDRA

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the workforce member completed all mandatory study-specific training requirements (protocol, ICF, EDC system) prior to or at assignment activation. Regulatory compliance prerequisite.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; MasterControl; FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this study assignment record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Used for incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2) GCP; ALCOA+

attributes.name: workday_assignment_code
attributes.description: The native project assignment identifier from Workday HCM. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the Workday HCM source system for payroll and project accounting alignment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM; SAP S/4HANA; SOX

products.name: workforce_delegation_log
products.description: Transactional record of the formal delegation of trial-related duties from the Principal Investigator (PI) to site staff and CRO personnel, as required by ICH E6(R2) Section 8.3.25. Captures delegating PI, delegatee employee, study, site, delegated task or responsibility, delegation start date, end date, PI signature date, and delegation log version. Regulatory artifact required in the Trial Master File (TMF). Distinct from study_assignment — this is a GCP-mandated legal document, not an operational resource record.
products.reference: ICH E6(R2) §8.3.25 Delegation of Duties Log; FDA Form 1572

attributes.name: workforce_delegation_log_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each delegation log record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this regulatory artifact.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Section 8.3.25; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: compliance_sop_id
