attributes.description: Indicates whether this competitive intelligence entry has been flagged as directly relevant to a program-level go/no-go decision. When True, the entry must be reviewed by the program governance committee.
attributes.references: Internal Portfolio Governance SOP; ICH E3

attributes.name: indication_overlap_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the degree and nature of therapeutic indication overlap between the competing asset and the program's investigational product. Supports TPP differentiation and regulatory strategy.
attributes.references: ICH E3; MedDRA; FDA Guidance on Indication Labeling

attributes.name: indication_overlap_level
attributes.description: Categorical assessment of how closely the competitor's target indication overlaps with the program's indication. Full = same patient population; Partial = overlapping subpopulation; Adjacent = related but distinct indication; None = no overlap.
attributes.references: MedDRA; ICH E3; FDA Guidance on Indication Labeling

attributes.name: intelligence_source_name
attributes.description: Specific name of the source from which this competitive intelligence was obtained (e.g., ASCO 2024 Annual Meeting, FDA Approval Letter, PubMed PMID 12345678, Bloomberg Intelligence Report). Supports traceability and ALCOA+ compliance.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R3) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: intelligence_source_type
attributes.description: Category of the primary source from which this competitive intelligence was obtained. Supports source credibility assessment and ALCOA+ data provenance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: public_registry|conference_abstract|publication|press_release|analyst_report|regulatory_filing|kol_interview|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R3) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: intelligence_source_url
attributes.description: URL or hyperlink to the primary source document or registry entry from which this competitive intelligence was obtained. Enables direct verification and audit trail.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R3)

attributes.name: key_differentiators
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the key clinical, safety, or commercial differentiators of the competing asset relative to the program's investigational product. Directly informs TPP refinement and go/no-go decision rationale.
attributes.references: ICH E3; FDA Guidance on Labeling; EMA Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC)

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this competitive intelligence entry was last reviewed and validated by the responsible program team member or competitive intelligence analyst.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R3) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: last_updated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the content of this competitive intelligence record was last substantively updated with new information. Distinct from last_reviewed_date (which may confirm no change).
attributes.references: ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R3) GCP; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: line_of_therapy
attributes.description: Treatment line for which the competing asset is being developed or approved. Informs competitive positioning and TPP refinement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: first_line|second_line|third_line_plus|maintenance|adjuvant|neoadjuvant|any — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Oncology Labeling Guidance; EMA Oncology Guidelines; CTCAE v5.0

attributes.name: mechanism_of_action
attributes.description: Pharmacological mechanism by which the competing asset exerts its therapeutic effect (e.g., PD-1 inhibitor, VEGFR antagonist, CAR-T). Informs differentiation strategy and Target Product Profile (TPP) refinement.
attributes.references: ICH S9; WHO-DD; MedDRA Pharmacology Classification

attributes.name: modality
attributes.description: Drug modality classification of the competing asset. Supports differentiation analysis and portfolio positioning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: small_molecule|biologic|cell_therapy|gene_therapy|oligonucleotide|vaccine|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA CDER/CBER Classification; EMA Scientific Guidelines; ICH Q6A/Q6B

attributes.name: partnership_licensing_notes
attributes.description: Notes on known partnerships, licensing agreements, or co-development arrangements associated with the competing asset. Informs competitive landscape and business development strategy.
attributes.references: Internal Business Development SOP; SEC Filings; EMA Public Assessment Reports

attributes.name: pricing_reimbursement_notes
attributes.description: Notes on the competitor's known or anticipated pricing, reimbursement status, and health technology assessment (HTA) outcomes. Informs commercial threat assessment and program value proposition. Classified as confidential due to strategic sensitivity.
attributes.references: Internal Commercial Strategy SOP; EMA HTA Regulation; FDA Value Framework

attributes.name: primary_endpoint_type
attributes.description: Type of primary clinical endpoint used in the competitor's pivotal trial (e.g., Overall Survival, Progression-Free Survival, HbA1c reduction). Informs endpoint strategy and SAP design for the program.
attributes.references: ICH E9(R1); FDA Guidance on Clinical Trial Endpoints; EMA Guideline on Clinical Endpoints

attributes.name: regulatory_designations
attributes.description: Special regulatory designations granted to the competing asset (e.g., Breakthrough Therapy, Fast Track, Orphan Drug, PRIME, Accelerated Approval). Informs competitive regulatory strategy.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312 Subpart E; EMA PRIME Scheme; ICH E3; OHRP

attributes.name: regulatory_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory status of the competing asset across major health authorities. Tracks IND/CTA filing, NDA/BLA/MAA submission, and approval status. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ind_filed|cta_filed|phase_3_ongoing|nda_bla_filed|maa_filed|approved|withdrawn|discontinued — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312/314; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH CTD/eCTD; PMDA; Health Canada

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_date
attributes.description: Anticipated or actual date of NDA/BLA/MAA or equivalent regulatory submission for the competing asset. Informs program urgency and submission timeline strategy.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH eCTD; PMDA; Health Canada

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this competitive intelligence entry should be reviewed and updated. Drives operational cadence for the competitive intelligence monitoring process.
attributes.references: Internal Portfolio Governance SOP; ICH E6(R3)

attributes.name: safety_profile_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the known or reported safety and tolerability profile of the competing asset, including key adverse events (AEs) and serious adverse events (SAEs). Informs the program's risk-benefit assessment and DSMB charter.
attributes.references: ICH E2A; ICH E2E; MedDRA; CTCAE v5.0; FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS); EMA EudraVigilance

attributes.name: target_patient_population
attributes.description: Description of the patient population targeted by the competing asset (e.g., biomarker-selected, line of therapy, disease stage). Used to assess competitive differentiation in patient recruitment and market positioning.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R3); FDA Patient-Focused Drug Development Guidance; EMA Guideline on Clinical Trials in Small Populations

attributes.name: tpp_impact_assessment
attributes.description: Narrative assessment of how this competitive intelligence entry impacts the program's Target Product Profile (TPP) — including potential need for differentiation in efficacy, safety, dosing, or patient population. Directly supports go/no-go decision-making.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance on Target Product Profile; EMA Scientific Advice; ICH E3

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this competitive intelligence record was last modified in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+ Principles; ICH E6(R3) GCP; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the associated competitive intelligence report or source document stored in Veeva Vault eTMF or quality management module. Enables direct document traceability.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault eTMF; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R3) TMF Reference Model

attributes.name: superseded_competitive_intelligence_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on competitive_intelligence (superseded_competitive_intelligence_id)

products.name: kri
products.description: Master record defining Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) monitored at the program level for portfolio governance. Captures indicator name, indicator type (KRI or KPI), metric definition, measurement unit, target threshold, warning threshold, critical threshold, measurement frequency, data source, responsible owner, and indicator status. Provides the program-level performance monitoring framework used in governance meetings and portfolio reviews. NOTE: This is the DEFINITION of the indicator, not the computed value — no analytics or aggregations are stored here.
products.reference: Program KRI/KPI Definition

attributes.name: kri_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the program-level Key Risk Indicator or Key Performance Indicator definition record. Primary key for this master resource entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical development program for which this KRI/KPI is defined. Links the indicator to its governing program portfolio context.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: indicator_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: KRI ownership is assigned to named employees accountable for monitoring and reporting in risk-based oversight frameworks. indicator_owner is a denormalized plain-text field; a FK enables KRI accountab
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: KRIs are defined to monitor compliance with specific regulatory obligations (e.g., KRI tracking enrollment rate against a pediatric obligation timeline). Linking program_kri to compliance.obligation s
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: previous_version_kri_id
attributes.description: Reference to the prior version of this KRI/KPI definition record, enabling a full version history chain for audit and regulatory inspection purposes.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: applicable_development_phase
attributes.description: The clinical development phase(s) for which this indicator definition is applicable (e.g., Phase_I, Phase_II, Phase_III, Phase_IV, all_phases). Allows phase-specific KRI/KPI frameworks within the same program.
attributes.references: ICH E8; FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: applicable_therapeutic_area
attributes.description: The therapeutic area for which this indicator is specifically calibrated (e.g., Oncology, Neurology, Cardiovascular). Some KRI thresholds are disease-area specific. Null if the indicator applies universally across all therapeutic areas.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MedDRA

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this KRI/KPI definition was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the transition from draft to active status and is required for regulatory audit trail.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the individual who formally approved this KRI/KPI definition or its most recent version change. Required for electronic signature compliance under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: benchmark_source
attributes.description: The source of the industry benchmark or historical baseline used to set the target and warning thresholds (e.g., 'TransCelerate Industry Benchmark 2023', 'Internal Historical Average 2020-2023', 'FDA Guidance', 'Sponsor SOPs'). Provides auditability for threshold-setting decisions.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: benchmark_value
attributes.description: The industry or historical benchmark value for this indicator against which the target threshold was calibrated. Enables comparison of program performance against external standards.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: capa_required_on_breach
attributes.business_glossary_term: Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) Required on Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) must be initiated in MasterControl when this indicator breaches its critical threshold. Supports GCP compliance and quality management workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP; MasterControl CAPA; 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: change_rationale
attributes.description: Business justification for the most recent change to this indicator definition, including threshold adjustments, metric redefinition, or ownership transfers. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this KRI/KPI definition record was first created in the system. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: critical_threshold
attributes.description: The threshold value at which the indicator triggers a red alert, indicating a critical risk or performance failure requiring immediate escalation to program governance or sponsor. Drives CAPA initiation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum; TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: data_source_object
attributes.description: The specific module, dataset, form, or table within the source system from which indicator data is extracted (e.g., 'AE Form' in Medidata Rave, 'Case Safety Report' in Oracle Argus Safety, 'Visit Tracking' in Oracle Siebel CTMS). Supports precise data lineage documentation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; CDISC SDTM

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the raw data for this indicator is sourced (e.g., Medidata Rave, Oracle Argus Safety, Oracle Siebel CTMS, SAP S/4HANA). Enables data lineage tracing and source system reconciliation.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: dsmb_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a critical threshold breach for this indicator must be reported to the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC). Drives automated DSMB notification workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on DMC; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this KRI/KPI definition is retired or superseded. Null for currently active indicators. Enables temporal versioning of the program monitoring framework.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this KRI/KPI definition becomes active and measurements begin. Supports versioning and historical comparison of indicator definitions over the program lifecycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: escalation_owner
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual or committee to whom a critical threshold breach is escalated (e.g., 'Program Steering Committee', 'DSMB', 'Sponsor Medical Monitor'). Distinct from the indicator owner who manages routine monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; DSMB Charter

attributes.name: governance_committee
attributes.description: The governance body (e.g., Program Review Board, Portfolio Governance Committee, DSMB/DMC, Joint Steering Committee) in whose meetings this indicator is reviewed. Links the KRI/KPI to the appropriate oversight forum.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on DMC; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: indicator_category
attributes.description: Business domain category grouping this indicator for portfolio governance reporting (e.g., safety, data_quality, enrollment, site_performance, regulatory, supply_chain, finance, operational). Enables domain-level roll-up in governance dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety|data_quality|enrollment|site_performance|regulatory|supply_chain|finance|operational|workforce|biostatistics — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: indicator_code
attributes.description: Unique business-facing alphanumeric code identifying this KRI/KPI definition within the program portfolio (e.g., PRG-KRI-001, PRG-KPI-042). Used as the externally-known identifier in governance reports and portfolio dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: indicator_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the KRI or KPI (e.g., 'Protocol Deviation Rate', 'Site Activation Cycle Time', 'SAE Reporting Compliance Rate'). Used as the display label in governance meetings and portfolio reviews.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: indicator_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this KRI/KPI definition. 'draft' = under development; 'active' = in use for governance monitoring; 'suspended' = temporarily paused; 'retired' = no longer monitored; 'under_review' = being reassessed for threshold or definition changes.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: indicator_subtype
attributes.description: Further classification within the indicator category (e.g., 'SAE Reporting' under safety, 'Protocol Deviation' under data_quality, 'Screen Failure Rate' under enrollment). Provides granular segmentation for drill-down analytics.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; CDISC CDASH

attributes.name: indicator_type
attributes.description: Classifies whether this indicator is a Key Risk Indicator (KRI) — measuring risk exposure — or a Key Performance Indicator (KPI) — measuring operational performance. Drives how thresholds are interpreted and escalated in governance.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this indicator is on the critical path for program delivery milestones. Critical path KRIs/KPIs receive priority escalation and are featured in executive portfolio dashboards.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Critical Path Initiative

attributes.name: is_regulatory_commitment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KRI/KPI is a formal regulatory commitment to a health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA) as part of a Risk Management Plan, IND, or study protocol. Regulatory commitment indicators require mandatory reporting and cannot be retired without authority approval.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 312; EMA EU CTR 536/2014; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: is_safety_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this indicator is classified as a safety-related KRI (e.g., SAE reporting timeliness, SUSAR submission compliance, AE data completeness). Safety indicators receive heightened governance scrutiny and may trigger DSMB notification.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); ICH E2A; FDA 21 CFR Part 312.32; EU CTR 536/2014

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this indicator definition was most recently reviewed by the governance committee or indicator owner, even if no changes were made. Supports periodic review compliance and governance cadence tracking.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; MasterControl

attributes.name: measurement_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether a higher value is favorable (e.g., consent rate), a lower value is favorable (e.g., protocol deviation rate), or the value should remain within a target range. Governs how threshold breaches are evaluated in governance logic.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: How often this indicator is measured and reported (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly). Determines the cadence of data collection and governance review cycles. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|bi_weekly|monthly|quarterly|per_visit|ad_hoc — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the indicator value (e.g., 'percentage', 'days', 'count', 'rate per 100 patient-years', 'USD'). Required for correct threshold interpretation and cross-program comparability.
attributes.references: CDISC CDASH; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: metric_definition
attributes.description: Precise business definition of what this indicator measures, including the numerator and denominator logic where applicable (e.g., 'Number of SAEs reported within 24 hours divided by total SAEs reported in the period, expressed as a percentage'). Ensures consistent interpretation across sites and studies.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC CDASH; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: reporting_period_type
attributes.description: Defines whether the indicator is measured over a rolling window (e.g., last 30 days), cumulatively from study start, at a specific point in time, or study-to-date. Critical for consistent interpretation of computed values.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: responsible_function
attributes.description: The organizational function or department accountable for monitoring and responding to this indicator (e.g., 'Clinical Operations', 'Biostatistics', 'Pharmacovigilance', 'Data Management', 'Regulatory Affairs'). Drives escalation routing in governance workflows.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); GCP

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which the indicator definition itself (thresholds, metric definition, ownership) is formally reviewed and potentially updated by the governance committee. Distinct from measurement_frequency which governs data collection cadence.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; MasterControl

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this KRI/KPI definition record was originated or is mastered (e.g., Oracle Siebel CTMS, MasterControl, internal governance tool). Supports data lineage and system-of-record traceability.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this KRI/KPI record in the originating source system (e.g., CTMS indicator ID, MasterControl document number). Enables bidirectional reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: target_threshold
attributes.description: The desired or optimal value for this indicator representing expected performance under normal operating conditions. Serves as the baseline against which warning and critical thresholds are calibrated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: threshold_operator
attributes.description: Logical operator defining how the measured value is compared to the warning and critical thresholds (e.g., 'gt' = greater than triggers alert, 'lt' = less than triggers alert, 'between' = value must remain within a range). Required for automated threshold evaluation logic.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this KRI/KPI definition record was most recently modified. Required for change tracking and audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this KRI/KPI definition (e.g., '1.0', '2.1'). Incremented when metric definition, thresholds, or ownership changes are approved. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+; MasterControl Document Control

attributes.name: warning_threshold
attributes.description: The threshold value at which the indicator triggers a yellow/amber alert, indicating early risk signal requiring heightened monitoring or investigation. Distinct from the critical threshold which triggers escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Addendum; TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: parent_kri_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on kri (parent_kri_id)

products.name: kri_reading
products.description: Transactional record capturing periodic observed readings of program-level KRIs and KPIs against their defined thresholds. Captures the KRI reference, reading date, observed value, threshold status (green/amber/red), trend direction, data source snapshot reference, and any commentary on the reading. Stores the raw operational measurement events — not aggregated analytics — enabling governance committees to review program health at each review cycle.
products.reference: Program KRI Observation

attributes.name: kri_reading_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Program Key Risk Indicator (KRI) Reading ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each periodic KRI/KPI reading record captured at the program level. Serves as the primary key for this transactional observation event.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) GCP; 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: clinical_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the clinical development program for which this KRI reading was captured. Links the observation to the governing program entity.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA IND regulations 21 CFR Part 312

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user (program lead, medical monitor, or governance committee chair) who formally confirmed and accepted this KRI reading. Required for electronic signature compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 when reading_status transitions to 'confirmed'.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: governance_meeting_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governance committee meeting (e.g., DSMB, PMC, Portfolio Review) during which this KRI reading was formally reviewed. Nullable when readings are generated outside a formal meeting cycle.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Guidance on Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: kri_id
attributes.description: Reference to the KRI/KPI definition record that specifies the metric name, threshold configuration, and measurement methodology for this reading. Ensures each reading is traceable to its governing definition.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: superseded_by_reading_kri_reading_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corrected KRI reading record that supersedes this one when reading_status is 'superseded'. Enables full audit chain reconstruction for regulatory inspection, ensuring the history of corrections is traceable per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KRI reading requires a documented corrective or mitigation action. True = a CAPA or risk mitigation action must be initiated; False = no action required beyond continued monitoring.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; MasterControl CAPA

attributes.name: amber_threshold_lower
attributes.description: The lower boundary of the caution (amber) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Values within the amber band trigger heightened monitoring and management attention without requiring immediate escalation.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: amber_threshold_upper
attributes.description: The upper boundary of the caution (amber) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Denormalized from the KRI definition to preserve the threshold configuration in effect at reading time.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: capa_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the CAPA record initiated in response to this KRI threshold breach. Links the reading to the formal quality management response tracked in MasterControl. Null when no CAPA has been initiated.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 820; MasterControl CAPA; ISO 9001

attributes.name: computation_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the observed value was computed automatically by an analytics pipeline, entered manually by a data manager or CRA, or produced through a semi-automated process requiring human validation. Relevant for data quality assessment and audit purposes under 21 CFR Part 11.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: confirmed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this KRI reading was formally confirmed by the governance reviewer. Represents a distinct lifecycle event timestamp required for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: consecutive_breach_count
attributes.description: Number of consecutive review cycles (including the current one) during which this KRI has been in amber or red status. Used by governance committees to assess persistence of risk signals and trigger escalation protocols when a defined breach duration threshold is exceeded.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this KRI reading record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a data quality concern was identified with the underlying source data used to compute this reading (e.g., incomplete EDC data, site data not yet reconciled, known system outage). True = data quality caveat applies; False = data considered complete and reliable.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: data_quality_note
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific data quality issue identified when data_quality_flag is True. Documents the nature of the concern (e.g., 'Site 007 data not yet entered in EDC', 'CTMS extract delayed by 3 days') to support audit review and reading interpretation.
attributes.references: ALCOA+; ICH E6(R2); 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: data_snapshot_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or version label of the source data snapshot used to compute this KRI reading (e.g., EDC data extract version, CTMS report run ID, database lock reference). Ensures full traceability of the observed value back to the underlying data state, supporting ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: ALCOA+ (Attributable Legible Contemporaneous Original Accurate); 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: denominator_value
attributes.description: The denominator used in computing a rate or percentage KRI (e.g., total enrolled subjects for a protocol deviation rate, total expected visits for a visit completion rate). Stored alongside the observed value to enable independent verification of the computed metric and support audit traceability.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this KRI reading has triggered a formal escalation to senior management, the sponsor, or a regulatory body based on threshold breach severity or consecutive breach count. True = escalation initiated; False = no escalation required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The organizational level to which this KRI reading has been escalated when escalation_flag is True. Determines the appropriate response protocol and notification recipients. Null when no escalation is required.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: green_threshold_lower
attributes.description: The lower boundary of the acceptable (green) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Denormalized from the KRI definition to preserve the threshold configuration that was in effect at the time of this specific reading, supporting historical audit and trend analysis.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: green_threshold_upper
attributes.description: The upper boundary of the acceptable (green) performance range for this KRI at the time of reading. Denormalized from the KRI definition to preserve the threshold configuration in effect at reading time.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: kri_category
attributes.description: High-level domain category classifying the KRI for portfolio-level aggregation and governance reporting. Enables committee members to filter and group indicators by risk domain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety|data_quality|enrollment|site_performance|regulatory|supply_chain|finance|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: numerator_value
attributes.description: The numerator used in computing a rate or percentage KRI (e.g., number of protocol deviations, number of completed visits). Stored alongside the denominator to enable independent verification of the observed_value and full audit traceability per ALCOA+ principles.
attributes.references: CDISC ADaM; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: observed_value
attributes.description: The raw numeric value of the KRI/KPI as measured at the reading date. This is the principal quantitative fact of the observation event (e.g., 0.85 for 85% enrollment rate, 3.2 for 3.2 days average SAE reporting lag). Stored at full precision to support downstream statistical analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC ADaM; TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: prior_reading_value
attributes.description: The observed value from the immediately preceding review cycle for this KRI. Stored on the current reading record to enable direct trend comparison without requiring a self-join, supporting governance committee dashboards and period-over-period analysis.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: reading_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this KRI observation was captured or the data snapshot was taken. Represents the principal business event date for this measurement, distinct from the record creation timestamp. Aligns with the review cycle cadence (weekly, monthly, quarterly).
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: reading_reference_code
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for this KRI reading event, typically formatted as KRI-RDG-{PROGRAM_CODE}-{YYYYMMDD}. Used in governance reports, dashboards, and audit trails to uniquely reference a specific reading without exposing the surrogate key.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: reading_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this KRI reading record. 'draft' = computed but not yet reviewed; 'under_review' = submitted for governance committee review; 'confirmed' = formally accepted by the governance body; 'superseded' = replaced by a corrected reading; 'voided' = invalidated due to data quality issues.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: review_cycle_period
attributes.description: The governance review period this reading belongs to, expressed as a standardized period label (e.g., '2024-Q1', '2024-W23', '2024-03'). Enables time-series alignment across multiple KRIs within the same review cycle for governance committee reporting.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); TransCelerate RBM Framework

attributes.name: review_cycle_type
attributes.description: Frequency classification of the review cycle during which this reading was generated. Determines the expected cadence for trend analysis and threshold breach escalation.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance

attributes.name: reviewer_commentary
attributes.description: Free-text narrative commentary provided by the governance committee reviewer or program lead explaining the context of the observed value, root cause of any threshold breach, mitigating factors, or planned actions. Captured at the time of formal review.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023; ALCOA+

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the underlying data for this KRI reading was extracted (e.g., Medidata Rave for EDC-based metrics, Oracle Siebel CTMS for site performance metrics, Oracle Argus Safety for safety metrics). Supports data lineage and audit traceability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Medidata Rave|Oracle Siebel CTMS|Oracle Argus Safety|SAS Drug Development|Oracle Clinical One|SAP S/4HANA|Veeva Vault|manual — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ALCOA+; 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The planned or aspirational target value for this KRI in the current review cycle, as defined in the program plan or Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP). Distinct from threshold boundaries — represents the desired performance level, enabling variance-from-target analysis.
attributes.references: ICH E6(R2); CDISC ADaM; SAP conventions

attributes.name: threshold_status
attributes.description: Red-Amber-Green (RAG) status classification of the observed value against the defined thresholds at the time of reading. 'green' = within acceptable range; 'amber' = caution zone requiring heightened monitoring; 'red' = threshold breached requiring escalation and action; 'not_applicable' = KRI not relevant for this cycle; 'data_unavailable' = source data not available for computation.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring; FDA Risk-Based Monitoring Guidance 2023

attributes.name: trend_direction
attributes.description: Directional trend classification comparing the current observed value to the prior period reading. 'improving' = moving toward green; 'worsening' = moving toward or deeper into red; 'stable' = no material change; 'insufficient_data' = fewer than two data points available; 'new_metric' = first reading for this KRI.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2) Risk-Based Monitoring

attributes.name: trend_magnitude
attributes.description: The absolute numeric change between the current observed_value and the prior_reading_value, expressed in the same unit_of_measure. Positive values indicate increase; negative values indicate decrease. Enables quantitative trend severity assessment beyond directional classification.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; CDISC ADaM

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the observed_value is expressed (e.g., 'percentage', 'days', 'count', 'rate_per_site', 'ratio'). Essential for correct interpretation of the numeric reading across heterogeneous KRI types.
attributes.references: CDISC SDTM; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this KRI reading record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles. Updated on any field change including status transitions and commentary additions.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 11; ICH E6(R2); ALCOA+

attributes.name: variance_from_target
attributes.description: The arithmetic difference between the observed_value and the target_value (observed minus target). Negative values indicate underperformance; positive values indicate overperformance relative to target. Stored as a raw operational field to support governance reporting without requiring recalculation.
attributes.references: TransCelerate RBM Framework; ICH E6(R2)

attributes.name: previous_kri_reading_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on kri_reading (previous_kri_reading_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`agreement_billing_milestone`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Billing milestone metrics tracking revenue recognition triggers, payment collection, and milestone completion rates for clinical trial contracts."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`agreement`.`agreement_billing_milestone`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "billing_status"
      expr: billing_status
      comment: "Current billing status of the milestone (e.g., Pending, Invoiced, Paid, Disputed)"
    - name: "approval_status"
      expr: approval_status
      comment: "Approval status of the milestone achievement"
    - name: "milestone_type"
      expr: milestone_type
      comment: "Category of milestone (e.g., Enrollment, Database Lock, CSR Delivery)"
    - name: "functional_area"
      expr: functional_area
      comment: "Functional department responsible for the milestone (e.g., Clinical Operations, Data Management, Biostatistics)"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Billing currency for the milestone"
    - name: "revenue_recognition_method"
      expr: revenue_recognition_method
      comment: "Method used for revenue recognition (e.g., Percentage of Completion, Milestone Method)"
    - name: "is_pass_through"
      expr: is_pass_through
      comment: "Whether the milestone represents a pass-through cost vs. service fee"
    - name: "planned_trigger_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', planned_trigger_date)
      comment: "Planned month for milestone trigger for forecasting"
  measures:
    - name: "total_milestone_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(milestone_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total value of billing milestones representing contracted revenue pipeline"
    - name: "total_adjusted_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(adjusted_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total adjusted milestone amounts after change orders or negotiations"
    - name: "avg_milestone_amount"
      expr: AVG(CAST(milestone_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average milestone value for pricing and forecasting analysis"
    - name: "avg_percent_complete"
      expr: AVG(CAST(percent_complete AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average completion percentage across milestones indicating overall contract execution progress"
    - name: "invoiced_milestone_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN billing_status = 'Invoiced' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of milestones that have been invoiced but not yet paid"
    - name: "paid_milestone_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN billing_status = 'Paid' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of milestones where payment has been received"
    - name: "disputed_milestone_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN billing_status = 'Disputed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of milestones in dispute - indicates sponsor relationship friction and revenue risk"
    - name: "overdue_milestone_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_trigger_date IS NULL AND planned_trigger_date < CURRENT_DATE() THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of milestones past their planned trigger date without achievement - indicates delivery risk"
$$
metric_views.description: Billing milestone metrics tracking revenue recognition triggers, payment collection, and milestone completion rates for clinical trial contracts.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`agreement_change_order`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Metrics tracking change orders to study contracts - critical for understanding scope creep, budget variance, and contract amendment velocity in clinical trials."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`agreement`.`change_order`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "co_status"
      expr: co_status
      comment: "Current status of the change order (e.g., Draft, Pending Approval, Approved, Rejected)"
    - name: "change_type"
      expr: change_type
      comment: "Category of change (e.g., Scope Expansion, Timeline Extension, Budget Increase)"
    - name: "change_reason"
      expr: change_reason
      comment: "Root cause driving the change order (e.g., Protocol Amendment, Enrollment Challenges, Regulatory Requirement)"
    - name: "priority"
      expr: priority
      comment: "Urgency level of the change order"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency of the financial impact for the change order"
    - name: "regulatory_driven_flag"
      expr: regulatory_driven_flag
      comment: "Whether the change order was triggered by a regulatory requirement"
    - name: "initiation_year_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', initiation_date)
      comment: "Month of change order initiation for trend analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_delta_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(delta_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Net financial impact of all change orders - positive indicates budget increases, negative indicates reductions"
    - name: "total_service_fee_delta"
      expr: SUM(CAST(service_fee_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total change in service fees from change orders - directly impacts CRO revenue"
    - name: "total_pass_through_delta"
      expr: SUM(CAST(pass_through_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total change in pass-through costs from change orders"
    - name: "avg_delta_value"
      expr: AVG(CAST(delta_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average financial impact per change order indicating typical scope change magnitude"
    - name: "approved_change_order_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN co_status = 'Approved' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of approved change orders representing confirmed scope/budget changes"
    - name: "pending_change_order_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN co_status IN ('Pending Approval', 'Under Review') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of change orders awaiting approval - indicates decision backlog"
    - name: "regulatory_driven_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_driven_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of change orders driven by regulatory requirements - non-discretionary changes"
    - name: "change_order_count"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of change orders for volume and velocity tracking"
$$
metric_views.description: Metrics tracking change orders to study contracts - critical for understanding scope creep, budget variance, and contract amendment velocity in clinical trials.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`agreement_service_level_agreement`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "SLA metrics tracking performance thresholds, penalty exposure, and compliance commitments across clinical trial service agreements."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`agreement`.`service_level_agreement`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "sla_status"
      expr: sla_status
      comment: "Current status of the SLA (e.g., Active, Expired, Superseded)"
    - name: "sla_type"
      expr: sla_type
      comment: "Type of SLA (e.g., Turnaround Time, Quality, Enrollment Rate)"
    - name: "service_category"
      expr: service_category
      comment: "Service category the SLA applies to (e.g., Data Management, Monitoring, Safety)"
    - name: "measurement_frequency"
      expr: measurement_frequency
      comment: "How often the SLA is measured (e.g., Monthly, Quarterly, Per Deliverable)"
    - name: "penalty_applicable"
      expr: penalty_applicable
      comment: "Whether financial penalties apply for SLA breach"
    - name: "credit_applicable"
      expr: credit_applicable
      comment: "Whether service credits apply for SLA breach"
    - name: "regulatory_commitment_flag"
      expr: regulatory_commitment_flag
      comment: "Whether the SLA is tied to a regulatory commitment - higher risk if breached"
  measures:
    - name: "total_penalty_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(penalty_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total potential penalty value across SLAs representing maximum financial exposure for non-performance"
    - name: "total_penalty_cap_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(penalty_cap_value AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total penalty cap across SLAs - maximum aggregate penalty exposure"
    - name: "total_credit_value"
      expr: SUM(CAST(credit_value AS DOUBLE))

      comment: "Department of the trainee"
    - name: "staff_role"
      expr: staff_role
      comment: "Role of the staff member being trained"
    - name: "assessment_passed"
      expr: assessment_passed
      comment: "Whether the training assessment was passed"
    - name: "is_current_version_training"
      expr: is_current_version_training
      comment: "Whether training is on the current SOP version"
    - name: "completion_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', completion_date)
      comment: "Month training was completed"
  measures:
    - name: "total_training_records"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of SOP training records"
    - name: "completed_trainings"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN training_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of completed training records"
    - name: "overdue_trainings"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND training_status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Waived') THEN 1 END)

    - name: "training_completion_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN training_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of training assignments completed — key compliance KPI"
    - name: "assessment_pass_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN assessment_passed = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN assessment_passed IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of training assessments passed — measures training effectiveness"
    - name: "avg_assessment_score"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST(assessment_score AS DOUBLE)), 2)
      comment: "Average assessment score across training records"
    - name: "current_version_training_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_current_version_training = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of training on current SOP versions — measures version currency compliance"
$$
metric_views.description: SOP training compliance metrics tracking completion rates, assessment pass rates, and overdue training for inspection readiness.

    - name: "regulatory_reportable_count"

      expr: isr_flag

    - name: "isr_result"

      comment: "Average completion percentage across timeline events"
    - name: "critical_path_events"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN critical_path_flag = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of events on the critical path"
    - name: "delayed_events"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN event_status = 'Delayed' OR (actual_date IS NOT NULL AND planned_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_date > planned_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of events that are delayed beyond planned date"
    - name: "critical_path_delay_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN critical_path_flag = true AND actual_date IS NOT NULL AND planned_date IS NOT NULL AND actual_date > planned_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN critical_path_flag = true AND actual_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of completed critical path events that were delayed, indicating schedule risk"
$$
metric_views.description: Timeline event execution metrics tracking schedule adherence, critical path performance, and delay patterns to support proactive timeline management.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`randomization_irt_transaction`

    - name: "sdv_rate_pct"

    - name: "distinct_subjects_transacted"

    - name: "distinct_sites_active"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT study_site_id)

metric_views.description: IRT system transaction metrics tracking interactive response technology operations, transaction success rates, and system reliability for randomization and dispensing workflows.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`randomization_rand_deviation`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Randomization deviation metrics tracking protocol violations in the randomization process, severity distribution, resolution rates, and regulatory reporting requirements."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`randomization`.`rand_deviation`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "study_id"
      expr: study_id
      comment: "Study identifier for deviation analysis by clinical trial"

      expr: investigational_site_id
      comment: "Site identifier for identifying sites with high deviation rates"
    - name: "deviation_type"
      expr: deviation_type
      comment: "Classification of the deviation (e.g., wrong treatment dispensed, stratification error)"
    - name: "deviation_status"
      expr: deviation_status
      comment: "Current status of the deviation (e.g., open, resolved, closed)"
    - name: "severity"
      expr: severity
      comment: "Severity level of the deviation (e.g., critical, major, minor)"
    - name: "root_cause_category"
      expr: root_cause_category
      comment: "Root cause classification for systemic issue identification"
    - name: "blinding_impact"
      expr: blinding_impact
      comment: "Impact on blinding integrity (e.g., none, partial, full unblinding)"
    - name: "population_impact"
      expr: population_impact
      comment: "Impact on analysis population (e.g., ITT, per-protocol exclusion)"
    - name: "discovery_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', discovery_date)
      comment: "Month of deviation discovery for trend analysis"
    - name: "regulatory_reportable"
      expr: regulatory_reportable
      comment: "Whether the deviation requires regulatory authority notification"
    - name: "irb_iec_reportable"
      expr: irb_iec_reportable
      comment: "Whether the deviation requires IRB/IEC notification"
  measures:
    - name: "total_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of randomization deviations — primary quality metric for randomization process"
    - name: "critical_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'critical' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of critical severity deviations requiring immediate intervention"
    - name: "major_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'major' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of major severity deviations with significant protocol impact"
    - name: "open_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN deviation_status = 'open' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of unresolved deviations requiring corrective action"
    - name: "resolved_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN deviation_status = 'resolved' OR deviation_status = 'closed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations that have been resolved or closed"
    - name: "resolution_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN deviation_status = 'resolved' OR deviation_status = 'closed' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations resolved — operational efficiency and compliance indicator"
    - name: "blinding_compromised_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN blinding_impact != 'none' AND blinding_impact IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations that compromised blinding integrity — critical trial validity metric"
    - name: "regulatory_reportable_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_reportable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations requiring regulatory authority reporting — compliance risk indicator"
    - name: "subject_safety_impacted_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN subject_safety_impact IS NOT NULL AND subject_safety_impact != 'none' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations with potential subject safety impact — patient safety metric"
    - name: "distinct_sites_with_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT investigational_site_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct sites with randomization deviations — identifies systemic vs isolated issues"
    - name: "sponsor_notified_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN sponsor_notified = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of deviations where sponsor has been notified — communication compliance metric"
$$
metric_views.description: Randomization deviation metrics tracking protocol violations in the randomization process, severity distribution, resolution rates, and regulatory reporting requirements.

      comment: "Count of emergency unblinding requests — critical safety event indicator"

    - name: "approved_submissions"

    - name: "distinct_products_submitted"

    - name: "distinct_agencies_targeted"

    - name: "avg_days_to_agency_action"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(agency_action_date, submission_date))
      comment: "Average number of days from submission to agency action date"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`safety_adverse_event`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core adverse event metrics for clinical trial safety monitoring, tracking AE volumes, seriousness rates, and treatment-emergent patterns."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`safety`.`adverse_event`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "severity"
      expr: severity
      comment: "Severity classification of the adverse event (mild, moderate, severe)"
    - name: "is_serious"
      expr: is_serious
      comment: "Whether the adverse event meets ICH seriousness criteria"
    - name: "is_susar"
      expr: is_susar
      comment: "Whether the event is a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction"
    - name: "is_teae"
      expr: is_teae
      comment: "Whether the event is a Treatment-Emergent Adverse Event"
    - name: "is_expected"
      expr: is_expected
      comment: "Whether the event is listed/expected per reference safety information"
    - name: "causality_assessment"
      expr: causality_assessment
      comment: "Investigator causality assessment (related, not related, possibly related)"
    - name: "ae_status"
      expr: ae_status
      comment: "Current status of the adverse event record"
    - name: "outcome"
      expr: outcome
      comment: "Clinical outcome of the adverse event (resolved, ongoing, fatal, etc.)"
    - name: "ctcae_grade"
      expr: ctcae_grade
      comment: "CTCAE toxicity grade (1-5)"
    - name: "meddra_soc_name"
      expr: meddra_soc_name
      comment: "MedDRA System Organ Class for event classification"
    - name: "meddra_pt_name"
      expr: meddra_pt_name
      comment: "MedDRA Preferred Term for the adverse event"
    - name: "action_taken"
      expr: action_taken
      comment: "Action taken with study drug in response to the AE"
    - name: "seriousness_criteria"
      expr: seriousness_criteria
      comment: "Specific seriousness criteria met (death, hospitalization, etc.)"
    - name: "report_type"
      expr: report_type
      comment: "Type of safety report (initial, follow-up)"
    - name: "onset_year_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', onset_date)
      comment: "Month of AE onset for temporal trend analysis"
    - name: "awareness_year_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', awareness_date)
      comment: "Month sponsor became aware of the AE"
  measures:
    - name: "total_adverse_events"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of adverse event records"
    - name: "serious_adverse_event_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_serious = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of serious adverse events (SAEs) requiring expedited reporting"
    - name: "susar_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions requiring urgent regulatory notification"
    - name: "teae_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_teae = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of Treatment-Emergent Adverse Events attributable to study drug exposure"
    - name: "sae_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_serious = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of all AEs that are serious — key safety signal indicator"
    - name: "susar_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_susar = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of AEs classified as SUSARs — triggers regulatory escalation review"
    - name: "teae_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN is_teae = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of AEs that are treatment-emergent — core efficacy-safety balance metric"
    - name: "drug_related_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN causality_assessment IN ('Related', 'Possibly Related', 'Probably Related') THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of AEs assessed as drug-related — informs benefit-risk assessment"
    - name: "fatal_outcome_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN outcome = 'Fatal' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of adverse events with fatal outcome — highest severity safety signal"
    - name: "unresolved_ae_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('Not Recovered', 'Ongoing', 'Unknown') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of AEs without resolution — indicates ongoing patient safety concerns"
    - name: "high_grade_ae_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN ctcae_grade IN ('4', '5') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of Grade 4-5 (life-threatening/fatal) AEs per CTCAE grading"
    - name: "dsmb_reported_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN dsmb_reported = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of AEs reported to Data Safety Monitoring Board — indicates escalation volume"
    - name: "distinct_subjects_with_ae"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Number of unique subjects experiencing adverse events — incidence denominator"
    - name: "distinct_meddra_pt_terms"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT meddra_pt_name)
      comment: "Number of distinct MedDRA preferred terms reported — breadth of safety profile"
$$
metric_views.description: Core adverse event metrics for clinical trial safety monitoring, tracking AE volumes, seriousness rates, and treatment-emergent patterns.

      expr: blind_broken
      comment: "Whether the blind was broken for this case"
    - name: "seriousness_criteria"
      expr: seriousness_criteria
      comment: "Specific seriousness criteria met"
    - name: "expectedness_assessment"
      expr: expectedness_assessment

    - name: "meddra_pt_code"
      expr: meddra_pt_code
      comment: "MedDRA Preferred Term code"
    - name: "dsmb_notified"
      expr: dsmb_notified
      comment: "Whether DSMB was notified of this SUSAR"
    - name: "irb_iec_notified"
      expr: irb_iec_notified
      comment: "Whether IRB/IEC was notified"
    - name: "awareness_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', awareness_date)
      comment: "Month of SUSAR awareness for trend analysis"
    - name: "onset_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', onset_date)
      comment: "Month of SUSAR onset"
  measures:
    - name: "total_susars"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total SUSAR count — primary regulatory safety volume metric"
    - name: "fatal_susar_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN outcome = 'Fatal' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Fatal SUSARs requiring 7-day expedited reporting"

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN blind_broken = TRUE THEN 1 END)

    - name: "dsmb_notification_rate_pct"

    - name: "distinct_subjects_with_susar"

    - name: "distinct_studies_with_susar"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT study_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`study_milestone`

LANGUAGE YAML

  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`study`.`study_milestone`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "milestone_status"
      expr: milestone_status
      comment: "Current status of the milestone (e.g., Planned, Achieved, Missed)"

      expr: milestone_category
      comment: "Category of milestone (e.g., Regulatory, Enrollment, Data)"

      expr: milestone_type
      comment: "Type classification of the milestone"

      expr: CAST(is_critical_path AS STRING)
      comment: "Whether the milestone is on the critical path"
    - name: "is_regulatory_milestone"
      expr: CAST(is_regulatory_milestone AS STRING)
      comment: "Whether this is a regulatory milestone"
    - name: "is_contractual"
      expr: CAST(is_contractual AS STRING)
      comment: "Whether the milestone is tied to a contractual obligation"

      expr: study_phase
      comment: "Study phase associated with this milestone"
    - name: "responsible_party"
      expr: responsible_party
      comment: "Party responsible for achieving the milestone"

      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', planned_date)
      comment: "Month of the planned milestone date for trend analysis"
  measures:
    - name: "total_milestones"

    - name: "ae_discontinuation_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN ae_related_discontinuation = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of dispositions due to adverse events — informs benefit-risk assessment."
    - name: "itt_population_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN analysis_population_itt = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects assigned to Intent-to-Treat population."
    - name: "safety_population_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN analysis_population_safety = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in the safety analysis population."
    - name: "deaths_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN death_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subject deaths — critical safety metric requiring immediate DSMB review."
    - name: "distinct_subjects"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Number of unique subjects with disposition records."
$$
metric_views.description: Subject disposition metrics tracking study completion, discontinuation reasons, and CONSORT flow for regulatory submissions.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`subject_enrollment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core enrollment metrics tracking subject recruitment, randomization, and study completion rates across clinical trials."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`subject`.`enrollment`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "enrollment_status"
      expr: enrollment_status
      comment: "Current enrollment status of the subject (e.g., Enrolled, Screened, Randomized, Completed, Withdrawn)."
    - name: "enrollment_type"
      expr: enrollment_type
      comment: "Type of enrollment (e.g., standard, re-screening, rollover)."
    - name: "blinding_status"
      expr: blinding_status
      comment: "Blinding status of the subject (e.g., blinded, unblinded)."
    - name: "cohort_code"
      expr: cohort_code
      comment: "Cohort or group assignment code for stratified analysis."
    - name: "enrollment_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', enrollment_date)
      comment: "Month of enrollment for time-series recruitment tracking."
    - name: "screening_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', screening_date)
      comment: "Month of screening for recruitment funnel analysis."
    - name: "screen_failure_reason"
      expr: screen_failure_reason
      comment: "Reason for screen failure, used to identify eligibility barriers."
    - name: "withdrawal_reason"
      expr: withdrawal_reason
      comment: "Reason for subject withdrawal from the study."
    - name: "source_system"
      expr: source_system
      comment: "Source system of record for the enrollment data."
    - name: "stratification_factor_1"
      expr: stratification_factor_1
      comment: "Primary stratification factor used in randomization."
    - name: "stratification_factor_2"
      expr: stratification_factor_2
      comment: "Secondary stratification factor used in randomization."
  measures:
    - name: "total_enrollments"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of enrollment records, representing subjects who entered the enrollment process."
    - name: "randomized_subjects"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN randomization_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects successfully randomized into the study."
    - name: "screen_failures"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN screen_failure_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects who failed screening, indicating recruitment quality issues."
    - name: "screen_failure_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN screen_failure_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of screened subjects who failed screening — key indicator of protocol feasibility and site quality."
    - name: "withdrawn_subjects"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN withdrawal_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects who withdrew from the study."
    - name: "withdrawal_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN withdrawal_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of enrolled subjects who withdrew — critical retention metric for study viability."
    - name: "completed_subjects"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN completion_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects who completed the study per protocol."
    - name: "completion_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN completion_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of enrolled subjects who completed the study — primary measure of study execution success."
    - name: "itt_population_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN itt_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in the Intent-to-Treat population for primary efficacy analysis."
    - name: "safety_population_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN safety_population_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in the safety analysis population."
    - name: "per_protocol_population_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN pp_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects in the Per-Protocol population for sensitivity analysis."
    - name: "avg_visit_compliance_pct"
      expr: ROUND(AVG(CAST(visit_compliance_pct AS DOUBLE)), 2)
      comment: "Average visit compliance percentage across enrolled subjects — measures protocol adherence."
    - name: "randomization_conversion_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN randomization_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN screening_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of screened subjects who were successfully randomized — key recruitment funnel metric."
    - name: "eligibility_confirmed_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN eligibility_confirmed = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of subjects with confirmed eligibility for study participation."
$$
metric_views.description: Core enrollment metrics tracking subject recruitment, randomization, and study completion rates across clinical trials.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`subject_stipend_payment`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `clinical_trials_ecm`.`_metrics`.`subject_deviation`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Protocol deviation metrics measuring compliance, data integrity impact, and regulatory reporting requirements across the study."
  source: "`clinical_trials_ecm`.`subject`.`subject_deviation`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "deviation_category"
      expr: deviation_category
      comment: "Category of protocol deviation (e.g., Eligibility, Informed Consent, Procedure, Visit Window)."
    - name: "deviation_status"
      expr: deviation_status
      comment: "Current status of the deviation (e.g., Open, Closed, Under Review)."
    - name: "type_code"
      expr: type_code
      comment: "Standardized type code for the deviation."
    - name: "data_integrity_impact"
      expr: data_integrity_impact
      comment: "Assessment of impact on data integrity (e.g., None, Minor, Major)."
    - name: "subject_safety_impact"
      expr: subject_safety_impact
      comment: "Assessment of impact on subject safety."
    - name: "root_cause_category"
      expr: root_cause_category
      comment: "Root cause category for systemic issue identification."
    - name: "subject_continuation_decision"
      expr: subject_continuation_decision
      comment: "Decision on whether subject continues in study after deviation."
    - name: "occurrence_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('month', occurrence_date)
      comment: "Month of deviation occurrence for trend analysis."
  measures:
    - name: "total_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of protocol deviations recorded."
    - name: "open_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN deviation_status = 'Open' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deviations still open and requiring resolution."
    - name: "regulatory_reportable_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN regulatory_reportable_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deviations requiring regulatory authority notification — compliance risk indicator."
    - name: "irb_reportable_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN irb_iec_reportable_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deviations requiring IRB/IEC reporting."
    - name: "major_data_integrity_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN data_integrity_impact = 'Major' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deviations with major data integrity impact — may affect primary endpoint analysis."
    - name: "safety_impacting_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN subject_safety_impact IS NOT NULL AND subject_safety_impact != 'None' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of deviations with potential subject safety impact — requires immediate attention."
    - name: "distinct_subjects_with_deviations"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT trial_subject_id)
      comment: "Number of unique subjects with at least one protocol deviation."
    - name: "sponsor_notification_rate_pct"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN sponsor_notified_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of deviations where sponsor was notified — measures communication compliance."
$$
metric_views.description: Protocol deviation metrics measuring compliance, data integrity impact, and regulatory reporting requirements across the study.
